MPs asked whether statements by an extremist imam, Al Haddad, that the minister called reprehensible, possibly including calls to violence, justified refusing his entry into the Netherlands, and how entry decisions are made. The minister answered that the statements may not be criminal in isolation, that without concrete indications of serious threat entry could not lawfully be refused, and that entry decisions for EU and non-EU nationals follow Schengen rules and case-by-case checks.
The law does not give me the room to refuse someone entry to the Netherlands solely on the basis of his statements, without concrete indications of imminent serious criminal offences.

The government declined to participate, arguing that food support is a matter for member states rather than the EU, and refused to convene talks with the foundation.

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers of Social Affairs about a non-compete clause in a staffing agency's contracts, including whether UWV refers jobseekers to such employers and whether refusing such a contract affects unemployment benefit. The minister answered that such clauses are legally permitted and courts can moderate them, that refusing a job with a non-compete is generally not a valid ground to deny benefits except in unusual cases, and that UWV cannot force a jobseeker to sign a contract breaching an earlier non-compete.
The mere fact that an employer has included a non-compete clause in the employment contract is not a reason to regard a job offer as unsuitable.
Het enkele feit dat een werkgever in het arbeidscontract een concurrentiebeding heeft opgenomen, is geen reden om een arbeidsaanbod als niet passend te beschouwen.

DPS wordt door de initiatiefnemende gemeenten en RCF ter beschikking gesteld aan alle gemeenten in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutlüer over de structurele overlast van groepen jongeren in Heemskerk en Beverwijk

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about structural youth nuisance in Heemskerk and Beverwijk, including whether a wider socio-economic approach and national programme support should be extended to these IJmond municipalities. The minister answered that police registrations of youth nuisance have fallen significantly in both municipalities, that local triangles are responsible, and pointed to existing national programmes without committing to additional funding or designation.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Mutluer over huisverboden voor plegers van huiselijk geweld

An MP asked the Justice Minister about temporary home bans for perpetrators of domestic violence, including whether perpetrators rather than victims should leave the home, longer cooling-off periods, mandatory help, and why bans cannot be imposed earlier after Veilig Thuis reports. The state secretary answered that perpetrators should leave in principle but case-by-case assessment is needed, and announced a review with municipalities and four pilots starting January 2026 to use home bans earlier.
I am currently examining, together with municipalities (mayors and aldermen, including the G4) and involved implementing organisations, how the use of the temporary home ban can be improved.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de effectiviteit en handhaafbaarheid van contact- en locatieverboden, met name in digitale context

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the effectiveness and enforceability of contact and location bans in digital contexts, including whether police can identify anonymous accounts used to evade bans. The government confirmed digital harassment reports, said it lacks data on digital violations, outlined existing powers to request account data, and committed to exploring whether further policy or legislative measures are needed.

Therefore the Minister of Justice and Security will explore in the coming period, in consultation with the organisations involved, whether the powers described are sufficient or whether additional policy or legislative measures are needed.

Daarom zal de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid de komende periode in afstemming met de betrokken organisaties verkennen of de hiervoor beschreven bevoegdheden daarvoor volstaan of dat aanvullende beleidsmatige of wetgevende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over onveilige plekken voor vrouwen

Mutluer asks why reports and complaints by women about unsafe places often go unaddressed by police and municipalities, what will be done, and whether capacity and funding are sufficient. Minister Van Oosten answers that municipalities and police take these seriously, that the VNG will examine bottlenecks, that police capacity in sex-crime teams is 46 fte short, and that CPTED support and programmes like Veilige Steden exist, with reporting promised through existing channels.
I will keep your House informed of progress on the various tracks through several channels.
Ik zal uw Kamer via verschillende wegen op de hoogte houden van de voortgang van de verschillende trajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf, Mutluer en Bruyning over de beschikbaarheid van acute hulp voor vrouwen naar aanleiding van de femicide-campagne 'Waar Ben Je'?

MPs asked whether the 24/7 Veilig Thuis chat for femicide signals is available everywhere, how the campaign's effect is monitored, and whether the statutory task should be extended to 24-hour availability. The state secretary answered that Veilig Thuis already has a legal duty to be reachable in acute situations, no national monitoring of the campaign effect exists, a 24/7 chat is being developed, and no change to the statutory task is planned.
Veilig Thuis does have the statutory duty to be reachable and available at all times in situations where immediate performance of its legal tasks is required.
Wel heeft Veilig Thuis de wettelijke taak om te allen tijde bereikbaar en beschikbaar te zijn in situaties waarin onmiddellijk uitvoering van de wettelijke taken geboden is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de bescherming van slachtoffers van huiselijk geweld en stalking

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the availability of technical protection tools (slachtofferdevice, AWARE alarm) for victims of domestic violence and stalking, and about a motion calling for nationwide rollout. The government answered that the device is piloted in four regions, rollout to more regions is planned from January 2026, and funding for victim support lies with municipalities, with cost discussions ongoing.
Municipalities have statutory policy discretion within the social domain to decide for themselves whether and how to use their powers.
Gemeenten hebben binnen het sociaal domein wettelijk beleidsruimte om zelf te bepalen of en hoe zij hun bevoegdheden gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de explosieve stijging van fraude met visa en phishing

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about the sharp rise in visa fraud and phishing, including reported case numbers, the role of travel portals, prevention campaigns and the Anti-Phishing Shield pilot. The Minister answered that no reliable police figures exist for visa fraud or phishing, outlined public awareness campaigns, the online fraud integrated approach, and a six-month APS pilot with KPN.
There are currently no reliable figures available on the number of police reports concerning visa fraud.
Er zijn op dit moment geen betrouwbare cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal aangiften over visumverstrekking bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat meerdere moorden op gewone Nederlanders zijn besteld via het dark web

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that at least seven murders of ordinary Dutch citizens were ordered via dark web platforms, asking about police knowledge, victim protection, investigative capacity and international cooperation. The minister gave mostly evasive answers, declining to discuss individual cases, protection measures and investigative methods, while pointing to digital recruitment plans and Europol's dark web programme.

To prevent investigation and prosecution of criminal offences in ongoing inquiries from being frustrated, neither the police nor the public prosecution service provide insight into the investigative strategies and methods used.

Om te voorkomen dat opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten in lopende onderzoeken mogelijk wordt gefrustreerd, wordt door politie en het openbaar ministerie geen inzicht gegeven in gehanteerde onderzoeksstrategieën en methodieken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de verkoop van het gasdrukwapen ‘Sentinel’ en de hiaten in de wet

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the legal sale of the 'Sentinel' gas-pressure weapon that may resemble a firearm, and about gaps in the Weapons and Ammunition Act. The minister acknowledged the legal ambiguity ('sprekende gelijkenis'), said the act will be modernised with an advisory review pending, and gave no monitoring data on sales or incidents.
The police have no insight into the scale, since the sale is then legal.
De politie heeft geen inzicht in de omvang, aangezien de verkoop dan legaal is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Becker en Van der Werf over erfrecht, levensverzekeringen en femicide

MPs Mutluer, Becker and Van der Werf asked whether a person declared fully non-accountable after killing a partner inherits by default, whether life insurance is paid out without checks, and whether the law should change. The State Secretary answered that such persons are not automatically disinherited without a criminal conviction, that courts can exclude them under reasonableness and fairness, that no legal change is considered opportune, and that insurers already contractually exclude payouts to beneficiaries involved in a crime.
I therefore do not consider a change in the law opportune, as my predecessor also informed the House earlier this year.
Een wetswijziging acht ik daarom niet opportuun, zoals ook mijn ambtsvoorganger eerder dit jaar aan uw Kamer heeft laten weten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over het bericht dat atlete Zoë Sedney zich in de steek gelaten voelde door de Atletiekunie na grensoverschrijdend gedrag van een teamgenoot

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked about a report that athlete Zoë Sedney felt abandoned by the Atletiekunie after a teammate's boundary-crossing conduct, including whether the victim was informed and consulted on the perpetrator's return, and about oversight of sports federations, the planned integrity centre, and case durations in sexual offence cases. The government answered that sports federations have a duty of care under the Blauwdruk, that it cannot judge individual cases, and that the Integere Sport Nederland integrity centre is in internet consultation, while case-duration measures are ongoing.
It is not for me as State Secretary to assess individual cases.
Het is als niet aan mij om als Staatssecretaris casuïstiek te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf en Mutluer over uitvoering van de maatregelen om femicide in Nederland aan te pakken

MPs Becker, Van der Werf and Mutluer asked the State Secretary about implementing measures against femicide, including the psychological violence bill, the Clare's Law study, the femicide monitor, a national coordinator, and police case coordination. The government answered that it is committed to the approach, gave timelines and status updates on most items, and deferred or pointed to other documents on several.
I expect this bill can go into consultation before summer 2026.
Ik verwacht dat dit wetsvoorstel voor de zomer van 2026 in consultatie kan gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over burgers die de grens menen te moeten bewaken

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked the Minister of Justice and Security about citizens who conducted self-appointed border checks at Ter Apel and Sellingen, and whether these were lawful and what authorities did. The minister answered with a factual account of the incidents, said prosecution and courts decide on criminal conduct, stressed that border checks are reserved to the Royal Marechaussee, and noted ongoing police and cross-border contact with German authorities.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether there are criminal offences.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over burgers die de grens menen te moeten bewaken

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice Minister how to view racist remarks in a WhatsApp group of citizens conducting border checks for asylum seekers, and whether prosecution will follow. The minister said citizens must not take the law into their own hands, that border checks belong to legally authorised authorities, that the remarks are objectionable, and that whether offences occurred is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts to decide.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the judge to determine whether criminal offences have occurred.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk de rechter om te bepalen of er sprake is van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de hackaanval op het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister about the hack of the Public Prosecution Service (OM) digital environment, including data stolen, staff and witness safety, Citrix vulnerability, and restoration timing. The minister answered that no evidence yet shows data was manipulated or taken, that the OM is returning online in phases with enhanced monitoring, and that the NCSC has urged all Citrix users to investigate, while withholding details of the ongoing criminal investigation.
I cannot provide you with any information about the ongoing criminal investigation while that investigation continues.
Over het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik u gedurende dat onderzoek geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Mutluer over het lekken van persoonsgegevens door ambtenaren aan criminelen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about civil servants leaking personal data such as addresses and licence plates to criminals, including a recent Amsterdam case, and asked for figures on prosecutions by municipality, the state's support for municipal integrity, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's role, and a joint vulnerability assessment with the VNG. The government answered that the police and judiciary do not register the employer of suspects so the figures cannot be given, pointed to existing municipal integrity measures and national support programmes, described the Data Protection Authority's supervisory role, and announced a new national anti-corruption approach with concrete actions planned for 2025.

The systems of the police, the Rijksrecherche and the judiciary do not record from which function a suspect breached the duty of confidentiality, or whether information was leaked to criminals or other persons.

De systemen van politie, Rijksrecherche en de Rechtspraak registreren niet vanuit welke functie door een verdachte de geheimhoudingsplicht is geschonden, en of informatie aan criminelen of andere personen is gelekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht ‘Schrikbarende toename van online oplichting’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that online fraud victims reached 2.4 million, why young people are targeted more, what concrete measures exist, whether victims feel helped, how banks and platforms cooperate, the PNBF refund scheme, priority and capacity, and the role of NCSC and DTC. The minister acknowledges the rise, describes the integrated approach with public and private partners, prevention campaigns, the digital reporting desk and EUR 52.6 million investment, but gives no data on PNBF use and says effects are hard to measure.
It is therefore not possible to obtain an overview of the number of requests under the PNBF scheme.
Het is daardoor niet mogelijk om een overzicht te verkrijgen van het aantal verzoeken in het kader van de PNBF-regeling.
Antwoord op van de leden Van Nispen en Mutluer over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het politieonderwijs en de structurele tekorten in de opsporing

MPs Van Nispen and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about police training capacity at the Politieacademie, shortages in investigation roles, and the use of field academies and external providers. The minister confirmed the shortages, outlined new direct-entry routes and training numbers, and said quality is safeguarded by central certification while a structural route is being developed, without committing to the requested early letter on external providers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de politiebegroting

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police budget: the outcome of the police task force review, the size and causes of the 2026–2029 deficit, how it will be closed, and how much extra money the police has received. The minister answered that the residual shortfall is tens of millions in 2026 rising to about 300 million structurally from 2030, caused by personnel costs, IT and digitalisation, and housing, that the korpschef must take control measures in 2026 sparing operational capacity, and that multi-year solutions will be prepared for the 2027 budget with the local authorities involved.
The korpschef and I are in discussion with the local authorities about the police's financial shortfall.
De korpschef en ik zijn in gesprek met de gezagen over het financiële tekort bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden White en Mutluer over de aanhoudende problematiek van vuurwapenbezit op Curaçao

MPs White and Mutluer asked about rising firearm possession on Curaçao and the other Caribbean islands, including enforcement capacity, youth prevention, coastal smuggling and online sales. The minister answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own law enforcement, acknowledged capacity shortfalls and said Netherlands cooperates through the Justitieel Vierpartijenoverleg and related programmes.
Curaçao, as an autonomous country within the Kingdom, has its own responsibility for law enforcement and for policy to combat illegal firearms and their possession.
Curaçao heeft als autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk een eigen verantwoordelijkheid voor de rechtshandhaving en voor het beleid om illegale vuurwapens en het bezit hiervan tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Mutluer over buitenlandse beïnvloeding op het emancipatiebeleid

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Education, Culture and Science and the Minister of Justice and Security about foreign influence by extreme conservative lobby groups on emancipation policy, including disinformation, funding flows, and threats to LGBTQ+ and migrant rights. The government answered that lobbying is lawful but that incitement and intimidation fall outside democratic limits, pointed to the pending Wtmo and an anti-SLAPP directive, and said it lacks a legal basis for the requested investigations into funding.
The ministries do not have a legal basis to carry out these kinds of investigations.
De ministeries beschikken niet over een juridische grondslag om dit soort onderzoeken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de onafhankelijkheid van de beoordeling van politiegeweld in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether police use-of-force investigations are independent, and whether Dutch assessment of force meets ECHR case law on absolute or strict necessity. The minister rejected the criticism, arguing that Dutch rules (proportionality, subsidiarity, prosecutorial oversight and independent investigators such as the Rijksrecherche) satisfy the ECHR.
I do not share this conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de oproep van een Nederlands/Syrisch influencer tot 'uitroeien' van Alawieten

Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about an influencer's call to 'exterminate' Alawites after killings in Syria, and whether similar calls had occurred in the Netherlands and whether measures were taken against sectarian spillover. The government answered that it cannot retrieve counts of reports or investigations from police and prosecution systems, stated it takes community tensions seriously via SZW monitoring and the NCTV, and said no signals currently show violent incidents against specific persons.
From the systems of the police and the Public Prosecution Service it cannot be retrieved how many reports, complaints or criminal investigations are carried out regarding such calls.
Uit de systemen van politie en Openbaar Ministerie kan niet worden gehaald hoeveel meldingen, aangiften of strafrechtelijke onderzoeken er worden gedaan naar dergelijke oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de mogelijke uitlevering van een Amerikaanse vrouw

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands received a US extradition request for a woman suspected of murder, who had reportedly stayed in an asylum centre, and whether extradition would be refused if the death penalty could apply. The minister declined to comment on the individual case but explained that Dutch extradition law and treaties require a death-penalty guarantee before extradition, and that the Netherlands would refuse if the US could not give one.
I cannot make statements about ongoing criminal proceedings.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke procedures kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de blijvende ICT-problemen bij het Openbaar Ministerie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about recurring ICT failures at the Public Prosecution Service (OM), including the latest outage and what has been done and invested to fix it. The minister acknowledged the outages and the outdated systems, listed past and planned investments, and said the upgrade proceeds step by step under supervision of the College of Procurators-General, without new commitments.
The OM is doing its utmost to improve its ICT.
Het OM spant zich tot het uiterste in om de ICT te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het doen van aangifte tegen een politieagent

An MP asked the Justice Minister why people wanting to file a criminal complaint (aangifte) against a police officer are routed to the complaints procedure, and whether this is consistent with the duty to record complaints. The minister acknowledged the chatbot wrongly routed people to complaints, said this will be fixed, stated that aangifte against police must be possible and is normally handled by the VIK units, and noted that the police do not register separately how many aangiften against officers are filed.
I have learned from the police that this will be improved, so that in future a person will first be pointed to the option to file a criminal complaint.
Van de politie heb ik vernomen dat dit wordt verbeterd, zodat in de toekomst iemand eerst op de aangiftemogelijkheid gewezen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Afgesproken normen in zedenzaken niet gehaald’

MPs Van der Werf and Mutluer asked why agreed time-limit norms for sex-offence cases were again not met, and what the government will do about longer processing times, reduced victim willingness to report, understaffing and prioritisation. Minister Van Weel answered that some processing times slightly improved in 2024, that the action plan is extended to end 2025, that staffing shortfalls and new Sexual Offences Act capacity are being addressed, and that no additional measures are planned for now.

None of the trajectories meets the target norm, but the general picture is that the criminal justice chain organisations managed to handle more older cases and reduce backlogs without processing times increasing.

Op geen van de trajecten wordt de streefnorm gehaald, maar het algemene beeld is dat het de organisaties in de strafrechtketen is gelukt om meer oudere zaken af te handelen en de voorraden te verminderen zonder dat de doorlooptijden zijn opgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Van der Werf en Mutluer over de stand van zaken van de aanpak van femicide

MPs Becker, Van der Werf and Mutluer asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the progress of the femicide action plan, including implementation steps, criminalising psychological violence, a 24/7 reporting point, funding, police training, the EU rape-centre directive, stalking, police case coordination, and children's contact with perpetrators after partner killings. The government answered that much detail will follow in a June 2025 progress letter, gave timelines for the bill on psychological violence and the EU directive (delayed to early 2026), described how the 10 million euro is being spent, and defended the existing legal framework on contact after partner killings.
I cannot currently indicate point by point in detail how the implementation of the femicide action plan stands.
Ik kan op dit moment niet per punt in detail aangeven hoe het staat met de implementatie van het plan van aanpak «Stop femicide!».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Pijpelink over het bericht dat criminele ronselaars hun slag slaan op scholen

MPs Mutluer and Pijpelink asked the ministers of Justice and Education about reports that criminal recruiters increasingly target pupils at schools, and what the government knows, trains, and does about it. The minister answers that no figures on school recruitment are recorded, points to a study requested from the Centre for Child and Human Trafficking, existing school safety duties, a planned notification duty for serious incidents, and the Preventie met Gezag programme, and says he will consult the VNG on youth workers at schools.
There are no figures available on the number of young people approached by criminals.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat wordt benaderd door criminelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over het onbetrouwbare algoritme dat jongeren als crimineel bestempelt

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about the Preselect Recidive algorithm that flags young suspects as future criminals, including its purpose, validation, transparency, privacy assessment, error rates and whether affected youths can object. The State Secretary answered that the tool only informs a human decision at the ZSM consultation, promised to register it in the Algorithm Register in 2025, to inform youths and parents, and to redevelop the tool with a new report in the second half of 2025.
When the Preselect Recidive is applied there is therefore always a decision by people, not by an algorithm, which also uses other information about the young person.
Er is bij de toepassing van de Preselect Recidive dus altijd sprake van een besluit door mensen, niet door een algoritme, waarbij ook andere informatie over de jongere wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de bedreiging van deurwaarders, ambtenaren en andere overheidsfunctionarissen door soevereinen

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about threats against bailiffs, civil servants and other officials by self-declared sovereigns, and what measures are taken to protect them. The minister answers that such threats are unacceptable, that a 2024 survey found 31% of cases of aggression involved self-declared sovereigns, that protection measures and a resilience coordinator exist, but that no specific classification of sovereign-related threats exists and no dedicated new measures are announced beyond existing programmes and further research.
This survey does not specifically examine threats and intimidation by sovereigns.
In dit onderzoek wordt niet specifiek gekeken naar bedreigingen en intimidatie door soevereinen.

Nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Mutluer over het onderzoeksrapport Beveiligingsproces van staatsgeheime vertrouwelijke informatie bij NCTV en politie van de Audit Dienst Rijk, alsmede de kabinetsrea

MPs Six Dijkstra and Mutluer asked the government about the ADR report on security failures at the NCTV and police, including oversight, the BVA's role, and a leak. This follow-up letter answers question 5 by stating that a search found documents on the NCTV's security situation, that these are being assessed, and that some passages will be withheld for state and privacy reasons, with further documents to follow.
This has led to certain passages in the documents not being made public because they may harm the interests of the State.
Dit heeft ertoe geleid bepaalde passages uit de documenten niet openbaar te maken omdat deze de belangen van de Staat kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over discriminatie van vrouwen bij het vastleggen van gecombineerde achternamen

An MP asked whether the new combined surname law discriminates against women, whether it should be amended to remove the father's veto, whether the transitional regime should be extended, and how other EU states regulate it. The Secretary of State defended the law, said it will be evaluated, rejected court-based substitute consent and extending the transitional period, and saw no reason to amend the law.
With this in view, it will be examined to what extent use is made of the broader choice the scheme offers.
Met het oog daarop zal worden gekeken in hoeverre van de ruimere keuzemogelijkheid die de regeling biedt, gebruik wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mutluer en Helder over het afluistersysteem van de politie

MPs Van Nispen, Mutluer, Helder and Van der Werf asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the police wiretap system from Elbit was delayed and that an upgrade was bought as a backup, including questions about the supplier's staff access, human rights risks and AI use. The Minister denies that a new system was secretly bought, says the upgrade was a precaution, states that the new system will only be used once it meets requirements, and gives no firm guarantee on the first-half 2025 rollout.
Furthermore, it is good to note that because of the confidential tender, I cannot make statements about the supplier of the current wiretap system.
Verder is het goed om aan te geven dat vanwege de aanbesteding onder geheimhouding ik geen uitspraken kan doen over de leverancier van het huidige tapsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Westerveld over veilige opvang slachtoffers huiselijk geweld in de knel

MPs Mutluer and Westerveld asked about shortages of safe shelter places for domestic violence victims, who are being housed in hotels and holiday parks, and about the government's responsibility and funding. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible, that capacity data is still being developed, that extra funding has been provided but is not earmarked, and that the government will discuss the issue with municipalities and Valente but rules out returning to national financing for now.
Municipalities do not have to account to the national government for how they have precisely used the funds.
Gemeenten hoeven geen verantwoording te geven aan het Rijk over hoe zij de middelen precies hebben benut.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Mutluer over gezichtsherkenning bij de politie

MPs Kathmann, Lahlah and Mutluer asked about police use of facial recognition and camera surveillance at peaceful demonstrations, citing an Amnesty report, and asked about oversight, data sources, retention and procurement. The Minister replied that police do not use real-time facial recognition at demonstrations, only retrospectively against suspects of crimes, that the Dutch DPA has adequate expertise to supervise, and that a national legal framework and an AI-regulation-based transparency register are being explored and will follow.
Only when criminal offences have been committed can the police subsequently use facial recognition technology to identify suspects.
Enkel wanneer sprake is van strafbare feiten kan door de politie achteraf gezichtsherkenningstechnologie worden ingezet om verdachten te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de inzet van jongeren als “geldezels”

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about young people used as money mules by online fraudsters: how many there are, detection rates, prosecution, restorative justice, debt aid, recidivism, VOG implications and prevention. The minister answers in detail with estimates, court figures and prevention programmes, while stating that precise figures are unknown and that no additional measures are needed for now.
Precise figures on this problem are not known.
Precieze cijfers over dit probleem zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de eisen ten aanzien van de kleurenblindheid bij de politie

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security whether colour-vision requirements for police recruits can be relaxed given staffing needs, whether colour-blind candidates can be admitted, and whether aids are available. The minister defends the colour-vision requirement for executive police roles on grounds of accurate observation and safety, notes that assistive tools are not scientifically proven, and says the police are reviewing the recruitment standards without knowing yet whether colour requirements will change.
The police have started a review of the recruitment requirements.
De politie is gestart met een herijking van de aanstellingseisen.
Antwoord op de vragen van leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over het uitlezen van mobiele telefoons

MPs Kathmann and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister how the CJEU ruling allowing phone searches for minor offences would affect Dutch practice, and what protocols, consent rules and data retention apply. The minister replied that the ruling's impact is still uncertain, that a codifying bill will be consulted on once clearer, and described current Dutch rules, biometric unlocking and data storage periods.
Before the end of the year, your House will receive the policy response to the evaluation reports.
Voor het einde van het jaar ontvangt uw Kamer de beleidsreactie op de evaluatierapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het landelijk kwaliteitskader in relatie tot Preventie met gezag

An MP asked the Justice Minister how the national quality framework for effective youth interventions was developed, whether it conflicts with local needs, and why some programmes may be stopped for lacking proven effectiveness. The minister answered that municipalities hold the regie, the framework is non-binding guidance under a learning approach with municipalities, and no programmes have been stopped on that basis, while committing to address the matter in the next progress report.
Municipalities have control over their own local PmG approach.
Gemeenten hebben de regie over hun eigen lokale aanpak PmG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Mutluer, Michon-Derkzen, Van Nispen en Aardema over het bericht ‘Politiehack van 62.000 medewerkers is gevaarlijk: naam agent is handelswaar’

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police data breach exposing contact details of about 62,000 officers, including timing of notification, risks to officers and families, and safeguards against similar leaks. The minister answered that work contact details and occasionally private contact details were exposed, that a pass-the-cookie attack by likely state actors was used, that notification was delayed in part, and that measures are being taken but investigations are ongoing and the wider lessons for government systems are limited.
In the interest of the ongoing investigations, I cannot say anything about that.
In het belang van de lopende onderzoeken kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Inge van Dijk, Helder en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Honderden agenten met PTSS krijgen geen passende WIA-uitwerking door gebrek aan kennis over ziekte bij UWV’

MPs from CDA, BBB and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers whether UWV medical assessors lack knowledge of PTSD, leaving police officers without proper WIA benefits, and proposed a specialist desk and training. The minister denied a knowledge gap, said PTSD is covered by general medical knowledge and assessor re-registration, and offered no new training or desk beyond existing optional courses.
I do not recognise that picture.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over geld terugvorderen van fraudeurs door slachtoffers van online oplichting

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asks the Justice Minister why victims of online fraud make little use of the PNBF procedure to recover money, and about data, awareness, police pilots and bank cooperation. The minister replies that PNBF is a private bank scheme without central registration, promises talks with the banks and Betaalvereniging on data and evaluation, and describes existing and ongoing prevention and cooperation initiatives.
For answering the question about an indication of how many requests have been made since 2021, no answer can be given within the requested response period.
Voor de beantwoording van de vraag om een indicatie hoeveel verzoeken er zijn gedaan sinds 2021 kan geen antwoord worden gegeven binnen de gevraagde beantwoordingstermijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de nog steeds openbare bangalijsten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why public 'bangalijsten' (lists of women's names for sexual shaming) remain on Telegram despite takedown requests, and what enforcement tools supervisors have. The State Secretary answered that the independent bodies (Openbaar Ministerie, AP, ACM and Belgian regulators) decide on enforcement, that a handhavingsverzoek to the AP has been made, and that the DSA's liability exemption creates an incentive to remove illegal content while national regulators are not yet competent.
They have far-reaching independence and it is ultimately up to them to weigh, case by case, whether to apply the available powers and instruments.
Zij hebben verregaande zelfstandigheid en het is uiteindelijk aan hen om per geval een afweging te maken over de eventuele toepassing van beschikbare bevoegdheden en instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kostić over een brand op een balkon waar een lhbti+ vlag hing

MPs Mutluer and Kostić asked the Justice and Education ministers about an arson fire in Breda that possibly targeted a rainbow flag, the aftercare for the victim, rising anti-LGBTI discrimination, the regenbooggemeenten programme, the timing of a new action plan, and the implementation of motions on police and intersectional discrimination. The minister condemned the incident while noting the investigation is ongoing, listed support measures, school programmes and planned research, and committed to a follow-up approach and action plan by spring 2025 while declining to comment on the victim's case for privacy reasons.
Because of the privacy and safety of the victim, I will not make further statements about this specific case.
Vanwege de privacy en de veiligheid van het slachtoffer doe ik geen verdere uitspraken over deze specifieke zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk, Helder en Michon-Derkzen over de voorgenomen sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from several parties ask the Minister of Justice and Security why the police plan to close the Wolvega station and replace it with a smaller police post, questioning the decision's basis, its effect on police presence, consultation with local government, and the link to coalition plans for more police presence in neighbourhoods. The Minister answers that station locations are a police responsibility, that the transformation follows a 2015 housing plan aimed at more mobile policing on the street, that no final location has been chosen, and that a new police post is planned by end 2025 with the municipality of Weststellingwerf.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, stay open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en De Hoop over onveiligheidsgevoelens van vrouwen in de openbare ruimte.

MPs Mutluer and De Hoop asked ministers about high levels of feeling unsafe among women in public space and on public transport, and what measures are taken. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites Veiligheidsmonitor data, says public transport partners are responsible and will act, and promises further engagement and evaluation without firm new commitments.
I call on the parties involved to take up their role in this and, where necessary, to come up with additional measures.
Ik vraag de betrokken partijen om hierin hun rol te pakken en waar noodzakelijk te komen met aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het slachtoffers bangalijsten op Telegram

An MP asked the government about Telegram 'bangalijsten' (lists targeting female students), victims' compensation, anonymity, sanctions on student associations and the role of the Dutch data protection authority. The government answered that universities and student associations bear primary responsibility, that victims can access support and civil or criminal routes, and that the AP acts independently and does not discuss enforcement with the ministry.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority is an independent supervisor that assesses case by case, on its own initiative or on request, whether the General Data Protection Regulation is complied with.
De AP is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder die per geval – uit eigen beweging of op verzoek – beoordeelt of wordt voldaan aan de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (hierna:
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Mutluer over ‘het bericht omtrent de opheffing van commissie-Schneiders die de Landelijke Eenheid onderzocht en zou monitoren’

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether the Schneiders committee on the Landelijke Eenheid police unit was dissolved after delivering its final report, whether the report will be sent to parliament, and how the transition, culture change, leadership and staff participation are being secured. The minister answers that the report was delivered as agreed, that oversight now rests with the police leadership and the Inspectorate, that Schneiders stays on as an adviser, and that the transition is a multi-year process with funding kept in place.
Oversight of and direction for following up the recommendations is a responsibility of the police leadership and, by extension, the leadership of the Landelijke Eenheden.
Toezicht op en sturing geven aan de opvolging van de gedane aanbevelingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de korpsleiding en in het verlengde daarvan de leidingen van de Landelijke Eenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer, Lahlah, Boswijk en Helder over de sluiting van het politiebureau in Wolvega

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA and BBB asked the Minister of Justice about the planned closure of the Wolvega police station, its consistency with the coalition's commitment to visible policing, the reasons for closure, and talks with the municipality. The Minister answered that a smaller police post will replace it, the police decide closures in consultation with local authorities, and talks with the municipality are ongoing.
Decisions on which police stations or posts are added, remain open or close are a responsibility of the police.
Keuzes over welke politiebureaus of posten die worden toegevoegd, geopend blijven of sluiten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over extreemrechtse memes

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the impact of far-right memes on society and young people, the police's capacity to recognise them, the role of platforms and the ATKM, and whether an awareness campaign is planned. The Minister answers that memes are a radicalisation vehicle, outlines strengthening of digital resilience, the Versterkte Aanpak Online and existing removal powers, and promises further steps but no concrete new measures beyond exploring a campaign.
The cabinet is working on a Strengthened Online Approach (VAO) regarding extremist and terrorist content.
Het kabinet werkt aan een Versterkte Aanpak Online (VAO) inzake extremistische en terroristische content.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over bangalijsten op Telegram

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about bangalijsten (lists of men to be intimidated) spread on Telegram, including whether prosecutors can order takedowns and whether Telegram can be prosecuted under the doxing offence. The minister answered that Telegram is hard to reach, prosecutors can use the rechter-commissaris-authorised takedown power but must weigh feasibility and it requires an international legal assistance request, and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Using this power first requires an assessment of whether the applicable conditions can be met.
Inzet van deze bevoegdheid vraagt in eerste instantie een weging of aan de daarvoor geldende voorwaarden kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Nispen over alarmpistolen die door jongeren worden omgebouwd tot dodelijke vuurwapens

MPs Mutluer and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about youths converting alarm pistols into lethal firearms, including conviction figures, social media sales, youth motives, and cross-border and platform enforcement. The minister answered that 265 of 1,721 weapons convictions in 2023 involved minors, announced a youth weapons action plan review and a National Firearms Focal Point, and said Telegram's DSA obligations and cross-border enforcement would be pursued.
The Judiciary's registration systems cannot search specifically for convictions for selling or possessing an alarm pistol.
In de registratiesystemen van de Rechtspraak kan niet specifiek gezocht worden op veroordelingen voor het verkopen of bezitten van een alarmpistool.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het artikel 'Serious security breach hits EU police agency'

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that sensitive personnel files and communications of Europol top officials disappeared from a secured storage room at Europol's The Hague headquarters, and when the government became aware of it. The minister regrets the incident, says Europol has started a security investigation due to finish in 2024 and HR process improvements, while stating operational information was never affected.
The disappearance of the files containing personal information of Europol top officials is an internal matter.
Antwoord 4 Het verdwijnen van de bestanden met persoonlijk informatie van topfunctionarissen van Europol is een interne aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Mutluer over de het bericht ‘dat bij de brandweer PTSS niet wordt herkend als beroepsziekte, in tegenstelling tot bij defensie en politie’

MPs Boswijk and Mutluer asked whether PTSS is recognised as an occupational disease for firefighters, unlike for defence and police, and about support, data and insurance. The minister answered that PTSS is not nationally recognised for firefighters because fire service employers are the 25 safety regions, that a national model scheme is being prepared, and that she will keep discussing the matter with the regions.
There is currently no good view of the number of firefighters with PTSS in the Netherlands.
Er is op dit moment geen goed zicht op het aantal brandweermensen met PTSS in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kostić over Kritiek op besluit provincie Friesland tegen actief regenboogbeleid

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether rainbow provinces should be obliged to run active LGBTI policy, after Friesland's decision to drop such a stance, and requested figures on discrimination reports and police reports in Friesland. The minister answered that the rainbow-province label is a provincial initiative with no national conditions, that policy content is for provinces themselves, and supplied reporting figures from Tumba and the police.
I am happy to work together with the provinces on this, but as stated, the content of rainbow policy is ultimately up to the provinces themselves.
Ik werk hierin graag samen met de provincies, maar zoals gezegd is de invulling van het regenboogbeleid uiteindelijk aan de provincies zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het schrappen van verkrachting uit Europese wetgeving over gendergerelateerd geweld

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands opposes including rape in EU rules on gender-based violence, while other member states support it and the Netherlands passed a broader sexual offences law. The minister answered that the Netherlands follows the Legal Service's advice on EU competence and legal risk, that the directive still strengthens victim protection, and that the position will not be revised.
The majority of member states, including the Netherlands, do not want to accept the legal risks connected to EU harmonisation of the criminalisation in question.
De meerderheid van de lidstaten, waaronder Nederland, wil de juridische risico's die verbonden zijn aan de EU-harmonisatie van de genoemde strafbaarstelling niet accepteren.

Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de nog altijd bestaande oververtegenwoordiging van mannen in de top van grote Nederlandse bedrijven en de stijging van het aantal vrouwen die maar heel beperkt blijft

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the persistent underrepresentation of women in the top of large Dutch companies, the slow rise in women, and why many firms did not report under the Topvrouwenwet. The minister acknowledged the increase is too slow, said it is too early to draw conclusions, and committed to writing to non-reporting companies and issuing a progress report.
I am going to send a letter to the companies that did not report.
Ik ga aan de bedrijven die niet gerapporteerd hebben een brief te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over hulp aan mannelijke sekswerkers

MP Mutluer asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about support for young male sex workers, including minors, after a Eindhoven drop-in centre faced closure, and whether the House of Inner Strength can be funded. The government answered that exit programmes (DUUP, 6 million euro per year) are open to all sex workers, that municipalities are responsible for youth and victim care, and that a follow-up meeting with VNG and VWS would take place in March 2024.
I have no insight into the numbers of boys and men who use this drop-in centre or which region they come from.
Ik heb geen inzage in de aantallen jongens en mannen die gebruik maken van dit inloophuis en uit welke regio zij komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over het uitleveringsverdrag dat Nederland heeft gesloten met Marokko

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice Minister about the extradition treaty with Morocco, including its scope, the reliability of Moroccan justice, and safeguards for journalists and activists. The Minister explained the treaty extends extradition beyond multilateral-treaty offences to any offence with a sentence of at least one year, that political-offence refusal grounds apply, and that human rights assessments were made, but declined to give a judgement on Moroccan courts or offer blanket guarantees.
I refrain from giving a judgement on the Moroccan judiciary.
Ik onthoud mij van een oordeel over de Marokkaanse rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht 'Politie wil meer autowrakken optakelen om misdrijven op te lossen'

An MP asked whether recovering sunken cars could help solve crimes, why such wrecks are not always recovered given costs, and whether police and Rijkswaterstaat should coordinate on this. The minister agreed recovery can yield leads, said the number of wrecks yielding criminal evidence is unknown, and explained that waterway managers prioritise navigation safety while police decide case by case, with cooperation talks ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht ‘Gemeente in gesprek met ministerie over aanvullende tegemoetkoming gedupeerden waterramp’

An MP asks the Justice and Security minister about unreimbursed residual and consequential flood damage in Zuid-Limburg, the motion on 'schrijnende situaties', and why only a narrow group qualifies for a one-off payment. The minister says a regulation for one-off payments to those in financial distress is being drafted, that about 200 victims are expected to qualify, and that the Quick scan figures did not reserve money for compensation.
Once the decision-making has taken place, I will inform your House.
Zodra de besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over designerdrugs die teruggegeven moeten worden aan de eigenaar

An MP asked the Justice Minister why about 1,100 kg of designer drugs seized in Zaanstad had to be returned to their owner because the substances fall outside the Opium Act, and what legal options exist. The minister agreed this is undesirable, pointed to the pending NPS bill (a generic list IA) as the remedy, and stated that current law offers no criminal or administrative enforcement tools.
A complete overview of NPS that remain with the owner/possessor cannot be obtained, because NPS are not punishable conduct if the substance is not listed on list I or list II of the Opium Act.

Een totaal overzicht van NPS dat bij de eigenaar/bezitter blijft, is niet te achterhalen, omdat NPS geen strafbare gedragingen betreffen als de betreffende stof niet op lijst I of lijst II bij de Opiumwet staat.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Sneller, Michon-Derkzen, Kuik, Mutluer en Temmink over agressie en geweld tegen beroepsgroepen met een publieke functie

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA, GroenLinks-PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reporting, prosecution, sentencing and prevention of aggression and violence against public-service workers. The minister answers that reporting should be made mandatory in practice through employer norms, that no reliable national picture exists, and that existing protocols, WODC research and Weerbaar Bestuur initiatives are being used, while leaving primary employer responsibility with organisations.
A reliable national picture of aggression and violence against officials with a public task is lacking.
Een betrouwbaar landelijk beeld van agressie en geweld tegen functionarissen met een publieke taak ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het artikel ‘Cowboys azen op miljoenen die Rijk investeert in jeugdcriminaliteit’

MP Mutluer asked the ministers about a Trouw report that outside providers are targeting Rijk funds for youth crime prevention, and about how spending is controlled and made effective. The ministers answered that municipalities are warned to be critical of providers, that a monitoring cycle, evaluations and a WODC study will track effectiveness, and they gave a budget overview and an update on the Drop In youth-work research.

To stimulate and facilitate municipalities within the learning approach of Preventie met gezag, we share scientific knowledge on risk and protective factors and the active ingredients based on them with them.

Om gemeenten binnen (de lerende aanpak van) Preventie met gezag te stimuleren en faciliteren delen wij wetenschappelijke kennis ten aanzien van risico- en beschermende factoren en daarop gebaseerde werkzame bestanddelen met hen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Mutluer en Piri over de aanhouding van medewerkers van NCTV en politie vanwege het lekken van staatsgeheime informatie

MPs Sneller, Mutluer and Piri asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about the arrest of NCTV and police staff for allegedly leaking state secret information, including risks to people, critical infrastructure, timing of an investigation, and foreign contacts. The minister declined to give operational details pending criminal and Auditdienst Rijk investigations, said no signals currently show acute risk to critical infrastructure, and promised to inform parliament once the investigation concludes.
In the interest of those investigations, and given the risk of harm if sensitive or classified information reaches third parties prematurely, no additional information can be provided at this time.

In het belang van die onderzoeken en gelet op het afbreukrisico indien voortijdig gevoelige of gerubriceerde informatie bij derden terechtkomt, kan er op dit moment geen aanvullende informatie worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over ‘de blijvend lange doorlooptijden bij zedenzaken’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why case processing times in sexual offence cases remain long, whether they have decreased since earlier answers, how many extra FTEs were recruited under the Klaver motion, what more is needed to meet the six-month norm, and whether the Action Plan has reduced processing times. The minister reported modest improvements in 2022 against the chain norms, a 3.8 FTE vacancy gap, a complex plan to address the problem, and expected effects from 2024 onward, referring to a forthcoming police half-year report for staffing figures.
Improving processing times is a complex matter.
Het verbeteren van de doorlooptijden is een complexe aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over huwelijksdwang of achterlating in het buitenland

Two MPs asked ministers about forced marriage and abandonment of girls abroad, including BRP deregistration, prevalence data, residence and nationality recovery, legal aid and feminist foreign policy. The government answered that precise prevalence data are lacking, outlined existing registration and reporting rules, pointed to planned research and measures, and described routes for recovering residence status and nationality.
Precise and reliable figures on the extent of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Ellemeet over een uitzending van Argos over de dood van Sammy Baker

MPs Mutluer and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an Argos broadcast on the death of Sammy Baker, the adequacy of the handling framework for people with confused behaviour, and whether the treatment of fatal incidents involving police should be investigated. The Minister said the Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to revisit its earlier decision not to prosecute (self-defence), that the framework gives no powers to arrest, that she will not assess the lawfulness of force and sees no need for a new study, and referred to existing measures for a cross-domain approach.
It is then up to other authorities – where appropriate the judge – to assess whether the use of force was lawful or not.
Het is daarna aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om te beoordelen of er wel of niet sprake is van een rechtmatige geweldsaanwending.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Piri over de detentie van een Nederlander in Spanje

MPs Mutluer and Piri asked about the detention in Spain of a Dutch national from Tilburg, whether the Netherlands was involved, whether he was flagged for terrorism, and whether a 'white list' should be created. The ministers declined detailed comment citing the pending case and privacy rules, stated the Netherlands had no link to the Spanish grounds for arrest, noted he had since been returned to the Netherlands, and rejected a generic white list as unsuitable.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Mutluer over de onterechte verdenking van aanwezigheid bij een klimaatprotest op luchthaven Schiphol

MPs Ellemeet and Mutluer asked how the Public Prosecution Service and Marechaussee identified about 400 climate protesters detained at Schiphol in November 2022, after some of the 176 warning letters went to people who were not present, and whether this was careful conduct. The minister explains that photos were matched using social media, open sources and a facial recognition program under art. 55c Sv, that eight people received apology letters, and that an internal review is ongoing with commitments to remove wrongly processed data and learn lessons.
In a number of cases it later turned out that the identification was incorrect.
Bij een aantal personen bleek achteraf sprake te zijn van een onjuiste identificatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht ‘Drugsmaffia biedt ‘hulp’ aan Limburgse horecaondernemers die sinds de watersnood problemen hebben’

An MP asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers whether criminals offering help to flood-hit Limburg hospitality entrepreneurs was known, and what support the state provides. The minister answered that the matter is known, outlined prevention efforts and compensation schemes (Wts, provincial omzetderving scheme with a second opening), and said the state would keep working on resilience against organised crime.
Progress will be reported to the House on a regular basis in the half-yearly letter on the approach to organised, undermining crime and in reports on the progress of handling Wts claims.

Over de voortgang wordt de Kamer op regelmatige basis geïnformeerd in de halfjaarbrief aanpak georganiseerde, ondermijnende criminaliteit en in rapportages over de voortgang van de afhandeling van de Wts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Van Baarle, Koekkoek, Den Haan en Mutluer over de illegale undercover onderzoeken bij moskeeën

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about covert undercover investigations of mosques by her ministry, including whether affected citizens should be personally informed as the Landsadvocaat and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens urged. The minister admitted the processing of personal data lacked a legal basis and said the ministry will now actively inform those whose reliable contact details it can obtain, while others may ask the ministry whether they are in its records.
My ministry will therefore actively inform those people for whom reliable contact details are available.
Mijn ministerie zal daarom die mensen actief informeren, van wie betrouwbare contactgegevens voor handen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over kinderen en drugscriminaliteit

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about drug-related problems among children, referring to a news report on Hollands Kroon, and whether preventive and integrated approaches should be extended to more municipalities. The minister answers that the Preventie met gezag approach is being extended to 27 municipalities selected on data, that smaller municipalities such as Hollands Kroon do not qualify for the area-based approach but get a flexible approach, and that integrated cooperation among organisations is pursued.
For that reason, the area-based Preventie met gezag approach is being extended to 27 municipalities.
Daarom wordt de gebiedsgerichte aanpak Preventie met gezag uitgebreid naar 27 gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de borging van de kwaliteit van familierechtelijke onderzoeken

An MP asked whether the NIFP intends to stop mediating and quality-assuring family-law forensic reports, why, and how independent reporters' quality and access to expertise will be protected. The minister confirmed NIFP announced this in late 2022 due to workload and waiting times, that talks on alternative arrangements are ongoing, that the independent reporter remains responsible for quality, and that the government will report progress in spring 2024 without committing to specific interim steps.
I consider it important that the right of parents and children to counter-expertise, and the quality and independence of the reports, remain preserved.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat het recht van ouders en kinderen op contra-expertise, de kwaliteit en de onafhankelijkheid van de rapportages behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over criminele uitbuiting van basisscholieren

An MP asked the Justice Minister about criminals recruiting primary school pupils for crime and whether this constitutes human trafficking under Article 273f, and whether the non-punishment principle for victims should be codified. The government answered that recruitment of pupils is being monitored with prevention tools, a victim helpline pilot and a reporting duty for schools, that trafficking requires the conditions of Article 273f to be met, and that the non-punishment principle is already applied through prosecutorial discretion and court practice without a separate statutory provision.
Anchoring this in an explicit statutory provision alongside the already extensive set of instruments is not considered advisable, precisely because of the variety of cases.
Verankering in een expliciete, wettelijke bepaling naast dit reeds uitgebreide instrumentarium wordt – juist vanwege de variëteit aan gevallen – niet opportuun geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over discriminerende spreekkoren in de stadions

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about discriminatory chants in football stadiums, including the KNVB guideline, enforcement by clubs, ongoing talks, and a technology pilot. The minister answered that the KNVB guideline lets referees stop matches, that from the 2023/24 season homophobic chants aimed at individuals will lead to warnings, stoppages and stadium bans, and that the technology pilot continues and will be scaled up.
The KNVB does not explicitly keep track of how many matches are stopped.
De KNVB houdt niet expliciet bij hoeveel wedstrijden worden stilgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de agent die veroordeeld is voor racisme en nu leidinggevende wordt bij de vreemdelingenpolitie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a police officer convicted for racist insults who was set to take a leadership role at the immigration police, and whether such promotions occur elsewhere and how police norms are enforced. The minister answered that the appointment was withdrawn, that the officer was already sanctioned, that no separate figures on similar cases are kept, and that the police are working on a uniform approach to discrimination and racism.
No separate figures are kept on this.
Hierover worden geen aparte cijfers bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over toename geweld bij de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the reported rise in police use of force in 2022, including non-professional or wrongful force, and whether this is linked to rising violence against police and to people with confused behaviour. The minister answered that the figures on police force and on violence against officers cannot be directly compared, that the police plan a study to explain the figures, and that the 13% share of non-professional uses of force reflects normal fluctuation that cannot yet show a trend.
Out of the general wish to be able to explain the GDPA figures and to identify possible links, the police intend to commission a study.
Vanuit de algemene wens om duiding te kunnen geven aan de GDPA cijfers en eventuele verbanden te kunnen leggen, is de politie voornemens een onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Bushoff over long covid bij de politie

MPs Mutluer and Bushoff asked about long COVID among police officers, including numbers reporting, sick-leave impact, whether it is treated as an occupational illness, and support measures. The minister answered that 378 police staff with post-COVID complaints are registered with the company doctor, that police treat COVID infection as an accident at work under conditions, and that general national post-COVID measures are in place.
From the standpoint of medical confidentiality, it is not known to what extent these colleagues are absent from work as a result of their post-COVID-19 complaints.
Uit het oogpunt van medische geheimhouding is niet bekend in welke mate deze collega's verzuimen als gevolg van hun post- COVID-19 klachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Kathmann over online identiteitsfraude

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked about online identity fraude, including its prevalence, links to data hacks, who bears the burden of proof for disputed contracts, and whether businesses should verify customer identities. The minister answered that no central figures exist, pointed to CMI and Fraudemonitor data, stated the trader bears the burden of proof, and said verification is a business responsibility while promising a letter on the Energy Act.
Article 150 of the Code of Civil Procedure provides that the party relying on legal consequences of facts or rights it asserts bears the burden of proving them.
Artikel 150 van de Wet van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering stelt dat de partij die zich beroept op rechtsgevolgen van door haar gestelde feiten of rechten, de bewijslast daarvan draagt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Nijboer over de registratie van fraudeurs door verzekeraars naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Nederlandse verzekeraars spelen voor aanklager en rechter tegelijk'

MPs Mutluer and Nijboer asked whether insurers may keep their own lists of fraudsters, how insured persons learn of their registration and can object, how often Kifid upheld complaints, whether insurers should report fraud to prosecutors rather than register it, and whether stronger rules are needed. Minister Kaag answers that insurers may register under the PIFI protocol approved by the Dutch data protection authority, that complaints are upheld in about 17-21% of cases, that reporting to prosecutors is decided case by case on proportionality, and that no stricter rules are needed.
Kifid does not have such (reliable) information on the number of complaints from data subjects for the years 2018, 2019 and 2020.
Kifid beschikt niet over dergelijke (betrouwbare) informatie over het aantal klachten van betrokkenen voor de jaren 2018, 2019 en 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Mutluer, Teunissen, Sylvana Simons en Ellemeet over het bericht 'politie keek heimelijk mee in chatgroepen van Extinction Rebellion'

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police secretly monitored Extinction Rebellion chat groups, under which legal powers, and how this relates to the right to demonstrate. The Minister declined to comment on the specific case pending a court ruling, described general police information-gathering powers, and said the proportionality assessment lies with the police and the mayor.
I cannot address this specific question because the court is still considering the case concerning the suspicion of incitement.
Op deze concrete vraag kan ik niet ingaan omdat de rechter zich nog buigt over de zaak betreffende de verdenking wegens opruiing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het toegankelijker maken van aangifte bij partnergeweld en het voorkomen van femicide

An MP asked the government about making reporting of partner violence easier, preventing femicide, training professionals, and reviewing police and support practices. The State Secretary answered that training and knowledge-sharing are being developed, an Inspectorate study of ex-partner stalking is underway, and a broader programme on gender-related violence is being prepared.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security is currently investigating the approach to (ex-)partner stalking by the police, Public Prosecution Service, Veilig Thuis and probation.
Op dit moment doet de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (IJenV) onderzoek naar de aanpak bij (ex-)partnerstalking door politie, Openbaar Ministerie, Veilig Thuis en reclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het artikel over het falende communicatiesysteem bij klopjacht Rijsbergen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about C2000 radio communication failures during the Rijsbergen manhunt, its costs, the push-to-talk backup app, and plans for replacement. The minister acknowledged the problems, described ongoing coverage improvements and monitoring, reported budget figures, and said a replacement proposal will be updated and reported to parliament every half year.
I will continue to inform you every half year about this state of affairs.
Ik zal u halfjaarlijks blijven informeren over deze stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over jongeren met een licht verstandelijke beperking in de criminaliteit

MP Mutluer asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about young people with mild intellectual disabilities being recruited into crime and exploited, and about police, care and information gaps. The government acknowledges overrepresentation in youth justice and difficulty for police in recognising the disability, points to ongoing prevention programmes, a forthcoming WODC study and a care-continuity study, but declines to launch new pilots.
We will ask the Scientific Research and Documentation Centre to conduct research on this, and will inform the House about it.
Wij zullen het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Documentatiecentrum vragen om hier onderzoek naar te doen, en zullen uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de strafbaarheid van “stealthing”

MP Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security how many reports of stealthing were filed in the past five years, how many criminal cases and what case law exist, whether current criminal law can punish it, and whether it should be explicitly criminalised. The Minister said stealthing is not a separate registered category so a file review would be needed, noted a Rotterdam court acquitted of rape but convicted for coercion while the prosecution appeals, and stated that stealthing falls under the proposed intentional rape offence in the sexual offences bill.
Stealthing is currently not a separate criminal offence or police recording category under which reports can be registered.
Stealthing is momenteel geen apart strafbaar feit of maatschappelijke klasse (categorie) waarop aangiftes in het politiesysteem geregistreerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Meer geld naar gokreclames in aanloop naar verbod’

MPs Van Nispen, Bikker and Mutluer asked why gambling advertising spending rose despite industry self-regulation promises, and when the promised ban would take effect. The Minister said a ban on untargeted online gambling advertising takes effect by 1 July 2023, that self-regulation is insufficient, and that he has repeatedly urged restraint from state-owned gambling companies.
The ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling will be adopted shortly and takes effect by 1 July 2023 at the latest.
Het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen wordt binnenkort vastgesteld en treedt uiterlijk per 1 juli 2023 in werking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij en Mutluer over het bericht 'Zorgen om online gokken in de klas: ‘Ze denken snel geld te verdienen’'

MPs from four parties asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health how minors gain access to online gambling accounts, whether gambling operators take age checks seriously, and when a ban on gambling advertising takes effect, including whether a two-strikes model should apply. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the Kansspelautoriteit has received no signals of circumvention, promises awareness activities and a ban on untargeted gambling ads by 1 July 2023, but rejects a two-strikes model as not fitting proportionate enforcement.
That is why I am doing everything I can to bring the ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling into effect as soon as possible.
Daarom stel ik alles in het werk om het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen zo snel mogelijk in werking te laten treden.
