Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Mutluer over het bericht dat pasfoto’s van buitenlanders ten onrechte door de politie gebruikt worden

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz and Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police use passport photos of foreigners from the CATCH-Vreemdelingen database, questioning the legal basis under the Aliens Act and whether it meets EU requirements. The Minister explains that police biometric experts run facial comparisons on the database only under Article 107(6) conditions, that the database is held separately from criminal law systems, and that practice applies the stricter conditions even to facial images, but does not concede any legal problem.
For the purposes of investigating and prosecuting criminal offences, the police do not have free access to the BVV and CATCH-Vreemdelingen.
De politie heeft ten behoeve van de opsporing en vervolging van strafbare feiten geen vrije toegang tot de BVV en CATCH-Vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat de politie kleine criminaliteit laat schieten

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a press report that police in Oost-Nederland leave minor crimes such as fraud, animal cruelty and small cannabis cultivation unpursued, and about the internal guidance document behind this and its impact on victims. The minister confirmed the document is an operational tool still under discussion with mayors, said it is not a list of crimes never pursued, acknowledged capacity shortages, and pointed to extra police capacity, restorative justice and the selectivity framework.
I cannot share it with your House for now, because it is still under discussion with the mayors in the Oost-Nederland regional unit.
Ik kan het nu nog niet delen met uw Kamer, omdat het nog onderwerp van bespreking is met de burgemeesters in de regionale eenheid Oost-Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de ernstige tekortkomingen bij jeugdgevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about inspectorates' warnings that youth detention facilities have reached a critical limit, including whether judges and placement decisions reflect shortages and whether minors are placed in adult prisons. The minister confirmed the warnings, acknowledged shortages, and said additional measures were taken, but gave partial answers and denied any opname-stop or minors in adult prisons, while noting that young adults may be held in remand centres.
I have not held talks with the inspectorates about this inspection letter.
Ik ben over deze inspectiebrief niet in gesprek geweest met de inspecties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Piri en Mutluer over het bericht dat de Duitse Rijksoverheid overweegt om mensen uit Turkije en Syrië die getroffen zijn door de aardbeving tijdelijk een visum te geven

MPs from the PvdA asked the Foreign Minister whether, following Germany and Belgium, the Netherlands would grant quick and simple visas to Turkish and Syrian earthquake victims with relatives in the Netherlands, and how visa policy is coordinated in Europe. The minister answered that first and second-degree relatives of Dutch residents already get priority visa processing under existing EU rules, with individual assessment and a 90-day Schengen visa, and described coordination with Schengen partners and EU bodies.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in close consultation with the Ministry of Justice and Security, facilitates first and second-degree relatives of Dutch residents from the earthquake area in applying for a Schengen visa.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken faciliteert, in nauwe samenspraak met het Ministerie van JenV, eerste/tweede graads-familieleden van Nederlanders uit het aardbevingsgebied bij de aanvraag van een Schengenvisum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het gebrek aan hulp aan gestrafte jongeren

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about reports that half of court-ordered help for young offenders is not provided or provided too late, and whether this raises reoffending. The government says such non-delivery is not registered, accepts that specialist help is needed and that it may contribute to reoffending, and points to ongoing procurement reforms and an exploration of youth-justice help without committing to central national arrangement.
I am working with the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport and the Association of Dutch Municipalities on the bill 'Act improving the availability of care for young people'.

Ik werk samen met de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) aan het wetvoorstel «Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid zorg voor jeugdigen»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de verharding van jeugdcriminaliteit

An MP asks the Justice and Security and Legal Protection ministers whether juvenile crime is becoming more violent and whether comprehensive research into its causes exists. The ministers acknowledge a rise in serious juvenile offences, list ongoing and completed studies (EPIC, WODC deelstudies, Bureau Beke), and say they agree overarching research is important without committing to a new study.
We also believe such research is of great importance and that is why it has been set in motion.
Wij zijn ook van mening dat dergelijk onderzoek van groot belang is en daarom is dat in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de racistische leuzen op de Erasmusbrug

An MP asked the Justice and Interior Ministers about racist slogans projected on the Erasmus Bridge during New Year's Eve, whether the government condemns them, whether further actions are planned, whether a criminal investigation will conclude soon, how to protect vulnerable youth, and how to coordinate with other countries. The government condemned the expressions, said a criminal investigation by the OM and police is ongoing and it cannot comment on it, described planned measures against radicalisation and online extremism, and referred to existing and forthcoming policy documents.
We cannot make further statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen wij geen verdere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de voortgang van interlandelijke adoptie

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the phase-out of intercountry adoption programmes would let pending adoption files, especially US cases, be completed or taken over by the new central mediation body (CBO), and whether affected parents had been promised that their procedures would be finished. The Minister confirmed that files in phase-out countries will not be transferred to the CBO, that existing mediators may continue until mid-2025, and that parents can switch to a continuing country instead.

Not burdening the CBO with the files in countries of origin with which the adoption relationship is ended does not mean that the adoption procedures of these prospective adoptive parents stop immediately.

Het niet belasten van de CBO met de dossiers die in landen van herkomst liggen waarmee de adoptierelatie wordt beëindigd houdt overigens niet in dat de adoptieprocedures van deze aspirant-adoptiefouders per direct stoppen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de uitvoering van de motie Mutluer om meer hoogopgeleide mensen bij de politie te krijgen

Mutluer (PvdA) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the motion to attract more highly educated people to the police is being implemented, including how many detectives and specialists are needed, whether the 720 specialist entry places suffice, and whether universities should provide specialist training. The minister answered that about a quarter of the 10,750 investigation staff are higher-educated, roughly 500 specialists a year are needed, the current 720 places are for now sufficient though labour shortages limit recruitment, and the Police Academy already cooperates with universities and universities of applied sciences.
The police do not work so much with a target figure, but with a staffing plan from which a recruitment task and an internal progression task with the associated training need follow.
De politie werkt niet zozeer met een streefcijfer, maar met een personeelsplan waaruit een wervingsopgave en een doorstroomopgave met bijbehorende opleidingsbehoefte volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Mutluer over ‘Het schrijnende tekort aan forensisch artsen’

MPs asked the ministers about the severe shortage of forensic doctors, including how often shifts went unfilled, whether child abuse evidence was lost, and what structural solutions exist. The government reported recurring unfilled shifts in some regions, no known cases of lost child-abuse evidence, a temporary arrangement through 2023 with a sustainable solution still being developed, and that more funding is still being sought.
This despite many forensic doctors already working more shifts than desired.
Dit ondanks dat veel forensisch artsen al meer diensten draaien dan gewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht 'Adviescommissie stapt op omdat minister ongeschikte notarissen benoemt'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the minister overrode negative advice from the notary-candidate advisory commission (CTN) on integrity and suitability, and how the appointment process works. The minister confirmed three overrides in 2022, explained the procedure, and stated that integrity violations cannot be ruled out but that appointments proceed only when concerns are adequately addressed; a new interim commission was appointed.
In 2022 I departed from a negative advice of the CTN in three cases.
In 2022 ben ik in drie gevallen afgeweken van een negatief advies van de CTN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Ellemeet over de behandeling van politieagenten die hebben meegewerkt aan de documentaire De Blauwe Familie

MPs Mutluer and Ellemeet asked the Justice Minister about the treatment of police officers who took part in the documentary De Blauwe Familie on racism within the police, including reports of no recognition or rehabilitation, a single commendation while others faced criminal proceedings, and a claimed unanswered call from the police chief. The Minister condemned racism, said the police leadership has contacted each participant and will be urged to pursue reconciliation, announced an action plan and a coordinator, and declined to comment on individual cases.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on individual cases.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Mohandis over criminelen die schoolkinderen ronselen met snus

MPs Mutluer and Mohandis asked the Justice Minister and the Health State Secretary about criminals recruiting schoolchildren with snus, including police handling, enforcement against snus sales and planned awareness campaigns. The minister acknowledged the concern, cited a broad youth crime prevention programme, said no police figures on the phenomenon exist, and pointed to ongoing NVWA enforcement and a forthcoming decision on a snus ban.
The police registrations contain no concrete indications of criminals recruiting schoolchildren with snus.
In de registraties van de politie zijn geen concrete aanwijzingen gevonden voor criminelen die schoolkinderen ronselen met snus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Mutluer over schulden bij publieke dienstverleners, waaronder politieagenten en andere ambtenaren

MPs Kuiken and Mutluer asked whether police officers and other civil servants in integrity-sensitive roles are screened for problematic debts, and what is being done given rising energy prices. The ministers confirm debt is a screening criterion for security clearances, describe monitoring of wage garnishments, and list existing support schemes (social funds, financial helplines, occupational social work) across police, central government, Defence and municipalities.
There is no central registration of problematic debts among civil servants as a whole.
Er is geen centrale registratie van problematische schulden onder overheidspersoneel als geheel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Baarle over het artikel 'Rekenkamer waarschuwt voor mogelijke 'vooringenomenheid bij politie-algoritmes' en het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer hierover

MPs Mutluer and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Court of Audit's finding on possible bias in police algorithms, including whether the audit applied the right legal framework (AVG instead of Wpg), privacy risks of the CAS system, reliance on citizen reports, and risks of indirect discrimination. The Minister answered that the Wpg and AVG are not interchangeable, that the police judged a data protection impact assessment not mandatory but is pursuing an AI impact assessment, that CAS output is area-based and excludes ethnicity variables while residual bias risks are being studied, and that the police will share a table of deployment counts per speerpunt.

Nevertheless, the House of Representatives (for example via the Standing Committee on Digital Affairs) has the option of asking the Court of Audit to further reflect on the findings concerning the CAS algorithm.

Desalniettemin bestaat voor de Tweede Kamer (bijvoorbeeld via de Vaste commissie Digitale Zaken) de mogelijkheid de Algemene Rekenkamer te vragen nader te reflecteren op de bevindingen rondom het algoritme van het CAS

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de te vormen Landelijke Eenheid opsporing in relatie tot de Nationale Samenwerking Ondermijnende Criminaliteit (NSOC) de opvolger van het Multidisciplinaire Interventieteam (MI

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the new national investigation unit (Landelijke Eenheid opsporing) relates to NSOC, the successor to the MIT, covering tasks, leadership, overlap, timing of plans and funding. The minister answered that the LE will be split into two units with tasks, steering and funding unchanged, that NSOC is a complementary cooperation rather than an investigative service, and gave the funding and operational results on request.
Once I have received the transition plan, I will ask the Schneiders committee to issue advice on it.
Zodra ik het transitieplan heb ontvangen, zal ik de commissie Schneiders vragen hierover een advies uit te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de investeringen tegen ondermijning

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that about 900 million euros spent against undermining crime (ondermijning) between 2017 and 2022 yielded little measurable result, and about the lack of a complete project list. The minister confirmed the 926 million total, explained the shift from incidental project funding to structural funding, admitted no definitive project list exists, and pointed to periodic progress letters for results.
I cannot provide a definitive list of all initiatives and projects financed with undermining funds.
Ik kan geen definitieve lijst verstrekken van alle initiatieven en projecten die met ondermijningsgelden zijn gefinancierd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over een incident van grensoverschrijdend gedrag binnen de tbs-kliniek Oostvaarders in Almere

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a sexual misconduct incident by an employee at the Oostvaarderskliniek tbs clinic, its adequacy of response, incident figures for that clinic and other tbs clinics, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The Minister found the individual response adequate but, given multiple reports, announced an external investigation, an interim director, Inspectorate involvement, and provided incident data while acknowledging inconsistent registration definitions.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security will be involved in setting up the investigation.
De Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid zal bij de opzet van het onderzoek betrokken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat kleinschalige jeugdgevangenissen leegstaan

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why five small-scale youth detention units (KVJJ) are largely empty, how placement decisions are made, and whether the DIZ division rather than judges should decide placement. The minister answers that the units are underused due to slow referral, that placement criteria are being revised, and that centralised DIZ decision-making ensures uniformity, while promising a monitor report in April 2023.
Judges can give advice on the place of enforcement (such as a KVJJ).
Rechters kunnen over de plaats van tenuitvoerlegging (zoals een KVJJ) advies uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de tbs-capaciteit

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the rise in TBS (forensic psychiatric) orders, bed capacity, staffing, waiting prisoners, and staff workload and wellbeing. The Minister confirmed a 58% rise in orders since 2017, outlined capacity growth, budget increases, procurement changes and recruitment efforts, while acknowledging waiting lists and a tight labour market.
As of 5 September 2022, 118 people in the prison system are waiting for a place in a TBS clinic, 73 of them in a Penitentiary Psychiatric Centre (PPC).
Op peildatum 5 september 2022 wachten er 118 personen in het gevangeniswezen op een plek in een TBS-kliniek, waarvan 73 in een Penitentiair Psychiatrisch Centrum (PPC).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat leden van de zogenoemde Mocro-Maffia vanuit de gevangenis nieuwe misdrijven voorbereiden

An MP asked whether authorities fear that imprisoned leaders of the Mocro-maffia still prepare crimes from detention, and what has been done to stop this. The minister confirms the concern, says current measures are insufficient for a specific group, and announces stricter EBI detention regime and new legislation, while declining to discuss specific investigations.
I cannot go into any criminal investigations or the indications underlying them at this moment.
Op eventuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken en aanwijzingen die daaraan ten grondslag liggen kan ik op dit moment niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de 1500 geseponeerde zaken bij rechtbank Gelderland

An MP asks whether victims learned of the dismissal of 1,500 cases at Gelderland court through the media before receiving OM notices, and about compensation, restorative justice and victims' speaking rights in OM penal orders. The minister acknowledges the communication could have been better, explains compensation for victims of cases dismissed for delay, and says the speaking-rights issue will be discussed with the College of Procurators-General.
The OM attaches great value to careful communication towards victims.
Het OM hecht grote waarde aan een zorgvuldige communicatie richting slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Mutluer over de indexatie van verkeersboetes

MPs Mutluer and Kathmann asked whether the government will index traffic fines to inflation during a cost-of-living crisis and whether it will exempt them, and how many fines were imposed, unpaid, or led to debt. The Minister of Justice and Security replied that fines are indexed annually to correct for price erosion, that the government will address inflation impacts through other means, and that a review of the indexation method is planned.
I have instructed my department to review the long-standing system for indexing Wahv fines based on inflation.
Wel heb ik mijn departement opdracht gegeven om de reeds lang bestaande systematiek voor de indexering van Wahv-boetes gebaseerd op de inflatie tegen het licht te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Mutluer over mbo-studenten die niet worden toegelaten in Utrechtse cafés, andere uitgaansgelegenheden en sportfaciliteiten

MPs De Hoop and Mutluer asked whether refusing mbo students at Utrecht bars and sports facilities, while admitting university and HBO students, amounts to discrimination and whether it is covered by the constitutional non-discrimination clause. The minister condemned the unequal treatment and noted a conversation with the café owner, but said refusal by level of education is not legally prohibited and falls outside the equal-treatment statutes, relying on moral persuasion and a forthcoming mbo work agenda.
In horizontal legal relationships, meaning relations between citizens, citizens can invoke various equal treatment laws
In horizontale rechtsverhoudingen, waarmee de relatie tussen burgers onderling wordt bedoeld, kunnen burgers wel een beroep doen op verschillende gelijke behandelingswetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Mutluer over het bericht Prijsexplosie GHB vanwege oorlog in Oekraïne, verslaafden stoppen met de drug

MPs Bikker and Mutluer asked whether the government will expand outreach and addiction care for GHB users after reports of a price spike that could push users to stop abruptly or switch to other drugs. The State Secretary answered that substitution is undesirable, pointed to existing addiction-care initiatives, online information and monitoring, and to the government's drug-prevention and organised-crime policy, without committing to new concrete steps.
Given the concern raised by Novadic-Kentron, we remain alert to signals that give cause for intervention.
Gelet op de vrees van Novadic-Kentron blijven we alert op signalen die aanleiding geven tot ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het beperkt zicht op het ronselen van jongeren voor gedwongen criminaliteit

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the limited visibility of youths recruited into forced criminality, citing a CKM report estimating about 2,500 suspected victims versus 672 registered victims. The minister agreed criminal exploitation belongs within the fight against undermining crime, pointed to prevention programmes, data-sharing challenges, victim protection measures and planned follow-up research, but did not commit to new specific extra budget beyond existing funding.
The contrast in figures is partly due to data sharing and the challenges surrounding it.
Het contrast in cijfers heeft enerzijds te maken met gegevensdeling en de uitdagingen hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat een vanwege een personeelstekort bij de rechtbank Gelderland zaken niet meer voor de rechter worden gebracht

MP Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about reports that about 1500 criminal cases at the Gelderland district court will be dropped (sepot) due to staff shortages, and whether this is symptomatic elsewhere and how victims will be compensated. The minister acknowledged the shortage and regret, said about 90% of those cases will be dismissed, admitted victims may be harmed and promised to explore compensation and a letter to victims, and to discuss victims' speaking rights for OM penal orders with the College of Procurators-General.
That is why it is being examined how best to meet the victims' needs.
Daarom wordt gekeken op welke wijze het beste tegemoet kan worden gekomen aan de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Nauwere samenwerking tussen Nederlandse en Marokkaanse politie’

MPs Piri and Mutluer asked the government why it pursued closer police cooperation with Morocco before answering earlier questions, and whether this could intimidate Moroccan political opponents in the Netherlands given past torture and spyware allegations. The minister answered that Morocco is an important partner against organised crime, that an extradition treaty would only be explored, and that the government finds the alleged spyware use unacceptable, while leaving the allegations to Moroccan authorities and deferring the written consultation answers to a later date.
The visit of the police chief to Morocco was intended as a get-to-know-you meeting, to strengthen relations and discuss mutual interests in better cooperation to combat organised crime.

Het bezoek van de korpschef aan Marokko stond in het teken van nadere kennismaking, het aanhalen van de relaties en het bespreken van de wederzijdse belangen in betere samenwerking om georganiseerde criminaliteit te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Baarle over de mogelijke vooringenomenheid bij algoritmes gebruikt door de Politie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about possible bias in the police predictive algorithm CAS, following an Audit Office report, and whether the system should be suspended. The minister answered that the police have been asked to tighten control procedures, that the system's variables do not include nationality, and that suspension is not necessary now, citing mitigating measures on governance and accountability.
I have therefore asked the police to tighten the procedures for recording these checks in the regular process.
Ik heb de politie daarom gevraagd om in het reguliere proces de procedures voor het vastleggen van deze controles aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over risicoprofilering door de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND)

MP Mutluer asked the government about the IND's risk model for recognised sponsors, which since 2014 recorded the ethnic background of company boards and continued until May 2021 despite internal warnings. The State Secretary admitted the registration should not have happened, said it had no effect on decisions, and announced a new risk model under review by TNO.
I want to state at the outset that registering the origin of the company board should not have happened.
Ik wil voorop stellen dat het registreren van de afkomst van het bedrijfsbestuur niet had mogen gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het tekort aan forensisch artsen

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the shortage of forensic doctors, which the GGD says leaves evidence of sexual offences and child abuse undetected and forces choices between autopsies and injury examinations, and whether €20 million a year would be provided to NFI and GGDs. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to temporary fixes, a noodmaatregel letting basic doctors perform autopsies under conditions, regional cooperation, and task-shifting pilots, but gave no immediate structural funding commitment.
Finding solutions to the capacity shortage therefore has the highest priority for me and my colleagues at VWS and BZK.
Het vinden van oplossingen voor het capaciteitstekort heeft daarom de hoogste prioriteit van mij en mijn collega's van VWS en BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de bescherming van LHBTI+’ers

MP Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about protecting LHBTI people from violence and discrimination, including discrimination data, prosecution rates, discrimination detectives, a bill on higher penalties for discriminatory intent, and medical treatment of intersex children. The minister answered that the government shares the concern, cites the Regenboogakkoord, the action plan, a research project and 2 million euro for police, provides discrimination statistics, and says the bill is being considered with Raad van State advice and that the intersex treatment question lies with medical professionals and a planned quality standard.
I expect that this knowledge can also contribute to further policy and initiatives aimed at combating violence against LHBTI persons.
Ik ga ervan uit dat deze kennis ook kan bijdragen aan verder beleid en initiatieven gericht op het tegengaan van geweld tegen LHBTI-personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Mutluer over demonstraties bij abortusklinieken

MPs Ellemeet and Mutluer asked the minister whether a national ban on demonstrations at abortion clinics is desirable, given reported intimidation of women and inconsistent local rules. The minister answered that demonstrations are protected by fundamental rights, that content cannot ground restrictions, that local mayors and police/prosecutors handle enforcement, and that he will consult clinics and the NGvA, without committing to a national ban.
Taking measures is therefore a local matter, and it is up to the police and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) to enforce.
Het treffen van maatregelen is dus een lokale aangelegenheid, en het is aan de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat er steeds meer zedenzaken op de plank belanden

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that sexual offence cases are increasingly stalled, the risk this poses to victims' willingness to report, and what is being done about delays and the rights and information of victims. The minister acknowledged that the professional case-handling norms have not been met for years, announced new agreements with the police, prosecution and judiciary and a separate letter to parliament in May, while largely defending complexity and quality as reasons for longer timelines.
Nevertheless, I note that, despite improvement measures in recent years, the professional case-handling norms have not been met in recent years.
Toch constateer ik dat, ondanks de verbetermaatregelen uit de afgelopen jaren, de professionele ketennormen de laatste jaren niet worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over grensoverschrijdend gedrag bij de politie

MP Mutluer asked the Minister of Justice and Security about cross-boundary misconduct (bullying, discrimination, harassment) within the police, including its causes, reporting channels, independent investigation and external expertise. The minister acknowledged higher-than-average rates, attributed them to team and workload factors, described existing reporting channels including the police ombudsman, and said further steps would be reported to parliament in autumn 2022.
I aim to inform your House about this in the autumn.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover te informeren in het najaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het uitsluitbeleid van Jehovah’s Getuigen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the shunning policy of Jehovah's Witnesses, its psychological harm, research, possible criminal or tax measures, and steps taken to protect victims. The minister acknowledges the harm, notes shunning is not itself a crime but related conduct may fall under existing criminal provisions, promises a cabinet reaction by 1 June, and reports an expert commission reviewing ANBI tax status.
I am closely following the reports about the complaint filed by the Dutch Committee Against JW's Shunning: Now is the time.
Ik volg de berichtgeving omtrent de aangifte die is gedaan door het Dutch Committee Against JW's Shunning: Now is the time daarom nauwgezet.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Heera Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland moet zich uitspreken tegen grote militaire actie in Cariben

MPs Ceder and Heera Dijk asked the government how it responds to the US military operation 'Southern Spear' against alleged drug boats in the Caribbean, whether it will call for independent investigation, whether US use of Curaçao facilities played a role, and whether it will inform the House. The government says the Kingdom is not involved in the US national operation, stresses adherence to international law without judging the US self-defence claim, notes only unarmed surveillance flights are covered by the 2000 facilities treaty, and leaves independent investigation primarily to the US while referring to diplomatic channels.
The Kingdom is not involved in the national US deployment in international waters and international airspace.
Het Koninkrijk is niet betrokken bij de nationale inzet vanuit de VS in de internationale wateren en het internationale luchtruim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heera Dijk over het bericht dat het Van Gogh Museum de deuren dreigt te sluiten

MP Heera Dijk asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that the Van Gogh Museum may close, probing state ownership of the building, safety and maintenance norms, the adequacy of the housing subsidy, security and the 1962 agreement. The Minister replied that since 2017 the museum bears full maintenance responsibility, that the housing subsidy is adequate, and that the museum has reserves and alternative financing options, while sharing a redacted expert report.
After assessing this objection, I have decided not to make part of the information public, in view of commercial sensitivity and the continuity of the museum.
Na beoordeling van deze zienswijze heb ik besloten een deel van de informatie niet openbaar te maken in het kader van bedrijfsgevoeligheid en continuïteit van het museum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heera Dijk en Rooderkerk over de doorstroomtoets op de BES-eilanden

MPs Heera Dijk and Rooderkerk asked whether the mandatory Doorstroomtoets Bonaire, replacing the IEP test for 2025-2026, can be combined with the IEP test and whether early testing and unvalidated predictive value pose risks for Bonaire pupils. The state secretary confirmed the statutory obligation, rejected dual testing as infeasible, defended the early testing date and the test's quality, and committed to talks with school boards and an evaluation with the Chamber.
That is why I support administering this test this school year.
Daarom sta ik er ook achter om deze toets dit schooljaar af te nemen.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over intimiderende demonstraties bij abortusklinieken en scholen

MP Paulusma asked the state secretaries about intimidating demonstrations near abortion clinics and schools, including whether a buffer zone could be legislated and whether data and municipal guidance are needed. The government condemns intimidation but says demonstrations are protected, leaves enforcement to mayors and police, and points to a pending WODC study to be published in November before deciding on further legislation.
After publication of this study it will be considered whether further legislation is desirable.
Na publicatie van dit onderzoek zal worden bezien of nadere wetgeving wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over RSvirus immunisatie voor alle kinderen in het eerste levensjaar

An MP asked why infants under one year old but born before 1 April 2025 are excluded from the RS-virus immunisation, despite the earlier commitment to cover all infants in their first year. The state secretary answered that the programme starts with babies born from 1 April 2025 because older infants have lower risk, and refused to extend eligibility as this would strain youth health care planning and capacity.
No. Extending the target group to children born before 1 April 2025 is not feasible.
Nee. Het uitbreiden van de doelgroep naar kinderen die vóór 1 april 2025 geboren zijn, is niet uitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over opnemen van Palestijnse patiënten uit Gaza

MPs Bamenga, Paternotte and Paulusma (D66) asked why the Netherlands has not admitted any Palestinian patients from Gaza for treatment, while many Western European countries have, and whether this breaches international obligations, including the ICJ ruling and the WHO appeals. The government answers that it prioritises regional treatment and financial and diplomatic support for medical evacuations, cites funding amounts, and says it will continue pressing Israel to allow more evacuations, without committing to bring patients to the Netherlands.
The cabinet focuses on treating seriously ill patients in the region.
Het kabinet zet in op behandeling van ernstig zieke patiënten in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga, Paternotte en Paulusma over medische evacuaties uit Gaza

D66 MPs asked the government to release a study by two former ambassadors on medical evacuations from Gaza, to explain why the Netherlands does not take patients while many European states do, and to take in a contingent of patients. The government refused to share the study, said it prioritises support for care in the region over evacuation to the Netherlands, and listed financial contributions and a contact point for medical professionals.
The exploration discussed during the RDINEV is confidential and will not be shared with your House to protect the unity of Cabinet policy.
De verkenning die tijdens de RDINEV werd besproken is vertrouwelijk, en wordt niet met uw Kamer gedeeld ter bescherming van de eenheid van Kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Paulusma en Bamenga over een mogelijk naderend staakt-het-vuren in Gaza

MPs from D66 asked the government about a possible Gaza ceasefire, humanitarian access, the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation model, medical evacuations and dual-use restrictions on prosthetics. The minister answered that Nederland demands unhindered humanitarian access through UN-led channels, rejects the GHF model, and will support medical capacity in the region and the WHO, but does not consider evacuation to the Netherlands desirable at present.
The cabinet cannot verify these figures.
Het kabinet kan deze cijfers niet verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over medicinale cannabis

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the Health Minister about delays to the medicinal cannabis policy, supply continuity for patients, the closing of the procurement for a second grower, reimbursement and inspection capacity. The Minister said the policy rule and law change will proceed on schedule, supply will come from existing stock with a fallback import plan, and no new plans exist to change the current variety offer or reimbursement.
The Ministry of VWS will then proceed to import medicinal cannabis as a finished product.
Het Ministerie van VWS zal dan overgaan tot import van medicinale cannabis als «gereed product».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de verwachte toename van geslachtsziekten en ongewenste zwangerschappen door bezuinigingen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether cuts to sexual health services and prevention would increase STIs and unwanted pregnancies, and what the effects, capacity impacts and monitoring would be. The State Secretary answered that the 10% cut to the ASG sexual health scheme from 2026 will mainly reduce care, that effects were not studied, that the impact is hard to quantify, and that the Chamber was informed on 18 June 2025.
No study has been carried out into the expected effects of this cut.
Er is geen onderzoek verricht naar de verwachte effecten van deze bezuiniging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Paulusma, Bikker en Krul over het beëindigen van de VWS-subsidie aan het IKNL Trialbureau

MPs asked why the minister is ending the VWS subsidy for the IKNL trial bureau, its amount, timing, alternatives and impact. The minister confirmed the subsidy for trial activities ends on 1 January 2026 on state aid grounds, stated the 2025 amount, and declined substantive answers on alternatives and timing because an objection by IKNL is pending.
Because of this ongoing objection procedure, I cannot make any further substantive statements.
Vanwege deze lopende bezwaarprocedure kan ik daarom verder geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Bushoff over de oproep van Stichting Donorkind tot persoonlijk geïnformeerd worden vanwege overschrijdingen aantal donorkinderen per donor

MPs Paulusma and Bushoff asked the state secretary about donor-limit breaches in Dutch fertility clinics and whether affected donor children, mothers and donors would be contacted personally, plus steps against cross-border donation. The state secretary confirmed 85 donors exceeded the 25-offspring guideline, said clinics and the CdkB are responsible for communication, promised a faciliterende role, and described the new Wdkb monitoring and planned BRP authorisations, while declining to know cross-border donor use.
The clinics and the CdkB are responsible for communication towards all those involved.
De klinieken en het Cdkb zijn verantwoordelijk voor de communicatie richting alle betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de stijging van jongeren en mannen in de bijstand

MP Paulusma asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the rise in young people and men on social assistance, including a possible labour-market mismatch, the 2026 municipal fund cut and the Borstlap advice. The State Secretary acknowledges the rise, cites several possible causes, points to existing and planned measures such as Participatiewet in balans and Van school naar duurzaam werk, and says a fuller policy review will be sent to parliament before the summer recess.
The cabinet wants to help as many people who can work into work as possible.
Het kabinet wil zoveel mogelijk mensen die kunnen werken aan het werk helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over regulering van bestrijdingsmiddelen

Two D66 MPs asked about the difference between low- and high-risk pesticides, health risks to farmers, residents and children, and whether municipalities can regulate pesticides and set spray-free zones. The minister explains the EU categories (candidates for substitution are approved for 7 years with comparative assessment), states that no carcinogenic substances are approved and that the RIVM is researching Parkinson, COPD and leukaemia, promises to improve municipal knowledge and information, but declines to set a national spray-free zone rule pending a research plan.
I maintain close contact with the VNG on the pesticide policy field.
Ik onderhoud nauw contact met de VNG over het beleidsterrein gewasbescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de oproep van het Nederlands Genootschap van Abortusartsen (NGvA), om tegen de motie De Korte / Bikker (Kamerstuk 36600-XVI-174) te stemmen

MP Paulusma asks the state secretary for health how he reflects on the NGvA abortion doctors' call to vote against the De Korte/Bikker motion and whether registering reasons for abortion undermines women's autonomy and access to care. The state secretary says mandatory registration of reasons is unacceptable and not legally provided for, that the motion's evaluation of rising abortion numbers does not require reason-gathering, and that researchers will be asked to look at broader factors such as contraception and disinformation.
A registration obligation for motives does not fit here and may give a woman the feeling that she must justify her decision.
Een registratieplicht van motieven past hier niet bij en kan een vrouw het gevoel geven dat ze zich moet verantwoorden voor haar besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de alternatieve dekking door geld uit de wijkverpleging te halen

An MP from D66 asks Minister Agema why the wijkverpleging (district nursing) budget was chosen to cover a €165 million shortfall, what the consequences are for care and staffing, and whether the Integraal Zorgakkoord is put at risk. The minister replies that the underspending is structural and reallocating it does not affect district nursing services or IZA commitments, and that consultation with stakeholders took place.
This is explicitly not a cut to the funds needed for district nursing.
Het betreft nadrukkelijk géén bezuiniging op de benodigde middelen voor wijkverpleging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over veehouderij en gezondheid omwonenden (VGO-III)

MPs Podt and Paulusma asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Health about the health risks for residents living near goat farms, including the rising goat numbers despite earlier advice on distances, the lack of causal proof, and whether direct measures will follow. The ministers answered that the risks are taken seriously, that the Health Council has been asked to advise in two parts (June and November 2025) before any follow-up policy is decided, and that talks with provinces and a WUR advice on reducing pathogens in stables are underway.
We take the health risks shown in the VGO-III report very seriously.
De gezondheidsrisico’s die uit het VGO-III rapport blijken, nemen we heel serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Rooderkerk over het bericht 'De impact van vervuilende industrie op burgers en overheden'

MPs Paulusma and Rooderkerk asked the Health Minister about health risks from polluting industry, climate change, air quality, housing, zoonoses, pandemic preparedness and budget cuts. The minister answered that climate change poses health risks, that industrial clusters are regulated regionally, that work on industry and residents is ongoing, and that funding decisions are still pending.
Much work has been done in recent years to improve our pandemic preparedness.
Er is in de afgelopen jaren hard gewerkt aan het verbeteren van onze pandemische paraatheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de uitzending De onmisbaren: Huisartsen

MP Paulusma asked the Minister of Health about a broadcast on GPs, covering the number of people without a GP, GP numbers and regional shortages, practice premises, NZa tariffs, the shift towards locum work, and use of thuisarts.nl. The minister answered in detail with data from Nivel and the NZa, noting that a 0.3% share of adults lack a registered GP and that a national action plan is in progress, but gave few commitments beyond a forthcoming Nivel study on patient stops.
I expect to be able to inform your House about this soon.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer hier spoedig over te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Alarm om stijgende kosten kinderopvang: ouders straks tot duizend euro meer kwijt’

Paulusma (D66) asked the state secretary about a report that parents face up to a thousand euros more in childcare costs in 2026 because maximum hourly rates will not be indexed, and about effects on low incomes, participation and labour supply. The state secretary disputed the single-figure claim, gave illustrative calculations showing the parent contribution share rising for low and middle incomes in 2026 while higher subsidy rates offset it for higher incomes, and said effects on usage and work hours cannot be predicted precisely.
I intend to send the draft decree containing the 2026 reimbursement percentages to the House before the summer for the pre-consultation procedure.
Ik ben voornemens het ontwerpbesluit met daarin de vergoedingspercentages voor 2026 nog voor de zomer aan uw Kamer te zenden voor de voorhangprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht 'Minister Fleur Agema (PVV) past haar bezuinigingsplannen voor de zorg voor onverzekerden aan na kritiek op haar uitspraken in Zembla'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health about press reports that she planned to cut the SOV scheme for uninsured care by lowering doctors' fees, and about related questions on access, acute care and international practice. The minister answered that the €40m cut is tied to reducing uninsured people, that a merged new scheme is being prepared, that a research trajectory with Rotterdam is planned, and that she shared no plans with the press beyond the 18 December letter.
I explained my plans in my letter of 18 December 2024. I have no plans other than those I shared with the press.
Ik heb mijn plannen toegelicht in mijn brief van 18 december 2024. Ik heb geen andere plannen dan deze gedeeld met de pers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de pandemische paraatheid van Nederland in het licht van recente internationale ontwikkelingen en aangekondigde bezuinigingen

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the ministers about Dutch pandemic preparedness amid international outbreaks, planned budget cuts of 300 million euros, staffing, vaccination willingness, and bird flu risks. The government answered largely by describing existing EU frameworks and programmes, noting that cuts are phased in and clarity will come mid-2025, and committing to further analysis and studies on bird flu structural measures.
The Ministry of VWS expects to be able to provide more clarity on funding for 2026 and beyond by mid-2025.
Het Ministerie van VWS verwacht medio 2025 meer duidelijkheid te kunnen geven over de middelen voor 2026 en verder.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de Internationale Dag van de Migraine en het bericht 'Elke dag hebben 70.000 mensen een migraineaanval, maar de meeste gaan pas na een jaar naar de dokter'

An MP from D66 asks the health minister why migraine research is narrowed to hormonal causes rather than access-to-care bottlenecks, and about GP guidance, workplace reporting, and a public campaign. The minister says hormonal research is one part of a women's health programme, a Zorginstituut advice on reimbursement is pending, no data exist on workplace reporting, and a national campaign is not the ministry's role.
In response to these parliamentary questions I have asked ZonMw to at least put the issue of access to care on the agenda for this consultation.
Ik heb ZonMw naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen gevraagd het vraagstuk van de toegang tot zorg in elk geval te agenderen voor deze consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Minister Agema 'heel erg bezorgd' over bezuinigingen zorg’

An MP asked the Health Minister how she was involved in negotiating health-sector budget cuts used as cover for an education budget amendment, and what information was exchanged. The minister answered that ministry officials discussed the health measures with the education and finance ministries, that the health ministry gave no information to negotiating parties, and that the finance ministry's information was sent to parliament; the cut plan was later changed by a parliamentary motion.
The Ministry of VWS has not provided any information regarding the cuts to the negotiating parties.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen informatie met betrekking tot de bezuinigingen verstrekt aan de onderhandelende partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Westerveld, Paulusma, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Teunissen over de gevolgen van de overwinning van Trump voor vrouwen wereldwijd

Six MPs asked the ministers how Trump's return and the expanded Mexico City Policy (Global Gag Rule) would affect women's health and abortion access worldwide, and what the Netherlands would do to fill any gap. The minister confirmed awareness of the policy and Project 2025 but declined to speculate on US changes, pointing instead to a forthcoming development policy letter and continued Dutch commitment to partners.
The cabinet is not anticipating that.
Het kabinet loopt daar niet op vooruit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Paulusma over het artikel 'Aidsfonds maakt zich zorgen over stijging hiv-infecties bij jonge mannen'

MPs Rooderkerk and Paulusma asked the State Secretary of Health about rising HIV diagnoses among young men, the effectiveness of PrEP and condom campaigns, budget cuts to prevention, and whether Amsterdam's approach can be scaled nationally. The State Secretary acknowledged the rise, described PrEP-care and prevention measures, said that cuts to specific grants are under review with decisions due early next year, and promised a monitoring update before summer.
I will inform your House about this in more detail before the summer.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover voor de zomer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Paulusma over de voorbereiding op het vaker opduiken van fentanyl in Nederland

MPs Sneller and Paulusma (D66) asked the State Secretary for Health about preparedness for fentanyl and synthetic opioids appearing more often in the Netherlands, including warnings from Belgium, monitoring of vulnerable groups, prevention budgets and the planned cuts to prevention, harm reduction and the Mainline subsidy. The State Secretary answered that no signals yet show synthetic opioids gaining ground, that a preparedness scan and a ban on risky new psychoactive substances are underway, but defended the budget cuts as necessary while stating that enough funding remains.
The Trimbos Institute has been commissioned in this context to produce a preparedness scan aimed at preventing harmful effects of synthetic opioids.
Het Trimbos-instituut heeft in dat kader opdracht gekregen om te komen tot een preparedness-scan gericht op voorkoming van schadelijke effecten van synthetische opioïden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht 'Toezichthouder: toegankelijkheid jeugdzorg onder druk'

MP Paulusma asked the State Secretary for Health about the Youth Authority's finding that access to youth care is under pressure, including waiting lists, data quality, personnel shortages, municipal overspending and prevention. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the Reform Agenda, the bill on availability of youth care, data and monitoring work, and a forthcoming expert commission advice, but gave no national waiting-list figures and declined further research on municipal top-up spending.
Figures on waiting times are not available at the national level.
Cijfers over wachttijden zijn niet op landelijk niveau beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de Internationale Dag van de Migraine en het bericht ‘Elke dag hebben 70.000 mensen een migraineaanval, maar de meesten gaan pas na een jaar naar de dokter’

An MP asked the health minister about migraine, its underdiagnosis and undertreatment, and its large workplace costs, following a news report. The minister acknowledged the gap in care and research, pointed to planned women's health research, referred to existing guidance and funding, and said cross-ministry work on sickness absence is ongoing.
I therefore consider it important that more knowledge comes about this.
Ik vind het dan ook belangrijk dat hierover meer kennis komt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Incassobureaus overtreden de wet: ‘Zorgelijk’’

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked about reports that debt collection agencies break the law, how many were inspected, and what the government will do for affected debtors and whether enforcement can start earlier. The government answered that the Inspectorate visited 11 agencies but cannot disclose violation details, that the inspectorate is independent and will keep a information-and-encouragement approach until 2025, and that the minister cannot direct enforcement.
It is up to the Inspectorate JenV to publish, if legally possible, how it shapes its supervision of debt collection agencies and which violations it finds.
Het is aan de Inspectie JenV om (indien juridisch mogelijk) te publiceren over hoe zij het toezicht op incassodienstverleners vormgeeft en welke overtredingen zij daarbij constateert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis, Inge van Dijk, van Eijk en Paulusma over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs from several parties asked the government why victims of abuse in the dance world feel that compensation, apologies and trauma care are missing, and why the answers to earlier questions were so cold. The government replies that it relies on the Alliantie Dans Veilig and two new commissions, refers trauma care to existing mental health providers, says compensation is for the sector and civil or criminal law, and promises continued involvement without committing to new measures.
As for compensation for victims, that is a matter for the sector itself. It is not the role of the government here.
Wat betreft een tegemoetkoming aan slachtoffers is dat aan de sector zelf. Dat is hier niet de rol van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Paulusma over de dreiging op een moedwillige uitbraak van het MPOX-virus door een agressor

MPs Bushoff and Paulusma asked the Minister of Health what underpins the claimed threat of deliberate spread of the mpox virus by an aggressor, and whether supporting documents exist and whether the threat has changed since the stockpile was built. The Minister corrects the framing to smallpox, says there is no specific threat of deliberate mpox spread, refers to the 2022 national security risk analysis for bioweapon threats, and states Dutch preparedness includes smallpox vaccine stocks and guidance on anthrax and plague.
Other services are responsible for assessing whether such a threat exists.
Voor een inschatting over het bestaan van een dergelijke dreiging zijn andere diensten verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht 'Artsen zonder Grenzen: snel meer vaccins nodig tegen mpox Afrika'

Deputy Paulusma asked the Health Minister why the Netherlands would not send mpox vaccines to Africa as the WHO requested, and how this fits with pandemic preparedness lessons. Minister Agema agreed donations can help, but said Dutch stockpiles of about 100,000 doses must be kept for national preparedness and that outbreak control at the source comes first.
I therefore choose to keep the current stock of vaccines for the national preparedness of our country at the safe level of around 100,000.
Ik kies er daarom voor om de huidige voorraad vaccins voor de nationale paraatheid van ons land op het veilige niveau van ongeveer 100.000 te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Bamenga en Rooderkerk over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs from D66 asked the government to react to news that residents near heavy industry have higher healthcare costs, and about health data, pollution, legal enforcement of permits and the Tata Steel negotiations. The government answered that health depends on many factors so the link to industry is not direct, that no specific national data exists but further research (RIVM studies, a health impact method for permits under the Omgevingswet) is underway, and that enforcement tools lie with provinces and municipalities.
No, such insight specifically for residents of industry does not exist, and this possible link cannot simply be demonstrated, because it depends on many factors.
Nee, dergelijk inzicht speciaal voor omwonenden van de industrie bestaat niet en dit eventuele verband is ook niet zomaar aan te tonen, omdat het afhangt van veel factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het artikel 'Psychiaters eisen strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar euthanasie van Milou (17)'

Paulusma (D66) asked about psychiatrists' demand for a criminal investigation into the euthanasia of a 17-year-old, after the regional review committee judged it careful. The government answered that criminal investigation is only warranted where the review committee finds a breach, that the Public Prosecution Service saw no reason to investigate, and that it supports ThaNet efforts to build expertise on euthanasia in psychiatric cases.
The Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to start a criminal investigation in this case.
Het OM ziet geen reden om in dit geval een strafrechtelijk onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Paternotte over het bericht 'Zeker 29 doden bij Russische aanval op Oekraïne, kinderziekenhuis in Kyiv geraakt'

Two D66 MPs asked the health and foreign ministers how the Netherlands responds to a Russian strike that hit a children's hospital in Kyiv, including whether Dutch care for injured Ukrainian children could be arranged. Minister Agema answered that Dutch care is provided through the EU Medevac route, that care is first sought within Ukraine, and that the national patient-allocation centre will screen and match patients once Ukraine requests evacuations.

Once the Ukrainian government requests medical evacuations, the National Patient Distribution Centre (LCPS) will immediately arrange screening and matching of patients with care capacity in the Netherlands.

Zodra de Oekraïense regering verzoekt om medische evacuaties, zal het Landelijk Centrum Patiëntenspreiding (LCPS) per omgaande zorgdragen voor screening en matching van patiënten met de zorgcapaciteit in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis , Inge van Dijk, Van Eijk en Paulusma over de afhandeling van de misstanden in de danswereld en de omgang met slachtoffers

MPs asked the Minister of VWS and the State Secretary of OCW how the government is handling misconduct in the dance sector, including compensation, apologies, trauma care for victims, and the status of adopted motions. The government responded that the Alliantie Dans Veilig, with recognition statements, support networks, OCW dance round tables and a school-level social safety programme, is taking action, while leaving the date for compensation and the sports-offender ban to a separate letter on motions.

Recently the omnibus letter on motions and commitments on sport and exercise was sent by the Minister of VWS to the House of Representatives, and the motions concerning the dance sector form part of it.

Onlangs is de verzamelbrief over de moties en toezeggingen sport en bewegen door de Minister van VWS naar de Tweede Kamer verzonden, de moties met betrekking tot de danssector vormen daar onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars overstappers belemmeren waardoor de premie onnodig hoog is

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about reports that health insurers hinder switching, keeping premiums unnecessarily high, and about the effects on low-income groups, market oversight and basic-policy complexity. The minister acknowledges the issue, points to NZa information rules and planned exploration of more active notification, says no research into income groups will be commissioned, and notes that investigations by ACM and NZa are independent and confidential.
I will not commission research into the switching behaviour of different income groups.
Ik zal geen onderzoek uitzetten naar het overstapgedrag van verschillende inkomensgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat het aantal mensen in Nederland met gonorroe flink doorstijgt

MP Paulusma asked the ministers about the rise in gonorrhoea and falling condom use among young people, and about access to STI care, prevention campaigns, municipal funding and sexual health education. The State Secretary answered that the trends are worrying but not yet calling for acute action, that further research and policy decisions on sexual health care are pending for a next cabinet, and that no measures were accelerated.
Decision-making on the system and financing of (supplementary) sexual health care, however, is left to a next cabinet.
Besluitvorming over het stelsel en financiering van de (aanvullende) seksuele gezondheidszorg is echter aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over verspreiding van medische misinformatie op sociale media

An MP asks the government how it responds to the spread of medical misinformation on social media, its effects on trust in vaccination, contraception and maternity care, and whether platforms and regulators under the DSA should act. The government answers that it relies on platform responsibilities under the DSA, the Commission's enforcement, prebunking, trusted doctors' initiatives and public information, and declines to regulate content or require BIG registration for information-sharers.
It is still too early to assess whether very large online platforms and search engines are taking sufficient measures to mitigate that risk.
Het is nu nog te vroeg om te kunnen beoordelen of zeer grote online platforms en zoekmachines voldoende maatregelen nemen om dat risico te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat ouders alarm slaan over demonenuitdrijvingen en mishandelingen bij kinderen met autisme op een zorgboerderij in Wekerom

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports of demon-exorcism and abuse of children with autism at a care farm in Wekerom, including questions on oversight, profit and ANBI status. The government said the IGJ is investigating five recent reports, that religious freedom limits banning prayer healing, and that ANBI status is assessed neutrally, while committing to no new investigations beyond existing inspections.
The IGJ is currently examining the content of these reports and will determine any follow-up actions based on its investigation.
De IGJ onderzoekt op dit moment de inhoud van deze meldingen. Zij zal op basis van haar onderzoek eventuele vervolgacties bepalen.
Antwoorde op vragen van het lid Paulusma over mogelijke sluiting van vakken bij de KNVB Bekerfinale

An MP from D66 asked the government whether closing whole sections of De Kuip at the KNVB Cup final would reduce supporter tickets, and whether the government would engage with the KNVB and supporters' collective on ticket allocation and targeting of collective sanctions. The minister replied that ticket allocation and section closures are the responsibility of the KNVB and the local authorities, not the national government, and pointed to the existing Regiegroep and an update to follow after the 2023-2024 season figures.
Closing sections is the responsibility of the local triangle and the KNVB. The national government has no role in this.
Het sluiten van vakken is de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale driehoek en de KNVB. Hier heeft de Rijksoverheid geen rol bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over euthanasie bij psychisch lijden

MP Paulusma asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times for euthanasia requests based on psychological suffering, their causes, and how to speed up help and expand expertise. The minister acknowledged the unacceptable waits, pointed to psychiatrists' reluctance and the ThaNet network, and said EE's consultation function is under review, with no firm timeline for structural change.
I find it unacceptable if people with psychological suffering and a persistent death wish/euthanasia wish do not receive timely and appropriate care
Ik vind het onacceptabel als mensen met psychisch lijden en een aanhoudende doodswens/euthanasiewens geen tijdige en passende zorg krijgen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het artikel ‘Gendersensitieve aanpak nog onvoldoende aanwezig in bestaand beleid, gemeenten en Rijksoverheid aan zet’

Parliamentary questions from MP Paulusma (D66) asked about the application of the gender quality requirement and gender test in policy-making, following a College voor de Rechten van de Mens article. The minister answered that the gender test is not mandatory to report, so its use cannot be tracked, that responsibility lies with individual ministries, and that ZonMw research on gender effects in policy will be delivered in 2024.
The policy compass does not require the gender test to be included in the explanatory memorandum or policy document.
Het beleidskompas verplicht niet tot het opnemen van de gendertoets in de memorie van toelichting of beleidsnota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Minder vrouwen laten zich testen op baarmoederhalskanker

An MP asks the minister about falling participation in the cervical cancer screening programme and whether the government will act on it, including self-sampling and reminders. The minister acknowledges the concern, explains the reasons for non-participation and the steps taken, such as a self-sampling kit, information changes, and research due at year end.
The declining participation as such is a worrying development.
De dalende deelname als zodanig vind ik een zorgelijke ontwikkeling.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat Russische sancties zijn overtreden bij voetbaltransfers in binnen- en buitenland en het besluit van het IOC om Russische en Belarussische sporters onder neutra

An MP from D66 asked the minister about reports that football transfers involving Russian clubs may have breached sanctions, and about the IOC allowing Russian and Belarusian athletes to compete under a neutral flag. The minister replied that compliance with sanctions is each party's own responsibility, that supervisors investigate suspected breaches, that the government has no indication UEFA or FIFA rules conflict with sanctions, and that it opposes IOC's decision while limiting its own role to informal diplomacy.
In the Netherlands everyone is themselves responsible for complying with sanctions measures.
In Nederland is eenieder zelf verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van sanctiemaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Podt over de tekortkomingen in de geboortezorg voor asielzoekers

MPs Paulusma and Podt asked the government about a study showing higher perinatal loss among pregnant asylum seekers, interpreter use, relocation of pregnant women, and communication problems between care providers. The State Secretary replied that the data are already known and regretted, that existing measures and the care chain working group address them, that access to care is adequately arranged, and that relocation of pregnant women is restricted but not fully avoidable.
Yes. Access to maternity care is also well arranged for asylum seekers in the Netherlands.
Ja. De toegang tot de geboortezorg is ook voor asielzoeksters in Nederland goed geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het weigeren van palliatieve zorg vanwege het bereiken van het budgetplafond

An MP asked whether palliative home care was refused by Zilveren Kruis because a budget ceiling had been reached, and what structural fixes are planned. The minister acknowledges the case, says it was resolved with the insurer, describes ceiling-increase procedures and planned financing reforms, but offers no firm new oversight commitments.
At the end of this year a next letter to the House on palliative care will be sent, again giving the status of the various financing tracks.
Eind dit jaar zal een volgende Kamerbrief palliatieve zorg worden verzonden waarin opnieuw de stand van zaken van de verschillende trajecten rond de bekostiging zal worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Paulusma over het bericht '4 op de 10 mensen met laag inkomen verwachten problemen met betalen van zorgverzekering

MPs Kat and Paulusma asked the government about reports that many low-income people expect trouble paying health insurance premiums, rising premiums, unused healthcare allowance, and access to municipal collective health insurance. The minister acknowledged the concerns, gave premium and take-up figures, and listed existing and planned measures, without committing to new structural steps beyond monitoring and ongoing policy.
I will keep a close eye on the situation.
Ik blijf vinger aan de pols houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Tielen over de noodzaak om vaardigheden van ziekenhuisprofessionals actueel te houden en de rol van de subsidieregeling Kwaliteitsimpuls personeel ziekenhuiszorg daarin

MPs Paulusma and Tielen asked why no new KIPZ subsidy regulation for 2024 has been published despite the Integraal Zorgakkoord commitment to keep these funds for medical-specialist care, and how the funds and skills-maintenance goal will be secured. The minister says the 2024 extension carries state-aid risks, so the only way to pay out the full 227.5 million euros is an extension that is admittedly unlawful, with a new framework planned for 2025.

The only option I currently see to make the funds available in full in 2024, in line with the IZA agreement, is, given the state-aid risks, to extend the KIPZ subsidy scheme once in a way that is unlawful.

De enige mogelijkheid die ik op dit moment zie om de middelen conform de IZA afspraak in zijn geheel in 2024 beschikbaar te stellen is het, vanwege de risico's op staatssteun, onrechtmatig eenmalig verlengen van de Subsidieregeling KIPZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de dalende vaccinatiegraad

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about the declining vaccination rate, including measles coverage among infants, and proposed mobile vaccination points, twijfeltelefoon access, and an accelerated HPV campaign evaluation. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, noted that a national outbreak risk is not yet present, referred to pending RIVM research and planned follow-up letters, and said no extra funds beyond existing ones are available.
Beyond these already initiated actions and measures, there are currently no additional funds available for extra efforts to raise the vaccination rate.
Boven op deze al ingezette acties en maatregelen zijn er op dit moment geen extra middelen beschikbaar voor extra inzet om de vaccinatiegraad te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Nog geen 20 procent van jongeren haalde gratis hpv-prik: ‘Kan veel ellende voorkomen’

An MP asked why fewer than 20 percent of young adults invited for the free HPV vaccine had been vaccinated after five months, and what the government would do to raise uptake and avoid wasting vaccines near expiry. The State Secretary answered that uptake is not fully controllable, that the campaign and mobile vaccination points are being expanded, and that the vaccines will be used optimally or donated abroad, while declining to extend eligibility beyond the Health Council's advised age group.
I am therefore not dissatisfied with the provisional uptake; of course I would like to see even more young adults get the HPV vaccination.
Ik ben dan ook niet ontevreden over de voorlopige opkomst; uiteraard zou ik graag zien dat nog meer jongvolwassenen de vaccinatie tegen HPV nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Ginneken over aangezichtsoperaties bij transgenderzorg

D66 MPs asked the health minister about gender-affirming facial surgery: whether it is reimbursed, why insurers use prior authorisation, how passability assessments avoid arbitrariness, and whether rejections are checked. The minister said no data exist on volumes or rejections, defended the authorisation system and the 2021 assessment framework, and stated that not every request is approved.
No data are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over ALS en toegang tot medicijnen

An MP asked the Minister of Health how to speed up market approval and reimbursement for ALS medicines, how patients and the patient association are involved, and how fast-track routes and differences with the US FDA work. The Minister answered that the standard procedures apply, that reimbursement requires therapeutic value and cost-effectiveness, that patients are consulted only on draft Zorginstituut reports, and promised a dashboard on lead times and a letter before summer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over toestemming voor Australische psychiaters om psychedelica voor te schrijven voor patiënten met een behandelingsresistente depressie en posttraumatische stressstoor

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the Minister of Health about Australia's decision to allow authorised psychiatrists to prescribe psilocybin and MDMA for treatment-resistant depression and PTSD, and what this means for the Netherlands. The Minister replied that prescribing is currently not possible in the Netherlands beyond clinical research and Spravato, that changing Opium Act lists is not necessary for research or registration, and that a commission on MDMA and a ZonMw report will inform further steps.
I will give you my response to this report in a previously promised letter to the House on the state of affairs regarding psychedelics before the summer recess.
Ik zal u in een eerder toegezegde Kamerbrief over de stand van zaken rondom psychedelica voor het zomerreces mijn reactie geven op dit signalement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Romke de Jong over btw op menselijke geslachtscellen
