Two D66 MPs asked why human sperm and egg cells used for reproductive donation are taxed at the 21% general VAT rate, higher than the 9% rate for animal sperm, and why they are not exempt like human organs, blood and breast milk, and whether costs for people with a fertility wish should be reduced. The government answered that the EU VAT Directive offers no room for a reduced or exempt rate for human germ cells, that exemptions must be interpreted strictly, that the Embryowet already caps fees charged by sperm and egg banks, and that an EU amendment is not foreseen.
However, the VAT Directive offers no scope to apply the reduced rate to germ cells supplied to humans for reproductive purposes, so the standard rate of 21% applies to them.

De Btw-richtlijn biedt echter geen ruimte om het verlaagde tarief toe te passen op geslachtscellen die voor reproductieve doeleinden bij mensen worden geleverd, waardoor hierop het algemene tarief van 21% van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over een euthanasiewens bij (jonge) mensen met een psychische aandoening

An MP asks the Minister of Health about euthanasia requests from young people with psychiatric conditions, the taboo around it, waiting lists at the Expertisecentrum Euthanasie, and early help for people with persistent death wishes. The Minister responds that a national expert network and an exploratory study on early low-threshold help are underway, that waiting times for psychiatric requests are about two years, and that the network aims to shift care to psychiatrists and other ggz professionals.
This network aims to increase the expertise of psychiatrists and other doctors/ggz treatment providers who deal with persistent death wishes and euthanasia wishes/requests on a psychiatric basis.

Dit netwerk beoogt de deskundigheid van psychiaters en andere artsen/ggz-behandelaren, die te maken krijgen met persisterende doodswensen en euthanasiewensen/-verzoeken op psychische grondslag, te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Van den Hil en Paulusma over een gesprek met de Eilandsraad van Sint Eustatius

MPs asked about referral arrangements in a pilot for Sint Eustatius health care, including whether patients are sent only to Sint Maarten, lost medical records, reported deaths, inspectorate complaints and dialysis availability. The minister answered that referrals go to Sint Maarten Medical Center, referrals elsewhere remain specialist-initiated, records-sharing is being studied, the inspectorate received 13 reports over five years, and peritoneal dialysis talks are ongoing.
To improve digital data exchange, I am examining the possibilities for a (regional) electronic patient record.
Ter verbetering van de digitale gegevensuitwisseling onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden van een (regionaal) elektronisch patiënten dossier
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de petitie ‘Meer onderzoek naar (onverklaarde) gezondheidsklachten van vrouwen’

An MP asked the Health Minister about a petition on women's unexplained health complaints and about research gaps in medicine by sex and gender. The minister acknowledges the problem, describes consultations and a research agenda in progress, and notes existing funding and training efforts without committing to new binding measures.

I am currently consulting with civil society organisations (including WOMEN Inc., Vuurvrouwen, Voices for Women, patient associations), scientific associations (NVOG), KIMS, the Dutch GP association NHG and ZonMw to see whether a societal agenda with a linked research agenda on women-specific conditions is feasible.

Momenteel ben ik in overleg met maatschappelijke organisaties (onder andere WOMEN Inc., Vuurvrouwen, Voices for Women, patiëntenverenigingen), wetenschappelijke verenigingen (NVOG), het Kwaliteitsinstituut Medisch Specialisten (KIMS), het Nederlands Huisartsen Genootschap (NHG) en ZonMw om te bezien of het mogelijk is om te komen tot een maatschappelijke agenda
Antwoord op vragen van lid Paulusma en Kat over het bericht dat steeds meer mensen kiezen voor een hoog risico bij hun zorgverzekering

MPs Paulusma and Kat asked the minister about reports that more people choose high voluntary deductibles in health insurance, the risks this poses, the government's role in matching policies to needs, insurers' product range, and installment payment of the mandatory deductible. The minister sees no trend yet, relies on insurers, comparison sites and a government information campaign, points to NZa plans to tighten rules on near-identical policies, and says no further steps are needed on installment payment since insurers already offer it.
I think it is too early to speak of a "trend" and therefore I am also not in discussion with other departments about it.
Ik vind het te vroeg om te spreken over een «trend» en ben daarom ook niet in gesprek met andere departementen hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Boucke over stijgende energieprijzen zorginstellingen

MPs Paulusma and Boucke asked about rising energy costs for hospitals and residential care facilities, including reports of diesel emergency generators being used because they are cheaper than gas, and whether mitigating measures such as the energy price cap and WHOA restructuring apply. The minister acknowledges sector-wide financial pressure, says he is unaware of diesel signals, points to existing energy-cap and TEK compensation conditions, declines to provide an overview of at-risk institutions, and refers to earlier letters and sustainability support programmes.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sahla over de Verliezen in de wijkverpleging

MPs Paulusma and Sahla ask the minister about financial losses in district nursing (wijkverpleging), the NZa's view that the situation is worrying, contracting by insurers, budget underspending and staff sickness. The minister acknowledges sector pressure, points to IZA agreements including a 600 million euro downward adjustment and extra insurer revenue commitments for 2023, and says some data (tariffs, sector-specific sickness and deficit analysis) is not available yet.
I will closely monitor these agreements made in the IZA.
Ik zal deze afspraken die in het IZA gemaakt zijn nauwgezet volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de tuchtuitspraak van een huisarts die een patiënt niet doorstuurde ondanks een zeer sterk verhoogde D-dimeerwaarde wegens magnetisme en een Pfizer-vaccinatie

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a disciplinary tribunal's reprimand of a GP who failed to refer a patient despite very high D-dimer levels, and about the IGJ's capacity, the public disclosure of sanctions and protection of doctors. The Minister answered that the tribunal is independent, that the IGJ is capable of supervising and that existing rules and channels are adequate, while promising a Wet BIG evaluation in 2024.
I have confidence in disciplinary jurisprudence and that the disciplinary panels can give a sound, independent judgment.
Ik heb vertrouwen in de tuchtrechtspraak en dat de tuchtcolleges een gedegen, onafhankelijk oordeel kunnen geven.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Paulusma over medisch specialisten

MP Paulusma asked the Minister of Health about a news report on hospitals' vulnerability to fraud through doctors' side income, the Isala hospital case, how to prevent similar cases, employing medical specialists, and the Wibz bill. The Minister points to existing rules (gift-giving rules, the Transparantieregister Zorg, the Governancecode), says the IGJ sees no care-quality risks in the Isala case, promises further analysis and a letter in autumn, and describes the Wibz bill's tools for supervising corporate governance and profit distribution.

The Wibz bill therefore contains tightened rules on profit distribution and licensing conditions, and introduces public-law supervision of business operations affecting the quality, affordability and accessibility of care.

Het wetsvoorstel Integere bedrijfsvoering zorgaanbieders (Wibz) bevat daarom aanscherpingen van bestaande regels op het terrein van winstuitkering en vergunningsvoorwaarden, de introductie van publiekrechtelijk toezicht op onderdelen van de bedrijfsvoering die raken aan de kwaliteit, betaalbaarheid en toegankelijkheid van de zorg
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Raemakers en Paulusma over de uitspraak van de advocaat-generaal aan de Hoge Raad ten aanzien van verplichte anticonceptie in de gesloten jeugdzorg

MPs Raemakers and Paulusma asked the State Secretary for Health about the Advocate-General's opinion that compulsory contraception under the Wvggz may breach the ECHR, and whether it is also imposed in closed youth care. The State Secretary declined to anticipate the Supreme Court ruling, said closed youth care falls under the Youth Act rather than the Wvggz, and argued that compulsory contraception there should be exceptional and rare.
I await the Supreme Court's ruling with interest.
Ik wacht de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad met belangstelling af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Bikker over Het artikel 'Bonden dagen Helder voor rechter om uitblijven longcovidfonds zorg'

MPs Paulusma and Bikker asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about unions suing over the government's failure to set up a long-COVID fund for healthcare workers, and about the delayed letter promised under their motion. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said a legal review by the Raad van State is needed before deciding on support for this group, and promised an update this autumn.
After receiving the advice, the cabinet will decide on the follow-up to the exploration and will inform your House about this by letter as soon as possible.
Na ontvangst van de voorlichting beslist het kabinet over het vervolg op de verkenning en zal uw Kamer daarover zo spoedig mogelijk per brief informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Paulusma over het toenemende aantal covid-besmettingen in relatie tot de asielopvang

MPs Podt and Paulusma asked about rising COVID-19 infections in asylum reception centres, including monitoring, prevention measures, vaccination rates, quarantine capacity and staffing contingency planning. The State Secretary answered that COA relies on self-tests with no registration of positives due to GDPR, that measures and vaccination information are in place, that vaccination uptake cannot be measured, and that scenarios are being prepared by COA and IND.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Den Haan over de afspraken tussen de beroepsorganisaties en zorgverzekeraars uit het multidisciplinair document ‘Afbouwen antidepressiva (SSRI’s & SNRI’s)’

MPs Paulusma and Den Haan asked the Minister of Health about insurers' compliance with the 2018 multidisciplinary agreement on tapering antidepressants, and why insurers differ on covering taper strips. The Minister replied that insurers endorse the document, that evidence for specific tapering schemes is lacking, that some insurers cover taper strips under conditions while others do not, and pointed to a new TAPER-AD study and integrated care agreements.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Paulusma over de artikelen 'Het ene Nederland is het andere niet' en 'Er vallen doden door slechte zorg Sint Eustatius'

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretaries about press articles reporting deaths from poor healthcare on Sint Eustatius, including referral problems and the role of Zorg en Jeugd Caribisch Nederland. The government acknowledged the problems, described steps taken and planned (a referral pilot, protocol review, talks with providers), but declined to commission a specific investigation, pointing to the IGJ calamity inquiry already under way.
I am willing to enter into discussion with care providers about their concerns.
Ik ben bereid om in gesprek te gaan met zorgverleners over hun zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het voldoen aan inreisregels van andere landen rondom corona

An MP asked the health and foreign affairs ministers how Dutch travellers can meet foreign COVID entry rules that do not recognise Dutch recovery certificates or AstraZeneca/Janssen vaccinations, and whether reiseVaccinaties will be offered. The minister answered that travellers must check destination rules themselves, referred to testing and EU-level talks, and said a study on COVID vaccines as travel vaccinations is ongoing.
Once the study is completed, I will inform the House about it.
Als het onderzoek afgerond is, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de Molukse KNIL-militairen die begin jaren ’50 naar Nederland zijn gehaald

Paulusma (D66) asked about the Moluccan KNIL soldiers brought to the Netherlands in 1951, including how many are still alive, where the deceased are buried, grave-right extensions, veterans' cemetery status, and the living conditions and child deaths in the 'woonoorden'. The government answered that no complete overview exists, that grave maintenance is largely not a central government matter, that research on the housing camps is possible via existing subsidy schemes, and that commemoration is left largely to society.
The central government does not have an overview of where the people brought to the Netherlands in 1951 and already deceased are buried.
Het is niet in beeld bij de rijksoverheid waar de mensen die in 1951 naar Nederland zijn gehaald en reeds zijn overleden, begraven liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over zorgmedewerkers met post-covid-syndroom die reeds zijn ontslagen of dreigen hun baan te verliezen

An MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport when the support scheme for care workers with post-COVID syndrome will start, whether dismissals are being reported, how employers were urged to hold off, whether UWV can point employers to the scheme, and what retroactive options exist for already-dismissed workers. The minister expects the subsidy scheme to be published by June, confirms reports of recent dismissals, outlines measures to inform employers, and explains that the scheme does not give workers a right to claim and the legal position of workers is unchanged.
I expect to publish the subsidy scheme by June at the latest.
Ik verwacht uiterlijk in juni de subsidieregeling te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de laatste stand van zaken van zorgmedewerkers met post-covidsyndroom

An MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care about the number of care workers with long COVID entering the WIA disability scheme per month, about agreements with social partners and UWV, and about a bridging arrangement. The minister replied that privacy rules prevent employers from recording the cause of sick leave, that UWV applies the same assessment to all WIA claims, and that a temporary support measure for employers is being offered while research continues.
Under privacy regulations, employers are not permitted to record the reason or cause of sick leave.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving is registratie van de reden of oorzaak van ziekteverzuim door werkgevers niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Paulusma over de inzet van 1G in de culturele sector

MPs Wuite and Paulusma (D66) asked the ministers whether the 1G test-for-access requirement for large unplaced indoor events in the cultural sector would deter visitors, and what alternatives or flanking measures exist. The minister defended the 1G measure as a proportionate risk mitigation for high-risk events, rejected concerns about deterred visitors, and announced that Testen voor Toegang would end on 23 March 2022.
From 23 March, Testen voor Toegang also lapses for these events, and they can proceed without a test certificate.
Vanaf 23 maart vervalt ook voor deze evenementen Testen voor Toegang, en kunnen zij doorgaan zonder testbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Warmerdam, Paulusma en Sneller over therapeutisch gebruik van psychedelica zoals psilocybine, mdma en ketamine

D66 MPs asked the health minister about therapeutic use of psychedelics (psilocybin, MDMA, ketamine), including research funding, FDA-style fast-track approval, risks of uncoordinated use, and a central steering role. The minister agreed research is needed, pointed to ZonMw funding and a planned state commission on MDMA, and said central steering is for medical professional groups, with the government playing a facilitating and advisory role.
Central steering of research and implementation is for the medical professional groups to shape.
Centrale aansturing op onderzoek en implementatie is aan de medische beroepsgroepen om vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sjoerdsma over het reizen met en het verkrijgen van een Digitale Corona Certificaat

MPs Paulusma and Sjoerdsma asked the health minister about Digital Corona Certificate rules for travel to Austria, Germany and other EU states, and about obtaining Dutch or EU certificates after vaccination or infection abroad. The minister answered that member states set their own national access rules and that the EU regulation makes the issuing state responsible, acknowledging some unresolved gaps and promising to look for solutions.
I am currently looking into which solution is possible for this group.
Momenteel bezie ik welke oplossing mogelijk is voor deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de boostprik tegen COVID-19 voor adolescenten die jonger zijn dan 18 jaar

MP Paulusma asked the minister why the booster shot for under-18s was delayed despite other EU countries' advice and travel requirements, and whether citizens can still choose to get one. The minister replied that the government waited for the EMA's positive opinion of 24 February before making boosters available to adolescents, and that the long-term vaccination approach is still being prepared.
I will inform your House at a later time whether and, if so, when COVID-19 vaccines will be (able to be) available as travel vaccinations.
Ik zal uw Kamer op een later moment informeren of en, zo ja, wanneer COVID-19-vaccins beschikbaar (kunnen) komen als reizigersvaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over werkenden en studenten met Long Covid

Two MPs from D66 asked ministers about workers and students with long-covid, covering occupational care for self-employed, WIA disability inflow, paramedical recovery care coverage, and university support. The government answered that research on long-covid is ongoing, WIA inflow is partly explained by structural factors while UWV investigates the rest, paramedical care is capped at two six-month periods, and it will not extend this limit.
I do not intend to extend the maximum treatment period of twice six months.
Ik ben niet voornemens de maximale behandeltermijn van tweemaal zes maanden te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Ginneken over het niet dragen van mondkapjes in de taxi.

Two D66 MPs asked why the mask requirement in taxis lapses when only one passenger is present, whether this differs from public transport, and about risks and the use of partitions. The state secretary answered that the exemption follows from the 1.5-metre distance norm, that taxis are not public transport, and that no signals of enforcement problems have been received.
The Ministry of I&W regularly has contact with the transport operators about the corona measures.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft regelmatig contact met de vervoerders over de coronamaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Paulusma over de inzet van tolken in de jeugdzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about children interpreting for parents in youth care, the funding gap for interpreters under the Jeugdwet compared with mental health care, and risks to fact-finding in child protection cases. The State Secretary acknowledged that child interpreting is undesirable in serious cases, said no signals of children being refused or parents being excluded are known, and announced a study on interpreter funding due before summer.
No extensive investigation has been carried out in response to the questions you ask in questions 6 to 9.
Er is geen uitgebreid onderzoek gedaan naar aanleiding van de vragen die u stelt in de vragen 6 tot en met 9.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Paulusma en Sneller over medicinale cannabis en ontoereikend beleid op maatschappelijk behoefte

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the minister about medicinal cannabis access, limited varieties for patients with severe symptoms, the lack of information and policy, and the ban on home cultivation. The minister answered that BMC has expanded varieties, a European tender is underway, research is funded, an evaluation is pending, and home cultivation remains prohibited with no individual exemption.
Your House will be informed further before the summer about the next steps following this evaluation.
Uw Kamer wordt voor de zomer nader geïnformeerd over de vervolgstappen naar aanleiding van deze evaluatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Kuiken over de laatste stand van zaken in de aanpak tegen zorgverleners die corona ontkennen, bagatelliseren, nepnieuws verspreiden of bewust medicatie/behandelingen voorschrij

MPs Paulusma and Kuiken asked the health minister about the government's approach to healthcare professionals who deny or downplay COVID-19, spread misinformation, or prescribe ineffective treatments, including a call by a doctors' group against vaccinating pregnant women. The minister answered that the advice contradicts professional guidance, that IGJ has taken action against some doctors and imposed one fine, but declined to name other organisations and said tuchtrecht sanctions are for the disciplinary judge to decide.
I see no need to name these organisations explicitly.
Ik zie geen noodzaak deze organisaties expliciet bij naam te benoemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Paulusma over het bericht 'Dure betalingsregeling van Infomedics maakt de tandarts onbetaalbaar'

MPs Kat and Paulusma asked whether dental-clinic payment arrangements run by billing firm Infomedics, which charge patients service fees, are acceptable, and whether such fees should be banned. The minister said such fees should be avoided, that a ban is not under consideration, and that the sector and Infomedics will be consulted on practical solutions.
The cabinet has set itself the goal of preventing collection costs as much as possible and acting quickly on early payment arrears.
Het kabinet heeft wel als doel gesteld om incassokosten zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen en snel te acteren bij beginnende betalingsachterstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sneller over de maatschappelijke behoefte van verkoop van cannabisolie als medicijn

MPs Paulusma and Sneller asked the health minister about a court ruling that did not sentence a cannabis oil seller despite illegal sales, about patient need for medicinal cannabis oil, and about the barriers to researching its quality. The state secretary answered that patient need is not yet fully mapped, that a research study is planned for early 2022, that BMC rejected Suver Nuver's research exemption in 2019, and that policy changes will be considered after the BMC evaluation.
Together with the Bureau for Medicinal Cannabis and the Trimbos Institute, a study is currently being prepared to gain more insight into this.
Samen met het Bureau voor Medicinale Cannabis en het Trimbos Instituut wordt daarom momenteel gewerkt aan een onderzoek om hier meer inzicht in te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Aukje de Vries, Van den Berg, Kuiken en Bikker over de afschaling van reguliere zorg en de extra wachttijdproblematiek

MPs asked the Minister of Health about the renewed scaling-down of regular hospital care, uneven burden across hospitals, underuse of independent clinics, digital care, cross-border treatment, and publication of waiting-time data. The minister answered that national allocation agreements apply, that NZa and IGJ monitor compliance, that planned care in all hospitals has been halted under phase 2d, and that waiting-time information is being updated more often, while declining to commit to specific structural changes beyond existing frameworks.
The Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) monitor that the agreements are being complied with.
De Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) zien er op toe dat de afspraken worden nagekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Jasper van Dijk over in Nederland geboren Molukkers die stateloos zijn

MPs Paulusma and Van Dijk asked about Dutch-born Moluccans who are stateless but hold Dutch travel documents under the Moluccans Position Act, including how many there are, how naturalisation works, and whether they should be actively informed about the option of Dutch nationality with voting rights. The state secretary answers that about 850 such people hold documents, at least 450 have obtained Dutch nationality over the years, and she is willing to discuss the matter with the Moluccan community while showing restraint in actively promoting nationality, since the Act was a deliberate choice.
I am of course willing to discuss this with representatives of the Moluccan community.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met vertegenwoordigers van de Molukse gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Van Ginneken, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Simons over het faillissement van de ggz-instelling voor transgenderzorg 'Stepwork'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and BIJ1 asked about the bankruptcy of Stepwork, a major transgender care mental health provider, its impact on waiting lists and continuity of care, and what government could have done earlier. The State Secretary answered that continuity of care is secured through takeover by Genderhealthcare, that the government had intervened repeatedly since 2019, and that a review of the psychological assessment requirement is being prepared via ZonMw.
The policy of the Ministry of VWS is aimed at continuity of care for patients and clients, not at continuity of individual institutions.
Het beleid van VWS is gericht op continuïteit van zorg voor patiënten en cliënten, en niet op continuïteit van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Paulusma over de voortgang in de inhaalzorg

An MP asked the Minister of Health about differences between hospitals in delivering catch-up care after the COVID-19 backlog, the spreading of patients, the role of UMCs, primary care and treatment centres, and whether untreated patients have simply recovered. The Minister answered that waiting times vary by region and treatment, referred to NZa monitoring and existing agreements, stated no further broad regional patient transfers are planned, and said monitoring and communication efforts continue.
No percentage is known for what share of care in UMCs cannot be transferred to other hospitals.
Over welk deel van de zorg door umc's niet kan worden overgedragen aan andere ziekenhuizen is geen percentage bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van der Laan over het WRR-rapport: Kiezen voor houdbare zorg

Two D66 MPs asked the health minister about the WRR report on sustainable healthcare, including quick wins, citizen forums, foreign care workers and prevention. The minister answered that hard political choices are needed but largely deferred concrete responses on the recommendations to a next cabinet, pointing to existing policy documents.
It is up to a next cabinet to make choices on this and to respond substantively to the WRR recommendations.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om daar keuzes in te maken en inhoudelijk te reageren op de aanbevelingen van de WRR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het initiatief van een aantal ziekenhuizen in de strijd tegen geneesmiddelkaping

An MP asked the minister whether he knows of and supports a hospital initiative with compounding pharmacy A15 to counter drug price increases through registration of compounded drugs, and asked about a NFKOO subsidy with similar aims and the IGJ's preference for commercial parties. The state secretary answered that the initiative is known and welcomed for affordability, that the NFKOO subsidy partly overlaps with it and is being used to support A15, and that the IGJ applies neutral quality-based supervision, while committing to EU-level adjustment of the orphan drug regulation and a FAST helpdesk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Kuiken over artsen die corona ontkennen, bagatelliseren, nepnieuws verspreiden of alternatieve behandelingen aanbieden

MPs Paulusma and Kuiken asked the Health Minister about doctors and groups denying or downplaying COVID-19, spreading misinformation and offering unproven treatments, and how the IGJ supervises them. The minister condemned the rhetoric, said the IGJ has sent around fifty corrective letters and about ten warnings of possible sanctions, and that the IGJ is preparing a disciplinary complaint, while stating that the tuchtrechter's threshold for acting against doctors' public statements is high.
Over the past months the IGJ has sent roughly fifty corrective letters to doctors who gave evidently incorrect information about the coronavirus or vaccinations.
De IGJ heeft de afgelopen maanden ongeveer vijftig keer een corrigerende brief gestuurd naar artsen die evident onjuiste informatie gaven over het coronavirus of vaccinaties
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht ‘Onderzoek: Sekseverschil blijft bij onderzoek naar corona vaak onderbelicht’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about under-representation of sex differences in COVID-19 research, data publication, and possible under-diagnosis of women with Long COVID. The minister answered that data publication via EMA is expanding, that guidelines and research already address sex and risk groups, and that C-support and an updated multidisciplinary guideline are being set up.
Therefore, for medicines authorised in Europe, study data are published on the clinical data website of the European Medicines Agency (EMA).
Daarom worden voor geneesmiddelen, waarvoor in Europa een handelsvergunning is verleend, de studiedata gepubliceerd op de klinische data website van de het Europees Geneesmiddelen Agentschap (EMA).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over zwaargewonde slachtoffers die niet in het juiste ziekenhuis terecht komen

An MP asked the state secretary about a study finding that a third of severely injured accident victims are taken to the wrong hospital, especially older women, and what will be done about selection, the 90% target and the 240-patient norm. The government acknowledged the problem, pointed to triage protocols, training and an app, said the 90% norm is not yet met and will be discussed with partners, and deferred concentration decisions to a future cabinet.
VWS will discuss with the LNAZ, NVZ, AZN and ZN which further improvements they will make in care for seriously injured patients.

VWS zal met het Landelijk Netwerk Acute Zorg (LNAZ, dit netwerk coördineert landelijk de traumazorg), de Nederlandse Vereniging van Ziekenhuizen (NVZ), Ambulancezorg Nederland (AZN) en Zorgverzekeraars Nederland (ZN) bespreken welke verdere verbeteringen zij gaan aanbrengen in de zorg voor ernstig verwonde patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over de inhaalzorg in de curatieve zorg

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about the scope, patient allocation, oversight and enforcement of catch-up care in curative care, including the role of the ACM and NZa. The minister answers that insurers and the NZa will give the scope by mid-July, that patients are informed via insurers and information cards, that the NZa monitors and supervises insurers, and that no new research will be initiated.
By mid-July, insurers and the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) are expected to provide insight into the scope of catch-up care per specialty.
Half juli kan naar verwachting het inzicht worden gegeven door zorgverzekeraars en de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZA) over de omvang van de inhaalzorg per specialisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulusma over het bericht dat onderzoekers met het Zorginstituut een rekenmodel hebben ontwikkeld voor reële prijzen voor oude medicijnen die opnieuw op de markt komen

MP Paulusma asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Amsterdam UMC and Zorginstituut cost model for reasonable prices of old medicines relaunched as orphan drugs, and whether it could be applied more widely and to reimbursed drugs. The minister agreed excessive price hikes are undesirable, supported tighter EU orphan-drug rules, said the model suits only a limited set of drugs and is not a replacement for value-based pricing.
The Zorginstituut is currently exploring whether it is feasible to flag these kinds of developments at an early stage.
Het Zorginstituut is momenteel aan het verkennen of het haalbaar is om in een vroeg stadium dit soort ontwikkelingen te signaleren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Paternotte over de berichtgeving dat arbeidsmigranten niet allemaal een vaccin krijgen en de maatschappelijke opvang voor ongedocumenteerden wordt afgebouwd

Opposition MPs Paulusma and Paternotte asked why migrant workers and undocumented people not registered in the BRP may not receive vaccination invitations and why emergency shelter is being wound down. Minister De Jonge answered that unregistered groups are being reached via GGD regional plans and outreach, and that the shelter wind-down timing remains appropriate.

The Ministry of VWS asked the GGD regions, together with regional partners such as municipalities, shelter organisations and street doctors, to draw up a regional implementation plan for vaccinating homeless people, people in women's shelters and undocumented people.

Het Ministerie van VWS heeft GGD-en verzocht – in samenwerking met regionale partners zoals gemeenten, opvanginstellingen en straatdokters – een regionaal uitvoeringsplan te maken voor de vaccinatie van dakloze mensen, mensen die verblijven in de vrouwenopvang en ongedocumenteerde mensen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Paulusma over het bericht dat het Zorginstituut Nederland adviseert om een nieuw medicijn tegen taaislijmziekte niet op te nemen in het basispakket vanwege de te hoge prijs van f

MPs Kuiken and Paulusma asked the Minister of Medical Care about the Zorginstituut's advice not to add the cystic fibrosis drug Kaftrio to the basic package because of Vertex's price, and about joint European negotiation, transparency and legal tools against high drug prices. The Minister replied that the Institute advised conditional inclusion (including a price reduction), that joint Benelux negotiation was not considered opportune, that new price deals for existing CFTR modulators are not yet decided, and that she is pursuing price transparency and referred to her policy letter for further measures.
Joint negotiation is complex because the agreements already made on Orkambi and Symkevi are confidential.
Anderzijds is gezamenlijk onderhandelen complex omdat de reeds gemaakte afspraken over Orkambi en Symkevi vertrouwelijk zijn.

m: Motie van het lid Vondeling over een meldplicht bij signalen van illegaal verblijf
Motion asking the government to legally oblige all public bodies and publicly funded organisations to report signals of illegal residence to the police and IND and enforce strictly.
requests the government to legally oblige all government bodies and government-funded organisations to report signals of illegal residence
verzoekt de regering om alle overheidsinstanties en door de overheid gefinancierde organisaties wettelijk te verplichten signalen van illegaal verblijf te melden
Motie van het lid Vondeling over geen enkele gemeente nog opvang laten bieden aan illegalen
Motion asks the government to ensure no municipality provides shelter to illegal migrants and to cut the municipal fund for municipalities that refuse.
requests the government to ensure no municipality still provides shelter to illegal migrants
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat geen enkele gemeente nog opvang biedt aan illegalen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Vondeling ter vervanging van nr. 33 over het strafbaar stellen van illegaal verblijf van vreemdelingen
Makes unlawful residence of adult foreigners who know or suspect their stay is unlawful a criminal offence, with a six-month maximum sentence or fine.
The adult foreigner who stays in the Netherlands while knowing or having serious reason to suspect that stay is unlawful is punished
De meerderjarige vreemdeling die in Nederland verblijft terwijl hij weet of ernstige reden heeft te vermoeden dat dat verblijf niet rechtmatig is, wordt gestraft
Amendement van het lid Vondeling over het strafbaar stellen van illegaal verblijf van vreemdelingen
Makes illegal stay by adults without a right to reside a criminal offence punishable by up to six months' imprisonment, and adds a related aggravating ground to article 66a.
Criminalising illegality is a necessary 'stick behind the door' to motivate illegals to leave the Netherlands.
Strafbaarstelling van illegaliteit is een noodzakelijke «stok achter de deur» om illegalen te motiveren Nederland te verlaten.
Amendement van het lid Vondeling over het intrekken van de Wet gemeentelijke taak mogelijk maken asielopvangvoorzieningen
Repeals the Spreidingswet, removing the statutory obligation imposed on municipalities to provide asylum reception places, and makes related consequential changes.
The Act enabling the municipal task for asylum reception facilities is repealed.
De Wet gemeentelijke taak mogelijk maken asielopvangvoorzieningen wordt ingetrokken.
Amendement van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over niet afstand nemen van de islamitische shariawetgeving als afwijzingsgrond voor een asielaanvraag
Makes refusal to sign an anti-sharia declaration a ground for rejecting an asylum application, without a further assessment of the case.
If an asylum seeker refuses to sign this declaration, the asylum application is rejected.
Indien een asielzoeker weigert deze verklaring te ondertekenen, wordt de asielaanvraag afgewezen.
Motie van het lid Vondeling over het aantal kennismigranten dat via de Europese blauwe kaart naar Nederland mag komen maximaal beperken
Asks the government to cap the number of knowledge migrants entering the Netherlands via the EU Blue Card.
requests the government to limit as far as possible the number of knowledge migrants who may come to the Netherlands via the EU Blue Card
verzoekt de regering het aantal kennismigranten dat via de Europese blauwe kaart naar Nederland mag komen maximaal te beperken
Amendement van de leden Emiel van Dijk en Vondeling over het schrappen van de bevoegdheid om strafbeschikkingen op te leggen aan criminele asielzoekers
Bars the public prosecutor from issuing penal orders (strafbeschikkingen) to foreign nationals, including asylum seekers.
The public prosecutor cannot issue a penal order if the suspect is a foreigner
De officier van justitie kan geen strafbeschikking uitvaardigen indien de verdachte een vreemdeling is
Motie van het lid Vondeling over stoppen met het weggeven van huizen aan statushouders ten koste van Nederlanders
Asks the government to stop allocating houses to status holders at the expense of Dutch citizens on the waiting list.
requests the government to stop giving houses to status holders at the expense of Dutch people
verzoekt de regering te stoppen met het weggeven van huizen aan statushouders ten koste van Nederlanders
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Vondeling ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het verlagen van de leeftijd voor een kindgesprek
Lowers the age at which judges must invite a child to a private hearing from twelve to eight years in civil code and procedure code.
in article 809 of the Code of Civil Procedure twelve years is replaced by eight years
In artikel 809 van het Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering wordt «twaalf jaren» steeds vervangen door «acht jaren».
Amendement van het lid Vondeling over het verlagen van de leeftijd voor een kindgesprek
Lowers from twelve to eight the age at which judges must invite children to a private conversation about their views in family cases.
At present judges are legally obliged to invite children of twelve years old to a so-called child conversation.
Op dit moment zijn rechters wettelijk verplicht om kinderen van twaalf jaar uit te nodigen voor een zogenaamd kindgesprek.
Amendement van het lid Vondeling over een verwijderingstermijn van maximaal 24 uur
Sets a maximum of 24 hours for providers to remove child abuse images when ordered by an authority.
that this term shall be at most twenty-four hours
dat die termijn ten hoogste vierentwintig uren bedraagt
Amendement van het lid Vondeling over incompatibiliteit van het rechterschap en het lidmaatschap van provinciale staten, de gemeenteraad en de waterschappen
Extends the incompatibility rule for judges to membership of municipal councils, provincial councils and water boards, and bars judicial officers from those bodies.
This amendment therefore also provides a ban on holding the office of judge simultaneously with membership of provincial states, the municipal council and the water boards.
Daarom regelt dit amendement ook een verbod op het gelijktijdig uitoefenen van het ambt van de rechter en het lidmaatschap van de provinciale staten, de gemeenteraad en de waterschappen.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht dat 10 procent van de gevangenen ongewenst vreemdeling is

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister why foreign offenders without residence status can enter the Netherlands but are hard to deport after crimes, whether free-roaming offenders exist, the cost per detainee, the origin and asylum background of these prisoners, and whether borders should close to asylum seekers and migrants from Islamic countries. The government answered that VRIS offenders are prioritised for return, that some tbs-passants and self-reporters are not detained and their status is not registered, that costs are estimated at 125-130 million euro per year, that origin and asylum background are not recorded, and that closing borders to groups is not a realistic solution.
It is not registered whether detainees come from an Islamic country.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd of gedetineerden uit een islamitisch land komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over het bericht dat een Hamas-fan die betrokken was bij de terreuraanval van 7 oktober opduikt bij een pro-Palestijnse sit-in Amsterdam

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked why a man who filmed the 7 October 2023 attack and praised Hamas could enter the Netherlands and attend a pro-Palestinian sit-in, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers from Islamic countries. The government said it will legislate against glorifying terrorism, will not comment on individual cases, gave no exact figures on Hamas supporters, and refused to close borders by origin, citing non-discrimination law.
The cabinet makes no statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doet het kabinet geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over dat het antisemitische punkduo Bob Vylan in september en oktober optreedt in Amsterdam en Tilburg

An MP asks whether Bob Vylan, a punk duo accused of antisemitic chanting at Glastonbury, should be barred from performing at Paradiso and 013 and from entering the Netherlands. The Minister says entry can be refused under Schengen rules for threats to public order, that municipalities decide on performances, and that a pre-emptive ban requires concrete serious disorder risks; he does not commit to cancelling the shows.
The local government is responsible for maintaining public order and makes its own assessment in this.
Het lokaal bestuur is verantwoordelijk voor de handhaving van de openbare orde en maakt daarin een eigen afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over dat visumvrij reizen voor Turken wordt versoepeld

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether visa rules for Turkish citizens were being loosened and whether this could bring millions of Turks to the Netherlands. Minister Brekelmans answered that the change only adjusts the Schengen cascade model for repeat, bona fide travellers, that visa conditions are unchanged, and that visa liberalisation for Turkey is not on the table because Turkey still has to meet six outstanding conditions.
It concerns an adjustment of the existing Schengen cascade model for Turkish travellers who have previously used their visa correctly.
Het gaat om een aanpassing van het bestaande Schengen cascademodel voor Turkse reizigers die eerder op de juiste manier gebruik hebben gemaakt van hun visum

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Vondeling over het bericht dat Denemarken en Italië steun zoeken om de bevoegdheden van het Europese Hof van de Rechten van de Mensen op het gebied van asiel en immigratie te be

PVV MPs Wilders and Vondeling asked whether the government would co-sign a letter by Denmark and Italy seeking to limit the European Court of Human Rights' reach on asylum and immigration, and whether it had been approached to support it. The government answered that it supports the letter's general call for a dialogue on expelling convicted foreigners but will not co-sign because the call to debate the Court's interpretation of the ECHR touches judicial independence, and that it will pursue this via other channels.
The Netherlands does not want to give the impression that it wishes to sit in the judge's seat and therefore cannot support that part of the call.
Nederland wil niet de indruk wekken op de stoel van de rechter te willen zitten en kan daarom dat deel van de oproep niet steunen.
Antwoord op van het lid Vondeling over de aanstelling van een oud GL-raadslid in Amsterdam en de directeur van Oxfam International als secretaris directeur van de Adviesraad Migratie

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the appointment of Evelien van Roemburg, a former GroenLinks councillor and Oxfam International director, as secretary-director of the Adviesraad Migratie was appropriate given her public statements, and whether it would be reversed. The minister confirmed the appointment, stated the advisory council is independent, and said the selection followed a standard civil-service procedure, declining to reverse it.
This appointment concerns a civil-service appointment.
Deze aanstelling betreft een ambtelijke benoeming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht ‘Onlogische, lange en onnodige ritten: misbruik taxivervoer asielzoekers blootgelegd´

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reported misuse of taxi transport for asylum seekers, including how much was spent, why COA books taxis without control, and whether rides will be curbed. The minister reported high taxi and medical transport volumes and costs, said COA will limit non-medical taxi rides from 1 June, and referred to planned tightening on fraud-linked withdrawal of asylum permits.
COA indicates that it cannot share the current costs of this, due to commercially confidential information.
COA geeft aan dat het de huidige kosten hiervan, vanwege bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, niet kan delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vondeling en Emiel van Dijk over Ayoub Y. die in 2020 de 18-jarige Rik van de Rakt doodstak.

PVV MPs asked why Ayoub M., who stabbed 18-year-old Rik van de Rakt while holding a temporary residence permit, was not stripped of his permit, why he may soon qualify for tbs leave, and whether he will be deported. The ministers said they do not discuss individual cases, described the tbs leave assessment procedure in general terms, and pointed to their general policy letter on revoking asylum permits.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht dat Oekraïners nog steeds niet hoeven mee te betalen aan hun opvang

An MP asked why almost no municipality collects the own contribution Ukrainian refugees owe for their reception, and whether the government will ensure collection by 1 January 2025 and raise the contribution. The minister answered that municipalities were given until 1 January 2025 to implement the contribution, that the Rijk supports them and covers collection costs, and that the contribution will be reassessed after a cost study.
That is why agreements were made with municipalities that they will have until 1 January 2025 at the latest to do this.
Daarom is met gemeenten afgesproken dat zij hiervoor tot uiterlijk 1 januari 2025 de tijd krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over de aanhouding van een griffier voor het lekken van informatie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice about the arrest of a court clerk in Rotterdam on suspicion of leaking information, including what was leaked, how many cases were involved and whether earlier signals existed. The State Secretary declined to discuss the facts or individual cases because the Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing, and only noted that this is a suspicion, not established guilt.
It is not for me as State Secretary to make statements about individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Staatssecretaris om uitspraken te doen over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over nog steeds geen terugkeer ontvoerde dochter Madeline

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection what steps have been taken to reunite a 10-year-old girl with her father in the Philippines, despite an arrest warrant and a court order for her return. The minister replies that the case is a domestic matter for Philippine authorities, that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs provides consular assistance but cannot discuss substance for privacy reasons, and that no contact with the Philippine Central Authority has occurred.
Nevertheless, as Minister for Legal Protection I have no instruments at my disposal to take steps.
Desondanks heb ik als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen instrumenten tot mijn beschikking om stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het mediabericht dat de gemeente Soest een besluit zou hebben genomen om bingo te verbieden

An MP asked the government whether the municipality of Soest banned senior bingo afternoons under the Betting and Gaming Act, and whether the rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that no municipal ban exists, that bingo in private settings or without prizes is allowed, and that an exception for small games in hospitality venues will be added to the Alcohol Act.
I will add an exception to the Alcohol Act for organising small games of chance, such as bingo, in hospitality venues
Ik ga in de Alcoholwet een uitzondering opnemen voor het organiseren van kleine kansspelen, zoals bingo's, in horecalokaliteiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht dat er steeds meer malafide letselspecialisten zijn

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of increasingly fraudulent injury-claim specialists taking money from victims, and about measures against them. The minister said no figures exist, pointed to the NKL quality mark and a pending WODC study with a policy response due in Q3 2024, and declined to make such specialists a protected profession pending that research.
I want to await the content of this study. The results of this study will appear before the summer recess.
Ik wil de inhoud van dit onderzoek afwachten. De resultaten van dit onderzoek zullen voor het zomerreces verschijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Vondeling over een moeder die voor gerechtigheid vecht na de dood van haar zoon

MPs Vondeling and Faber-van de Klashorst asked about the case of a 22-year-old killed by a driver who was speeding and under the influence, including why he was released from pre-trial detention, why the hearing took 14 months, whether sentences are too low, and whether friends of victims should get speaking rights in court. The Minister declined to comment on the pending case, pointed to 2020 tougher traffic-offence laws, ongoing reforms on driving bans and drink-driving, and said speaking rights for close friends will be considered in the new Code of Criminal Procedure.
No statements will be made about the present case, as it is still before the judge, and any investigation results are subject to the judge's assessment.
Over de onderhavige zaak worden geen mededelingen gedaan, nu deze nog onder de rechter is, en eventuele onderzoeksresultaten aan het oordeel van de rechter onderworpen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de Kamerleden Vondeling en Crijns over het bericht dat uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen stilzwijgend worden verlengd

MPs Vondeling and Crijns asked whether child out-of-home placements and supervision orders are extended without a court hearing via the 'meldbrief' procedure, and whether this is extra-legal. The minister acknowledged roughly 4,000 yearly extensions decided without a hearing (under 30%), said the meldbrief procedure is problematic, and promised the LOVF is seeking an alternative, while maintaining the judge decides whether to hold a hearing.
The National Consultation on Family and Youth Law has indicated, in consultation with my ministry, that it gives high priority to finding an alternative to the current meldbrief procedure.

Het Landelijk Overleg Vakinhoud Familie- en jeugdrecht (LOVF) heeft in overleg met mijn ministerie aangegeven hoge prioriteit te geven aan het zoeken naar een alternatief voor de huidige procedure met de meldbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vondeling en Markuszower over ‘overvolle gevangenissen en Tbs-klinieken’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many convicted offenders are free because prisons and tbs clinics are full, whether convicted criminals should never escape their sentences, and what will be done to ensure all sentenced criminals are imprisoned. The Minister answered that 636 adult male self-reporters are temporarily not being called up, that about 150 tbs-passanten are held in prisons, and that the measure is a temporary emergency to be lifted as soon as staffing allows, with further measures being examined.
Not admitting self-reporters is a temporary emergency measure due to staff shortages at DJI, so that not all cells can be used.
Het niet opnemen van zelfmelders is een tijdelijke noodmaatregel als gevolg van persoonstekort bij DJI waardoor niet alle cellen inzetbaar zijn.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Six Dijkstra over de personele bezetting bij de Commissie Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (CTIVD)

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Interior Minister how oversight of the AIVD and MIVD will be ensured when the temporary law on cyber programmes and bulk datasets takes effect on 1 July, given the CTIVD's stated lack of capacity, and when the CTIVD will get the workspace needed to hire 10 promised FTE. The government replied that the CTIVD will be temporarily housed from 1 January 2025 and permanently from 1 July 2026 with enough space for the expansion, but that the CTIVD has said it cannot oversee the other provisions of the law until its move is complete, so those powers will only be used after that or earlier if agreed with the CTIVD.
The CTIVD has indicated it cannot oversee the other provisions of the Temporary Act because the cyber specialists needed for this are largely occupied with work on the housing problem.

De CTIVD heeft aangegeven geen toezicht te kunnen houden op de overige bepalingen uit de Tijdelijke wet, omdat de daarvoor benodigde cyberspecialisten voor een groot deel belast zijn met werkzaamheden voor de huisvestingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Koekkoek over het niet op orde hebben van het toezicht op de geheime diensten

MPs Kathmann and Koekkoek asked why the CTIVD, which oversees the intelligence services, still lacks workspace and 10 additional staff, and whether the new Temporary Act can responsibly take effect without a fully equipped overseer. The government answers that housing is being sought with strict security requirements, a temporary solution is available from January 2025 and permanent housing by mid-2026, and that the Act's powers will be phased in as oversight capacity grows.

As stated in the letter of 26 June 2024 on the entry into force of the Temporary Act, the Act contains provisions that must become available as soon as possible but that create no additional work for the CTIVD.

Zoals in de brief van 26 juni 2024 over de inwerkingtreding van de Tijdelijke wet is aangegeven, bevat de Tijdelijke wet voorzieningen waarvan het van groot belang is dat deze zo spoedig mogelijk beschikbaar komen, maar waar geen extra werkzaamheden voor de CTIVD uit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de betrokkenheid van de regering bij het strafproces tegen een Kamerlid en openbaarmaking van alle daarop betrekking hebbende documenten

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the government was involved in the criminal prosecution of a fellow MP and asked for disclosure of all related documents. The Minister of Justice answered that the Public Prosecution Service informed the ministry in advance as is customary for sensitive cases, that no overview of contacts or public statements is available, that no contacts with the judiciary occurred, and that documents will not be released beyond what was already stated.
I do not have such an overview and for that reason it is not possible to provide it.
Over een dergelijk overzicht beschik ik niet en om die reden is het niet mogelijk om dit te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het staatsbezoek van de Emir van Qatar

An SGP MP asked the government about the state visit of the Emir of Qatar, including the royal lunch, whether the Emir would be pressed to free Israeli hostages, and the presence of Hamas leaders in Doha. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the visit followed standard protocol, that the hostage release was stressed in talks, and that Qatar's mediation role requires its ties with Hamas.
During the conversation with the Emir, the importance of releasing the hostages was strongly emphasised.
Tijdens het gesprek met de Emir is het belang van de vrijlating van de gegijzelden sterk benadrukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de mogelijkheden voor aanvullende leveringen van luchtafweersystemen aan Oekraïne

Boswijk (CDA) asks whether the government will seize the room NATO's Secretary General opened to dip below stockpile floors and deliver more Patriot systems to Ukraine, and whether it will push for more joint NATO exercises. Minister Ollongren answers that the Netherlands has led a coalition assembling a full Patriot system, contributing three launchers and a radar, backs expanding stockpiles and production, and that existing joint exercises already occur without freeing capabilities.
The Netherlands has taken the lead in bringing together an international coalition for the supply of additional Patriot capacity to Ukraine.
Nederland heeft het voortouw genomen om een internationale coalitie bijeen te brengen voor de levering van aanvullende Patriot capaciteit aan Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de benoeming tot Secretaris-Generaal van de NAVO

An MP asked the Prime Minister why he had denied in 2022 being a candidate for NATO Secretary-General, when he later confirmed availability in October 2023, and when he began discussing the post. The Prime Minister confirmed the 2021 trip, said he had earlier declined such approaches, and that he became available via diplomatic contact in September 2023 and publicly confirmed it in October 2023.
The answer to the questions in April 2022 was: "I am not leaving and am therefore not a candidate for the post of SG of NATO."
Het antwoord op de vragen in april 2022 luidde: «Ik ga niet weg en ben dus geen kandidaat voor de functie van SG van de NAVO.»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitspraken van Koningin Máxima inzake de digitale euro

MP Van Houwelingen (FVD) asked the Prime Minister whether Queen Máxima had advocated for the digital euro, citing two statements she made. The Minister of Finance answered that the Queen did not argue for or against a digital euro, that her remarks concerned financial inclusion within her UN role, and that the questions could not be answered within three weeks.
Queen Máxima has neither advocated for nor against a possible digital euro.
Koningin Máxima heeft niet voor of tegen een mogelijke digitale euro gepleit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Nord Stream-gasleiding

An MP from FVD asked the Prime Minister whether the state responsible for blowing up Nord Stream should be treated as hostile, why the government would not call a sabotage act of aggression regardless of perpetrator, and about Gasunie's investment and state ownership. The government declined to speculate on the perpetrator, which the German authorities are investigating, and answered the financial questions largely factually, saying Gasunie's net investment was lower and had been recovered through dividends.
German authorities are conducting an investigation into the circumstances of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines.
Er wordt door de Duitse autoriteiten onderzoek gedaan naar de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nordstream pijpleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet whether its 2030 targets (housing, social rental share, insulation, affordable rent quotas) were still achievable. The minister answered that progress is on track for most targets, with some delays in housing and insulation of rental homes, and promised further reporting.
For the National Insulation Programme the targets are not out of sight.
Voor het Nationaal Isolatieprogramma zijn de doelstellingen niet uit beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to state, for each 2030 target, whether it is still achievable, including nitrogen halving and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that nitrogen deposition targets are out of reach due to revised critical deposition values, and that organic farmland is growing steadily but a large gap remains, with extra funding reserved.
The nitrogen targets are currently out of reach.
De stikstofdoelen liggen op dit moment buiten bereik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked about progress toward the cabinet's 2030 targets on poverty and debt, and whether current measures suffice. The minister answers that poverty and child poverty targets will not be met without additional policy per the CPB forecast, while the debt target shows a slight rise with no CBS forecast, and commits to informing parliament in early June.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the cabinet whether four education and research targets (zero truant children, 3% R&D spending, fewer than 18,000 early school leavers by 2026, and basic skills by 2028) remain achievable and why. The Minister answered that the targets are not hopeless, described the measures taken, and acknowledged that R&D spending (2.30% of GDP) and truancy figures are behind track, without changing the cabinet's commitments.
The picture that the targets under K, Q, U and V have become hopelessly out of reach is not one we recognise.
Het beeld dat de genoemde doelstellingen onder K, Q, U en V hopeloos uit beeld zijn geraakt herkennen wij niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current progress on 19 government targets for 2030 and beyond, with concrete figures per target. The answer, limited to the target of 50% less raw material use, says the government is replacing that target with a new set of national circular-economy goals and that PBL will monitor progress in its next report in 2025.
In the National Circular Economy Programme 2023–2030 it was announced that the target of using 50% fewer abiotic raw materials by 2030 will be replaced by a set of overarching national goals.

In het Nationaal Programma Circulaire Economie (NPCE) 2023–2030 ... is aangekondigd dat de doelstelling om in 2030 50% minder abiotische grondstoffen te gebruiken, vervangen zal worden door een set aan overkoepelende doelen op nationaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet to report progress on its 2030 targets, including 100% clean water by 2027 under the EU Water Framework Directive. The minister answered only that sub-question, stating that roughly three-quarters of about 100,000 water-body targets are currently met, that many planned measures risk not being completed by 2027, and that a progress update will come before a June debate and an evaluation at year end.
In the run-up to the Water committee debate of 25 June, the House will receive an update on the progress of the KRW impulse programme.
In aanloop naar het Commissiedebat Water van 25 juni ontvangt de Kamer een update over de voortgang van het KRW-impulsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government for the progress on its 2030 targets for CO2 reduction and R&D spending, citing reports that the targets were out of reach. The ministers answer that the 55-60% CO2 target is within reach given PBL projections of 46-57% plus further measures, and that the 3% GDP R&D target is ambitious, with uncertainty from the paused National Growth Fund.

The PBL indicates that the expected greenhouse gas emission reduction in the Netherlands in 2030, based on the policy on the agenda for which an effect estimate could be made, comes to about 46–57% compared with 1990.

Het PBL geeft aan dat de verwachte broeikasgasemissiereductie in Nederland in 2030 op basis van het geagendeerde beleid, waarvoor een effectschatting kon worden gemaakt, uitkomt op circa 46–57% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the cabinet for the current status of its 2030 targets, including halving road deaths. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answers only the road-casualty sub-question: the target is likely too ambitious, the cabinet keeps existing measures and will examine an extra step, with results expected mid-2024.
For question 2, under e, you will receive a separate answer from me shortly.
Voor vraag 2, onder e, zult u op korte termijn een separaat antwoord van mij ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het bericht ‘Israëlische ambassade dient klacht in bij Schiphol na incident met vrijgelaten gijzelaar’

MPs Wilders and Markuszower asked whether reports were true that two Israeli women, one a former Hamas hostage, were mistreated by a Schiphol security employee, and whether the employee could be dismissed. The minister said he was shocked, the Marechaussee mediated on site, the employee works for Schiphol so the ministry lacks authority over them, and Schiphol says it apologised personally via the embassy.
Because it concerns an employee of Schiphol, the Ministry of IenW has no authority over this employee.
Omdat het een medewerker van Schiphol betreft, heeft het Ministerie van IenW geen zeggenschap over deze medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Stultiens over de voortgang van kabinetsdoelstellingen zoals in deze vragen geformuleerd onder i, j, r, s en t

MPs Van der Lee and Stultiens asked the government about progress on cabinet targets for 2030 and 2040, including zero homelessness, zero youth in closed youth care, reducing health inequalities and reducing overweight. The State Secretary replied that targets are ambitious but progress is partial: homelessness and overweight targets are unlikely to be met without intensified measures, closed placements have fallen but zero is not yet reached, and the health-inequality mission has no quantitative forecast yet.
The calculation shows that the agreements do contribute to fewer people with overweight, but with the actions from the NPA introduced in recent years the ambitions for 2040 will not be achieved.

De doorrekening laat zien dat de afspraken weliswaar bijdragen aan minder mensen die overgewicht hebben, maar met de acties uit het NPA die de afgelopen jaren zijn ingevoerd worden de ambities voor 2040 niet bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de dreiging van een nucleaire oorlog tussen Nederland en Rusland

MPs Baudet and Van Houwelingen asked the government about the risk of nuclear war with Russia, including whether troops would be sent to Ukraine, the effects of nuclear weapons, and whether Ukraine could join NATO and the EU. The ministers answered that Russia's invasion is illegal, that Nederland is not at war with Russia, that deterrence is maintained, and that no decision on troop deployment can be anticipated, while several questions were answered jointly or left to later decisions.
The cabinet cannot elaborate further on the nature of the discussions due to confidentiality.
Het kabinet kan in verband met vertrouwelijkheid niet verder op de aard van de besprekingen in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over jihadistische illegalen in Nederland en de reactie van het kabinet op eerdere vragen hierover

An MP from JA21 asked the government about jihadist illegal residents in the Netherlands, including whether they are being actively tracked, how many failed asylum seekers with jihadist sympathies left with unknown destination, and why a promised letter and national monitoring pilot were delayed. The Justice Minister answered that the letter was sent on 11 March 2024, that data on these groups cannot be automatically extracted, that about 15 denaturalised terrorism convicts are at liberty with some supervision measures, and that a national return coordination pilot starts within weeks.
The number of rejected asylum seekers with jihadist sympathies who pose a threat to national security cannot be automatically derived from the DT&V systems.
Het aantal uitgeprocedeerde asielzoekers met jihadistische sympathieën dat een dreiging vormt voor de nationale veiligheid kan niet automatisch aan de systemen van DT&V te worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over de Russische desinformatiecampagne via sociale media in Duitsland

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about a reported Russian disinformation campaign on X in Germany and whether similar campaigns target the Netherlands, including the adequacy of Dutch law, the EU Digital Services Act and platform responsibility. The minister acknowledged foreign interference risks, said no concrete Dutch cases were identified in the election, pointed to EU and NATO information sharing, announced a review of whole-of-government disinformation policy, and noted the European Commission opened a formal DSA procedure against X.

In its letter of 9 November 2023 the cabinet already announced it would examine whether, and if so how, the whole-of-government approach to disinformation about the core democratic processes should be strengthened.

In de brief 9 november 2023 heeft het kabinet daarom al aangekondigd te onderzoeken of, en zo ja hoe, de Rijksbrede aanpak van desinformatie over de kernprocessen van de democratie versterkt moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een overzicht van de functies of rollen die leden van het kabinet en het Koningshuis op dit moment vervullen bij het World Economic Forum

An FVD MP asked the cabinet for an overview of cabinet members' and the Royal House's roles at the World Economic Forum, and who has access to the 'Great Reset Portal'. The government listed the Minister of SZW's membership of the Jobs Consortium and the Queen's roles in the Edison Alliance and a now-dissolved board, and said the Great Reset portal no longer exists, with access previously held by three ministers.
The Minister of SZW is a member of the Jobs Consortium.
De Minister van SZW is lid van het Jobs Consortium
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het zoveelste gekleurde onderzoek over naar extreem geweld in het voormalige Nederlands-Indië

An MP asks the government about its handling of extreme violence in the Dutch East Indies, including a proposed investigation of the Bersiap period, rehabilitation of figures like Spoor and Westerling, backpay for KNIL survivors, Moluccan apologies and Papua. The government points to its earlier decolonisation research and apologies, rejects several demands, and declines to take new commitments on most points.
The cabinet continues the dialogue with representatives of the Moluccan communities.
Het kabinet zet de dialoog met vertegenwoordigers uit de Molukse gemeenschappen voort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice concerns about the winning parties, and whether such meetings are compatible with civil service neutrality. The government answered that the meetings were regular discussions of the election outcome, denied that working attitudes changed, declined to say how many staff attended, and said no similar meetings are planned.
No, it is not recorded how many staff members took part in regular staff meetings and consultations on the election outcome during the day.
Nee, er wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers gedurende de dag in reguliere staven en overleggen over de verkiezingsuitslag hebben gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministry meetings after the November 2023 election let civil servants voice their feelings about the outcome, whether this places civil servants who voted for winning parties in an awkward position, and whether such meetings will be held again. The VWS minister answered that discussions about what the result means for policy work took place, that attendance was not recorded, that civil servants must remain politically neutral, and that the ministry values an open and safe working climate.
It was not recorded how many employees were present.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel medewerkers aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government confirmed that BZK held two meetings to interpret the result, stated civil servants must remain politically neutral, and said such sessions fit an open workplace culture without committing to avoid them in future.
Civil servants have a supporting, advisory and executing role, in which they are expected, on the basis of professionalism, to advise objectively.
Ambtenaren hebben hierbij een ondersteunende, adviserende en uitvoerende rol, waarin zij op basis van professionaliteit worden geacht om objectief te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Defence organised meetings for officials after the November 2023 election, including whether such meetings put civil servants in a difficult position and whether they will be repeated. The minister answered that no departmental, DG or directorate-level meetings were held, only regular discussions of the election result, and that a safe working environment and political neutrality of officials are important.
No meetings were organised at the Ministry of Defence at departmental, directorate-general or directorate level following the election result.
Op het Ministerie van Defensie zijn geen bijeenkomsten georganiseerd op departementaal, dan wel op directoraat-generaal of directieniveau naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether civil servants were gathered after the November 2023 election to voice concerns about winning parties, and whether such meetings would recur.
