The minister replied that no formal meetings were held, only routine discussions on the election result, and that civil servants should be free to share reflections while staying politically neutral.
No formal meetings were organised by the ministry or at Directorate-General level.
Er zijn geen formele bijeenkomsten georganiseerd door het ministerie of op DG-niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings for civil servants after the November 2023 election result, what they were for, and whether such gatherings undermine civil servant neutrality. The minister confirmed meetings were held to reflect on the result, said staff were encouraged to share views without restriction, declined to give attendance numbers, and said such meetings may be repeated after a new coalition agreement.
It was not recorded how many colleagues attended the various meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel collega's de verschillende bijeenkomsten hebben bijgewoond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministers whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election results, what their purpose was, whether staff could voice how their working approach would change, and whether such meetings threaten civil servants' neutrality. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the ministry held an online briefing on the election outcome for all staff, with no interactive input, plus internal directorate discussions, that such briefings are standard after elections and planned after the coalition agreement, and that civil servants remain politically neutral.
Because many employees watched the online presentation together on one screen, it cannot be determined exactly how many employees attended.
Omdat veel medewerkers de online presentatie samen op een scherm hebben bekeken, is niet exact te achterhalen hoeveel medewerkers hierbij aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether OCW held internal meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the outcome and how this affects their neutrality. The minister confirmed a departmental meeting and several directorate meetings focused on the implications of the results and the primacy of politics, stating civil servants remain politically neutral and that such reflection is part of their work.
It is important that civil servants remain politically neutral in their work.
Het is belangrijk dat ambtenaren politiek neutraal zijn en blijven in hun werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, whether staff could voice how the result changed their work, and whether such meetings threaten civil service neutrality. The minister replied that no formal meetings were organised, only informal discussions in some units, that such open dialogue fits a safe working climate, and that civil servants remain politically neutral and execute decisions made by ministers.
There is no insight into how many people participated.
Er is geen zicht op hoeveel personen deelnamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether they held meetings with civil servants after the November 2023 election, what was discussed, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The Minister of LNV answered that meetings were held to anticipate policy implications, that no restrictions were placed on input, and that such meetings remain acceptable, while stressing civil servant political neutrality.
It was not recorded how many civil servants attended the meetings.
Er is niet bijgehouden hoeveel ambtenaren bij de bijeenkomsten aanwezig waren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van 22 november 2023

An MP asked whether ministries held meetings after the November 2023 election where civil servants could voice concerns about the election result, and whether this undermines their neutrality. The government answered that such discussions took place only within existing regular meetings, that no separate meetings are planned, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
This is not possible; no overviews are kept of how many and which employees attended which meetings.
Dit is niet mogelijk, er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van hoeveel en welke medewerkers er bij welke overleggen aanwezig zijn geweest
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over bijeenkomsten met ambtenaren naar aanleiding van de verkiezingsuitslag van     22 november 2023

An MP asked ministries whether civil servants were invited to meetings after the November 2023 election about how their working conditions might change under a new coalition, and whether such meetings threaten civil servant neutrality. The government answered that no departmental meetings were held beyond regular discussions of the election, that it does not rule out future meetings about election outcomes, and that civil servants must remain politically neutral.
No, I do not rule out that in the future meetings will take place where the outcome of elections is discussed.
Nee, ik sluit niet uit dat in de toekomst bijeenkomsten plaatsvinden waar over de uitkomst van verkiezingen wordt gesproken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Zwitserse regering die het World Economic Forum, op basis van de Zwitserse 'Host State Act' (HSA), formeel erkent als een 'internationale organisatie'

The MP asks whether Switzerland formally recognised the World Economic Forum as an international organisation under its Host State Act, with immunity and tax privileges, and why the Prime Minister called the WEF a non-governmental organisation. The minister confirms the Swiss agreement (recognising the WEF as another international body, granting foundation status and direct federal tax exemption but no immunity), describes the WEF as an international NGO without political decision-making, and says the questions can be answered separately within three weeks.
No political decision-making takes place there.
Er vindt geen politieke besluitvorming plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het WEF en de belasting voor miljonairs en miljardairs

An SP MP asked the government whether it endorses the WEF participation and why taxpayers fund it, what the costs are, whether ministers account for outcomes, and what has been done about taxing millionaires and billionaires after motions on that topic. The minister replied that attendance offers networking and Dutch interests, listed accommodation costs of about 6,000 euros in total and that the government is transparent about its delegation, and referred to earlier studies (Bouwstenen 2020 and 2022, a 2023 letter and an IBO fiche on wealth tax) as the follow-up to the millionaire tax motions.
Besides six cabinet members, ten civil servants from the Netherlands travelled to Davos.
Naast zes kabinetsleden, zijn tien ambtenaren uit Nederland afgereisd naar Davos.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Palmen over bericht ‘Sabotage in Iran: een missie in duisternis’

Two MPs asked the Prime Minister whether political leadership was fully informed and gave green light before an Iranian sabotage operation reported by Volkskrant, and whether the legal powers exist for digital sabotage. The minister declined to discuss operations or the information given to the Prime Minister, citing secrecy, and pointed to parliamentary oversight via the CIVD and the CTIVD and to the legal basis for disruption measures.
Because of the mentioned duty of secrecy, the information provided to the Prime Minister cannot be addressed in public.
Vanwege de genoemde plicht tot geheimhouding kan in het openbaar niet worden ingegaan op de informatievoorziening aan de Minister-President.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de betrokkenheid van een AIVD’er bij het saboteren van het Iraanse kernwapenprogramma

MP Sneller asked the government whether the AIVD was involved in a 2007 sabotage operation against Iran's nuclear programme, who approved it, whether parliament's intelligence committee was informed, and whether the CTIVD should investigate. The minister declined to answer on the specific operation citing the statutory duty of secrecy, stated that the same rules apply abroad as at home, and said the CTIVD decides itself whether to investigate.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the methods of the services, I cannot respond substantively to the alleged involvement of the Netherlands.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palmen over de opvolging van de aanbevelingen bij het rapport “De archivering van chatberichten bij het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken”

An MP asks the Prime Minister about follow-up to the inspectorate's report on archiving chat messages at the Prime Minister's ministry, including the ministry's placement under enhanced supervision, the new document management system, and whether the Prime Minister's chats are archived systematically and searchably. The government answers that the ministry is under enhanced supervision and that chats are now stored in the document system, but largely defers to the national approach, leaves key questions on systematic and verifiable archiving without a concrete timeline, and points to pending legislation and ongoing market research.
As I reported in my response to the Inspectorate's report, I have not deleted any chat messages since the end of May 2022, and they are retained for safekeeping and archiving.
Zoals ik heb gemeld in deze reactie op het Inspectierapport verwijder ik sinds eind mei 2022 geen chatberichten meer en worden deze bewaard ten behoeve van veiligstelling en archivering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over het vertrek van demissionaire ministers

SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why he agreed to early departures of caretaker ministers, whether such exits harm continuity and public trust, and whether pensions continue. The government answered that the PM does not grant or refuse such departures, that staying is generally desirable but a personal decision, and that continuity is handled case by case; it gave no new commitment.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Vroonhoven en Dassen over minister Van Nieuwenhuizen die zich met energiebedrijven en honderden miljoenen subsidies bemoeide, nadat ze wist dat ze voorzitter van Energie Neder

MPs Omtzigt, Van Vroonhoven and Dassen asked the Prime Minister how former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen could take part in decisions on subsidies and compensation for energy companies after she knew she would head Energie Nederland, and why the related FOIA request and ministerial information took so long. The government answered that no integrity issue arose, that she left the post after a political weighing, that the FOIA delay was regretted but not politically motivated, and that the requested cabinet and committee documents would not be published.

It is not appropriate to make public documents that were on the agenda of a ministerial committee or the Council of Ministers, because publication could jeopardise the proper functioning of the Council of Ministers.

Het ligt niet in de rede om stukken die geagendeerd zijn geweest in een ministeriële commissie of in de ministerraad openbaar te maken, omdat door openbaarmaking het goed functioneren van de ministerraad in het gedrang kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘Het gesprek met Klaus Schwab over kunstmatige intelligentie’ aan

An MP from FvD asked the Prime Minister why he and the government withhold substantive information about a 2023 informal meeting with Klaus Schwab (WEF) on artificial intelligence, who attended, and whether AI was linked to One Health, digital identity, biometric identification, CBDC or online information control. Rutte answered that the discussion was informal and focused on AI opportunities and risks, that One Health, digital ID, biometrics, CBDC and information control were not discussed, and that inviting people to parliament is for parliament itself to decide.
The conversation had an informal character and was intended to exchange views freely.
Het gesprek had een informeel karakter en was bedoeld om vrij met elkaar van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het D66-plan ‘Toekomst van toetreding’

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister whether the government agrees that the EU enlargement process should be reformed, and to respond to the party's plan for phased accession. The minister defended the current merit-based, conditional and reversible enlargement methodology, noted some faster integration options and declined to back revising the methodology.
Although the cabinet is open to new ideas for cooperation with candidate member states, the government is not in favour of revising the methodology of the EU enlargement process.
Hoewel het kabinet openstaat voor nieuwe ideeën voor samenwerking met de kandidaat-lidstaten, is de regering geen voorstander van het herzien van de methodologie van het EU-uitbreidingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over de aanslag op Thierry Baudet in Gent

An FVD MP asked the Justice Minister about the attack on Thierry Baudet in Ghent, the release of the Ukrainian suspect, possible Belgian negligence, and Baudet's placement on Myrotvorets' enemies list. The minister answered that he cannot comment on individual cases or Belgian decisions, said contact with Belgian authorities took place, and declined to take action on the list, calling it the work of an organisation independent of the Ukrainian government.
It is not for me to make statements about decisions taken by the Belgian authorities, nor about individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over beslissingen die zijn genomen door de Belgische autoriteiten, noch over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Hammelburg, Piri, Van der Lee en Dassen  over ‘De Russische oorlog tegen Oekraïne is eenpraktijkexamen voor Europa – en de tijd begint te dringen’

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and Volt asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the government sees risks to US military aid to Ukraine from congressional gridlock and a possible 2024 US administration cutting support, and whether Europe can cover any shortfall. The government answered that US, European and international support remains essential, that a new House speaker has been appointed, that Europe must take more responsibility, and that it will continue support in consultation with allies while F-16 transfer and munitions decisions depend on training, infrastructure, US export approval and EU criteria.
The cabinet will continue to support Ukraine for as long as necessary.
Het kabinet blijft Oekraïne steunen zolang als dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het feit dat de Minister van VWS op een foto stond met een Taliban-vertegenwoordiger in Den Haag

An MP asked how a Taliban representative obtained a Dutch visa and an access pass to a WHO event hosted in The Hague, whether intelligence services should have known, and what security and follow-up steps are planned. The minister answered that the WHO wrongly invited the representative, the visa was assessed under EU rules without a sanctions listing, and the government will review invitation and visa procedures, while the investigation into how the invitation occurred is still ongoing.
Furthermore, this case gives the Ministry of Foreign Affairs reason to examine where the visa process can be tightened so that such visa applications always undergo an additional assessment.
Voorts is deze casus voor het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aanleiding te bezien waar het visumproces kan worden aangescherpt zodat dergelijke visumaanvragen altijd een extra afweging ondergaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Nederlandse vlag

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister whether the national flag is the most inclusive flag, whether government buildings may fly partisan flags such as pride or SDG flags, and whether such flags exclude many citizens. The government repeatedly answered that it is not for the Prime Minister to judge which flag is most inclusive, that flag rules for other flags are the responsibility of the relevant minister or local authorities, and that it will not speculate about ideological associations.
The flag instruction does not apply to other flags. There are no general statutory rules for flying other flags.
Voor andere vlaggen geldt de vlaginstructie niet. Er zijn geen algemene wettelijke regels voor het vlaggen met andere vlaggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hammelburg, Sneller, Wassenberg en Bromet over het bericht dat prins Bernhard lid was van de NSDAP

Four MPs asked the Prime Minister how he views reports that Prince Bernhard had an NSDAP membership card, and whether he would support a CIDI call for research into the prince's Nazi-era past. The Prime Minister acknowledged the reports and said the information was already publicly known from accessible archives, and that further research will become possible at the Royal House Archive from early 2024 by extending access to 1948.
From the beginning of 2024, further research can be carried out in the Royal House Archive by extending access to the year 1948.
Met ingang van begin 2024 kan verder onderzoek worden verricht in het Koninklijk Huisarchief door verruiming van de toegang tot in het jaar 1948.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de Nederlandse onthouding bij stemming in de VN Algemene Vergadering over een humanitair staakt-het-vuren

An MP asked why the Netherlands abstained on a UN General Assembly resolution calling for a humanitarian ceasefire in Gaza, and whether the full cabinet or vice-premiers were informed. The minister explains the abstention as a balance of supported elements against missing ones (Israel's right to self-defence, condemnation of Hamas, release of hostages), keeps EU unity, and admits in hindsight that broader consultation would have been better, while stating the steminstructie was not normally put to the cabinet.
As a rule, a voting instruction is not submitted to the Council of Ministers.
In de regel wordt een steminstructie niet voorgelegd aan de ministerraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het artikel 'Tunesië weigert delegatie Europees Parlement toegang tot het land'

An MP asked the Prime Minister about Tunisia refusing a European Parliament delegation access, and how the Netherlands and EU should respond to Tunisia's president and whether Tunisia remains a reliable partner. The minister answered that the government finds the refusal regrettable and has raised concerns bilaterally and within the EU, but ruled out ending cooperation and emphasised continued dialogue.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that the European Parliament can do its work.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat het Europees Parlement zijn werk kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Inge van Dijk, Temmink, Van der Plas en Dekker-Abdulaziz over de RAM database bij de Belastingdienst

Five MPs asked the government about the RAM database at the Belastingdienst, including whether privacy impact assessments were done, whether parliament was misinformed, and why an external investigation is needed. The State Secretary answered that an external investigation and an investigation by the Dutch Data Protection Authority are pending, so definitive answers and the legality question cannot yet be given, and that memos and documents will be sent later.
I wish to emphasise that definitive answers can only be given after the external investigation and the investigation by the AP.
Ik wil daarbij benadrukken dat pas na het externe onderzoek en het onderzoek door de AP definitieve antwoorden gegeven kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het vernietigende rapport van het Adviescollege Openbaarheid en Informatiehuishouding (ACOI) over een Woo-verzoek van Nieuwsuur over de speech over groepsimmuniteit van premier

Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister about an ACOI advisory opinion criticising the government's handling of a Woo request on the group-immunity strategy behind the early COVID-19 speech, including how the hotspot archive is structured and whether a listing of its roughly 13,000 documents can be provided. Rutte answered that the ministry archived COVID-related material in a hotspot folder, that a full overview is not reasonably possible, that the requested group-immunity documents are not held by the ministry after a search of about 500 hits, and that the speech drafting timeline is covered by an earlier Woo decision.
A complete overview of COVID-19-related documents in the document management system of the Ministry of General Affairs cannot reasonably be provided.
Een volledig overzicht van COVID-19-gerelateerde documenten in het DMS van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken is redelijkerwijs niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over het gesprek met Klaus Schwab over kunstmatige intelligentie

An MP from FvD asked the Prime Minister about a 27 September 2023 meeting with Klaus Schwab on artificial intelligence in the global economy, including who initiated it, the purpose, participants, outcome and whether minutes exist. The government confirmed the meeting, said it was an informal exchange with no set goal or outcome, and that no minutes were made.
No minutes were made of the conversation. It was an informal conversation.
Van het gesprek zijn geen notulen gemaakt. Het betrof een informeel gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de rol van meesterdiplomaat Frans Timmermans bij de vrijlating Venezolaanse drugsbaron Hugo Carvajal

A Groep Van Haga MP asked whether the then foreign minister Timmermans' 2014 release of Venezuelan Hugo Carvajal in Aruba, criticised by US and Aruban officials, would be investigated and why it was ordered. The minister answered that the matter had been explained in detail to parliament in 2014, that Carvajal was entitled to consular immunity under the Vienna Convention, and that justice in Aruba is autonomous.
The matter, including the role of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, was explained in detail in 2014 through answers to parliamentary questions.
De kwestie is, inclusief de rol van de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, in 2014 uitvoerig toegelicht aan de hand van antwoorden op Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over dat de gemeentevlag, de provincievlag en de Nederlandse vlag alle inwoners van respectievelijk de gemeente, provincie en Nederland representeren

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister whether municipal, provincial and national flags represent all residents, whether government bodies may display other flags such as Pride and SDG flags, and whether such flags conflict with ideological neutrality. The Prime Minister answered that the flag instruction covers only the Dutch flag, that no general legal rules govern other flags (responsibility lies with ministers and local authorities), that government must be inclusive, and that Pride flags signal support for the LHBTIQ+ community.
There are no general legal rules for flying other flags.
Er zijn geen algemene wettelijke regels voor het vlaggen met andere vlaggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Yesilgöz: verdedigen dwangwet door Van der Burg ’niet ongeloofwaardig’

An MP from JA21 asked the Prime Minister whether ministers who defend the dispersal law in cabinet can criticise it as lijsttrekker during the election campaign, and whether this is constitutionally sound. The Prime Minister confirmed full cabinet support, said campaigning ministers are customary and raise no constitutional objection, and declined to judge what voters find understandable.
It is customary for sitting office holders to contribute to the election campaign of their political party. There are no constitutional objections to this.
Het is gebruikelijk dat zittende bewindspersonen een bijdrage leveren aan de verkiezingscampagne van hun politieke partij. Hier zijn geen staatsrechtelijke bezwaren tegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Romke de Jong (D66) over het bericht 'Afschaffing btw op groente en fruit dreigt te sneuvelen'

MPs Grinwis and Romke de Jong asked why the government doubts introducing a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables despite coalition support and the Prime Minister's remark that the tax service can implement it. The state secretaries answer that no decision has been taken, that the zero rate would invite endless legal challenges under the neutrality principle and cost 550-950 million euros, and that implementation on 1 January 2024 is not advisable.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de levering van F16’s aan Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether the decision to supply F-16s to Ukraine was taken on 20 August 2023 without first submitting it to parliament, given the caretaker cabinet, and how many aircraft and under what conditions. The government answered that it has only expressed the intention to supply F-16s, that delivery depends on training, infrastructure, US approval and EU export criteria, that numbers are not yet fixed, and that parliament will be informed later about the timeline.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged timeline for delivery.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over het cancelen van het Regiment Van Heutsz tijdens de Nationale Indiëherdenking

An MP asked the government about the omission of the Regiment Van Heutsz banner at the 2023 National Indies Commemoration and the enhanced role of the Indonesian ambassador, raising concerns about consultation and the commemoration's direction. The state secretary answered that the independent foundation decides the format, that the banner rotation reflects diversity of military involvement, that the government will not take steps or enter specific talks, and that it supports the organisation.
The Foundation National Commemoration 15 August 1945 is independent and itself decides how the national commemoration on 15 August is shaped.
De stichting Nationale herdenking 15 augustus 1945 is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf hoe de nationale herdenking op 15 augustus wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Warmerdam over het artikel 'Italië begint met schrappen namen van niet-biologische moeders uit geboorteakten'

An MP asked the government about Italy's order to remove non-biological mothers' names from children's birth certificates, its consequences for parental rights, children's rights, and LGBTQ+ rights, and whether the Netherlands would speak out. The government answered that the consequences are uncertain and that it shares concerns, will raise the matter bilaterally with Italy, judges a public statement premature, and is monitoring implications for Dutch parents in Italy under EU law.
The cabinet also has concerns about the possible consequences of this development.
Het kabinet heeft ook zorgen over de eventuele gevolgen van deze ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat illegaal teakhout uit Myanmar gebruikt is bij de renovatie van de Groene Draeck

An MP asked whether illegal Myanmar teak was used in the publicly co-funded renovation of the royal yacht Groene Draeck, whether its origin can be verified, and whether an independent investigation will be held. The Prime Minister replied that the renovation is a matter for the Royal Household, that the wood was bought from a German supplier within the EU with a due diligence declaration, that its origin cannot be traced because records were discarded, and that no independent investigation is warranted.
The public interest is not at stake, and I therefore see no reason for an investigation.
Het openbaar belang is niet aan de orde, en ik zie derhalve geen aanleiding voor onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het schieten met een pistool en mitrailleur op een foto van mijn hoofd

The MP Wilders asks whether the government is aware of a video showing a threat against him, whether the AIVD and NCTV were informed, what steps are taken to trace the perpetrator, and whether diplomatic measures will be taken if the video comes from Pakistan. The minister condemns the threat, declines to comment on intelligence and protection matters or on the individual investigation, and says the Pakistani ambassador would be informed of concerns and that a legal assistance request is possible.
As Minister of Justice and Security, I cannot go into individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kroger en Piri over de berichtgeving rondom de Tunesië-deal

MPs Kroger and Piri asked about the formal status, accountability and human rights safeguards of the EU-Tunisia memorandum of understanding on migration and partnership. The government answered that the MoU is a non-binding political commitment agreed by the European Commission, with no formal role for the European Parliament, and that existing human rights obligations are unchanged, while committing to press Tunisia on rights and to keep the House informed on implementation and funding.
There is no formal role for the European Parliament in the drafting of MoUs.
Er is geen formele rol van het Europees parlement bij de totstandkoming van MoU’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt over het artikel 'Tunesië-deal zit vol ‘juridische bochten’, zeggen experts'

An MP from D66 asked the government about the EU-Tunisia migration deal, including the EUR 105 million for border management, human rights safeguards, monitoring, asylum capacity and legal basis. The government answered that the MoU is non-binding, references respect for human rights and international law, and that details will follow once the Commission specifies the EU support.
Your House will be informed further once more detailed information can be provided on the design and conditions of EU support and any budgetary consequences for the Dutch budget.
Uw Kamer zal, zodra nadere informatie kan worden gegeven over vormgeving en voorwaarden van de EU-steun en eventuele budgettaire gevolgen voor de Nederlandse begroting, nader worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Drost en Ceder over de aanhoudende berichtgeving over de zorgelijke omgang met migranten aan de Tunesische grens

MPs Drost and Ceder asked the Prime Minister about reports of deaths and mistreatment of migrants at the Tunisian borders, the EU-Tunisia migration deal, Dutch responsibility, and the human rights safeguards in the deal. The government answered that the events are hard to verify and worrying, that it supports monitoring and human rights in the deal, will raise concerns in dialogue with Tunisia, and will inform parliament once details of EU support are known.
The Netherlands, in contacts with Tunisia, works for humane reception and protection with respect for human rights.
Nederland zet zich in contacten met Tunesië in voor humane opvang en bescherming met respect voor mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het artikel 'Ik dacht: ze gaan ons vermoorden. Ze gaan alle zwarte mensen in Tunesië vermoorden'

An MP asks the ministers whether they are aware of reports that Tunisian authorities expelled Black migrants without food, water or phones into the desert near the Libyan border, whether this breaches the EU-Tunisia MoU and human rights law, and what steps will be taken. The government says it is aware of worrying reports but that it is unclear what exactly happened, notes the MoU is not legally binding, and says it will keep raising migration management and human rights with Tunisia through EU and bilateral channels.
Based on the information known to the cabinet, it is unclear exactly what happened.
Op basis van de bij het kabinet bekende informatie is onduidelijk wat er precies is gebeurd.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de uitspraken van de minister van Financiën over de voordracht van de huidige minister van Buitenlandse Zaken als Eurocommissaris

An MP from JA21 asked the Prime Minister whether Finance Minister Kaag's media remarks, suggesting she would have preferred a D66 candidate over the cabinet's nominee Hoekstra as EU Commissioner, breached cabinet unity and whether she should be dismissed. The Prime Minister answered that Kaag did not distance herself from the cabinet's nomination, so cabinet unity was not at issue.
Minister Kaag did not distance herself from the cabinet's nomination in her statements.
Minister Kaag heeft in haar uitspraken geen afstand genomen van de voordracht van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Baarle, Eerdmans en Omtzigt over de voordracht van Wopke Hoekstra als Eurocommissaris

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister how Wopke Hoekstra was nominated as Dutch European Commissioner, including the procedure, any candidate profile, whether parliament was informed, and whether his departure leaves the Foreign Ministry without political direction. The government replied that the nomination followed the standard Article 246 TFEU procedure after consultation within cabinet and with the Commission President, that no candidate profile was drawn up, that parliament was not informed beyond the standard procedure, and that ministerial responsibility for the Foreign Ministry is secured.
No. The procedure was followed in line with standing policy on earlier appointments, see the answers to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. De procedure is conform staand beleid van eerdere benoemingen gevolgd, zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘brieven die professor Klaus Schwab heeft verzonden naar de premier’

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Chamber could receive the replies sent by or on behalf of him to four letters from Klaus Schwab (WEF). The Prime Minister answered yes and attached the formal and informal replies.
Yes, in the annex you will find the (in)formal replies sent by or on behalf of me to Mr Schwab or the WEF.
Ja, in de bijlage vindt u de (in)formele antwoorden die door of namens mij aan de heer Schwab of het WEF zijn gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boutkan over het bericht Regeringstoestel PH-GOV voor het eerst op Groningen Airport Eelde

MP Boutkan asked the government why a 19-minute domestic flight without passengers was used to collect the King from Groningen Airport for a trip to Madrid, and why the King did not travel by train or car, and whether this is justifiable amid climate change and poverty. The government answered that the flight carried a delegation, that the choice was the most suitable after weighing efficiency, safety, cost, sustainability and availability, and that the flight request form was recently revised.
The flight was therefore not operated without passengers and was the most suitable choice for transport to Spain.
De vlucht is derhalve niet zonder passagiers afgelegd en was de meest geschikte keuze voor het vervoer naar Spanje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het migratiepakket

An MP asks the state secretary of Justice and Security for a list of migration measures considered during failed coalition talks, of measures the four parties could agree on, and of measures the demissionary cabinet plans to implement, and whether a package can still be agreed. The government answers that no list of agreed measures exists, that the demissionary cabinet is exercising restraint so no list can be given, and that agreement on a package is not expected, while pointing to earlier letters containing internal documents.
Anticipating that, it is not possible to provide a list of measures or to give a precise date.
Vooruitlopend daarop is het niet mogelijk een lijst van maatregelen te bieden of een precieze datum aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het informeren van de Kamer over de Bilderbergconferentie 2023 in Lissabon

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister whether he and Minister Kaag attended the 2023 Bilderberg conference on government authority and why the government refuses to disclose positions they put forward there, citing the Chatham House Rule. The Prime Minister answered that no government positions are tabled at the conference, that quoting publicly known views of Henry Kissinger is not a breach of the rule, and that the questions were answered separately, though late.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Sneller over ‘Versterking kennisfunctie van de Rijksoverheid’

Sneller (D66) asked how the government has followed up on a 2018 KWINK report on open publication of ministry research and protection against political or civil-servant steering, whether a Rijksbrede knowledge function should be strengthened (Rijkslab, chief science officers), and whether ministries should have their own knowledge institutes like the WODC. The minister answered that departments already promote open publication, that no government-wide stakeholder study is needed, that the knowledge function remains a departmental responsibility with only possible interdepartmental agreements, and that the answers could not be given before the committee debate.
I therefore see no need for a government-wide stakeholder study.
Ik zie dan ook geen noodzaak voor een Rijksbreed stakeholdersonderzoek.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Haga over het naar voorbeeld van Frankrijk en België in verzet komen tegen 'klimaatpaus' Timmermans

An MP asked the government whether it shares Belgian and French concern about EU climate policy under Timmermans, including the risk of another legal nitrogen crisis and too many green rules, and whether it will pause new EU green legislation. The minister answered that the government supports the green transition, will press Dutch interests in negotiations (e.g. weakening the nature restoration law's binding targets), and will inform parliament via BNC-fiches.
For the cabinet, the green transition is not up for discussion.
Voor het kabinet staat de groene transitie niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Bilderbergconferentie in Lissabon

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about their attendance at the 2023 Bilderberg conference in Lisbon, including whether they attended in a personal capacity, why travel costs were borne by the state, and whether the Chamber could receive the invitations and a summary of positions put forward. The government confirmed both attended, that invitations would not be made public like other diplomatic correspondence, that costs are publicly disclosed under the travel-cost regulation, and that the conference is informal under Chatham House Rules with no summary of positions provided, referring to the conference website.
These invitations will, as is usual with diplomatic correspondence with other states or international organisations, not be made public.
Deze uitnodigingen zullen, net als gebruikelijk met diplomatieke correspondentie met andere staten of internationale organisaties, niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het decoratiestelsel

An MP asks the Prime Minister's government about the Dutch honours system: public support for a republic, refusals of royal decorations, non-royal honours, return of decorations after death, and posthumous awards. The minister answers that refusals are rare, defends the royal honours system as ministerially countersigned and case-by-case, and rejects new non-royal or posthumous civil honours.
A royal decoration is therefore, contrary to what is sometimes thought, not a personal favour from the King.
Een koninklijke onderscheiding is dus, in tegenstelling tot wat wel eens wordt gedacht, geen persoonlijke gunst van de Koning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Japan weigert verantwoordelijk te nemen voor de onmenselijke behandeling van 'troostmeisjes' – die gedwongen werden tot prostitutie – gedurende de Tweede Wereld

An MP asked the government about Japan's refusal to acknowledge responsibility for forced prostitution of 'comfort women' in WWII, and whether Dutch state and royal family profited from the liquidation of Japanese wartime bank funds that held their earnings. The government answered that archives (Foreign Affairs, Finance, NEFIS, National Archives) do not allow verification of such profit, sees no reason for further research, and cited archival access restrictions and the Archives Act.
At this moment the Dutch State sees no reason to conduct further investigation into the money flows, beyond the archival research already carried out.
Op dit moment ziet de Nederlandse Staat geen aanleiding om, naast het verrichte archiefonderzoek, nader onderzoek te doen naar de geldstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over een Wob/Woo-verzoek uit januari 2021 naar de reactie op het rapport ‘Ongekend Onrecht’

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked for a detailed timeline of how the government handled a Wob/Woo request from January 2021 for drafts and related documents on the response to the 'Ongekend Onrecht' report, including court rulings, why it was omitted from an earlier list, and disclosure of the inventory and drafts. The Minister answered most questions substantively, providing timelines, the court ruling and decisions, but refused to release draft letters, citing the need for internal confidentiality, and deferred assessment of the handling to the court.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de beloftes van het kabinet na het aftreden vanwege het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal

An MP asks the cabinet to report on progress on all promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including a timeline for redress for parents and children, and a full list of commitments with status, spending and responsibility. The government answers that it refers to its earlier progress letters and departmental contributions on the recovery operation, transparency, the legality principle and hardship clauses, but does not provide a single consolidated status overview of every promise.
In this letter the cabinet proposed to inform the House further in future about progress on the actions from the cabinet response in the relevant separate tracks.
In deze brief heeft het kabinet het voorstel gedaan om de Kamer voortaan verder te informeren over de voortgang van de acties uit de kabinetsreactie in de relevante afzonderlijke trajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de politieke keuzes die nodig zijn om de klimaat- en natuurcrisis te bestrijden

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether the government is making the political choices needed to tackle the climate and nature crisis, including whether its targets are sufficient for the Paris commitments, whether it heeds scientists, and whether it acknowledges the link to nature loss and livestock emissions. The minister responds that the government takes the crisis seriously, relies on IPCC-based science and an annual climate cycle, announces supplementary measures, but largely restates existing policy and does not admit the targets fall short or commit to new concrete steps.
The cabinet takes the climate crisis very seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de klimaatcrisis zeer serieus.

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de definitieve fatwa en de oproep aan Nederlandse moslims mij te vermoorden

An MP from the PVV asked the government to condemn a Pakistani fatwa calling for the MP's murder, to explain how such threats are handled, and to consider expelling the Pakistani ambassador. The government condemned the threats, said it raised concerns with Pakistan, noted a prosecution decision, and declined to discuss threat cases or intelligence assessments in public.
As is known to your House, I cannot publicly make statements about the working methods of the intelligence and security services, or about concrete threat cases and personal security measures.

Zoals bij uw Kamer bekend kan ik over de werkwijze van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten, alsmede informatie over concrete dreigings-casuïstiek en beveiligingsmaatregelen van personen, in het openbaar geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over zeer recent in Pakistan herhaalde en herbevestigde fatwa en honderden dreigementen tegen een Nederlandse parlementariër

Wilders asks the Prime Minister why a Pakistani cleric's renewed fatwa and hundreds of death threats against him have not been publicly condemned and prosecuted, and what the government will do to secure prosecution of threateners abroad. The government condemns the fatwas and threats, says it has raised serious concerns with Pakistan at several levels, notes prosecution of one Pakistan-based person is underway, but states that foreign criminal investigation is for the foreign authorities.
If no legal assistance is provided by the foreign country, the Public Prosecution Service can only prosecute persons in the Netherlands who can be directly identified from their online statements.

Het Openbaar Ministerie kan – als er door het buitenland geen rechtshulp wordt verleend – alleen personen in Nederland vervolgen die rechtstreeks zijn te identificeren op basis van hun online gedane uitlatingen.
Antwoord op op vragen van lid Wilders over het bericht ‘Radicaliseringsexpert Soumaya Sahla wil haar plek bij de VVD terugveroveren’

Wilders asks the Prime Minister, in dozens of numbered questions, to disclose the content, medium and context of his contacts with Soumaya Sahla, a convicted terrorist, and whether he spoke to her in his party or government capacity. Rutte answers that he will not separate his roles on these matters, refuses most questions by pointing to the limits of the ministerial duty to inform, and does not disclose the contents of the messages or calls.

The duty to provide information to members of the House of Representatives and Senate applies to ministers and state secretaries. However, office holders do not perform all their work in their official capacity.
De inlichtingenplicht aan leden van de Tweede en Eerste Kamer geldt voor Ministers en Staatssecretarissen. Bewindslieden verrichten echter niet al hun werkzaamheden uit hoofde van hun ambt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over strengere regels voor schepen die migranten redden op de Middellandse Zee

An MP asked whether Italy's new rules and fines on NGO rescue ships in the Mediterranean, and the Dutch absence of a humanitarian exemption in people-smuggling law, are compatible with international law and should be challenged. The State Secretary answered that Italian law is a matter for Italy and the courts and the Commission, that NGO rescue is valued but private ships should not aid smugglers, and that existing criminal-law defences suffice without an explicit humanitarian exemption.
It is not for the cabinet to judge whether this Italian law is compatible with European and international treaties; that is reserved for a judge.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over de verenigbaarheid van deze Italiaanse wet met Europese en internationaalrechtelijke verdragen.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Ceder en Podt over de uitspraken van de minister-president inzake NGO's

MPs Ceder and Podt asked the Prime Minister and the State Secretary of Justice and Security to explain and justify the Prime Minister's remarks distinguishing 'good and bad' NGOs at sea, and whether those remarks were unfounded. The State Secretary answered that the government values NGO rescue work, that national authorities (the Public Prosecution Service in the Netherlands) decide on criminal investigation, and that humanitarian motives can already be weighed under necessity defences, while giving no evidence that specific NGOs are involved in smuggling.
It is up to the national (investigative) authorities, if there is cause, to investigate this and, where necessary, to proceed to criminal prosecution.
Het is aan de nationale (opsporings)autoriteiten – als daartoe aanleiding is – hiernaar onderzoek te doen en zo nodig over te gaan tot strafrechtelijke vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de brief van Eurocommissaris Sinkevicius van 28 maart 2023 inzake de voortgang van de integrale aanpak

Member Omtzigt asked whether the Minister met Commissioner Sinkevičius on 28 March 2023, requested the minutes and the 14 February letter, and asked how and when the Commissioner's letter was received and what the Dutch government's role in its drafting was. The Minister denied any meeting, said both letters had been sent to the House, explained the letter reached the Permanent Representation and then the ministry, and stated the Dutch government had no substantive involvement in drafting it.
On 3 April I sent your House both my letter of 14 February 2023 to Commissioner Sinkevičius and the Commissioner's reply letter of 28 March 2023.
Ik heb op 3 april uw Kamer zowel mijn brief van 14 februari 2023 aan Eurocommissaris Sinkevičius toegezonden als de antwoordbrief van de Eurocommissaris van 28 maart 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over het vertrouwen in het bestuur

An MP from the PvdA asks the Interior Minister and Prime Minister about declining public trust in local government, linking it to national failures on Groningen gas extraction, the childcare benefits affair and asylum reception at Ter Apel, and asks whether the Prime Minister's refusal to answer questions on 2030 government targets undermines accountability. The minister answers that local government still enjoys more trust than national institutions, that trust drivers include responsiveness and reliability, and that the government is working on participation and administrative reforms, while declining to give a direct answer on the 2030 targets, which were referred to the responsible ministers with a commitment to inform parliament before Accountability Day 2023.
Restoring trust between residents and government is a task for the entire cabinet.
Het herstel van het vertrouwen tussen inwoners en overheid is een opgave voor het gehele kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over illegaal verblijf in het Torentje

MP Van Haga asked the Prime Minister why the cabinet stays in the Torentje despite fire-brigade advice, calling it illegal occupation that ignores safety rules and sets a bad example. Prime Minister Rutte replied that supplementary safety measures were taken, the fire-brigade recommendations were incorporated, the Hague municipality extended the permit to July 2024, and that no illegal occupation exists, referring to a related Leijten answer for detail.
There is therefore no question of illegal residence in the Torentje.
Van illegaal verblijf in het Torentje is dan ook geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de aanwezigheid van de Nederlandse kabinetsdelegatie op het World Economic Forum in Davos

An SP MP asked why the Dutch cabinet delegation attended the 2023 World Economic Forum in Davos, its costs, its agenda, and its views on inequality and taxation of the wealthy. The government answered that the forum is a useful platform for exchanging ideas, gave a cost table per minister, referred to programmes and livestreams, and stated that the forum involves no political decision-making.
Some sessions had a confidential character. For that reason the WEF does not share the content and participant list.
Enkele sessies hadden een vertrouwelijk karakter. Het WEF deelt de inhoud en deelnemerslijst om die reden niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de berichtgeving over ‘Project Fear’ van de Britse overheid tijdens de coronacrisis

An MP asks the Health Minister and Prime Minister whether the UK's 'Project Fear' strategy of timing the disclosure of a Covid variant to create fear for lockdown was known to the Dutch government, and whether the Dutch government used similar tactics, including linking the curfew to such a variant and using behavioural methods. The minister answers that he was unaware of the UK strategy, sees no reason to contact the UK, denies that fear was deliberately created or that information was used for political ends, and states that the curfew followed the epidemiological situation.
I see no reason to contact the British government.
Ik zie geen reden om contact op te nemen met de Britse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mogelijke oorsprong van de coronapandemie als gevolg van een ‘lableak’

An MP asked the health minister whether the COVID-19 lab-leak hypothesis from the Wuhan Institute of Virology is plausible, why a Outbreak Management Team member suppressed it, why the cabinet was not informed, and whether the government will disclose information and act. The minister answered that origin is a scientific question for the WHO, that the government does not get involved in scientific discussions, that origin did not affect epidemic control, and that he will not seek contact with US authorities or disclose further information.
For the answer to such questions I rely on the WHO.
Voor het antwoord op dergelijke vragen vertrouw ik op de WHO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het beschermen van carnaval

An MP asked the government about a news report questioning carnival's racial composition, whether carnival is threatened by 'wokeism' and what it will do to protect it, and why it does not stand up for traditions like paasvuren affected by nitrogen policy. The state secretary replied that culture belongs to everyone, that she sees no sign carnival needs protection from any social current, and that she supports all forms of heritage in line with UNESCO commitments.
Culture, and therefore also carnival, belongs to and is for everyone.
Cultuur, en dus ook carnaval, is van en voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het risico op een onbeheersbare brand en het niet vertrekken van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken

An SP MP asked why the Ministry of General Affairs refuses to leave the Binnenhof despite fire-brigade warnings of an uncontrollable fire risk, why the move slipped from its planned date, and who is liable in case of fire. The government answers that the move is delayed because the planned temporary location at Catshuis was dropped, that Bezuidenhoutseweg 73 is being prepared, that extra fire-safety measures are in place, and that liability depends on the circumstances.
For this reason, the Central Government Real Estate Agency has requested an extension of the permit for use of the Binnenhof complex.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf heeft om deze reden een verlenging van de vergunning voor gebruik van het Binnenhof-complex aangevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het niet-vervolgen van doodsbedreigers

An MP asks why the Public Prosecution Service declined to prosecute people who threatened him with death, and whether this undermines his safety and the rule of law. The Minister of Justice answers that individual prosecutorial decisions cannot be discussed to avoid political interference, that threats against MPs are assessed with great care regardless of political affiliation, and that the AIVD monitors threats to protected persons.
As Minister of Justice and Security I cannot address individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over fatwa’s en bedreigingen

An MP asks the Prime Minister and several ministers what has concretely been done to identify, prosecute or extradite people who issued fatwas and death threats against him, and how many threat cases were prosecuted. The minister replies that individual cases cannot be discussed, that Pakistan has not answered legal assistance requests, that the Public Prosecution Service decides prosecution case by case, and that threats are forwarded to the intelligence services.
I cannot go into individual cases; the Public Prosecution Service is the designated body to inform you confidentially about such matters.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken, het Openbaar Ministerie is de aangewezen instantie om u, als betrokkene, vertrouwelijk over dergelijke zaken te informeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Eppink, Van der Staaij, Van der Plas en Agnes Mulder over de ontmoeting tussen de minister-president en de Azerbeidzjaanse president Aliyev

MPs asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the January 2023 meeting with Azerbaijani President Aliyev in Davos, including gas deliveries, the Lachin corridor blockade, ECHR rulings and Armenian prisoners. The government answered that the meeting raised Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation and the Lachin blockade, that it did not address the ECHR interim measures or Armenian prisoners, and that it did not condemn Azerbaijan's occupation of Armenian territory, while promising continued calls for compliance.
During the conversation, the Prime Minister conveyed the Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation in Nagorno-Karabakh resulting from the de facto blockade of the Lachin corridor.
Tijdens het gesprek heeft de Minister-President de Nederlandse zorgen over de humanitaire situatie in Nagorno-Karabach als gevolg van de de facto blokkade van de Laçın-corridor overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het steunen van Polen in haar lijn om weer baas in eigen land te worden

MP Van Haga asks whether the government agrees that Polish national law should outweigh EU law and whether the Netherlands should support Poland's position, citing EU regulation problems. The Minister answers that the government rejects primacy of national law over EU law, stresses the need for all member states to respect EU legal principles, and fully supports the Commission's infringement action against Poland over its Constitutional Tribunal rulings.
The cabinet fully supports the Commission in its decision to take Poland to the EU Court of Justice over these rulings of the Polish Constitutional Tribunal.
Het kabinet steunt de Commissie volledig in haar besluit om Polen voor het EU-Hof van Justitie te dagen over deze uitspraken van het Poolse Grondwettelijk Hof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ‘De latente stikstofruimte en extern salderen’

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the ministers about buy-outs of farms for nitrogen permit space, unregistered latent permit capacity, the unrecorded 30% deduction in external netting, and the AERIUS model update, requesting lists and data. The minister answered that the external netting evaluation is ongoing with results expected mid-2023, that stricter external netting rules and registration of freed space are being pursued, and that a complete picture of latent space cannot be obtained.
I expect to be able to share the results of the evaluation with the House around mid-2023.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van de evaluatie medio 2023 met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het naleven van integriteitsregels door bewindspersonen

An SP MP asked why Minister Kaag's membership of the Global Preparedness Monitoring Board was not registered as a secondary position under the code of conduct, despite advice to register it, and about enforcement of integrity rules. The government answered that the role was an official function carried out for policy purposes rather than a Blauwe Boek side position, that the Chamber had been informed, and that the code is primarily the responsibility of each minister, with annual ministerial-council agendas and integrity training planned.
There is no secondary position within the meaning of the Blauwe Boek, the handbook for ministers, because the function was carried out in the context of policy implementation.
Er is geen sprake van een nevenfunctie in de zin van het Blauwe Boek, het handboek voor bewindspersonen, omdat de functie is uitgevoerd in het kader van de beleidsuitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de stand van zaken rondom het toeslagenschandaal, de hersteloperatie en de uithuis geplaatste kinderen

Mr. Omtzigt asked the government about the state of the childcare benefits scandal recovery operation, reports of administrative chaos and staff pressure, the return of children placed in care, whether the cabinet is in control, and whistleblower protection. The State Secretary answered that a prognosis projects most affected parents compensated by 2025 with objections closed in 2026, that staff numbers grew over 13%, that signals of workload are recognised, and that staff can report concerns internally or anonymously, while many answers restate existing policy and give no specific new commitments.
At the same time there is no single golden solution that ensures all affected parents can complete their recovery in the short term.
Tegelijk is er niet één gouden oplossing die ervoor zorgt dat álle gedupeerde ouders op korte termijn hun herstel kunnen afronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijkheid dat de Nederlandse overheid toegang heeft of had tot portals voor het aangeven van desinformatie bij sociale media

Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch government, including ministries, intelligence services, police, regulators and other bodies, has or had access to platform portals for reporting disinformation or other content on social media, and what that access was used for. The government answered that the ministry of BZK holds trusted flagger status at several platforms, used only sparingly around elections, along with several regulators and the police for illegal or harmful content, and that intelligence services will not comment; it could not answer all questions within the deadline and withheld some operational guidance.
Through these channels the Ministry of BZK has no power to compel these companies to remove certain content or take other actions.
Het Ministerie van BZK heeft via deze kanalen geen bevoegdheid deze bedrijven te dwingen bepaalde content te laten verwijderen of andere acties te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het recente AD-interview met de veroordeelde moslimterrorist Soumaya Sahla

Wilders asked Prime Minister Rutte about his contacts with convicted terrorist Soumaya Sahla, including a 2022 phone call and whether he scouted her for the VVD, and about her potential access to parliament. Rutte answered most questions by declining to go into private contacts and pointing to the VVD as a party matter, while confirming the 2019 meeting and refusing to rule out future security risks.
I will not go into this further for the reason stated in the answer to question 5.
Ik ga hier om de in het antwoord op vraag 5 genoemde reden niet nader op in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘Het World Economic Forum (WEF)’

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he spoke at the World Economic Forum in Davos in January 2023 and, if so, asked for the text of his speech. The Prime Minister confirmed participation in three panel discussions, all livestreamed and available on YouTube, and referred to those recordings instead of providing a speech text.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Akerboom over de Catshuissessie met het bedrijfsleven over de IMVO-wet en het vestigingsklimaat

Two MPs asked whether the Prime Minister's Catshuis session with business on the investment climate would target the IMVO due diligence law, which companies attend, and whether sustainable firms and OECD guidelines would be on the agenda. The minister answered that the session is broader than IMVO, covers the investment climate and geopolitics, lists the attending companies, and that a level playing field with neighbouring countries, including OECD guidelines, is important.
This Catshuis session is not specifically about (I)MVO, but broadly about the investment climate.
Deze Catshuissessie gaat niet specifiek over (I)MVO, maar breed over het vestigingsklimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de brandbrief van 50 topambtenaren over de verhouding tussen politiek en ambtenarij

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether he regards it as acceptable that a letter from 50 senior civil servants about the politics-civil service relationship reached the press, and asks for examples, the training content, and the letter itself. The government answers that civil servants work under ministerial responsibility and cannot speak publicly on policy, provides the letter, notes the matter was discussed with secretaries-general, and promises continued dialogue but gives no examples.
The letter makes no mention of this training.
In de brief wordt geen melding gemaakt van deze training.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de rechtsstaat en beloofde verbeteringen na het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the government about progress on promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including the eleven 'buikpijn' cases, the implementation of softer legal discretion, the role of inspectorates and ombudsman signals, the Landsadvocaat, and the Ministerial Commission on the childcare benefits recovery. The minister answered that the cases are being pursued by the relevant departments, gave progress updates across the reaction to the 'Ongekend onrecht' report, and said the Landsadvocaat and commission data are not available as overviews, while promising ongoing reporting to parliament.
No overviews are available of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de brief aan de vertegenwoordigers van de Republik Maluku Selatan

Sylvana Simons (BIJ1) asked the Prime Minister whether a 14 October 2022 letter to the RMS representative, which classed the Moluccan community as part of an 'Indische gemeenschap', was a deliberate insult, and asked about the treatment of Moluccans since 1951, possible apologies, redress and a study. The Secretary of State acknowledged the wording was insensitive and unintended, reaffirmed apologies and collective recognition efforts, and said further study was unnecessary, though the topic would be discussed with the community.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht “Maxima: digitaal geld via centrale banken kan veel voordelen hebben.”

An MP asked the government about a news report on Queen Máxima's views on digital central bank money, whether such money is politically contested, and whether political statements by royals fit the constitutional role of the Crown. The minister confirmed awareness, described the Dutch parliament's critical-constructive stance on a digital euro and the EU legislative route, and answered the royal question only by noting ministerial responsibility for royal family members.
The cabinet characterises the general Dutch position as constructive-critical.
Het kabinet kwalificeert de algemene Nederlandse houding hiermee als constructief-kritisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat Koningin Máxima pleit voor de digitale euro

Opposition MP Eppink asked whether Queen Máxima, speaking at the IMF in her UN role, advocated a digital euro on behalf of the government and whether this was partisan given constitutional limits on royal political statements. Minister Kaag answered that the Queen spoke in her UNSGSA capacity without advocating a digital euro, that her remarks match government policy, and that any introduction would require democratic decision-making at EU level with cash remaining legal tender.
In her speech she did not make a plea for (the introduction of) a digital euro.
In haar speech heeft zij geen pleidooi gehouden voor (de invoering van) een digitale euro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ‘het totaal onvoorbereid zijn op een nucleaire oorlog’

An MP asked the government about Dutch unpreparedness for a nuclear war, Russian nuclear rhetoric, air defence, public shelters, iodine tablets, reinstating Bescherming Bevolking and de-escalation. The government answered that it takes Russian nuclear rhetoric seriously, relies on NATO deterrence, sees no basis to revive shelters or Bescherming Bevolking, and that iodine tablets are available for specific cases.
The cabinet has taken note of this advice. It is currently not opportune to fall back on a facility that was abolished 37 years ago.
Het kabinet heeft kennis genomen van dit advies. Het is op dit moment niet opportuun om terug te vallen op een voorziening die 37 jaar geleden is afgeschaft.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over het verstrijken van de termijn om nieuwe informatie aan te leveren aan de GRECO (te weten 30 september 2022) naar aanleiding van de nog niet afgeronde behandeling van de GRECO

An MP asked about the former minister Van Nieuwenhuizen's contacts with the government on energy compensation, the deadline for information to GRECO, and the definition of lobbyist in the lobby register proposal. The government answered that she did not take part in the energy price talks, that the GRECO deadline moved to December 2022, and that a definition of lobbyist requires research by Professor Braun first.
Question 2: Can you send an overview of all contacts (including phone calls) between Ms Van Nieuwenhuizen and Ministers and State Secretaries over the past six months?
Vraag 2 Kunt u een overzicht sturen van alle contacten (inclusief telefoongesprekken) tussen mevrouw Van Nieuwenhuizen en Ministers en Staatssecretarissen van de afgelopen zes maanden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Maatoug over het bericht 'Brussel duldt geen inmenging in besteding coronamiljarden'

MPs Dassen and Maatoug asked whether the government supports the Commission's claim that disclosing documents on informal talks about the Dutch recovery plan would undermine decision-making, and how the decision-making process is defined. Minister Kaag answered that disclosure of pre-2022 documents no longer undermines the process, that the formal decision-making only started after the final plan was submitted on 8 July 2022, and that Parliament was kept informed throughout, while deferring the Commission-related questions to the Commission.

As regards the documents on the talks between the Dutch cabinet and the European Commission for this period that are in our possession, I am of the view that disclosing these documents no longer undermines the decision-making process surrounding approval of the Dutch plan.

Voor wat betreft de documenten over de gesprekken tussen het Nederlandse kabinet en de Europese Commissie voor deze periode die in ons bezit zijn, ben ik van mening dat openbaarmaking van deze documenten het besluitvormingsproces rondom de goedkeuring van het Nederlandse plan niet langer ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Onaanvaardbare wijzigingen bij de Nationale Indiëherdenking en over het aandringen bij Indonesië voor het maken van excuses voor de Bersiap

Mr Van Haga asked the Prime Minister 15 questions about changes to the National Indies Commemoration of 15 August, including a larger role for the Indonesian ambassador and whether Indonesia should be urged to apologise for the Bersiap. The Secretary of State answered that the commemoration foundation is independent, the government did not request the changes or agree any deal with Indonesia, and the government will not press the foundation to reverse them or urge Indonesia to apologise.
The Nationale Herdenking 15 augustus 1945 foundation is an independent organisation that itself decides how the commemoration is shaped in substance.
De stichting Nationale Herdenking 15 augustus 1945 is een onafhankelijke organisatie die zelf bepaalt hoe de herdenking er inhoudelijk uitziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over de prijscap op energie

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about the planned energy price cap, its costs, who it covers, safeguards against excess profits by energy companies, and related consultations. Minister Jetten answered that a price cap from 1 January 2023 is planned with volume limits and maximum tariffs, costs are not yet exact and will be funded partly from energy tax cuts, and the government intends to bar disconnections this winter, while many answers refer to a separate letter and some consultation details are not shared.
Given the short deadline for answering, for further explanation of this answer I refer briefly to my letter of 20 September 2022.
Gegeven de korte termijn die is gesteld voor beantwoording, verwijs ik voor verdere uitleg van dit antwoord kortheidshalve naar mijn brief van 20 september 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het lekken van geheime kabinetsplannen

The SP's Leijten asked the Prime Minister about leaked draft budget and purchasing-power measures for Prinsjesdag, how the press obtained them, what has been done to prevent leaks, and who had access. The government declined to confirm or deny specific reported measures, citing the embargo, said it deplored leaks, and gave only general answers about coalition consultations and confidentiality rules.
I therefore cannot yet address specific measures reported in the media, as I would thereby be confirming or denying measures.
