Ik kan daarom op dit moment nog niet ingaan op specifieke maatregelen die in de media worden genoemd, aangezien ik daarmee maatregelen zou bevestigen of ontkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bewust vertragen van Wob-verzoeken en het betalen van dwangsommen door de regering

MP Omtzigt asked whether Wob freedom-of-information requests are deliberately delayed by ministries, whether courts have imposed penalty payments (dwangsommen) on ministries for missed deadlines, and for the list of cases and the interdepartmental Wob/Woo meeting minutes. The minister admits many statutory deadlines are missed and that over two million euros in penalties were incurred in 2019-2021, cites complexity and backlog as causes, acknowledges one request (datacenter Zeewolde) was deliberately postponed at third-party request, promises improvement measures and minutes, but answers were late and some details were withheld.
I also see that in many cases the statutory deadlines are not met and that the ministries, including my own, are not complying with the law.
Ook ik zie dat in veel gevallen de wettelijke termijnen niet worden gehaald en dat de Ministeries, waaronder mijn eigen Ministerie, zich daarmee niet aan de wet houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gelekte maatregelen naar aanleiding van het bereikte begrotingsakkoord in aanloop naar Prinsjesdag

MP Omtzigt asks the Prime Minister and Finance ministers whether leaked pre-Budget Day measures (air ticket tax, corporate tax, box 3, student grants and others) are accurate, who leaked them, and why a leak by an opposition MP was punished while government leaks are not. The Prime Minister declines to confirm or deny specific leaked measures because the Prinsjesdag proposals are still under Council of State advice and CPB calculation, confirms the coalition agreement's rise in air passenger tax, says he regrets the breach of the confidentiality rule, but does not say who leaked or what the ministerial discussion concluded.
The decision-making process on the Prinsjesdag documents has not yet been completed.
Het besluitvormingsproces over de Prinsjesdagstukken is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over opzeggen Vluchtelingenverdrag

Opposition MP Van Haga asked whether the asylum crisis is uncontrollable, whether the 1951 Refugee Convention pulls in asylum seekers, and whether withdrawing from it would make regional reception possible. The government answered that the asylum situation is under strain but not uncontrollable, that the Convention has no proven pull effect, and that withdrawal would not change Dutch obligations under the ECHR and EU law.
The cabinet does want to gain more grip on migration and to be able to anticipate in time.
Het kabinet wil wel meer grip krijgen op migratie en tijdig kunnen anticiperen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over ‘de rol van de premier in de Uber-files’

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked the Prime Minister about his and his advisers' contacts with Uber, Neelie Kroes's informal role, her appointment as StartupDelta envoy and the Uber Files revelations. The Prime Minister answered that he knew of Kroes's advisory role since 2016, described his meetings with Uber executives as functional business contacts, declined to comment on the Dutch prosecution and tax matters, and referred several questions to the European Commission, the Tax Authority and other ministries.
I have been aware of Ms Kroes's role as a member of Uber's advisory council since her appointment in May 2016.
Ik ben sinds haar aanstelling in mei 2016 op de hoogte van de rol van mevrouw Kroes als lid van de adviesraad van Uber.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over oorlogsmisdaden gepleegd door het Oekraïense leger

An FVD MP asked whether Ukrainian forces committing war crimes by using residential areas, schools and hospitals for military purposes, and whether Dutch-supplied weapons used in such ways, should lead the government to halt arms deliveries or confront Ukraine's ambassador. The minister said the government had no report underlying Amnesty's press release, that international humanitarian law binds all parties, that every export is checked against EU criteria with end-user certificates, and that it would not stop deliveries or summon the ambassador, while raising legal frameworks in routine contacts.
Every supply of Dutch equipment to Ukraine is tested against the EU arms export criteria.
Elke leverantie van Nederlands materieel aan Oekraïne wordt getoetst aan de EU wapenexportcriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het informeren van de Kamer

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked the Prime Minister why earlier written answers on informing parliament were summary, and whether the government takes parliament's concerns about timely information seriously. The Prime Minister answered that the cabinet stresses timely information, reminded ministries of the rule that documents reach the Tweede Kamer at least a quarter hour before media release, and said each minister must weigh circumstances case by case.

Since 2013 the working agreement for sending documents to the House of Representatives has been that documents must be delivered to the clerks at least a quarter hour before news is released to the media.

Sinds 2013 geldt hiervoor als werkafspraak voor verzending van stukken aan de Tweede Kamer dat stukken minimaal een kwartier voordat door media nieuws naar buiten wordt gebracht dienen te worden aangeleverd bij de griffies
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ’het gebruik van Energie en de plek waar de miljardenwinsten terecht komen, terwijl de Nederlandse huishoudens in Energie-armoede vervallen’

Omtzigt asked the ministers how much gas is extracted in the Netherlands in 2022, where it goes, what long-term contracts and prices the state and its companies have, how much the state earns from gas, and whether consumers are overcharged, including whether electricity producers' profits and subsidies are fair. The government answered that the gas cannot be traced to a final destination, that contract terms are confidential, that the state earns gas revenue through specified channels, and that it is examining targeted relief for vulnerable households.
The content of these contracts is confidential, and this confidentiality is also agreed in the contracts themselves.
De inhoud van deze contracten is vertrouwelijk en deze vertrouwelijkheid is ook in de contracten zelf afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Nijboer, Grinwis, Maatoug, Stoffer, Dassen en Inge van Dijk over de Uber-files en aanverwante zaken

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Uber Files, including Tax Authority conduct toward Uber, exchange-of-information handling, multilateral audits, the NFIA and APBI roles and the withheld Unilever bidbook. The Secretary answered largely by citing tax secrecy, promising an internal investigation with results expected in September, offering a confidential briefing, and declining to change rules or reveal individual cases.
Due to the fiscal confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act (AWR), I have not been able to answer all questions and cannot make the results of the investigation public.

Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) heb ik niet alle vragen kunnen beantwoorden en kan ik ook de resultaten van het onderzoek niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over stikstof

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about internal Finance Ministry calculations showing that a 39-kton ammonia reduction target for the national rural area programme exceeds what is needed, and about the number of farms affected, withheld or unpublished modelling, and whether the targets could change. The minister answered that the calculations are unvalidated internal advice not equal to government policy, promised to share them with RIVM and to inform parliament on final figures, but declined to publish the figures now.
These are internal calculations by the Ministry of Finance with an indicative character that have not yet been scientifically validated.
Het betreffen ambtelijke berekeningen van het Ministerie van Financiën met een indicatief karakter en die nog niet wetenschappelijk zijn gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over verslag van staatskasfraude in Suriname

An MP asks the government whether it accepts the findings of a report on alleged state-treasury fraud in Suriname, whether Suriname's economy has collapsed, and whether the Prime Minister should make a state visit given these allegations. The minister answers that prosecution of alleged fraud is for the Surinamese prosecutor, that IMF and Paris Club debt steps are underway, and that the visit is a working visit within good bilateral relations.
It is not for the Netherlands to establish the truth regarding a matter occurring in another sovereign country and to pass judgment on it here.
Het is niet aan Nederland om aan waarheidsvinding te doen ten aanzien van een zaak die in een ander, soeverein land speelt en hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de gesprekken met boeren

An MP asks the Prime Minister about his talks with farmers, the Zuid-Holland provincial livestock relocation scheme, and whether he will withdraw or postpone the nitrogen plans and share the conversation records. The Prime Minister answers that the scheme is a voluntary instrument, that talks aim to listen, that no minutes were kept and one official's notes will not be shared, and that the nitrogen policy will continue jointly with the provinces.
No minutes were made of the conversations; personal notes of one conversation were made by an official.
Er zijn geen verslagen gemaakt van de gesprekken, er zijn van één gesprek persoonlijke aantekeningen gemaakt door een ambtenaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de bagatellisering van de Bersiap

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister about vandalism of a Leiden Indies monument and whether the government considers the Bersiap killings a genocide or ethnic cleansing. The Prime Minister said the vandalism is a local matter and declined to qualify the Bersiap violence as genocide, citing its specific legal meaning and the NIOD/NIMH/KITLV report's term 'extreem geweld'.
This is a matter for the local government. The local government has the information and powers that may be relevant here.
Dit is een aangelegenheid van het lokaal bestuur. Het lokaal bestuur beschikt over de informatie en bevoegdheden die hierbij van belang kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over drinkwater

An MP asks whether the government accepts that drinking water bills will rise sharply due to inflation and investment needs, and whether it will prevent this price rise for a primary necessity. The minister confirms tariffs will rise because they must be cost-covering under the Drinkwaterwet, says the government is aware of inflation effects, and notes that full independence from foreign water sources is not possible.
Drinking water tariffs must be cost-covering (Article 11 of the Drinking Water Act).
De tarieven van drinkwater dienen kostendekkend te zijn (artikel 11 van de Drinkwaterwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over luxetaks op drinkwater

Van Haga asked whether the reported luxury tax on drinking water is known and whether the government will reject it, since drinking water is a basic need. Minister Harbers confirmed awareness, said drinking water is a basic necessity whose affordability matters, and said no decision has been taken; a survey of water-saving measures, including a higher tariff for above-average use, will be sent to parliament this autumn.
No decision has yet been taken on the possible measures and instruments in the forthcoming survey.
Over de mogelijke maatregelen en instrumenten in de nog te verschijnen verkenning heeft nog geen besluitvorming heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga inzake het plegen van meerdere ambtsmisdrijven tijdens coronacrisis

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether Dutch officials and ministers committed criminal misconduct (ambtsmisdrijven) during the COVID crisis by weakening evidence bases, using measures that allegedly breached the Constitution and ECHR, and signing the Twm law, and asked about the lack of constitutional review. The Minister of Health, on behalf of the Prime Minister, rejected all claims, arguing the measures were grounded in RIVM modelling, were enacted through the democratic legislative process with parliamentary and Council of State involvement, and that no misconduct occurred.
The judgement that signing and cooperating on the Twm amounted to criminal misconduct has no basis whatsoever.
Het oordeel dat met ondertekening van en meewerken aan de Twm ambtsmisdrijven zouden zijn begaan, mist iedere grond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Kröger over een reis per vliegtuig m.b.t. het staatsbezoek van de Koning en Koningin aan Oostenrijk

GroenLinks MPs asked why the royal state visit to Austria used a plane rather than a train, whether the royal carriage could be used for international rail travel, and how this fits sustainable transport policy. The minister replied that a train took over 12 hours versus about 1.5 hours by plane, that trains are considered but not always suitable, and that the royal carriage is already internationally approved and was last used abroad years ago.
For the route from the Netherlands to Austria, the train unfortunately was not (yet) a full alternative.
Voor het traject van Nederland naar Oostenrijk bleek de trein helaas (nog) geen volwaardig alternatief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het oproepen tot gebruik vetorecht inzake EU-wanbeleid boeren

An MP asked the Minister-President about a report that Brussels is also examining Dutch manure policy, and whether the government would invoke a national veto against nitrogen demands and the manure policy. The Minister of Agriculture answered that Nitrate Directive obligations follow from EU law adopted through the normal procedures, that Dutch interests are served through the Council, and that member states have no veto in EU legislation.
Member states have no veto in this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bezoek aan Oekraïne

An MP asked the Prime Minister why he speaks of 'our war' in Ukraine and whether this amounts to declaring war on Russia, and questioned whether war rhetoric and arms deliveries help peace, whether arms makers profit, and what diplomatic steps are being taken toward negotiations. The Prime Minister denied Netherlands is at war with Russia, framed 'our war' as figurative, defended military and financial support to Ukraine, and said negotiations are for Ukraine to decide while a diplomatic channel to Russia is maintained.
The Netherlands is not at war with Russia.
Nederland is niet in oorlog met Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de escalatie van de boerenprotesten

Van der Plas (BBB) asked the government about escalating farmer protests, including the involvement of other groups, the appointment of Remkes as independent mediator, and whether the nitrogen plans should be paused. The ministers condemned violent and intimidating acts, said dialogue and mediation continue, and refused to pause the nitrogen plans or reconsider Remkes's appointment.
Delaying that process or lowering the national targets is, however, not an option, given the urgent climate, water and nature challenge.
Vertragen op dat proces of verlagen van de nationale doelen is evenwel geen optie, gezien de urgente klimaat-, water- en natuuropgave.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over berekeningen over stikstof van het Ministerie van Financiën, die een totaal ander beeld op de stikstofproblematiek werpen en over de bemiddelingspoging van dhr

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about unpublished Ministry of Finance nitrogen calculations showing smaller agricultural reductions needed if climate targets are met, and why these were not shared with parliament, plus the role of mediator Remkes and the basis of the NPLG targets. The government answered that the calculations are unvalidated, indicative internal advice, that they were shared with LNV and interdepartmentally and later published, and that targets will be adjusted as new projections (KEV 2022) come in.
The cabinet considers publishing unvalidated calculations that are still part of policy preparation not in the interest of good and democratic governance.
Het kabinet acht het openbaar maken van niet-gevalideerde berekeningen die nog onderdeel zijn van de beleidsvoorbereiding niet in het belang van goede en democratische bestuursvoering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de inform

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister-President and Foreign Affairs Minister what measures the ministry has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, on hardship-causing laws, prior inventories, the handling of new proposals, the baseline measurement for digital information management, the chat-message retention policy, and the number of FOI requests. The government answered that departments are conducting inventories of hardship-causing rules, outlined the methodology and timelines, described the retention rules for chat messages, and referred to attached overviews for FOI request data.
Question 2: Has this research, or have these studies, been shared with the House? If not, can you explain in detail why not and send the research to the House without delay?
Vraag 2 Is dit onderzoek of zijn deze onderzoeken met de Kamer gedeeld? Zo nee, kunt u uitgebreid motiveren waarom niet en kunt u het onderzoek onverwijld naar de Kamer sturen?

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op het gebied van hardheden en d

The SP MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management which measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal on harsh rules and information management, including inventories of harsh legislation, methods used, new-proposal safeguards, chat-message retention and FOI request backlogs. The minister answered that each department is conducting an inventory of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, referred to letters and annexes for timelines and methods, said chat messages need only be kept when the decision is not recorded elsewhere, and provided a FOI overview in an annex.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, each department is conducting an inventory of laws and regulations that turn out harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked the Ministers of SZW and the Prime Minister which measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of laws and their information management. The government answered that departments are inventorying harsh laws under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that independent research and a chat-message retention policy exist, and that further letters and action plans will follow.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, each department carries out an inventory of laws and regulations that turn out harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Beckerman over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op het gebied van hardhe

MPs Leijten and Beckerman asked which measures the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality has taken following the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh consequences of laws and the handling of information. The minister responded that departments are conducting inventories of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that research reports and timelines were or will be shared, and described the chat-message retention policy and pending Wob/Woo request figures.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, every department is carrying out an inventory of laws and regulations that have harsh effects on people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuisho

Leijten (SP) asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Economic Affairs what measures her ministry has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, against laws and procedures that cause hardship, and about its information management, including chat message retention and FOI/WOO requests. The minister, on behalf of the cabinet, answered that departmental inventories of harsh regulations are under way, pointed to separate reports and letters, and described the chat-message retention rules for officials.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de in

MPs Leijten and Kwint asked what the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science has done after the childcare benefits scandal regarding hardship-causing laws, the review of such rules, its information management and handling of FOI requests. The minister answered that departmental inventories of hardship-causing regulations are underway under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, with results and timelines to be sent to parliament, and that chat-message retention follows government-wide rules.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informa

The SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the Justice and Security Ministry what measures it has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, to find and fix harsh or disproportionate laws and procedures and to manage its information (including chat messages and FOI requests). The minister replies that the department is carrying out the government-wide inventory of harsh rules under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, is applying a shared analysis toolkit, will report on timelines in an annexed letter, and is clarifying the chat-message retention rules for ministers, with a practical proposal promised by end of August.
To this end, a practical proposal for a uniform working method that ministers can use will be made by the end of August.
Hiertoe wordt voor eind augustus een praktisch voorstel gedaan voor een uniforme werkwijze die door de bewindslieden gebruikt kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Financiën naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuishouding

SP MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister what measures the Finance Ministry took after the childcare benefits scandal on harsh outcomes of rules and on information management. The minister answered that inventories of harsh rules are underway across departments, that results will be sent later, and that chat-message retention guidance for ministers will be clarified.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuishouding

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked the Minister of Interior about measures at her ministry after the childcare benefits scandal regarding hardship rules and information management, including investigations into harsh regulations, a baseline measurement for information management, the EUR 780 million budget, and chat message retention. The minister answered that each department is conducting inventories of harsh rules, that the Open op Orde programme and a regeringscommissaris Informatiehuishouding are in place, and that the departmental action plans and baseline measurements will be sent to the House, with promises of further updates after the summer.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de

The MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the Ministry of VWS what measures it has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of laws and rules, and about its information management such as retention of chat messages and FOI request handling. The minister answered that departments are conducting inventories of harsh regulations under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, referred to letters and annexes for details, and described the chat-message retention policy.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Defensie naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuisho

MPs Leijten and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister-President and Minister of Defence what measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of rules and the information management. The government answered that departments are conducting inventories of harsh legislation under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that the ministries' action plans and baseline measurements will be sent separately, and that the chat-message retention policy for ministers is being clarified.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, every ministry is carrying out an inventory of legislation and regulations that work harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de jaarvergadering van het World Economic Forum

An MP asked for an overview of all sessions and informal meetings at the WEF annual meeting in Davos (22-26 May 2022) attended by cabinet members, and which followed Chatham House Rules. The government listed the ministers and the Queen who attended, referred to their programmes in annexes, and said no minutes were kept and Chatham House Rules generally applied, with many sessions streamed online.
No minutes were made of the WEF meetings.
Van de WEF-bijeenkomsten zijn geen notulen gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitspraak van de premier inzake de oorlog in Oekraïne

The MP asked whether the Prime Minister's statement that the war in Ukraine is also 'our war' means the Netherlands is in a state of war with Russia. The Prime Minister answered no, explaining the remark was meant figuratively and describing Dutch military, sanctions and accountability support.
No, the Netherlands is not at war with Russia.
Nee, Nederland is niet in oorlog met Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de bemiddelaar in het stikstofdossier en de juridische status van de stikstofplannen

Omtzigt asked the government about the nitrogen (stikstof) targets, whether the 74% reduction by 2030 in the coalition agreement is in law (current law sets 50% by 2030), the legal status of provincial measures, and whether the mediator Remkes is independent, asking for advice and consultation before the process starts. Minister Staghouwer replied that the 50% legal target stands until a bill to move the 74% target to 2030 passes, that provinces have discretion but the national target is a result obligation, and that the planned bill will go through the standard consultation, Council of State advice and financial checks.
The bill is expected to be submitted to the House of Representatives in the first half of 2023.
Het benodigde wetsvoorstel zal naar verwachting in de eerste helft van 2023 bij de Tweede Kamer worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vragen van de leden Sneller, Van Weyenberg en Romke de Jong over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked how the government's new framework contract for photography procurement affects photographers' administrative burden, costs, rates and market power, and whether the photographers were consulted. The government answered that a single agency will manage a pool of photographers with lower admin burdens for them, a hourly rate of 109 euros, a likely rise in costs for the state, and that the photographers were contacted in an earlier round.
The aim of this procurement is to contract a single agency that, in consultation with clients, selects a pool of photographers to carry out assignments under the framework agreement.
Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om één bureau te contracteren dat, in samenspraak met opdrachtgevers, een poule van fotografen selecteert om opdrachten binnen de raamovereenkomst uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de aanwezigheid dit jaar bij de Bilderbergconferentie

An MP from FvD asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister why they attended the 2022 Bilderberg conference, which sessions they joined, what was discussed, and whether minutes could be released. The government confirmed attendance for the full conference, deferred to the conference secretariat for invitation policy and reasons, and refused to share Nederlandse input or minutes, citing Chatham House Rules that Rutte said he accepted by attending.
No, see the answer to question 6.
Nee, zie het antwoord op vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de Bilderberg-conferentie

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the Bilderberg conference, including what was discussed and decided, costs to taxpayers, and whether full transparency will be provided. The government answered that discussions fall under Chatham House Rules, no decisions are taken there, the total cost of the minister's participation was EUR 8,837.99 and is publicly disclosed, and that voters influence the government through elected MPs.

As also indicated in the answers to the questions from the member Van Houwelingen, the discussions during the conference fall under the Chatham House Rules in order to promote an open exchange of ideas and opinions.

Zoals ook aangegeven in de beantwoording op de vragen van het lid van Houwelingen vallen de besprekingen tijdens de conferentie onder de Chatham House Rules om zo een open uitwisseling van ideeën en meningen te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de steeds verder uit de hand lopende klimaatcrisis en de noodzaak van een persconferentie voor het klimaat

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Prime Minister about the worsening climate crisis, the urgency of climate measures, and whether he would hold recurring press conferences on climate. The minister replied that the cabinet recognises the threat, describes its efforts to build public support, and says he will consider press contact on climate only if the gas market developments make it topical.

As I discussed with the standing committee on Economic Affairs and Climate during the debate on 22 June, I am considering scheduling regular press contacts or press conferences in the context of developments on the gas market.

Zoals ik heb gewisseld met de vaste commissie EZK tijdens het debat op 22 juni overweeg ik om in het kader van de ontwikkelingen op de gasmarkt regelmatig contactmomenten met de pers of persgesprekken te beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van hacksoftware, zoals Pegasus, in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked about Dutch use of hacking software such as Pegasus, including purchases, users, offences, targets, supplier screening, statistics, and the Wet CCIII evaluation. The government answered that police buy commercial intrusion software under judicial authorization, that operational details and expenditures cannot be disclosed for protection of methods, and that the Wet CCIII evaluation is delayed and expected after summer 2022.

Providing third parties with information on which specific software the police hold and use for this special investigative power entails unacceptable risks for the usability of those means and thereby for the investigative interest.

Het verstrekken van informatie aan derden over welke specifieke software de politie beschikt en gebruikt bij de inzet van deze bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheid, brengt onaanvaardbare risico’s met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen en daarmee het opsporingsbelang.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de onzichtbaarheid van de premier in het maatschappelijk debat over de dringende noodzaak om de natuur te herstellen en de stikstofmaatregelen die daarvoor nodig zijn

An MP asked the Prime Minister why he has been largely absent from public debate on the nitrogen crisis and nature restoration, and whether he accepts responsibility for past policy choices and the resulting unrest. The Prime Minister answered that he is ultimately responsible for his cabinets' policy, pointed to measures taken since the 2019 PAS ruling and a 25 billion euro reservation, and said ministers primarily carry the nitrogen portfolio while he will defend policy when it arises.
As mentioned before, as Prime Minister I am responsible for everything that happens under my administration, including the policy choices made in nature and nitrogen policy.
Zoals vaker benoemd, ben ik als Minister-President verantwoordelijk voor datgene wat er onder mijn bewind gebeurt, dus ook voor de gemaakte beleidskeuzes in het natuur- en stikstofbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het informeren van de Kamer

Westerveld and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked the Prime Minister whether the cabinet still holds that Parliament must be informed before the media when cabinet plans are released, and how often ministers were reminded of this. Rutte answered only by reaffirming the principle of timely information to both Houses under article 68 of the Constitution, saying it still guides cabinet members, without giving any concrete figures or new commitment.
This includes that the government informs both Houses as quickly as reasonably possible about relevant matters.
Daarbij hoort dat de regering de Kamers zo snel als redelijkerwijs mogelijk informeert over relevante zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de Russische olieboycot door Brussel

Member Van Haga asked the Prime Minister about the economic and price consequences for Dutch citizens of an EU oil embargo on Russia, and why de-escalation and a peace mission were not pursued. The government answered that the economic impact cannot be fully predicted, that the sanctions package contains transition periods, and that consumers and firms will feel the costs, while maintaining support for Ukraine and Russia's sole responsibility for the war.

However, it is not possible to determine the economic consequences in detail in advance, because the precise impact depends on the extent to which companies manage to secure replacement supplies in time.

Het is echter niet mogelijk om de economische gevolgen vooraf in detail duidelijk te krijgen, omdat de precieze impact afhangt van de mate waarin bedrijven erin slagen om tijdig vervangend aanbod aan te kunnen trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de bagatellisering van de Bersiap

An MP asks the Prime Minister about his use of quotation marks around the term Bersiap, whether this minimises the violence, and related questions on the Indies research programme and the Rijksmuseum exhibition. The Prime Minister answers that the term is used in quotation marks out of respect for its place in collective memory, rejects any state supervision of press freedom, and says no link has been found between the research and attacks on the Indisch Monument.
Such a form of supervision is not compatible with freedom of the press (Article 7 of the Constitution).
Een dergelijke vorm van toezicht is niet verenigbaar met de vrijheid van drukpers (artikel 7 van de Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de uitkomsten van de Conferentie over de Toekomst van Europa

An MP asked the government about its position on the outcomes of the Conference on the Future of Europe, including treaty change, EU voting rules, the European Parliament's right of initiative, the cost of the Conference and public support. The government welcomed the outcomes, said most proposals can be realised within existing treaties, opposed a Parliament right of initiative without careful study, favoured more qualified majority voting in foreign policy, and declined to commission new public-support research beyond the existing Kijk op Europa dialogues.
The cabinet will share a cabinet appraisal with your House before the European Council of 23 and 24 June.
Het kabinet zal een kabinetsappreciatie met uw Kamer delen, voorafgaand aan de Europese Raad van 23 en 24 juni.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de uitspraken over het niet willen oplossen van het stikstofprobleem vanwege electoraal eigenbelang

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether he privately said he would not solve the nitrogen crisis because it would cost the VVD votes, and asks how that squares with his public stance and whether he is fit for office. The Prime Minister does not recall his exact words, points to the nitrogen approach, funding and planned measures, and refuses to judge his own fitness, leaving that to the MPs.
It is then up to Mr Ouwehand and other members of the House of Representatives to form a judgement on this.
Het is vervolgens aan het lid Ouwehand en overige leden van de Tweede Kamer om hier een oordeel over te vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uithuisgeplaatste kinderen in het toeslagenschandaal

Omtzigt asks the government, after the unanimously adopted motion on children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, why the independent investigation has not started, how many such placements persist and how many were reviewed, what is being done about abuse and forced removals, and what has been done to prevent a repeat. The minister answers that an Inspectorate investigation is underway, the Ondersteuningsteam is supporting families, reviews are part of regular youth protection work, and the government cannot give figures on reviews or abuse, while proposing talks with parliament on a possible commission.
I have no insight into the number of reassessments or requests that have taken place in this context.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal herbeoordelingen of verzoeken dat in dit kader heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de uitspraken tijdens de ministerraad over het toeslagenschandaal

The SP's Marijnissen asked the Prime Minister about his statement that settling the childcare benefits scandal would take years, and about delays in appeals, Commissie Werkelijke Schade processing, Belastingdienst deadlines, and the placement of 1115 children out of home. Staatssecretaris De Vries answered that restoration will take several years, outlined the backlog measures (anonymisation capacity, mediation pilot, BAC single-member hearings) and the Ondersteuningsteam, but gave no firm deadline and did not commit to a fixed completion date.

In addition, the Bezwaarschriftenadviescommissie (BAC) has started single-member hearings (by one member) instead of three members, in cases suited to this, so that more members are freed up to handle other cases.

Daarnaast is de Bezwaarschriftenadviescommissie (BAC) gestart met het enkelvoudig horen (door één lid) in plaats van drie leden, in zaken die zich daarvoor lenen, om zodoende meer leden vrij te maken om andere zaken te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over de berichten 'Chaos rond energiegeld – Willekeur in gemeenten' en 'Steeds meer huishoudenskunnen energierekening nauwelijks nog voldoen'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the government about reports of chaos and arbitrariness in municipal distribution of the one-off energy allowance and about households struggling with energy bills, including whether energy suppliers were using debt collectors. Minister Schouten answered that the government has taken relief measures, that municipalities have policy freedom in the allowance, and that the state guarantees financial compensation to municipalities, while leaving much of the response to local democracy and existing debt assistance channels.
With these commitments, in my view there is no longer any brake on the objective of the bill.
Met deze toezeggingen bestaat er naar mijn mening geen rem meer op de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de “erkenning van de Armeense genocide”

MP Eppink asked the Prime Minister whether the government will finally unequivocally recognise the Armenian genocide, and whether it will answer before the 24 April commemoration day. The government replied that the Voordewind motion is under consideration, that Netherlands will consult like-minded EU states on recognising genocides, and that international court rulings, scholarly research and UN Security Council findings will weigh heavily.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de zeer recent in Pakistan uitgesproken fatwa en dreigementen tegen een Nederlandse parlementariër

An MP asked the Prime Minister about threats and a fatwa from Pakistan against Geert Wilders and whether the government would protest, investigate and protect him. The government condemned the threats, said it raised concerns with Pakistani authorities, and explained that Pakistan has not answered prior mutual legal assistance requests while the Public Prosecution Service assesses criminality case by case.
As is known, for security reasons the cabinet makes no statements about specific security matters.
Zoals bekend doet het kabinet vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen geen uitspraken over specifieke veiligheidsaangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Markuszower over het afdwingen van opvangplaatsen van vreemdelingen

PVV MPs asked whether the government would requisition property such as sports halls, offices, hotels and homes to house asylum seekers, and whether ministers would house migrants in their own property. The state secretary answered that requisitioning property is not currently under consideration and referred to earlier letters on ministers' property holdings, adding that housing migrants in one's own home is a private matter and not an obligation.
For completeness, I refer you regarding ownership of immovable property to letters from the Prime Minister dated 14 January 2022 on the interests of ministers.
Volledigheidshalve verwijs ik u ten aanzien van het bezit van onroerend goed naar brieven van de Minister-President d.d. 14 januari 2022 inzake de belangen van bewindspersonen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het bericht ‘Documenten kabinetsformatie openbaar’ op de website www.kabinetsformatie2021.nl.

An MP asks the Prime Minister why the post from citizens and organisations received by the 2021 formateurs was not actively published, as in 2017, and whether this breaks with precedent. The Prime Minister answers that GDPR limits publication of personal data, that correspondence with parliament and ministries has been published, that the archive is available on request, and that the formation file is governed by the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur.
apart from processing in the form of publishing the inventory, which contains many personal data
afgezien van verwerking in de vorm van een publicatie van de inventaris die vele persoonsgegevens bevat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Leijten over het bericht ‘Maxima als test voor de monarchie’ uit het Algemeen Dagblad van 31 januari 2022 en de documentaire ‘Een Porseleinen Huwelijk van BNNVARA

MPs Sneller and Leijten asked the Prime Minister and ministers about press and documentary reports on the 2001 decision not to prosecute Jorge Zorreguieta, the role of the Prosecution Service, and an intelligence check on him and Edwin de Roy van Zuydewijn without ministers being informed. The government answered in detail on the chain of communication, the BVD check, and safeguards, denying political influence over the prosecution decision and describing the current naslag arrangements.
No indication of political influence on the content of this decision has been found.
Van politieke beïnvloeding van de inhoud van deze beslissing is niet gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Kuiken, Nijboer en De Hoop over 50.000 opvangplekken voor vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

Opposition PvdA MPs asked how the government will support municipalities in securing and managing about 50,000 reception places for Ukrainian refugees, and about preparations for education, healthcare, housing, language lessons and work. The government answered that safety regions coordinate place creation with municipalities, a national reception programme is being prepared, and that housing, education and healthcare measures are being worked out, with further letters promised.
The cabinet considers it important that displaced persons from Ukraine residing in our country have the opportunity to learn the Dutch language
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat ontheemden uit Oekraïne die in ons land verblijven de mogelijkheid hebben om de Nederlandse taal te leren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Omtzigt en Klaver over het gebruik van privé berichtenservices en privé mailboxen door bewindspersonen voor hun werk

MPs asked whether ministers' use of private email and messaging apps for government work is covered by the Wob and parliamentary inquiries, and about the Kamp Gmail and Snel phone cases. The government answered that work-related messages on private accounts fall under the Wob and parliamentary inquiry powers, that a ministry review of the VWS/BZK private accounts found no security or archiving risk, and it promised to supply usage overviews for the current and previous cabinets later.

Under Article 6(1) of the Parliamentary Inquiry Act, a parliamentary inquiry committee can demand copies of, access to, or knowledge of work-related documents, regardless of the form of communication used.

Op grond van artikel 6, eerste lid, van de Wet op de Parlementaire enquête kan er door een ingestelde parlementaire commissie een afschrift van, inzage in of kennisneming van werkgerelateerde documenten gevorderd worden, ongeacht de gehanteerde vorm van communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aangenomen motie om binnen 48 uur de fiscale gegevens van de personen op de sanctielijst te beschikking te stellen aan de autoriteiten die de sancties moeten opleggen

MP Omtzigt asked the government about the adopted motion requiring tax data, including APA and ATR rulings, of persons on the sanctions list to be shared within 48 hours with sanctions enforcement authorities, and about the Tax Authority's data sharing, asset freezing and contacts with listed persons. The State Secretary answered that a tax secrecy exemption was granted and a legal basis is being pursued, that the ruling inventory of 3,400 requests is ongoing, and that contacts with listed persons are not tracked.
No overview is kept of contacts that ministers and officials have with persons on sanctions lists.
Er wordt geen overzicht bijgehouden van contacten die bewindspersonen en ambtenaren hebben met personen die op sanctielijsten staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Piri over de voorbereidingen voor de opvang van Oekraïners die hun land moeten ontvluchten vanwege de Russische invasie

MPs Ploumen and Piri asked about preparations for receiving Ukrainians fleeing the Russian invasion, including EU coordination, capacity, asylum procedures and whether Ukraine should remain a safe country of origin. The government answered that it is preparing for large-scale reception with municipalities and safety regions, has imposed a half-year decision and departure moratorium, and has suspended Ukraine's safe-country designation, but gave mostly general answers and referred to earlier letters.
The designation of Ukraine as a safe country of origin has also been suspended for at least the same period, until a new reassessment has taken place.
Ook is de aanwijzing van Oekraïne als veilig land van herkomst opgeschort voor in ieder geval dezelfde periode, totdat een nieuwe herbeoordeling zal hebben plaatsgevonden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Dassen over de openbaarmaking van de brief die Cora van Nieuwenhuis tekende voor de informateur, voordat zij minister werd en waarin zij beloofde om geen afspraken te maken over

MPs Omtzigt and Dassen asked the Prime Minister to publish the letter former minister Cora van Nieuwenhuizen signed before taking office, pledging no post-office arrangements, and whether her conduct and oversight of those pledges were adequate. The Prime Minister said the standard letter's text is fully public without signature and personal data, that there is no reason to think she breached her pledges, and that the cabinet plans no separate oversight of former ministers beyond new integrity measures requiring legislation.
The cabinet has no intention of establishing any form of oversight of (former) office holders.
Het kabinet heeft geen voornemens om een vorm van toezicht op (gewezen) bewindspersonen in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uithuisgeplaatste kinderen en het toeslagenschandaal

An MP asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, including reunification prospects, complaint procedures at the youth care inspectorate and certified institutions, the scope of the inspectorates' investigation, and legal protection for parents and children. The minister answered at length, often stating that the inspectorates lack competence to handle individual complaints, declined to name the investigators, and said the requested two-week deadline could not be met.
I am not willing to give you the names of the staff (officials) of the inspectorates who carry out the investigation.
Ik ben niet bereid u de namen te geven van de medewerkers (ambtenaren) van de inspecties die het onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het Predicaat Koninklijk

MP Bromet asked the Prime Minister about the criteria for the Royal Predicate, whether Shell loses it by moving its head office abroad, and when it can be withdrawn after an unblemished-conduct breach such as a criminal conviction. The minister answered that the predicate is an honorary tradition governed by royal decrees, that a headquarters move risks loss of Dutch identity, and that withdrawal is a proportionate, case-by-case decision after a company is asked to explain itself.
The Royal Predicate is a long-standing tradition.
Het predicaat Koninklijk is een reeds lang bestaande traditie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Omtzigt over het WHO-verdrag voor pandemische preventie

Two MPs asked the Health Minister and the Prime Minister about preparations for a WHO pandemic prevention treaty, including draft texts, negotiation mandate, timeline, EU competence, the 2021 op-ed signed by Rutte, and whether the structural 300 million euro pandemic preparedness budget relates to the treaty. The minister described the INB process, said drafts will be shared when available and parliament informed before the second INB session, and denied a link between the budget and the treaty.
Once the contours of the pandemic treaty are clearer, parliament will be informed.
Zodra de contouren van het pandemieverdrag duidelijker zijn, zal het parlement worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het Nederlandse vestigingsklimaat

An MP asked the Minister for Economic Affairs and Climate whether the Dutch investment climate has improved or worsened, why Shell moved its headquarters to the UK, and how the Milieudefensie climate ruling and subsidies to NGOs such as Milieudefensie, Urgenda and Natuurmonumenten affect the investment climate. The minister answered that the climate is relatively good according to rankings but signals of concern exist, attributed the Shell move mainly to simplifying its share structure, listed government subsidies to these organisations, and promised further letters on the investment climate.
I will inform the House further in the first quarter of this year on how I intend to work on the investment climate.
Ik zal uw Kamer nog in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar verder informeren over hoe ik werk wil maken van het vestigingsklimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de veroordeelde moslimterrorist Soumaya Sahla

An MP asks the Prime Minister about his contacts with Soumaya Sahla, a convicted terrorist, including her meeting at the Prime Minister's office, her former role as adviser to the VVD and NCTV/AIVD contacts. The Prime Minister answers that he met her once in 2019, cannot reflect on court rulings, refers party matters to the VVD and says access to government buildings is for each organisation to decide.
As I told the media on 28 January, I will not go further into the content of such conversations.
Zoals ik op 28 januari jl. tegenover media heb gezegd, ga ik niet verder in op de inhoud van dergelijke gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe ‘Carnivoor? Geef het door!’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Prime Minister whether the Ministry of General Affairs would join the national meat- and dairy-free week and adopt a 'Carnivore? Pass it on' principle making plant-based food the default in its canteen, citing climate and nature benefits. The government answered that its canteens follow the Dutch dietary guidelines and sustainability criteria, that the ministry's catering participates in the meat- and dairy-free week, and that plant-based protein is a key element of new catering tenders, but it did not commit to a default plant-based menu, and the answers were late.
I have tried to send the answers for my department to your House before 7 March 2022. Unfortunately, this did not succeed.
Ik heb getracht de antwoorden voor mijn departement voor 7 maart 2022 toe te sturen aan uw Kamer. Dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het toenemende gebruik van Signal onder bewindspersonen en ambtenaren

An MP asked the government about officials and ministers increasingly using the disappearing-message app Signal and whether this allows relevant communications to escape Wob freedom-of-information requests and oversight. The minister answered that existing policy discourages messaging apps for official decision-making, that chat messages on decisions must be preserved, and that he will add advice to the handbook not to enable automatic deletion, while declining to provide per-ministry usage data or ban Signal.
I will communicate this addition to the handbook government-wide.
Ik zal deze aanvulling op de Handleiding rijksbreed communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Piri over het bericht “In Brussel hat Putin schon gesiegt”

MPs Ploumen and Piri asked the Prime Minister whether the Netherlands had resisted excluding Russia from SWIFT in EU discussions, and how that squared with calls for maximum sanctions, asking for a reply before the upcoming debate. The Prime Minister denied that the Netherlands opposed SWIFT exclusion, saying it has consistently pushed for the strongest possible package including SWIFT, and answered the remaining questions by referring back to that answer.
No. The Netherlands has consistently advocated for as large and severe a package as possible, with all options on the table.
Nee. Nederland heeft steeds gepleit voor een zo groot en zwaar mogelijk pakket, waarbij alle opties op tafel liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Palland en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Rutte gaat in gesprek met bedrijfsleven over toenemende 'ellende''

CDA MPs asked the government about reports that Prime Minister Rutte would talk with business about rising hardship, debt built up during COVID, the hardship-fund and TVL/NOW subsidy gaps, bank refinancing costs, retail support and Bbz/TONK uptake. The ministers answered that talks with business continue, that a broad set of debt-relief tools exists, that subsidy rules cannot easily cover edge cases without slowing payments, and that some follow-up letters and reviews will come.
The cabinet realises that the current support package does not fit every individual situation, and that feels uncomfortable.
Het kabinet beseft dat het huidige steunpakket niet op iedere individuele situatie aansluit, en dat voelt ongemakkelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht 'Boris Johnson wil VDL Nedcar aftroeven: Britse premier zet zich persoonlijk in voor komst Rivian naar Engeland'

CDA MP Amhaouch asked whether the Dutch government is actively working to attract Rivian's European plant to VDL Nedcar in Born, including whether the Prime Minister is personally involved, and how it responds to Johnson's competing offer. The minister confirms active support via NFIA and ongoing contact, but declines to disclose the stage of decision-making, contacts with prospective clients, or the content of Johnson's offer citing confidentiality.
Because of commercial confidentiality and because premature disclosure could harm the process, the cabinet is generally reticent about giving information on developments in current corporate cases.

Omwille van de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid en omdat voortijdige mededelingen het proces kunnen schaden is het kabinet over het algemeen terughoudend met het geven van informatie over ontwikkelingen rond actuele bedrijfscasussen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de aanvankelijke goedkeuring voor het aanblijven van de demissionair minister Infrastructuur en Waterstaat terwijl zij een lobbyfunctie voor de energiesector had aanvaard

The SP's Leijten asked Prime Minister Rutte how he reached the political assessment that minister Van Nieuwenhuizen could not stay on after accepting a lobbying job in the energy sector, who was consulted, whether memos exist, and how integrity rules and future cases will be handled. Rutte answered that he judged after political weighing on 26 August 2021 that the appointment did not fit the ministerial office, that no memos were written, that no integrity issue existed, and that new post-ministerial integrity measures are being prepared in legislation.
On 26 August 2021, after further political weighing, I came to the view that the appointment does not fit well with the office of minister.
Op 26 augustus 2021 ben ik na nadere politieke weging tot het inzicht gekomen dat de benoeming niet goed samen gaat met het ambt van bewindspersoon.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga, Ephraim en Smolders over juridisch bindende overeenkomsten met het World Economic Forum en aanverwante zaken

MPs Van Haga, Ephraim and Smolders asked whether the government has binding agreements with the World Economic Forum and whether Parliament can inspect them. The minister confirmed binding implementation agreements and grants under Dutch law, said the subsidy decisions are attached, and stated that the WEF is a private Swiss foundation and that the agreements fall within the budget Parliament approves.
Annex 3 contains the subsidy decisions issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to the WEF.
In de bijlage 3 treft u de aan het WEF verstrekte subsidiebeschikkingen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over Soumaya Sahla

An MP asked the ministers whether Soumaya Sahla, convicted for Hofstad group membership and illegal weapons possession, had ever advised the AIVD or NCTV. The ministers answered that the AIVD cannot comment publicly on specific conduct, while NCTV experts spoke with her a few times without her being involved in analyses or policy.
The AIVD cannot publicly address specific questions about its conduct.
De AIVD kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op concrete vragen over haar handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het artikel 'Rutte na roerig jaar: ‘Fouten heb ik te corrigeren’'

An MP from BIJ1 asked Prime Minister Rutte about his public admissions of communication mistakes in the early COVID-19 crisis, whether these hindered parliamentary debate, their effect on public support, concrete lessons learned, and the timing of the official evaluation. The government answered that it has reflected on its conduct in several parliamentary debates, that support for measures differs from compliance, and that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid is evaluating the crisis with a first partial report expected in February 2022.
The cabinet is and remains willing to reflect on its own conduct and is open to critical and constructive input from society and from the House.
Het kabinet is en blijft bereid te reflecteren op het eigen handelen en staat open voor kritische en constructieve geluiden vanuit de maatschappij en vanuit de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de regering brieven met aanwijzingen aan gemeentes stuurde zonder wettelijke grondslag

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked whether letters the government sent to municipalities instructing them to create emergency asylum reception places, called 'aanwijzingen', had any legal basis, and whether they amounted to mere requests. The government answered that the letters had no basis in Dutch law, were not legally binding, were intended as urgent requests, and that it will no longer use the term 'aanwijzing' in this way, while refusing to share some correspondence yet and not answering the criminal-law questions.
The cabinet regrets this. Therefore the cabinet no longer wishes to use the term 'aanwijzing' in a situation like this in this way.
Het kabinet betreurt dat. Daarom wil het kabinet de term «aanwijzing» in een situatie zoals deze niet meer op deze wijze gebruiken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pouw-Verweij over het vernietigende advies van de Raad voor de rechtspraak over de wetsvoorstellen 2G en 3G op de werkvloer, dat vlak voor kerst, met vijf weken vertraging, aan

MPs Omtzigt and Pouw-Verweij asked why the Council for the Judiciary's critical advice on the 2G/3G workplace bills was sent to parliament late, why its criticisms (necessity, proportionality, dismissal risk, privacy) were not summarised in the explanatory memorandum, and why ministers may not have seen it. The minister answers that the advice was omitted by error and sent later, that the bills were substantially amended in response, and that the government considered the advice fully.
The advice was mistakenly not sent to the House of Representatives together with the other advice issued on the two bills.
Het advies is abusievelijk niet tezamen met de andere over de twee genoemde wetsvoorstellen uitgebrachte adviezen naar de Tweede Kamer gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de juridische basis waarmee gemeentes gedwongen worden asielzoekers op te vangen

MP Omtzigt asked whether the Secretary of State's December 2021 letters 'designating' emergency asylum reception sites for Enschede, Gorinchem and the Rotterdam region have any legal basis, and whether this amounts to an unlawful directive to municipalities. The government replied that the letters are not legal directions, have no grounding in Dutch law and no public-law effect, were a request driven by an acute shortage of about 2,000 places, and that it would not be repeated lightly; it also declined to release a decision memo, saying none was written.
The directions have no basis in Dutch statute or regulation, as I stated during the Justice and Security budget debate in the Senate on 21 December.
De aanwijzingen hebben geen grondslag in Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving, zoals ik gemeld heb bij de begrotingsbehandeling JenV in de Eerste Kamer op 21 december jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over COVID-19 virusvariant B.1.1.529 en medicijnen tegen COVID-19

MP Omtzigt asked the Health Minister about the B.1.1.529 (omicron) variant: its detection in the Netherlands, surveillance capacity, scenarios, travel rules, antiviral procurement, vaccine contracts and Court of Audit access to those contracts. The minister answered that surveillance meets ECDC norms, that the government has prepared scenarios and travel measures, that vaccine contracts are confidential, and that the Court of Audit has insight into them.
The concluded contracts stipulate that confidentiality applies to these contracts.
