In de afgesloten contracten is afgesproken dat op deze contracten de vertrouwelijkheid van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden met het World Economic Forum (WEF) naar aanleiding van antwoorden hierover van het kabinet

An opposition MP (FvD) asked the Prime Minister detailed questions about ministers' ties to the World Economic Forum, including invitations, attendance, costs, communications and a meeting involving Queen Máxima. The government answered that ministers take no WEF training, that invitations are decided by the ministers themselves, that no minutes are usually kept, and that it cannot provide all documents or the full communications at short notice, but will honour specific requests and promises a letter on costs in Q1 2022.
Unfortunately it is not feasible to inventory, in the short term, all documents that played a role and to check them for information whose disclosure should be withheld in the interest of the state.

Het is helaas niet haalbaar om alle stukken die daarbij een rol hebben gespeeld op korte termijn te inventariseren en te toetsen op de aanwezigheid van informatie waarvan de openbaarmaking gelet op het belang van de staat achterwege moet blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over het nieuwsbericht ‘Kabinet polst Kamer over afschaffen dividendbelasting na besluit Shell’

Two SP MPs asked whether the cabinet sought parliamentary support for abolishing the dividend tax after Shell's announced departure, and about the costs, jobs and the verhuurderheffing. The government replied that it informed some parliamentary groups informally, that abolition costs about EUR 2 billion a year and is not currently on the agenda, that it cannot disclose Shell's tax position under tax secrecy, and that it cannot judge the verhuurderheffing as a caretaker cabinet.
No insight can be given into the tax position of a specific company because of the statutory tax secrecy obligation.
Er kan geen inzicht worden gegeven in de belastingpositie van een specifiek bedrijf vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de afhandeling van de schade van de wateroverlast in Limburg en Noord-Brabant van juli 2021

An MP asked the government about the slow handling of flood damage claims in Limburg and Noord-Brabant after July 2021, including delays, strict procedures, insurance exclusions and unclear rules for farmers. The minister said payments had started, defended the procedure and the 13-week and 4-6 week timelines, refused to extend the deadline or make advance payments, and declined to intervene in private insurance policies.
I consider it of great importance that those affected are helped adequately and as quickly as possible.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat gedupeerden adequaat en zo snel mogelijk worden geholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meijeren over de Nederlandse bijdrage aan het plan van het World Economic Forum voor een wereldwijde voedseltransitie

An MP asked the government about the Netherlands' role in a World Economic Forum plan for a global food transition, including WEF partnerships, the Global Coordinating Secretariat in the Netherlands, and financial contributions. The minister answered that no such WEF plan is known to the cabinet, that WEF partnerships are legally binding agreements, and that many details (funding, staffing, accountability) were referred to attached documents rather than stated in the answer.
The cabinet is not aware of any WEF plan for a global food transition.
Er is bij het kabinet geen plan van het WEF voor een wereldwijde voedseltransitie bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het vernietigen van interne correspondentie door de Europese commissie

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the European Commission destroys internal correspondence, contrary to EU rules, and how this affects access to documents and scrutiny. The government answered that it is not for the Dutch cabinet to judge Commission compliance, pointed to the EU Ombudsman, the General Court and the European Parliament, and said it generally pushes for transparency and will continue to do so in EU fora.
It is not for the cabinet to pronounce on whether the European Commission has acted in breach of its own EU rules.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om te treden in de vraag of de Europese Commissie in strijd heeft gehandeld met eigen EU-regels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de mogelijke familiebanden van een D66-Kamerlid met een veroordeelde terrorist

Wilders asks the Prime Minister whether he knew of family ties between D66 MP Fonda Sahla and a convicted terrorist sister, whether security services and the Tweede Kamer were informed, and whether the convicted person has access to Parliament. The government declines to comment on MPs' personal circumstances and on specific security matters, says it keeps threat analyses under review and informs protected persons in general terms, and says Parliament controls its own access policy.
The cabinet does not have information about who visits the Tweede Kamer, who has a Kamerpas, and who works for one of the political parties.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie over wie de Tweede Kamer bezoekt, wie een Kamerpas heeft en wie werkzaam is voor een van de politieke partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het aankomende staatsbezoek in Noorwegen en het aankaarten van de Noorse walvisjacht

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked whether the King knows that Norway killed 575 whales this year, whether IMF findings on whale carbon storage are known, and whether he would raise whaling with Norway during the state visit. The government confirms awareness of the figures and findings, says the climate-whaling link was not discussed but will feed into Dutch positions at the IWC, and reports that the Dutch position for a whaling ban was raised by other delegation members and by the Prime Minister by phone.
This subject was not raised by the King during the state visit, but it was raised by other members of the delegation.
Dit onderwerp is niet aangekaart door de Koning tijdens het staatsbezoek, maar wel door andere leden van de delegatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Vestering over de jachtakte van prinses Amalia voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether Princess Amalia obtained a hunting certificate, whether an exception to the minimum age was made, and whether this relates to management of the Crown Estate and a subsidy request. The minister answered that she obtained a hunting diploma (not a hunting licence), that no exception was made, and that there is no link between the diploma, the subsidy request and management of the Crown Estate.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de asielinstroom en de uitspraken van staatssecretaris Broekers-Knol

An MP from JA21 asked the government about reception shortages at asylum centres, the projected 2021 asylum inflow, and the handling of the Afghanistan-related motion. The State Secretary rejected the term 'asylum crisis', attributed shortages to COVID travel easing, Afghan evacuations and slow outflow of permit holders, and stated that a numerical ceiling on asylum intake is incompatible with Nederland's obligations.
I have asked the ACVZ to broadly map the options for using policy target figures to steer different forms of migration.
Ik heb de ACVZ gevraagd om breed in kaart te brengen welke mogelijkheden bestaan voor het gebruik van beleidsmatige richtgetallen bij sturing van verschillende vormen van migratie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Grondwet, het coronatoegangsbewijs – en de wetenschappelijke onderbouwing daarvan – en lessen die Nederland kan trekken uit van de aanpak in Corona in Noorwegen, Zweden en D

An MP asked the ministers about constitutional review of COVID measures, the scientific basis for the corona access certificate, and lessons from Norway, Sweden and Denmark. The government replied that constitutional review is applied to new laws and measures, that the certificate is justified by vaccine effectiveness, that little scientific study exists yet and a research question has been set out, and that the OVV has sent no interim report.
It is not the cabinet's task to request an interim report from the OVV. It concerns independent research.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet om een tussenrapportage bij de OVV op te vragen. Het gaat om onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij , Omtzigt, Den Haan, Gündoğan, Hijink en Westerveld over het tijdspad van boostervaccinaties

MPs asked the Dutch health minister why the Netherlands had not yet started voluntary COVID-19 booster vaccinations for over-65s and care residents, citing declining vaccine effectiveness, rollouts in Denmark, Sweden and the UK, and vaccine stock. The minister answered that vaccine effectiveness remained high, that the Health Council had advised boosters for the oldest groups and institutional residents, that a start date of 19 November was set, and that preparation (staffing, invitations, GGD capacity) required time.
From 19 November, booster vaccination will start.
Met ingang van 19 november start het vaccineren met de booster.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de uitspraken van de premier bij de klimaattop in Glasgow

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he said at a closed dinner at the Glasgow climate summit that climate policy cannot be more ambitious because people would otherwise vote far-right. The Prime Minister said he cannot recall the exact wording but stressed the need for public support and fair distribution of climate burdens, without denying the substance of the remark.
I cannot recall the exact wording of my remark to which Ms Fleming refers.
De precieze bewoording van mijn opmerking waar mevrouw Fleming naar verwijst kan ik niet terughalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een recente opmerking van de Minister-President in Brussel d.d. 25 oktober 2021

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister why he declined to answer a Dutch journalist's question about Dutch children placed in care while he was in Brussels, and whether this showed EU matters outweighing domestic accountability. The Prime Minister answered that he is accountable on domestic affairs in Brussels too, admitted his first reaction was wrong and that he should have answered directly, and said he speaks to the press mainly on the summit's agenda items.
No, I am also accountable in Brussels for domestic affairs.
Nee, ook in Brussel ben ik aanspreekbaar op binnenlandse aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de toezegging die is gedaan tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen om een aantal noties over het woonbeleid op een rij te zetten

MP Omtzigt asked the government to deliver promised housing policy notes, including a concrete multi-year plan on housing construction, rent allowance, the cost-sharing norm, sale of social housing and sustainable urban development targets. Minister Ollongren answered that the notes were sent on 5 October 2021 and outlined building pathways, but declined to commit to a full plan, leaving further measures to a new cabinet and promising only a later letter on additional funding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Bisschop over de interpretatie van de grondwettelijke bepalingen inzake het erfelijk koningschap, met name de artikelen 24 en 25

Two SGP MPs asked whether the government's position that a crown heir may marry a same-sex partner without renouncing the throne, and that a consent law is a sufficient route, is consistent with the constitution's closed hereditary succession and with the earlier cabinet's view that marriage implies capacity for children. The minister replied that consent is a matter for the legislature in a concrete case, that the government sees no obstacle to a consent law, and that the earlier view was less firm, without citing new advice.

It is inevitable that there is a fundamental tension with the closed system of succession in the Constitution, which precisely aims to establish on objective and unambiguous grounds who the monarchy passes to.

Het is onvermijdelijk dat er fundamenteel een spanning is met het gesloten systeem van erfopvolging in de Grondwet, dat juist beoogt om op objectieve en eenduidige gronden vast te stellen op wie het koningschap overgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Segers over het systematisch lekken vanuit het Catshuisoverleg

MPs Ceder and Segers asked the Prime Minister whether leaks from the Catshuis cabinet consultations are structural, who receives the documents, and what measures prevent them. The government acknowledges that plans leak with some regularity, says it does not know the motives or channels, and points to reminders of confidentiality while stating it will keep trying to prevent leaks.
I do not have information about the motives or causes of the leak, nor about how it occurs.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de motieven of oorzaken van het uitlekken, noch over de wijze waarop dit gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Omtzigt over het aantal evacuaties vanuit de ambassade in Kaboel

MPs Van Dijk and Omtzigt asked whether the 'three' figure for evacuation exceptions from Kabul was used in government deliberations, and why the minutes of the inter-ministerial meetings are withheld. The minister says the figure was only an order-of-magnitude illustration relayed by phone, that cabinet minutes are confidential to protect the unity of cabinet policy, and that questions cannot be answered within 72 hours.

For this reason, information about the views within the cabinet is not made public, such as minutes of the (Council of) Ministers and preparation for sub-councils, other consultations of ministers and preliminary official deliberations.

Om deze reden wordt informatie over de opvattingen binnen het kabinet niet openbaar, zoals bijvoorbeeld verslagen van de (Rijks)ministerraad en voorbereiding voor onderraden, andere overleggen van bewindslieden en ambtelijke voorportalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de uitspraken om zo min mogelijk vluchtelingen uit Afghanistan op te vangen

An MP asked Prime Minister Rutte to explain his reported statement that as few Afghan refugees as possible should come to the Netherlands, and whether this conflicts with municipalities being asked to find reception places, and whether the country's absorption capacity has been reached. Rutte answered that the cabinet prefers regional protection while still honouring international obligations, that asylum seekers are received during procedures, and that the government is seeking new reception places and faster housing flow for permit holders, while housing pressures stem from complex causes not simply migration.
I do not share the view that these principles are at odds with each other.
Ik deel niet dat deze uitgangspunten haaks op elkaar staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Piri over de evacuatie uit Afghanistan

MPs Omtzigt and Piri asked the government about the Afghanistan evacuation, including embassy correspondence, meeting records, military protection, Council of Ministers decisions, EUPOL interpreters and a promised independent inquiry. The ministers answered most questions substantively, provided some documents with redactions, declined to provide phone-call records because none exist, and committed to establishing an independent inquiry commission.
The cabinet will establish an independent external temporary commission to investigate the crisis approach, including the evacuations of the recent period.
Antwoord 17 Een onafhankelijke externe commissie van tijdelijke aard om onderzoek toe doen naar de crisisaanpak inclusief de evacuaties van de afgelopen periode zal door het kabinet worden ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Gijs van Dijk over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

MPs Sneller and Van Dijk asked the government about the tendering of photography contracts, including the administrative burden on photographers, a bureau-based model, tariffs, market power and legal grounds for the new approach. Prime Minister Rutte answered that the new framework will be published around late October/early November, that the hourly rate will be about 109 euros versus 117 now, and that the earlier multi-supplier framework was dropped partly for legal reasons.
The hourly rate in the new framework agreement will in all likelihood be 109 euros, for every hour a photographer takes photos on location.
Het uurtarief in de nieuwe raamovereenkomst zal naar alle waarschijnlijkheid € 109 bedragen, voor elk uur dat een fotograaf op locatie foto’s neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over de interpretatie van het begrip “wettige nakomelingen” in artikel 25 en artikel 31 van de Grondwet

An MP asked the Prime Minister how the constitutional term 'wettige nakomelingen' (lawful descendants) in articles 25 and 31 should be read, including whether children from same-sex marriages, adoption, or donor/surrogacy should qualify for succession. The government answered that a successor may marry a same-sex partner without losing the throne, but declined to settle the succession status of such children now, deferring it to a future consent law and case-specific weighing.
It is not useful to anticipate such a weighing regarding succession now, in the context of a consent law.
Het is niet dienstig om nu vooruit te lopen op een dergelijke weging omtrent de erfopvolging in het kader van een toestemmingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van der Woude over het boek ‘Amalia, de plicht roept’ van Peter Rehwinkel

MPs asked whether a crown heir marrying a same-sex partner would have to give up the throne, and whether that fits current norms and what it means for their children's eligibility. The government answered that a crown heir may marry a same-sex partner and need not renounce the throne, while noting the constitutional succession system sits in tension with modern family law and that the child question should be addressed in a future consent law.
The cabinet therefore does not see that a crown heir or the King would have to renounce the throne if they wished to marry a partner of the same sex.
Het kabinet ziet dus niet dat een troonopvolger of de Koning afstand zou moeten doen van de troon wanneer hij/zij zou willen trouwen met een partner van hetzelfde geslacht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het feit dat alle ministers en staatssecretarissen die tevens Kamerlid zijn, afwezig waren bij de hoofdelijke stemmingen over de QR-code en hoe zich dit verhoudt tot het grondw

MP Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister whether ministers and state secretaries who are also MPs were absent from the 16 September 2021 roll-call vote on the QR code, how that squares with the free-mandate rule of Article 67, and who decided to dismiss State Secretary Keijzer and whether cabinet rules were followed. Rutte answered that cabinet agreements on dual-role ministers are internal, that the dismissal was proposed with the agreement of the responsible minister and three deputy prime ministers rather than through a cabinet meeting, and that the answers were sent within the three-week deadline though not every question was answered individually.

In this case the Prime Minister, with the agreement of the Minister of EZK as responsible minister and the three Deputy Prime Ministers, proposed the said State Secretary for dismissal with immediate effect.

In dit geval heeft de Minister-President met instemming van de Minister van EZK, als verantwoordelijke Minister, en de drie Vice-Minister-Presidenten de genoemde Staatssecretaris voorgedragen voor ontslag met onmiddellijke ingang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het feit dat de ambassadeur in Afghanistan maar drie van de zestig familieleden van het lokaal ambassadepersoneel mocht evacueren

An SP MP asked the Minister-President whether the ambassador in Kabul was told to evacuate only three of sixty family members of local embassy staff, and whether that figure was a government decision. The Foreign Affairs minister answered that three was an illustrative order of magnitude for 'very restrictive' exceptions communicated by phone, not an absolute cap, that the cabinet later allowed all requested family members to be evacuated, and that the figure was regrettable in how it was conveyed.
To illustrate the conclusion 'very restrictive', the number 3 was mentioned in the exchange as an order of magnitude, without being intended as an absolute number.
Om de conclusie «zeer restrictief» te illustreren is in de uitwisseling het getal 3 als orde van grootte genoemd, zonder dat dat als een absoluut aantal is bedoeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en De Hoop over het functioneren van de voormalig minister en voormalig staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat gedurende de periode dat zij wisten dat zij lobbyist zouden w

MPs Arib and De Hoop asked the Prime Minister whether former minister van Nieuwenhuizen and former state secretary van Veldhoven could access information relevant to their future lobby-type roles while they knew of them, and whether that was undesirable. The government answered that they may have had access to such information, that the lobby ban and confidentiality duty apply, that the timing of their contacts is not known to it, and that van Nieuwenhuizen's appointment was ultimately judged incompatible with office and she was dismissed.
In principle it is up to the officials concerned themselves to shape a follow-on position with integrity.
Het is in principe aan de betrokken bewindspersonen zelf om op een integere wijze vorm te geven aan een vervolgfunctie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de gang van zaken met de nieuwe functies van de voormalig bewindspersonen Van Veldhoven en Van Nieuwenhuizen

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why the departure of former state secretary Van Veldhoven and minister Van Nieuwenhuizen was delayed after their new jobs became known, and why integrity and lobbying rules were not applied earlier. The government answered that the timing followed the dismissal process, that the handbook is not binding, that Van Nieuwenhuizen's ministerial role was adjusted and her appointment was reconsidered before she left, and that the minister is responsible for some answers.
As I also said in the debate of 8 September 2021, I would prefer ministers to stay on until a new cabinet takes office, but it remains a personal consideration.
Zoals ik ook in het debat van 8 september 2021 heb gezegd, zie ik liever dat bewindspersonen aanblijven tot het aantreden van een nieuw kabinet, maar het blijft een persoonlijke afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het rapport waarin de lockdown werd ontraden

An MP asks the Prime Minister and Health Minister about an internal report, reportedly obtained under FOI, that advised against a lockdown while estimating 520,000 QALYs lost, and whether the cabinet and OMT knew of it. The government answers that the note was an early-2020 internal discussion paper, was not shared with the Health Minister, Prime Minister or OMT, and that it rejects claims of concealment, while acknowledging the minister of Economic Affairs saw it.
This internal note was shared neither with the Minister of VWS nor with the Prime Minister.
Deze interne notitie is noch met de Minister van VWS noch met de Minister-President gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Kathmann over de hulp van ambtenaren bij een privékwestie van de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties

MPs Arib and Kathmann asked whether ministry officials helped State Secretary Knops with a private land purchase matter, and whether that is appropriate. The minister answers that the ministry checked the facts because integrity was at issue, found no improper conduct, and declines to publish the landsadvocaat's advice while stating the ministry bore no responsibility for the private lawsuit.
To be as transparent as possible, I have attached the email with which the landsadvocaat was asked for advice.
Om zoveel mogelijk transparant te zijn, heb ik de e-mail bijgevoegd waarmee de landsadvocaat om advies is gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van ambtenaren voor een privékwestie

MP Leijten asked whether a state secretary used civil servants for advice on a private matter, whether top officials may use ministry staff for private affairs, who handles integrity enforcement, and whether the ministry should have declined. The minister answered that private matters can affect a office-holder's functioning, that the ministry supports ministers in their ministerial role, that the landsadvocaat advice cost 4,173.68 euro paid by the ministry, that integrity rules for ministers will be codified in the Blauwe Boek, and that the internal handling is described in an earlier answer.
The ministry also has the task of advising the ministers on when a matter in the private sphere affects their functioning as minister.
Het ministerie heeft mede als taak om de bewindspersonen te adviseren over de vraag wanneer een aangelegenheid in de privésfeer van invloed is op het functioneren als bewindspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Ambtenaren hielpen staatssecretaris Knops bij privékwestie'

An MP asked whether civil servants, the state's lawyer and an agency were used to handle a private matter of State Secretary Knops, including legal analyses, communication advice and a Kadaster note, and whether this was proper and should be investigated. The minister answered that private matters can affect a minister's integrity so the ministry verified facts, that the legal analysis was only background information, that the Kadaster note led to no action, that no specific rules govern this, and that no independent investigation is needed.
This subject will be included in the concrete elaboration of the code of conduct for ministers and state secretaries.
Dit onderwerp zal worden betrokken bij de concrete uitwerking van de gedragscode voor bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over nevenfuncties van de demissionair minister van Defensie

An MP asked whether demissionary Defence Minister Henk Kamp still held seats on the Dutch Caribbean financial supervisory colleges, whether this was compatible with the Rijkswet financieel toezicht, and whether a public register of ministers' side positions exists. The Prime Minister answered that Kamp had announced resignation from these positions before swearing-in and confirmed it in writing, that formal dismissal would follow by royal decree, that a successor was not yet known, and that no central public register of ministers' side positions exists, though side positions may be noted on official CVs.
The State Secretary for the Interior will inform you about the succession of Mr Kamp.
De Staatssecretaris van BZK zal u over de opvolging van de heer Kamp informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de invoering van grenscontroles

An MP asked whether border checks for COVID certificates at the Dutch-Belgian border show that border controls can be introduced quickly, and about their costs and effect on other Marechaussee tasks. The government answered that these checks rest on the Public Health Act rather than Schengen border controls, cost about 550,000 euro until end 2021, were staffed by the KMar only until 31 August, and that controls against illegal migration are not currently needed given strict conditions for internal border controls.
These checks are not internal border controls within the legal framework of the Schengen Borders Code.
Deze controles zijn geen binnengrenscontroles in het juridisch kader van de Schengen-grenscode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de inzet van ministeries tijdens politieke campagnes van bewindspersonen

An MP (Leijten, SP) asked whether ministers acting as party leaders should be separated from their ministerial role, what rules govern ministry staff support for party-political activity during campaigns, and whether ministry social media and communication resources are used for campaigning. The Minister of Interior Affairs answered that ministerial and party roles are separate but partly overlap, that staff support is allowed only for government-policy content, and that existing guidelines (Donner letter 2011, Gedragscode Integriteit Rijk) apply equally during elections.

This means that the deployment of civil servants is permitted without reservation when a contribution promotes the unity of cabinet policy and insofar as a minister addresses policy-substantive topics falling within the ministry's remit.

Dat betekent dat de inzet van ambtenaren zonder meer is toegestaan wanneer een bijdrage de eenheid van het kabinetsbeleid bevordert en voor zover een bewindspersoon ingaat op beleidsinhoudelijke onderwerpen die vallen binnen het terrein van het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de oorzaken van de wateroverlast in Limburg

MP Thijssen asked the government whether climate change causes more extreme weather and flooding like in Limburg, and whether the Green Deal and climate targets must be met to prevent such disasters. The government answered that climate change raises the chance of extreme rainfall, stressed reducing emissions and climate adaptation, announced a policy table on the Limburg flooding, and said it supports the EU 55% target and will respond to the Fit for 55 proposals in September.
The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management announced to the House on 27 July the intention to set up a policy table.
De Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat heeft op 27 juli jongstleden aan uw Kamer het voornemen gemeld om een beleidstafel in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de benoeming van de secretaris-generaal bij het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

An MP asked why the caretaker cabinet appointed a senior official involved in the childcare benefits scandal as secretary-general of the Ministry of VWS, and whether other candidates were considered. The minister answered that an open procedure was followed, that involvement in the scandal is no bar to other posts, that individual conduct is not discussed publicly, and that the cabinet bears political responsibility and has resigned.
Individual conduct of civil servants is not discussed in public.
Over het individuele handelen van ambtenaren wordt niet in het openbaar gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de afwezigheid van het kabinet en de aanwezigheid van de Koning en Koningin bij de ‘Dutch Grand Prix’ in Zandvoort

An MP asked why ministers and state secretaries should not attend the Dutch Grand Prix in Zandvoort while the King and Queen do, given the King's role as head of government. The government answered that the cabinet agreed on restraint at events during the corona period, with capacity limited to two-thirds, and that the King's attendance as head of state reinforces the event's international profile.
In that light, the cabinet did not find it appropriate to attend itself.
Het kabinet vond het in dat licht niet gepast om zelf wel aanwezig te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over radicale ideeën voor een nieuwe bestuurscultuur

Omtzigt asked Prime Minister Rutte about his promised radical ideas for a new administrative culture, the status of motions on hardship effects, a regulatory commissioner for information management, the constitutional review ban (article 120) and a framework act for supervisors, and a state commission on the rule of law. The government answered that consultations and studies are underway, timelines have slipped, the drafting of the article 120 and supervisor-law bills is left to the next cabinet, and a state commission is being prepared with a draft mandate expected in November.
A draft mandate will be submitted to the House of Representatives and the Senate. The aim is to do so in November.
Een conceptopdracht zal worden voorgelegd aan de Tweede Kamer en de Eerste Kamer. Het streven is om dat te doen in november.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het Follow the Money artikel over Nordstream 2 en de Werkgroep Energie

MPs Van der Lee, Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about a Follow the Money report on the Dutch-Russian Energy Working Group, its restart, possible agreements linked to Nord Stream 2, and the protocol and sanctions implications. The minister replies that the working group made no agreements on specific projects such as Nord Stream 2, that the 2018 protocol has no formal status, and that the government keeps a neutral position on Nord Stream 2 as a commercial project.
There was (and is) no question of agreements on specific energy projects, such as Nord Stream 2.
Er was (en is) geen sprake van afspraken over specifieke energieprojecten, zoals Nord Stream 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden met, het World Economic Forum naar aanleiding van antwoorden op eerdere vragen

An MP asked the Prime Minister how cabinet members come to be involved with the World Economic Forum, whether they are invited, how long involvement lasts, and for communication and records. The minister answered that the WEF selects and invites participants, that not all ministers are approached, that the government will provide correspondence and participation overviews by the BHOS budget debate, and that WEF goals are not government goals.
The cabinet is willing to grant access to the written communication between the cabinet and the WEF.
Het kabinet is graag bereid inzage te verlenen in de (schriftelijke) communicatie tussen het kabinet en het WEF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Arib over het ontslag van de Minister en Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, C. van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga en S. van Veldhoven

Two PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister why the two state secretaries of Infrastructure and Water Management resigned early to take new jobs, and about lobbying restrictions for former office-holders. The government answered that the resignations were personal career choices, that a two-year lobbying ban applies to former ministers at their old department unless the secretary-general grants an exception, and that the ban's scope for the cases at hand is for the secretary-general to assess.

This rule is therefore not intended to make taking up such a position impossible, but to prevent a former office-holder from using knowledge and position gained in the previous role for the interests of the new employer during a set period.

Deze regel beoogt dus niet het in dienst treden bij een dergelijke instelling onmogelijk te maken maar wel om gedurende een bepaalde periode te voorkomen dat een oud-bewindspersoon kennis en positie op grond van de vorige functie inzet voor de belangen van de nieuwe werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Pouw-Verweij over het vertrek van Minister van Nieuwenhuizen van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

Two MPs asked the PM whether former Minister Van Nieuwenhuizen's move to lobby for the energy industry association created a conflict of interest with her infrastructure portfolio, and whether a cooling-off period for ministers should be introduced. The government answered that a minister may choose post-ministerial work within legal limits, that a recusal arrangement was agreed, that a binding cooling-off period would conflict with the constitutional right to free choice of work, and that the question of statutory rules is still under deliberation.
Within legal limits, it is up to a minister themselves to decide which positions they take on after serving as minister.
Het is, binnen wettelijke kaders, aan een Minister zelf om te bepalen welke functies hij of zij vervult na het vervullen van het ministersambt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de Minister een lobbyfunctie heeft aanvaard

Rep. Leijten (SP) asked whether a minister taking a lobbying post, and two ministers leaving the Infrastructure ministry early for other jobs, breach the Handbook for ministers, and whether the generous transition allowance and workload should be changed. The government answered that the lobby ban is not breached, that taking such posts is the minister's own decision within legal limits, that the allowance is not meant to deter early departure and will not be trimmed, and that the Defence secretary's appointment was agreed with the Defence minister.
Accepting a position is not in conflict with the Handbook for ministers.
Het aanvaarden van een functie is niet in het strijd met het handboek voor bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het lobbyverbod voor oud-bewindspersonen en de overstap van de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

An MP asked the government whether the post-office lobbying ban for former ministers still applies after the circular was withdrawn, whether officials may contact former ministers acting as lobbyists, and whether the ban should be legally anchored, including the Van Nieuwenhuizen case. The government confirmed the ban remains in force via the Gedragscode Integriteit Rijk and Handboek, noted it is still considering further measures for former ministers, and gave only partial answers on sanctions, exceptions and legal anchoring.
The cabinet is still considering whether further measures for former office-holders are desirable.
Het kabinet beraadt zich nog op de wenselijkheid van nadere maatregelen voor gewezen bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de dwangsommen die de Staat dreigt te moeten betalen omdat het kabinet Rutte III het Urgenda-vonnis niet lijkt uit te voeren

Ouwehand asks the Prime Minister whether the government's criticism of Urgenda for going back to court over non-execution of the climate judgment is justified, and whether the government will now take the measures needed to meet the 25% emission reduction for 2020 and the 1.5–2 degree goal. The State Secretary replies that the government will do everything to execute the judgment, that preliminary figures put 2020 emissions at 25.4% below 1990, that additional measures are being prepared because the 2030 target is under pressure, and that the government will not apologise but acknowledges the disappointment.
The cabinet has stated that it will do everything it can to give effect to the Urgenda judgment.
Het kabinet heeft aangegeven er alles aan te doen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Sneller, Wuite, Romke de Jong en Van Weyenberg over de aanbesteding van fotografieopdrachten

D66 MPs asked whether the Ministry of General Affairs' tender for photography services, which bundles assignments with a large image bank, would exclude freelancers and SMEs and create a monopsony. The Prime Minister's answer says the tender is in preparation, that a pool of photographers will be selected via a single agency, that the image-bank and commissioned photography will be split into separate tenders, and that the approach honours the 2017 Vos/Mulder motion.
The Ministry of General Affairs has decided, after further consideration, that the commissioned photography and image-bank photography, initially bundled, will be decoupled in this tender.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft op basis van nadere afwegingen besloten dat de van aanvang gebundeld ingezette opdracht- en beeldbankfotografie in deze aanbesteding worden losgekoppeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de fotografie-aanbesteding Rijksoverheid

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the upcoming central government photography tender, its status, and whether it would keep freelance photographers' rates from being pressured and give them a fairer chance to compete, as the Vos/Mulder motion requested. The Prime Minister answered that the tender is in preparation with a pre-announcement published, that a single agency will select a pool of photographers under a framework with fixed hourly rates, and that the design is intended to respect the motion's intent.
In my judgement, the new design does justice to the spirit of the Vos/Mulder motion.
Met de nieuwe opzet wordt naar mijn oordeel recht gedaan aan de geest van de motie Vos/Mulder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het eisen van vaccinatiebewijzen door ondernemers en andere organisaties

An MP asked the health minister whether private businesses demanding vaccination certificates for entry amounts to vaccination pressure, whether this is lawful and consistent with fundamental rights, and whether the government's goals and inclusion of the unvaccinated are still sound. The minister answered that vaccination is voluntary, that private parties may not request vaccination certificates under the temporary Covid access-pass law, that the rights concerned can be limited proportionately, and that the courts will judge private businesses' justifications case by case.
I refer you to my answer to question 6.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 17.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over ventileren overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked the government about ventilation in government buildings and schools, citing calls to air homes and school ventilation survey results showing only 38% compliance. The minister answered that most of the ~1,000 state buildings meet ventilation norms, outlined remedial measures, and described SUViS funding and ongoing work on a parliamentary motion for schools.
For the other (semi-)government buildings, the information is not centrally maintained.
Voor de overige (semi-) overheidsgebouwen wordt de informatie niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over de benoeming van nieuwe bewindslieden

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister about the caretaker cabinet's appointment of new ministers and state secretaries, including whether caretaker status is applied consistently, dual roles of MPs who are also ministers, the timing of announcement and swearing-in, and the severance entitlements of such appointees. The Prime Minister answered that caretaker restraint is applied consistently, that the Constitution's exception allows MPs to serve as ministers during caretaker periods, that MPs-ministers follow agreed limits on parliamentary activity, and that severance rules apply, with some appointees offering to waive their MP allowance.
The Constitution (Article 57, second paragraph) provides, among other things, that a member of the States General cannot also be a Minister or State Secretary.
In de Grondwet (artikel 57, tweede lid) staat onder meer dat een lid van de Staten-Generaal niet tevens Minister of Staatssecretaris kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de problemen rondom Paleis Soestdijk

An MP asked why the buyer of Paleis Soestdijk changed its plans substantially after purchase, whether the sale can be reversed, and whether public money should cover a budget gap, and asked how the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf views the sale process. The State Secretary answered that post-sale changes were approved as optimisations within the buyer's concept, the buyer bears the financial risk and the sale cannot be reversed, and the sale followed a careful, formally prescribed procedure.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf approved the proposed changes because it judged them to be elaborations/optimisations that fit within the proposed concept.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf heeft de voorgestelde wijzigingen goedgekeurd omdat het van oordeel was dat het ging om uitwerkingen/optimalisaties die binnen het voorgestelde concept pasten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Wassenberg over een eventuele subsidieaanvraag voor Kroondomein Het Loo

MPs Sneller and Wassenberg asked whether a new subsidy application for maintenance of Kroondomein Het Loo had been received, and when it would be shared with parliament. The minister replied that no application has been received yet, that the Chamber will be sent the subsidy framework before any application, and that applications must be submitted by 31 December 2021 for subsidy from 1 January 2022.
I will give effect to the above commitment by sending you the framework with the subsidy conditions against which any application will be assessed, before any possible application.
Ik zal invulling aan bovenstaande toezegging geven door u voorafgaande aan een eventuele aanvraag het kader met de subsidievoorwaarden te sturen, waaraan de aanvraag getoetst zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden met, het World Economic Forum

Member Van Houwelingen asked the government about rumours of ties between cabinet members and the World Economic Forum, whether combating disinformation on this is important, what the exact relationship is, what the WEF's character is, and how its agenda fits Dutch interests. The government answered that the WEF is an independent public-private platform, that cabinet members' involvement follows from their policy responsibilities, and that such contacts can help achieve cabinet goals.
Involvement in WEF activities can help achieve parts of cabinet policy.
Betrokkenheid bij activiteiten van het WEF kan helpen bij het verwezenlijken van onderdelen van het kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over besluiten die mede oorzaak zijn van het hoge aantal besmettingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about COVID-19 measures that contributed to high infection numbers, including BCO staffing, the 24/40-hour validity of tests, post-vaccination waiting periods, and the handling of the Delta variant. The minister answered that BCO capacity was reduced in the low-infection period, that the government deviated from OMT advice in places, that it published Catshuis documents for 9 July, and that a further Intra Action Review would await ongoing evaluations.
I have chosen that, after completion of vaccinations from 10 July for all vaccine types, the corresponding corona access certificates only become valid after 14 days.
Ik heb er voor gekozen om na afronding van vaccinaties vanaf 10 juli jl, voor alle type vaccins, de bijbehorende coronatoegangsbewijzen pas na 14 dagen geldig te laten zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het niet naleven van het klimaatvonnis door de Nederlandse Staat en een dreigende nieuwe rechtsgang van Urgenda als er niet binnen een maand een serieus klimaatplan op tafel l

MP Ouwehand asked the Prime Minister whether the state is failing to meet the Urgenda climate ruling, with a 25% emissions cut in 2020 and beyond, and whether a new court case and penalty payments are likely. The Staatssecretaris answered that the 2020 cut was estimated at 24.5% within uncertainty bounds, that 2021 emissions may rise, that extra short-term measures are being prepared with a commitment to inform parliament in the autumn Klimaatnota, and that the government is not aiming to pay penalties.
Therefore the cabinet will, in line with the legal obligation arising from the Climate Act's assurance cycle, prepare additional steps contributing to achieving the Climate Act targets.

Daarom zal het kabinet, conform de wettelijke verplichting die voortvloeit uit de borgingscyclus van de klimaatwet, extra stappen voorbereiden die bijdragen aan de realisatie van de doelen uit de Klimaatwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite, Ceder, Bromet, Wassenberg en Simons over het bericht “heeft premier Jacobs een punt als zij zegt dat Nederland vals speelt”

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister about the Rijksministerraad decision of 23 April 2021 to release the fifth tranche of liquidity support to Sint Maarten and why the State Secretary for Interior and Kingdom Relations did not implement it. The Prime Minister answered that concerns about corporate governance at the airport led the State Secretary to resubmit the matter, which the council reversed on 28 May, and that no change to the council's rules of procedure is planned.
I see no reason to amend the rules of procedure of the council of ministers.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het reglement van orde van de ministerraad te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de nieuwe Oekaze Kok en de soepeler omgang met het contact tussen ambtenaren en Kamerleden

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked why the revised guidelines on external contacts of civil servants with MPs still cause uncertainty and fear among officials, and whether the rules are in fact looser than the former Oekaze Kok. The minister answers that the rules are meant to be more permissive, outlines awareness training and a planned debate, and defends the remaining limits on civil servants' contact with Parliament as flowing from ministerial responsibility.
The cabinet wishes to stress that the rules have certainly not become stricter, but that the revision has in fact created more room for contacts between civil servants and MPs.
Het kabinet wil vooropstellen dat de regels zeker niet strenger zijn geworden, maar dat er met de herziening juist méér ruimte is gekomen voor contacten tussen rijksambtenaren en Kamerleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Hijink over sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen door de coronapandemie

MPs Leijten and Hijink asked the government how socioeconomic health inequalities have grown due to the coronavirus pandemic, and how communication about vaccination and measures reaches people who are digitally or functionally illiterate, and how many communication staff the government employs. The minister answered that research on the widening gap is ongoing with results expected by year-end, cited existing data and studies, listed communication staff numbers (811.5 fte at department communication directorates, 15 fte on the vaccination communication team), and described outreach tools for low-literacy and digitally less skilled groups.
It is expected that in the coming months it will become clearer what the consequences of the pandemic are for socioeconomic health inequalities in the Netherlands.
Naar verwachting zal de komende maanden meer duidelijk worden wat de gevolgen zijn van de pandemie voor de sociaaleconomische gezondheidsverschillen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de brief van de President Mr. J.G. Wattilete van de Republik Maluku Selatan

An MP asked the Prime Minister about a letter from the exiled Republic of South Maluku government, the 2010 court commitment to raise the grave of executed president Soumokil with Indonesia, the return of the RMS flag held by the Marines Museum, and a meeting with the RMS president. The government answered that Indonesia was last approached in 2015 without response and further raising is not considered promising, that the flag is not state property and will not be mediated, and that talks are not on the table because the Kingdom does not recognise the RMS.
Therefore I do not consider it promising to raise the matter again.
Daarom acht ik het niet kansrijk om de kwestie nogmaals aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de ceo altijd een Minister kan bellen

An MP asked why large companies take up so much of ministers' agendas, how often ministries meet VNO-NCW, and whether lobbying contacts, including phone calls, should be published, citing GRECO criticism on lobby transparency. The minister replied that departments publish agendas, that meeting companies is legitimate interactive policymaking, that openness of decision-making is preferred over full contact lists, and that GRECO recommendations are being worked on with a compliance report to follow.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het bericht dat het kabinet de notulen van de ministerraad die eerder naar de parlementaire ondervragingscommissie kinderopvangtoeslag zijn gegaan openbaar maakt

Wilders asks why the cabinet limits publication of Council of Ministers minutes to those already sent to the parliamentary inquiry on childcare benefits, and whether P-notes and minutes on the affair from 2018 onward will be published. Rutte replies that minutes stay confidential for government cohesion, but in this exceptional case the cabinet publishes the minutes given to the inquiry, excluding P-notes and other minutes, and refuses further publication.
For these reasons, the minutes are by default classified as state secret, highly confidential.
Om deze redenen worden de notulen standaard voorzien van de rubricering staatsgeheim, zeer geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de vrij te geven notulen van de ministerraden

An MP asked the Prime Minister to publish cabinet minutes (ministerraad notulen) on the childcare benefits scandal, including those from November 2019 and those cited by RTL Nieuws. The Prime Minister agreed to publish the minutes provided to the parliamentary inquiry, including anonymised and non-anonymised versions, but stated that other minutes would not be released, citing the need for confidential deliberation and the caretaker cabinet's mandate.
Other than the aforementioned minutes, no minutes will be made public.
Andere dan voorgenoemde notulen worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over openbaarmaking van alle documenten die betrekking hebben op 'Build Back Better'

An MP (Baudet, FvD) asked the Prime Minister to publish all government documents mentioning or relating to 'Build Back Better'. The Prime Minister answered by listing already-public Kamerstukken, cabinet and Council minutes passages, and internal briefing notes, explaining that diplomatic confidentiality prevents publishing full notes, so only the relevant passages are provided.

Confidentiality of conversations with international representatives is crucial for the proper functioning of international diplomatic relations, and it is not consistent with that to make such notes public.

Vertrouwelijkheid van gesprekken met internationale vertegenwoordigers, is cruciaal voor het goed functioneren van het internationale diplomatieke verkeer en het is niet in lijn daarmee dergelijke aantekeningen openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van Ojik en Leijten over het bericht ‘Statement of the Members of the European Council’

MPs Kuiken, Van Ojik and Leijten asked the Prime Minister whether the European Council's March 2021 statement to start work on modernising the EU-Turkey customs union squared with the minister's earlier remarks, and why it should not be paused given Turkey's withdrawal from the Istanbul Convention and moves against the HDP. The government replied that the customs union has not been decided, that discussion only starts under the positive agenda conditional on de-escalation, and that human rights and the rule of law must remain part of the EU-Turkey dialogue, with the minister having raised these concerns directly with Turkey.
The cabinet will reiterate this in relevant new discussions with colleagues.
Het kabinet zal dit bij relevante nieuwe discussies met collega’s opnieuw benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat Nederland niet is uitgenodigd voor de door de VS georganiseerde klimaattop

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the Netherlands was excluded from the US-hosted climate summit and whether Dutch climate leadership is credible, and what the government will do to follow up on the summit and COP-26. The minister replied that the Netherlands was invited to the ministerial on adaptation and resilience, rejected the claim that the Netherlands is not seen as a climate leader, and promised to inform parliament through letters on climate diplomacy and COP-26.
You will receive this letter before the summer.
U ontvangt deze brief voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de subsidie aan de Koning voor het beheer van het Kroondomein

An MP asked the government about a nature-management subsidy paid to the King for the Kroondomein, including legal basis, missing application, public access closures, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that the subsidy was lawfully granted under the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies, that Parliament was informed via the budget, and that no reclaim is warranted, while declining to comment on royal security measures.
I do not comment on security measures taken to protect the King.
Over veiligheidsmaatregelen die getroffen worden ter bescherming van de Koning doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over Kroondomein het Loo

Sneller (D66) asks whether Kroondomein het Loo is state-owned, whether the Kroondrager is usufructuary or economic owner, whether surpluses are paid out and how a subsidy was granted with an exception to public access (5,000 ha closed for three months, justified by privacy and security). The minister answers that the Kroondrager is usufructuary, that the subsidy followed the Kaderwet with a broader closure allowed for privacy, and that tax and private financial matters cannot be disclosed.
Financial transactions of natural persons count as conduct within the personal sphere of life.
Financiële transacties van natuurlijke personen gelden als gedragingen binnen de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de vaccinproductie bij Halix en de relatie met de Nederlandse regering

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Health and the Prime Minister about the Halix vaccine plant in Leiden, whether the government failed to invest there, and why Halix supplied the UK but not the EU. The minister answered at length: Halix only makes the active ingredient for AstraZeneca, the government did not invest because Halix did not request it, EU supply was handled through AstraZeneca and advance purchase agreements, and documents were provided.
The content of these kinds of conversations cannot be stated because of their confidential nature.
Over de inhoud van dit soort gesprekken kunnen i.v.m. het vertrouwelijke karakter geen uitspraken gedaan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Palland over het bericht 'Gaat de Nederlandse industrie aan boord van Nederlandse onderzeeboten?'

MPs Van Helvert and Palland (CDA) asked about concerns that Dutch industry may not be included in the new submarines given the three-yard competition, the cost burden on SMEs, and knock-out criteria for industrial participation. The government replied that essential security interests and strategic autonomy will be secured through primary and secondary requirements in the procurement, that a parallel industrial cooperation agreement led by EZK will pursue broader Dutch involvement, and that no fixed participation percentage is imposed in advance.
Defence will, after testing in the dialogue, set requirements in the D-phase to safeguard essential national security interests and strategic autonomy.
Defensie zal daarbij, na toetsing in de dialoog, in de D-fase eisen stellen ter borging van het wezenlijk nationaal veiligheidsbelang en de strategische autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de blunder van de verkenner waardoor het vertrouwen in de verkenning voor een nieuw kabinet is beschadigd

The SP asks the Prime Minister about a leaked internal note by outgoing informateur Ollongren referring to a 'position elsewhere' for MP Omtzigt during formation talks, and about trust damage. The government answers that formation is the Tweede Kamer's responsibility, not the cabinet's, and that it lacks specific information on the process.
There is no ministerial responsibility for the formation process.
Er is geen ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid voor het formatieproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over de vraag of de vaccinatiestrategie in Nederland voldoende kan worden versneld

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Health whether the Dutch COVID-19 vaccination strategy could be accelerated, comparing it with other EU countries and asking about preparations, private partners and vaccine stockpiles. The minister answered that Dutch preparations target up to 2.5 million vaccinations per week from May, that private and armed-forces support is being used, and that stock levels per vaccine were reported, with AstraZeneca stock expected to be worked down within two weeks.
I expect that this high AstraZeneca stock level will be worked down within two weeks.
Ik verwacht dat deze hoge voorraadstand AstraZeneca binnen twee weken is ingelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over psychologische oorlogsvoering om burgers een lockdown te laten accepteren

MP Baudet asked the Prime Minister whether the government used psychological manipulation or fear-inducing techniques to win public acceptance of lockdown measures, and whether it would release related internal documents. The Prime Minister denied using techniques to create fear, said manipulation is not justified, referred to a separate letter on communication, and said the cabinet already meets its information duty toward parliament.
The cabinet has an information duty towards the House of Representatives. Within the agreements made with the House on this, this duty is already being fulfilled.
Het kabinet heeft een informatieplicht richting de Tweede Kamer. Daaraan wordt – binnen de afspraken die daarover met de Tweede Kamer zijn gemaakt – reeds voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sjoerdsma over ‘De quota worden duur betaald‘

D66 MPs asked whether PM Rutte threatened the EU-Faroe trade relationship in 2017 to block a Faroese fisheries law affecting Dutch quota holdings, and questioned the government's intervention and the role of an honorary consul with fishing interests. The government denied an explicit threat, said it raised concerns via bilateral contacts and the EU, declined to publish conversation reports, and defended the honorary consul's appointment as serving Dutch economic interests.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Kuiken over de gang van zaken rond het naar buiten brengen van het besluit over de opening van kinderopvang en basisscholen

MPs Ploumen and Kuiken asked why the government publicly signalled reopening of primary schools and childcare before the OMT advice existed, how the OMT reasoned, and how safe reopening and testing capacity could be ensured. Minister De Jonge answered that hope for reopening preceded the advice, that the OMT weighed social interests alongside epidemiological risk, and that extra measures and testing were planned, while declining to disclose the OMT's internal vote and not answering the question on the exact timing of measures in full detail.
To enable an open exchange of views within the OMT, no statements are made about this exchange and the discussion remains confidential.
Om een open gedachtewisseling in het OMT mogelijk te maken, worden geen uitspraken gedaan over deze gedachtewisseling en blijft de bespreking vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Jetten over het bericht 'Wereldleiders willen ambitieuzere aanpak natuurverlies: 'We hebben geen moment te verliezen'

MPs De Groot and Jetten asked the Prime Minister about the outcome of the One Planet Summit, whether the Netherlands joined the 30% land and sea protection goal ahead of the Kunming biodiversity summit, the link between biodiversity loss and COVID-19, and how the Jetten/De Groot motion was followed up. The Prime Minister answered that the summit built momentum, that the Netherlands joined the High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People, that the zoonosis link is acknowledged by researchers but the SARS-CoV-2 origin is not settled, and that the summit contributed to implementing the motion.
The Netherlands has become a member of the High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People.
Nederland is lid geworden van de High Ambition Coalition for Nature and People.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Markuszower en Voordewind over de poging van het Koninklijk Huis om een strafzaak te beïnvloeden

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Justice Minister about alleged attempts by circles around the Royal House to influence the Poch criminal case, leaks from the investigation, and withheld Argentine legal-aid documents. The minister answered that the Commission Poch found no confirmation of the alleged influence, that a leak prosecution is likely time-barred, and that the archive documents will be assessed for release under Article 68 of the Constitution after the Commission is dissolved.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over het bericht dat het reisadvies van Curaçao naar oranje is bijgesteld

Two D66 MPs asked why the travel advice for Curaçao was changed to orange only on 8 December 2020 despite a record number of infections, how many Dutch travellers had booked trips, and why returning travellers from Curaçao were not tested while Atlanta flights were. Minister De Jonge answered that the advice followed rising infections and that Curaçao is no longer a high-risk area since 8 January, so no PCR or antigen test is required, while giving partial figures on travel volumes and declining to address booking numbers directly.
Can you answer these questions within a week, given the start of the Christmas holiday next week?
Vraag 12 Kunt u, vanwege de start van de kerstvakantie volgende week, deze vragen binnen een week beantwoorden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Nederlandse inzet bij de One Planet Summit van 12 januari 2021

An MP asked the Prime Minister why his prepared four-page speech for the One Planet Summit was not delivered, and whether it could be sent to Parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the speech was prepared, said it covered the key messages on deforestation, and committed to sending it to the Chamber, which he did.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Bosman, Bouali, Leijten, Asscher en Van Ojik over het juridische advies van de commissie over de Brexit-deal.

Six MPs and a Green MP asked the ministers whether the Council's Legal Service had put its advice on the Brexit deal in writing, and requested all internal and external legal advice on the deal, plus options for a smooth transition if the deal is mixed. The minister replied that the Legal Service confirmed its view only orally, that the conclusions will be written into the Council decision and a Commission statement, that the EU-only route is a political choice not binding on future deals, and that interim application of mixed parts is not possible, while the legal analysis and a confidential annex were shared with the Chamber.
There are no written opinions from the Council's Legal Service (JDR) on these questions; the JDR confirmed both points orally.
Er zijn over deze vraagstukken geen schriftelijke adviezen van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad (JDR) verschenen; de JDR heeft beide punten mondeling bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de onderhandelingen over het toekomstig partnerschap tussen de Europese Unie en het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asks the government about the state of the Brexit trade deal, whether it is mixed competence requiring national ratification, and how much time parliament and businesses have to study it. The minister answers that the deal was reached on 24 December 2020 and published, refers to letters for substantive assessment, says the deal is an EU-only competence with no legal need for a mixed agreement, and states the government prefers the deal over no-deal despite the short timeline.
For a substantive assessment, the cabinet refers to the letter sent to your House simultaneously with the answers to these questions.
Voor een inhoudelijke appreciatie verwijst het kabinet naar de brief die gelijktijdig met de beantwoording op deze vragen naar uw Kamer is verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het onderzoek naar de Nederlandse steun aan Syrische rebellen

An MP asks whether the Prime Minister tried to block a motion for an independent inquiry into the Dutch non-lethal aid (NLA) programme to Syrian rebels, and why the government opposes such a probe on grounds of confidentiality, allied relations and risk to rebel groups. The minister responds that the motion was implemented via advisory bodies, that a case-by-case fact-finding inquiry conflicts with confidentiality obligations, that a toetsingskader will be shared in spring 2021, and that no additional inquiry is needed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het artikel 'Kabinet gaat noodtoestand gebruiken voor avondklok'

MP Kuiken asked the Prime Minister whether the government would activate emergency powers under the Wet Buitengewone Bevoegdheden Burgerlijk Gezag for a curfew, whether this bypasses parliament, and whether parliament would be consulted. The government denied activating the act for now, explained that emergency powers are activated by royal decree followed by a bill to parliament, and committed to notifying parliament of any curfew intention unless urgency prevents it.
notification of the intention will be given to the States General, so that a exchange of views between government and States General can take place if desired
zal van het voornemen daartoe mededeling worden gedaan aan de Staten-Generaal, zodat daarover desgewenst tussen regering en Staten-Generaal van gedachten kan worden gewisseld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over ‘het bericht dat de minister-president onderzoek naar de Nederlandse steun aan Syrische rebellen probeert tegen te houden’

An MP asks the Prime Minister whether he is trying to block an inquiry into Dutch non-lethal support to Syrian rebels, and whether the promised investigation has been carried out, including questions on contacts with MPs about a motion and on objections from allies. The government replies that an independent CAVV/AIV advisory process replaced a retrospective fact-finding inquiry, that it opposes a new investigation citing security risks and allies' concerns, that it denies pressuring MPs, and that it will share a non-lethal assistance assessment framework in spring 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Nederlands kabinet vindt eisen Europees coronafonds lastig’

An MP asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs why the cabinet would not submit a national recovery plan in the first EU window and whether Dutch firms would lose EU coronavirus recovery funds as a result. The minister replied that the final decision is left to the incoming cabinet, that Dutch funds are not lost because later submission windows remain open, and that the government is taking other steps to protect the level playing field.
The cabinet deliberately chooses to leave the final decision on the reforms and investments to be included in the Recovery and Resilience Plan to the new cabinet.

Het kabinet kiest er bewust voor om het definitieve besluit over de hervormingen en investeringen die in het Recovery and Resilience Plan ( RRP) worden opgenomen door het nieuwe kabinet te laten nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over gesprekken met jongeren in Caribisch Nederland

MP Özütok asked whether the government will involve young people from Caribbean Netherlands in decision-making on the covid-19 crisis, citing the citizens' initiative 'Betrek jongeren'. State Secretary Knops says he knows the initiative, has spoken with young people on his visits, and will hold an online conversation with young people on 23 November, bringing their ideas to the cabinet.
On 23 November I have planned a first conversation with young people from Caribbean Netherlands to speak online about the themes that concern them.
Op 23 november a.s. heb ik een eerste gesprek gepland met jongeren uit Caribisch Nederland om via een online verbinding te spreken over de thema’s die bij hen leven.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Is er nog leven voor VDL Nedcar na 2023 nu BMW afhaakt’

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked the government whether it had contacts with VDL Nedcar, BMW or the German government about BMW ending its contract, which ministries are involved in finding a solution, and whether an integral action plan for the region will be made. Minister Wiebes answered that contacts with VDL Nedcar and BMW took place at high level, no contact with the German government occurred on the contract, several ministries and NFIA help find new clients, and a regional development package with funding and road projects is being pursued.
The cabinet is generally reticent about publishing information on the content of specific contacts with businesses.
Het kabinet is over het algemeen terughoudend met het publiceren van informatie over de inhoud van specifieke contacten met het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de afgebroken vakantiereis van leden van het Koninklijk Huis naar Griekenland

Sneller (D66) asked the Prime Minister whether he would prevent a repeat of the royal holiday to Greece and why the Vice-Prime Minister denied knowledge of it at a press conference, and asked whether communication followed guidelines and why two younger royals' stay was not disclosed. Rutte admits a wrong judgment about the King's planned holiday, says the Vice-PM was not informed beforehand, and argues the royals' private travel falls under their protected private sphere.
In general, foreign trips by the King that are not part of his public function belong to his personal sphere of life, which is protected by articles 10 and 41 of the Constitution.

In het algemeen behoren reizen naar het buitenland van de Koning die geen onderdeel uitmaken van zijn publieke functie, tot zijn persoonlijke levenssfeer die wordt gewaarborgd door de artikelen 10 en 41 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de besprekingen op het Catshuis.

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether a memo from three ministers on economic effects of lockdown scenarios was discussed at an informal Catshuis meeting, and why the Chamber cannot receive it despite earlier motions. The government answered that Catshuis meetings are informal, non-decisional consultations and that disclosure would harm confidential deliberation, while promising ongoing general information to the Chamber.
Disclosure of any documents would undermine the confidentiality necessary for free exchange of views in which this consultation between those present takes place.
Openbaarmaking van eventuele documenten doet afbreuk aan de bescherming van de voor de vrije gedachtewisseling noodzakelijke vertrouwelijkheid waarin dit overleg tussen de aanwezigen plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse digitale veiligheid en de ontmoeting met de Chinese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the government about the Dutch digital security implications of university research cooperation with Huawei and about the PM's and Foreign Minister Blok's meeting with Chinese FM Wang Yi. The government answered that the research is civilian (multilingual search), results are open access, universities are responsible for their own partner choices, and a neutral framework for telecom suppliers applies.

The cabinet will inform the House this autumn in more detail about the state of affairs in the process toward additional measures to counter unwanted knowledge and technology transfer through education and research.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer dit najaar nader informeren over de stand van zaken bij het proces om te komen tot aanvullende maatregelen
Antwoord op vragen van lid Asscher over de onduidelijkheid die is ontstaan over het maximum aantal personen dat momenteel is toegestaan in culturele instellingen

Asscher (PvdA) asks the ministers to clarify confusion over whether cultural venues may admit more than 30 visitors after the 13 October tightening, and whether exemptions, criteria, support and quick clear guidelines will be provided. Minister Van Engelshoven answers that the exemption possibility lapsed, a 30-visitor maximum applies to theatres, concert halls and cinemas, she sympathises with the sector, and additional support money is being considered, with the answers mostly referring back to the first answer.
For the answer to this question I refer to my answer to Question 2.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar mijn antwoord op Vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de besluitvorming in de coronapandemie

MP Asscher asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Health about the decision-making in the COVID-19 pandemic, including the clarity of the approach, the division of responsibilities and crisis structure, the informal Catshuis meetings, the criteria for the latest measures, and the role of behavioural scientists. Minister De Jonge answered that the strategy aims for targeted regional and national measures, described the layered advisory and ministerial decision-making structures, and declined to share the content of informal Catshuis discussions, citing the need for candid exchange.
It concerns informal and exploratory consultation at the initiative of the Prime Minister without a formal agenda.
