Het betreft informeel en beschouwend overleg op initiatief van de Minister-President zonder formele agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de vakantie van de Koning

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he knew of the King's holiday abroad, why he did not object, who decided the King should return, and related questions on ministerial responsibility. The Prime Minister answered almost every question by pointing to the duty to protect the unity of the Crown and the King's private life, admitted he misjudged the timing, and provided no substantive information on the decision.
This means that no information can be provided about political and/or administrative contacts relating to matters within the Crown.
Dit betekent dat geen informatie kan worden verstrekt over contacten van politieke en/of ambtelijke aard die betrekking hebben op hetgeen zich binnen de Kroon voltrekt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over de vraag dat de Koning voor de herfstvakantie naar Griekenland is afgereisd

An MP asked whether the King travelled to Greece before the autumn holiday, whether this sent the wrong signal given lockdown appeals, whether the trip was coordinated with the government, and whether the Deputy PM knew of it when denying any knowledge of a holiday. The Prime Minister confirmed the King returned, admitted a misjudgement, said the constitutional protection of the Crown limits disclosure of contacts, and explained the Deputy PM was not informed in advance.
This means that no information can be provided about political and/or official contacts relating to matters within the Crown.
Dit betekent dat geen informatie kan worden verstrekt over contacten van politieke en/of ambtelijke aard die betrekking hebben op hetgeen zich binnen de Kroon voltrekt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijke rechtsbasis van sancties tegen Wit-Rusland

Omtzigt asked whether the Sanctiewet 1977 allows sanctions against Belarus via an intergovernmental agreement among EU states, and how broadly 'internationale afspraken' is defined. Minister Blok confirmed the statutory text, said such an agreement could provide the basis but would take considerable time and conflict with ongoing EU Council negotiations, and described 'internationale afspraken' as a broad concept.
An intergovernmental agreement could be a sufficient legal basis to adopt a general administrative order with sanctions against Belarus or individuals from Belarus.
Een intergouvernementele afspraak zou voldoende rechtsbasis kunnen zijn om een algemene maatregel van bestuur vast te stellen met sancties tegen Wit-Rusland of individuen uit Wit-Rusland.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya Hemani, dat ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneemt om haar terug te krijgen in Nederland

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the government about the 2016 abduction of Dutch toddler Insiya Hemani to India, the enforcement of Dutch court rulings on her return, and what is being done to bring her back. The ministers confirmed awareness of the case and court rulings, said the Indian authorities are being pressed via diplomatic notes but that enforcement in India cannot be compelled by the Netherlands and that India's child-custody and immigration matters are for Indian law.
In this case, Dutch court rulings are being presented to the Indian authorities through diplomatic channels so that they can take note of them.
Nederlandse gerechtelijke uitspraken worden in deze zaak langs diplomatieke weg aangeboden aan de Indiase autoriteiten om daar kennis van te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Alkaya over het nieuws dat gedupeerde ouders van de CAF 11-zaak al veel eerder compensatie hadden kunnen krijgen

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked Prime Minister Rutte whether he blocked a compensation proposal for childcare benefit victims in June 2019, why earlier answers were evasive, and what he concretely did to resolve the affair. Rutte denied that any compensation proposal was blocked in the 7 June 2019 cabinet meeting, stated he was unaware of the Tax Authority's earlier warnings, and largely restated that the cabinet supported restitution, offering answers without new substance.
The questions wrongly assume that a compensation proposal by State Secretary Snel was blocked at the cabinet meeting of 7 June 2019.
In de vraagstelling wordt er ten onrechte van uitgegaan dat in de ministerraad van 7 juni 2019 een compensatievoorstel van Staatssecretaris Snel is tegengehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de uitlatingen van de minister-president tijdens het debat over de uitkomst van de Europese Top inzake het herstelfonds

An MP asked the Prime Minister, through written questions, how the Recovery Fund relates to eurobonds, the coalition agreement's ban on joint debt, and President Macron's 'common debt' remark, and whether monetary experts were consulted. Finance Minister Hoekstra answered that the instrument is a temporary, bounded EU bond issuance with joint liability proportional to GNI shares rather than joint and several guarantees, and that the Dutch government has sufficient expertise in-house.
With the recovery instrument, there is no structural joint financing or guaranteeing of member states' debts and deficits.
Er is met het herstelinstrument geen sprake van het structureel gemeenschappelijk financieren of garanderen van schulden en tekorten van de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus

An MP asks the government to justify continued COVID-19 restrictions, their proportionality, effects on mental health, economy and poverty, and the scientific basis for distancing and ventilation advice. The ministers respond that restrictions remain necessary to control the virus, describe the OMT and BAO advisory process and support measures, and state that herd immunity was never a goal.
The decision whether the measures proposed by the OMT are implemented is then up to the cabinet.
De afweging of de maatregelen die het OMT voorstelt worden uitgevoerd, is vervolgens aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kwint en Alkaya over het nieuws dat gedupeerde ouders van de CAF 11-zaak al veel eerder compensatie hadden kunnen krijgen

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked PM Rutte what role he played in blocking a June 2019 compensation proposal for CAF 11 childcare benefit parents, and whether he will apologise and why the former State Secretary who tried to compensate was lost while the one blocking it was promoted. Rutte answered briefly that the cabinet consistently supported making the affected parents whole from the moment the scale became clear, and that he has apologised for what happened.
From the moment the scale of the affair became clear to State Secretary Snel, the cabinet endorsed its commitment to do justice to the affected parents.
Vanaf het moment dat de omvang van de affaire bij Staatssecretaris Snel duidelijk begon te worden, heeft het kabinet zijn inzet om de gedupeerde ouders recht te doen onderschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de noodremprocedure

Two CDA MPs asked the Prime Minister whether the Commission can pay out recovery funds after three months if the Council does not agree on a Dutch-raised emergency brake concern, and how the procedure works. The government confirmed the procedure, explained that the Council must reach unanimity, that the Commission can fall back on the EFC route, and that the procedure was agreed with Commission and Council presidency involvement.
The starting point is that the procedure from the moment of consultation of the EFC generally lasts no longer than three months.
Het uitgangspunt is dat de procedure vanaf het moment van raadpleging van het EFC in de regel niet langer dan drie maanden duurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de gemeenschappelijke schuld die ontstaat door het ‘herstelfonds’

An MP asks whether the Netherlands agreed to the EU borrowing of 750 billion euros for the recovery fund, whether 390 billion of it amounts to common debt repaid collectively, what Dutch interests and costs are, what happens if a member state leaves, and why the government agreed despite a Kamer motion against debt mutualisation. The minister confirms agreement, argues the conditions (conditionality, emergency brake, temporary structure) make the framework acceptable, and gives estimated additional Dutch payments of about 1 billion euro in 2028 falling to about 0.8 billion by 2058.
There is no question of taking over (mutualising) the debts of member states.
Er is geen sprake van het overnemen (mutualiseren) van schulden van lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Hijink over de keuze voor Facebook om mensen te informeren over kabinetsbesluiten

Two SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why the government chose Facebook to inform the public about cabinet decisions, noting not everyone uses it, and why Parliament was not informed first, and whether this makes Facebook the new communication policy and whether pre-Prinsjesdag documents will be leaked there. The Prime Minister answered that Facebook is one channel for reach, that the post shared no new cabinet decisions, that the same information is always available on government websites, that Parliament had already received the relevant OMT advice, and denied any change in communication policy or future leaks.
Incidentally, no new cabinet decisions were shared in the relevant post.
Overigens zijn in het betreffende bericht geen nieuwe kabinetsbesluiten gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Özütok over het bericht ‘Parlement, maak een einde aan deze uitzonderingstoestand’

Two MPs asked the government to clarify how many people gathering at 1.5 metres constitutes a breach of the emergency ordinances, and why the Prime Minister's statements on group size, and the definition of an event, seemed inconsistent with fines and enforcement practice. The minister explained the successive rules for public spaces and gatherings, said the definition of event and the distinction with gatherings is clarified in an ordinance, and noted that a bill in preparation will address gathering norms.
In general, an emergency ordinance must contain sufficiently precise provisions to be complied with and enforced.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat een noodverordening voldoende bepaalde voorschriften moet bevatten om te kunnen worden nageleefd en gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Koning ten onrechte subsidie ontvangt voor Kroondomein het Loo

An MP asked whether the Crown estate Het Loo unlawfully received a subsidy, whether the 358-day public access rule and oversight by its Raad van Beheer are adequate, and for correspondence on the estate. The minister answered that the subsidy was granted under the Kaderwet EZ-subsidies with partial analogous application of the Gelderland regulation, that no exemption was granted, that the Crown's correspondence is withheld under constitutional privacy and Crown autonomy, and that the Raad van Beheer answers to the Crown.

Correspondence between the government and the Crown estate falls, under Article 41 of the Constitution, within the Crown's freedom to arrange its household and the protection of the King's private life.
Correspondentie tussen de regering en het Kroondomein valt, gelet op artikel 41 van de Grondwet, onder de inrichtingsvrijheid en bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de Koning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de Koning ten onrechte subsidie ontvangt voor Kroondomein het Loo

An MP asked whether the King wrongly receives subsidy for the Het Loo Kroondomein, including an exemption from public access of 7,200 hectares and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed. The minister answered that the subsidy was lawfully and carefully granted under nature-management rules, with partial closure allowed for privacy, and declined to reclaim it or change the arrangement.
Correspondence between members of the Royal House and ministers about the subsidy and opening of the Kroondomein is not known to me.
Correspondentie tussen leden van het Koninklijk Huis en ministers over de subsidie en openstelling van het Kroondomein is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en de Groot over het bericht ‘Koning krijgt ten onrechte subsidie voor het Loo’

MPs Sneller and De Groot asked whether the Minister knew of reports that the King receives subsidy for Het Loo despite exemptions from subsidy conditions, why the Chamber was not informed earlier, and whether the subsidy decision would be shared and the legal procedure monitored. The Minister confirmed knowledge, said the Chamber had been informed through budget debates and a letter, shared the subsidy decision as an attachment, defended the subsidy as lawfully granted, and committed to report on the court outcome and to inform the Chamber before any new subsidy is granted.
Yes. I have included the subsidy decision as an annex to this letter.
Ja. Ik heb de subsidiebeschikking als bijlage bij deze brief opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Paleis Noordeinde deze zomer niet open voor publiek’

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked why Paleis Noordeinde and the Koninklijke Stallen cannot reopen to the public this summer like museums, suggesting ticketed time slots over more days. Prime Minister Rutte answered that access is a matter for the King under article 41 of the Constitution, weighing COVID-19 measures, and that an online alternative is being developed instead.
Access to the palaces is a matter governed by article 41 of the Constitution: the King arranges his household, taking the public interest into account.
De toegang tot de paleizen is een aangelegenheid waarvoor artikel 41 van de Grondwet geldt: de Koning richt, met inachtneming van het openbaar belang, zijn huis in.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Asscher over anderhalve meter afstand houden in het theater

An MP asked whether household members must keep 1.5 metres distance from each other in theatres, why this differs from rules in hospitality and transport, and whether the sector can be treated like hospitality. The minister answered that household members do not need to keep distance from each other, including in theatres, and referred back to that answer for the other questions.
No, this is not correct. Members of one household do not need to keep 1.5 metres distance from each other, not even in theatres or other cultural institutions.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Leden van één huishouden hoeven onderling geen 1,5 meter afstand te houden, ook niet in theaters of andere culturele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Sneller over de vergoedingen van de inrichting van de privévertrekken van paleis Huis ten Bosch

Two MPs (Kuiken, Sneller) asked the Prime Minister whether the state or the King paid for furnishing the private quarters of Huis ten Bosch, and whether the B-component of the King's allowance should be evaluated every five years as the Court of Audit recommended. The government answered that the state covers renovation and basic furnishing, the King bears extra costs beyond the standard, the B-component is adjusted through indexation, and it sees no need for new measures, while withholding details of the King's own contribution citing privacy and Article 41 of the Constitution.
On this, given Article 41 of the Constitution and for reasons of protecting personal privacy, I cannot go into further detail.
Hierop kan ik, gelet op artikel 41 Grondwet en om redenen van bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, niet nader ingaan.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Wilders over de demonstratie van afgelopen maandag

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security to send the complete app exchange between the minister and the Amsterdam mayor about a demonstration before a parliamentary debate that afternoon. The minister's response is a reference to a separate letter answering the request, with no substance in this item itself.

Will you send the complete app exchange between the Minister of Justice and Security and the Amsterdam mayor about last Monday's demonstration to the House before the plenary debate on the coronavirus developments begins at 14:00 this afternoon?

Wilt u voor het begin van het plenaire debat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus hedenmiddag 14.00 uur de complete app-wisseling tussen de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid en de burgemeester van Amsterdam inzake de demonstratie van afgelopen maandag naar de Kamer sturen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over mogelijke bezuinigingen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance Minister whether spending cuts would follow the coronavirus crisis, how large they would be, and whether they would hit public services, social schemes or businesses. The minister answered that cuts are not on the table during the crisis, that nothing can be excluded given uncertainty, and that the government will keep assessing fiscal sustainability.
It is still too early to assess how large the effect on public finances will be, and what is needed to reach sound public finances in the longer term.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen beoordelen hoe groot het effect op de overheidsfinanciën zal zijn, en wat nodig is om te komen tot gezonde overheidsfinanciën op langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de Nederlandse strategie in de bestrijding van COVID-19

MP Asscher asked the government about its COVID-19 strategy, including whether it aims for containment or mitigation, the basis for contact tracing and quarantine choices, and advice on masks. Minister De Jonge answered that the strategy aims at maximal control of the virus with two central goals, and that the government will scale up testing, tracing and monitoring, while many questions were answered by reference to earlier letters or dealt with protocols and staffing.
From the start of the outbreak, the cabinet's strategy has been aimed at maximally controlling the virus.
Vanaf het begin van de uitbraak is de strategie van het kabinet gericht op het maximaal controleren van het virus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het vergeten hoekje van Opwierde

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why residents of several streets in Appingedam's Opwierde neighbourhood still lack clarity on Groningen earthquake reinforcement, why a district-based approach was not chosen, and how compensation will be provided. The minister answered that these homes are already registered, will be assessed this year, and that the risk-based prioritisation sets their lower-risk status, while committing to continued communication and capacity expansion.
The homes in the named streets in Appingedam have already been registered and will be assessed this year so that residents of these homes also have clarity.
De woningen in de genoemde straten in Appingedam zijn reeds opgenomen en zullen dit jaar beoordeeld worden zodat ook de bewoners van deze woningen duidelijkheid hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Ojik over het terug laten keren van Nederlanders uit Marokko

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Ojik asked how many Dutch nationals remain stranded in Morocco, how many have returned, at what level the government is negotiating with Morocco, why Morocco is not allowing them to return, and whether the King should contact the Moroccan King. The minister answered that over 1000 remain registered, about 1300 have returned via four repatriation flights, and that contacts with Moroccan authorities continue at a level chosen for effectiveness, without addressing the reasons Morocco gives or the royal contact proposal.
The Dutch aim is to organise all necessary repatriation flights in the short term.
Inzet van Nederland is om op korte termijn alle benodigde repatriëringsvluchten te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Buitenweg, Van Dam en Groothuizen over de brief van the European Network of Councils for the Judiciary (ENCJ) aan de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie over recente anti-Europese wetgeving

MPs from CDA, GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about the ENCJ letter on Polish rule-of-law reforms, the Polish 'muzzle law' and the Commission's infringement actions, and whether the Netherlands should start an Article 259 TFEU procedure against Poland. The ministers expressed serious concern, noted the Court of Justice's rulings and the Commission's role, supported rule-of-law conditionality in the EU budget, but argued that a Member State-initiated Article 259 procedure is not the appropriate instrument.
The separation of powers and the independence of the judiciary are essential principles of the democratic rule of law and form the core values of the European Union.
De scheiding der machten en onafhankelijkheid van de rechterlijke macht zijn essentiële beginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat en vormen de kernwaarden van de Europese Unie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de in 2013 ingezette fraudemaatregelen door het kabinet naar aanleiding van de morele corruptie door targets bij de Belastingdienst en de relatie met de Ministeriele commissie

An SP MP asked the government how it responded to the Adviescommissie uitvoering toeslagen finding that fraud enforcement at the Belastingdienst had to pay for itself (morally corrupt), what 2013 agreements underpinned this, and whether the Ministeriële Commissie Aanpak Fraude discussed it. The state secretary agreed the financing link was undesirable, described the 2013 business case and €33 million cost-recovery agreement with compensation obligations, and said the ministerial commission addressed cross-departmental topics with cost-benefit analyses only mentioned in passing.
Ik ben het eens met dat oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over COVID-19 en de bestrijding ervan

An MP asked the health minister about COVID-19 testing capacity, the government's testing policy, the role of asymptomatic carriers, nursing-home safety, OMT advice documents and when a recovered person stops being infectious. The minister answered that capacity is sufficient under current policy, pointed to letters to parliament for the strategy, and said the questions could not be answered earlier.

Do you recall sending the 60th and 61st OMT reports to the House on Thursday? Can you send all reports/advice from the 45th to the 57th OMT to the House, along with other unnumbered reports on this subject?

Vraag 15 Herinnert u zich dat u op donderdag het 60e en 61e verslag van het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) aan de Kamer stuurde? Kunt u alle verslagen/adviezen van het 45e OMT tot en met het 57e OMT aan de Kamer doen toekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over de RIVM-presentatie over de verschillende corona-scenario’s

An MP asked the health minister when the government knew that pre-23 March measures would overshoot IC capacity, why stricter measures and household isolation came late, and why the emergency ordinances took 23 days. The minister said he was kept informed through weekly briefings, referred to a letter of 7 April for the model questions, explained household isolation was added as IC admissions rose, and attributed the delay to the need for ordinances drafted with the safety regions.
For the answers to these questions I refer you to my letter to the House of 7 April.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik u naar mijn Kamerbrief van 7 april jl.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert en Van den Berg over het Coronafonds van de Europese Commissie en over het Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI)-initiatief van de G20

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the EU coronavirus investment initiative (CRII) allocations per member state, why Poland and Hungary receive large sums while the Netherlands receives very little, and about EU vaccine production and CEPI participation. The ministers answered that the CRII redistributes remaining cohesion funds based mainly on economic prosperity and implementation progress, not on COVID-19 impact, and that the government views CEPI positively and will consider a contribution, with information to follow in the weekly Corona letter.
The size of the available CRII budget per member state is therefore independent of the scale of the COVID-19 crisis in that member state.
De omvang van het beschikbare CRII-budget per lidstaat staat dus los van de omvang van de COVID-19-crisis in de betreffende lidstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut  en Van Ojik over het staatsbezoek aan Indonesië

MPs Karabulut and Van Ojik asked for the programme of the state visit to Indonesia, whether apologies for the colonial past were on it, and why broad apologies had not been given. The minister answered that the programme was adjusted after a boat accident, listed past apologies and spijtbetuigingen by Dutch officials, and stated the King expressed regret and apologies on 10 March 2020.

On 10 March 2020, during the state visit to Indonesia, the King, following earlier statements by Dutch ministers and ambassadors, expressed regret and apologies for acts of violence by Dutch forces in the years after the proclamation.

Op 10 maart 2020 heeft de Koning tijdens het staatsbezoek aan Indonesië, in navolging van eerdere uitspraken door Nederlandse bewindspersonen en ambassadeurs, spijt en excuses uitgesproken over geweldsontsporingen van Nederlandse zijde in de jaren na de proclamatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen, Beckerman en Alkaya over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis op huishoudens

Three SP MPs asked the government how it monitors the economic effects of the coronavirus on households, and whether utilities, landlords, mortgage lenders, the Waarborgfonds and the NHG should suspend evictions, disconnections and payments. The minister answered that utilities will not disconnect for arrears, evictions are postponed during the crisis by agreement with landlords, existing income and rent support measures are pointed to, and emergency support for homeless people is being arranged with municipalities.
Landlords have agreed as a common line that evictions will be postponed for the time being during the crisis period, unless there are evident reasons such as criminal activity or extreme nuisance.

Er is met de verhuurders als gezamenlijke lijn afgesproken dat huisuitzettingen voorlopig worden uitgesteld gedurende de crisisperiode, tenzij er evidente redenen zijn, zoals criminele activiteiten of extreme overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Den Boer over de gevolgen van het Corona-virus voor de rechtspleging en de rechtsbescherming

MPs Groothuizen and Den Boer asked how the Corona crisis affects criminal justice and legal protection, including the Public Prosecution Service's restricted approach, the Emergency Justice Act (Noodwet rechtspleging) and suspended community service sentences. Minister Grapperhaus answered that police, prosecutors, probation and courts have scaled back work to priority tasks, that remote legal aid is being organised and extra fees given, that the emergency act is not yet needed but would be decided via the Ministerial Crisis Committee, and that community service terms cannot currently be extended by law.
Applying the Emergency Justice Act is, given the exceptional measures it provides, not an instrument to be used lightly.
Het toepassen van de Noodwet rechtspleging is, mede gelet op de bijzondere voorzieningen die deze wet biedt, geen lichtzinnig in te zetten instrument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de capaciteit van IC-units en beademingsapparaten in Nederland i.v.m. de Corona-pandemie

An MP from the PVV asked the Prime Minister and the Health Minister how many COVID-19 patients were in Dutch intensive care, the projected growth, current IC and ventilator capacity, and what would be done to keep care available. The minister referred to the NVIC website for patient numbers and to earlier letters for capacity measures, gave no concrete figures or projections, and did not answer on the Friday deadline.
To keep everyone well informed about the number of COVID-19 patients in intensive care, the Dutch Association of Intensive Care (NVIC) updates the number daily on its website.

Antwoord 1, 2 Om iedereen blijvend goed te informeren over het aantal COVID-19-patiënten dat op de IC ligt, houdt de Nederlandse Vereniging van Intensive Care (NVIC) dagelijks op haar website ( www.nvic.nl ) bij om hoeveel patiënten dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Beckerman en Van Nispen over huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis

SP MPs asked why eviction summary proceedings are treated as urgent or postponed during the coronavirus crisis, whether evictions should be halted, and whether a law banning evictions is needed. The minister answers that eviction cases are postponed except in exceptional superspoed cases, that landlord associations agreed to avoid evictions during the crisis, and that the government will use emergency legislation to extend temporary leases.
Eviction cases have not been classified as urgent by the judiciary, so for now no oral hearings take place unless the judge in summary proceedings decides a hearing must go ahead.

Huisuitzettingen zijn door de rechtspraak niet aangemerkt als urgente zaken en voorlopig vinden er daarom geen mondelinge behandelingen plaats, tenzij de rechter in kort geding oordeelt dat een zitting moet doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over offensieve inzet van Afghaanse agenten in de periode 2011-2013

An SP MP asks the Prime Minister and the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether the Chamber was misled about offensive deployment of Dutch-trained Afghan police in Kunduz (2011-2013), as a post-mission assessment suggests, and why the final evaluation did not report it. The minister replies that the government had always said it could not fully exclude incidental involvement of Afghan police in operations against the Taliban, that structural offensive use was not seen, and that the Chamber was informed of placement problems in 2012-2013.
The government could not and cannot fully exclude that incidentally Afghan civilian police could have been involved in military operations in Kunduz against the Taliban.
De regering kon en kan echter niet volledig uitsluiten dat incidenteel Afghaanse civiele agenten betrokken konden worden bij militaire operaties in Kunduz tegen de Taliban.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Sneller over de mogelijke schikking met Shell

MPs Groothuizen and Sneller asked whether the Justice Minister discussed a possible settlement with Shell over the Etosha bribery investigation in Nigeria with prosecutors, whether ministry officials pushed for a settlement, why the Royal Household inquired about the case in 2016, and how the Prime Minister assesses Shell's conduct. The Minister answered that he was only informed of the investigation's status, denied requesting or pushing for a settlement, said the 2016 inquiry concerned a planned royal visit and media attention, and declined to comment on an ongoing criminal case.
Has the Minister asked the Public Prosecution Service to reach a settlement with Shell? If so, why did you do that and when did you do it?
Heeft de Minister het OM gevraagd een schikking te treffen met Shell? Zo ja, waarom heeft u dat gedaan en wanneer heeft u dat gedaan?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over miljonairs tegen belastingontwijking en voor hogere belastingen

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about a petition by wealthy individuals calling for higher taxes on the very rich and action against tax avoidance, and whether the cabinet supports it. The government answered that it combats tax avoidance as a priority and taxes high incomes more heavily, but sees no need for further tax increases on the very rich in the Dutch context, and gave detailed answers on tax avoidance, wealth inequality and box 2.
The cabinet considers it important that everyone in the Netherlands benefits from economic growth.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat iedereen in Nederland profiteert van de economische groei.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over burgerslachtoffers door Nederlands optreden in de strijd tegen Islamitische Staat

MP Karabulut asked the Prime Minister and the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about civilian casualties from the Dutch bombing at Hawija in June 2015, including when officials were informed, whether information was withheld from parliament, and compensation. The government answers that the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister were informed only in general terms about secondary explosions and possible civilian harm without figures, that an ICRC list was not shared with parliament, that the OM investigation documents cannot be made public, and that compensation options and a progress letter are still being studied.
It was standing policy that for operational reasons and domestic security no statements were made about specific cases.
Het was staand beleid dat om operationele redenen en omwille van de binnenlandse veiligheid geen uitspraken werden gedaan over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over zijn “ideeën” over Schengen en de herinvoering van grenscontroles

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister when Schengen's open borders become untenable, what alternatives he has in mind, what he discussed with Macron, and whether withholding these ideas undermines parliamentary control. The government replied that border controls are an ultimate measure not currently applicable, stressed strengthening external border protection and the common asylum system, said talks with France concern GEAS reform, and stated that parliament is informed via the annotated agenda and BNC-fiches.

As with all other European topics, your House is always informed in advance of Council meetings, in accordance with the applicable procedural agreements, about the intended cabinet position via the annotated agenda.

Net als voor alle andere Europese onderwerpen wordt uw Kamer, conform de geldende procedureafspraken, altijd voorafgaand aan bijeenkomsten in Raadskader geïnformeerd over het voorgenomen kabinetsstandpunt via de geannoteerde agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het onjuist informeren van de Kamer over een historische kunstverkoop door het Koninklijk Huis

MP Van Raak asked the Prime Minister why the Chamber was misinformed about the sale of the Munnicks van Cleeff atlas from Princess Juliana's estate, including the claimed binding condition that it remain in the Netherlands, whether it can be resold and split, and whether Utrecht institutions were offered it. The government answered that privacy and constitutional protections prevent full disclosure of the estate settlement, that the earlier information was accurate, that private agreements are legally relevant but the atlas's stay in the Netherlands is expected, and that the Utrecht exploration found no funds.

The general laws and rules protecting personal privacy, as guaranteed in the Constitution, the GDPR and other provisions, prevent a full account of the concrete settlement of the estate among the private heirs and other parties.

De algemene, voor alle Nederlanders geldende wet- en regelgeving ten behoeve van de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer, zoals gewaarborgd in de Grondwet, de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG), de uitvoeringregelgeving van de Grondwet en deze verordening alsmede andere bepalingen van de Grondwet, waaronder artikel 1 van de Grondwet, en wetgeving, staan er aan in de weg volledig in te gaan op de concrete afwikkeling van de nalatenschap tussen de verschillende particuliere erfgenamen en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller, Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht 'Rutte informeert Tweede Kamer onjuist over kunstverkoop Oranjes'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister about reports that the Munnicks van Cleeff atlas, a Raden Saleh painting and other art from Princess Juliana's estate were sold or kept out of museums against advice, and about the handling of the estate and the tax-credit scheme. The government answered that legal constraints on privacy and tax confidentiality limit disclosure of the estate settlement, that the atlas sale was not subject to a binding guarantee of staying in the Netherlands, and that the policy on displaying art acquired via the scheme is not legally binding but policy-based, with a commitment to follow the advisory committee's report.
As I noted in answer to question 2, various statutory provisions prevent a full account of the concrete settlement of the estate among the various private heirs and other parties.

Zoals ik in antwoord op vraag 2 heb opgemerkt staan verschillende wettelijke voorschriften er aan in de weg volledig in te gaan op de concrete afwikkeling van de nalatenschap tussen de verschillende particuliere erfgenamen en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Omtzigt, Kuiken en Verhoeven over de paspoorthandel van Malta en de betrokkenheid van een professor van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs asked the government about Malta's citizenship-by-investment scheme, the listed buyers of Maltese passports, the AIVD warning, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and a Groningen professor's links to a passport firm. The minister answered that the Maltese list covers all naturalisations, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes and the government will seek dialogue, that the Prime Minister raised rule-of-law concerns with his Maltese counterpart, and that the university is examining the professor's activities.
The cabinet considers the sale of passports to non-EU citizens who are suspected of crimes to be undesirable.
Het kabinet acht de verkoop van paspoorten aan niet-EU burgers, die onder verdenking staan van misdrijven, ongewenst.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aankondiging van de premier van Albanië, Edi Rama, dat hij paspoorten gaat verkopen aan rijke mensen van buiten de Europese Unie (die nu recht geven op reizen in het Schenge

Omtzigt asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about Albanian PM Rama's announced sale of passports to non-EU wealthy buyers, including tax concessions, and whether visa-free travel for Albanians should be suspended via the emergency brake. Minister Blok answered that the proposal was halted after Commission criticism, that Albania is sovereign over its tax and citizenship rules, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes, and that he sees no grounds to renew the emergency-brake request.
What he literally said in London is not known to the Cabinet.
Wat hij letterlijk in Londen heeft gezegd is het Kabinet niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de OPCW Douma-documenten op Wikileaks

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister whether leaked OPCW Douma documents were authentic, whether the final Douma report was sound, and whether an inquiry into its preparation was warranted. The minister replied that the OPCW has launched an independent investigation into the leaks, that he sees no reason to doubt the report's process or conclusions, and that no separate inquiry is needed.
No. As I indicated above, I find the OPCW's explanation convincing and appreciate the organisation's own handling of this matter.
Nee. Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven, vind ik de uitleg van de OPCW overtuigend en apprecieer ik de aanpak van deze kwestie door de organisatie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de kritiek van NGO’s op de concept-duurzaamheids-impactanalyse van het EU-Mercosur-verdrag en de status van het akkoord

An MP asked the government about NGO criticism of the draft sustainability impact assessment of the EU-Mercosur agreement, including its timing, data gaps on Brazilian deforestation and CO2, the mixed-competence status of the deal, and animal welfare conditions. The minister answered that the draft SIA is not final, the final version is expected mid-2020, a separate impact study on Dutch agriculture will be carried out, and the government will assess the deal before the Council decides.

The cabinet will, in accordance with the Voordewind et al. motion referring to the Koopmans/Snijder-Hazelhoff motion, commission a study into the impact of the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement on the Dutch economy, in particular Dutch agriculture and horticulture.

Het kabinet zal conform de motie Voordewind c.s. waarin verwezen wordt naar de motie Koopmans/Snijder-Hazelhoff een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de impact van het EU-Mercosur Associatieverdrag op de Nederlandse economie, in het bijzonder de Nederlandse land- en tuinbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over de uitspraak van minister-president na afloop van de ministerraad op 29 november 2019 ‘de treinen rijden op steenkool, en ik ga dan vliegen’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked about the Prime Minister's remark that trains run on coal while he flies, and whether the claim is accurate, plus the energy mix on the Den Haag–Madrid route and European high-speed rail coordination. The minister answered with 2017 Eurostat energy-mix figures for Belgium, France and Spain, said Dutch trains run on wind power, admitted other countries' electricity may partly be coal-based, and pledged to push international rail on the EU agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Diertens en Paternotte over het racisme tijdens de voetbalwedstrijd FC Den Bosch – Excelsior

MPs Diertens and Paternotte asked the ministers about racist abuse of Excelsior player Ahmad Mendes Moreira at the FC Den Bosch match, the club's initial reaction, the extent of racism in sport, existing policy, sanction powers of the KNVB and clubs, and related matters. Minister Bruins answered that the abuse was unacceptable, described the monitoring figures and existing programmes, and promised to report on a joint action plan after 31 January.
At the end of January I will come together with my colleagues of J&V and SZW and the KNVB with an action plan to better combat racism and discrimination in sport.
Eind januari kom ik samen met mijn ambtsgenoten van J&V en SZW en de KNVB met een aanvalsplan om racisme en discriminatie in de sport nog beter te bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Zeker drie EU-lidstaten gaan Syriëgangers uit eigen lang terughalen’?

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether reports that Belgium, Germany and France would repatriate IS detainees from Syria were true, how the government cooperates with allies and the US, and whether Iraq would prosecute European fighters. The minister denied the repatriation reports, described existing measures against returning fighters, and said talks with Iraq continue on prosecution under conditions excluding the death penalty.
No. This reporting turned out to be incorrect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de aanwezigheid van informatie op ministeries over de burgerdoden bij het Nederlandse bombardement op Hawija

MP Diks asked ministers whether ministries had been informed about the outcome of the CENTCOM investigation into civilian deaths at Hawija and whether the Defence Minister misinformed parliament in 2015. The government answers that ministries received only general, non-numerical information in 2015 meetings, the initial CENTCOM report was not shared with other departments, and the 2015 statements to parliament were found to be incorrect.
The initial CENTCOM report as such was never provided to other departments, in line with standing practice.
Het initiële CENTCOM-rapport als zodanig is nooit verstrekt aan andere departementen, conform staande praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de besluitvorming over geheimhouding burgerslachtoffers in Irak in 2015

The MPs asked how and when ministers were informed of civilian casualties in the 2015 Dutch air operation at Hawija, Iraq, whether the matter was discussed in ministerial sub-councils, and whether the Prime Minister was involved in keeping it secret. The Defence Minister answered that ministers were briefed in June 2015 on the basis of the After Action Report, that civilian casualties remain unconfirmed, that no decision to keep the facts secret was ever taken, and that the matter was not specifically discussed in the relevant sub-councils.
No, such a decision has never been taken.
Nee, van een dergelijke beslissing is nooit sprake geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over financiële overschotten op de Najaarsnota

Two PvdA MPs asked why a fiscal surplus of nearly 14 billion euros in mid-2019 coexists with shortages in police, healthcare and education, and whether part of it will be spent on those sectors or underspending moved to later years. The Finance Minister replied that the 2019 surplus is largely incidental, that the government has added billions structurally to these sectors, that some underspending will go to priorities such as education and undermining crime, and that underspent investment budgets were shifted to 2022-2024 via a ceiling correction.
The cabinet has now decided to spend part of the 2019 underspending on social priorities such as education, undermining crime, the nitrogen problem, legal aid, and safety and protection.

Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om een deel van de onderuitputting van 2019 uit te geven aan maatschappelijke prioriteiten als onderwijs, ondermijning, de stikstofproblematiek, de rechtsbijstand en veiligheid en beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over de uitspraken van mevrouw Lagarde, toekomstig president van de Europese Centrale Bank (ECB), en de noodzaak voor een review van het ECB beleid

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked the government about Christine Lagarde's remarks favouring jobs and growth over savers, and whether the ECB's monetary policy should be reviewed as parliament had requested. The minister answered that the ECB's independence limits government comment, that the government supports periodic reviews in general, and that the minister-president would convey parliament's view when the opportunity arises.
Given the independence of the ECB, the cabinet does not express a view on the necessity or desirability of a review.
Gezien de onafhankelijkheid van de ECB spreekt het kabinet zich niet uit over de noodzaak of wenselijkheid van een review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de greep in de ABP-kas

An MP asked whether the government's past premium reductions for the ABP pension fund, which allegedly cost pensioners over 30 billion guilders, were a political misstep warranting compensation. The Minister of the Interior replied that the cuts followed the rules of the time, the fund has been independent since 1996, and no compensation is warranted.
Contrary to what you state, in my view there is no question of a political misconduct.
Anders dan u stelt is er naar mijn overtuiging geen sprake van een politieke misstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het Brexit-ultimatum van de Franse president Macron en de Finse minister-president Rinne

MP Leijten asked whether the Brexit deadline set by Macron and Rinne reflected an EU Council position, whether such unilateral ultimatums help an orderly Brexit, and when the government was informed. The minister answered that the government does not recognise the media's 'ultimatum' framing, that no official French or EU deadline beyond 31 October 2019 was set, and that the UK was urged to present realistic proposals quickly.
The cabinet does not recognise the media reporting of 18 September about an 'ultimatum' and the alleged breaking of EU27 unity.
Het kabinet herkent zich niet in de mediaberichtgeving op 18 september over een «ultimatum» en het vermeende doorbreken van de eenheid van de EU27.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over de Amazonebranden en de westerse verantwoordelijkheid bij de branden

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the government whether Amazon fires are human-caused, whether the EU-Mercosur trade deal incentivises deforestation, and whether Dutch firms and trade partners should face sanctions or procurement exclusion. The minister replied that the fires are likely set deliberately, pointed to Brazil's primary responsibility, promised diplomatic pressure within the EU-Mercosur process, and said the Dutch government does not support the soy corridor while the procurement exclusion of named firms is not legally straightforward, so it will only explore aligning procurement with OECD guidelines.
Excluding parties from public procurement is not straightforwardly legally possible.
Het uitsluiten van partijen van overheidsaanbestedingen is niet zonder meer juridisch mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Karabulut, Voordewind, Van Helvert, Van der Staaij en Van Ojik over het bezoek van premier Rutte aan Indonesië

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the topics of Rutte's visit to Indonesia, including the military crackdown in Papua, and whether the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights would be invited to Papua. The government answered that human rights and Papua were discussed, that the Netherlands urged a prompt UN visit, and that the visit is now up to the UN and Indonesian authorities to arrange.
The aim of this conversation was to stress that dialogue and restraint are important to reach a lasting solution.
De inzet van dit gesprek was te benadrukken dat dialoog en terughoudendheid belangrijk zijn om tot een duurzame oplossing te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het betalen door de regering voor het werk van koningin Máxima als speciaal pleitbezorger namens de Verenigde Naties

An MP asked the government whether it pays about 150,000 euros a year for Queen Máxima's UN work as Special Advocate, and whether further royal costs sit outside the Crown budget. The government confirmed the roughly 150,000 euros annual average from the 'special multilateral activities' budget of Foreign Trade and Development, said some staff costs are not separately identified, and admitted its 2014 statement had wrongly implied only the Kroondomein subsidy fell outside the Crown budget.
During Queen Máxima's visits as UNSGSA, support is provided by local UN offices and logistical support by staff of the Dutch diplomatic missions.

Tijdens de bezoeken van Koningin Máxima als UNSGSA wordt ondersteuning verleend vanuit lokale kantoren van de VN en (logistieke) ondersteuning door medewerkers van de Nederlandse diplomatieke vertegenwoordigingen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Leijten over het Brexit-ultimatum van de Franse president en de Finse minister-president. D

An MP asks the government about the reported Brexit ultimatum by Macron and Rinne to the UK, whether it was agreed with the EU, and how it fits with the Dutch aim of avoiding no-deal. The minister replies that no EU deadline beyond 31 October exists, that the UK must present concrete proposals in time, and that the Netherlands still prefers an orderly withdrawal.
Neither the European Council (Article 50) nor the European Commission has adopted an EU position on a deadline other than 31 October.
Er is noch door de ER Artikel 50, noch door de Europese Commissie een EU-standpunt over een deadline ingenomen, anders dan die van 31 oktober
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de VS Nederland zou willen helpen Syriëgangers terug te halen

An MP asked the government whether the US offered to help repatriate Dutch Syria travellers and why the Netherlands does not actively retrieve them. The ministers confirmed a US offer (including help with transport of 10 Dutch women and children) but said the Netherlands did not accept it, citing remaining risks and existing policy.
The Netherlands has not accepted the offer.
Nederland heeft het aanbod niet aanvaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het opnieuw lekken van een Prinsjesdagplan

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would send the leaked Prinsjesdag plan on the health insurance premium to parliament, not only to the press, and do so before 6 September. The Prime Minister declined to send the plan early, saying the government will share its Prinsjesdag plans with parliament at the designated moments, during the budget debates and related bills.
The cabinet's Prinsjesdag plans are shared with your House at the designated moments.
De plannen van dit kabinet voor Prinsjesdag worden op de daarvoor aangewezen momenten met uw Kamer gedeeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het opnieuw lekken van een Prinsjesdagplan

The SP MP Van Raak asked the Prime Minister to send the Prinsjesdag housing policy plan, leaked to the press, to parliament before 6 September 2019. The Prime Minister declined to send the plan early, stating it will be shared at the proper moments during the budget debates and related legislative procedures.
The cabinet's Prinsjesdag plans will be shared with your House at the designated moments.
De plannen van dit kabinet voor Prinsjesdag worden op de daarvoor aangewezen momenten met uw Kamer gedeeld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Van Otterloo, Van Brenk en Sazias over "de Augustusraming van het CPB"

Four 50PLUS MPs asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister why the CPB's August forecast cut pensioners' purchasing-power gains sharply, whether pension cuts were included, why the share of households gaining or losing was dropped from the table, and the size of interest-rate windfalls. The Minister answered that the changes stem from updated inflation and interest-rate assumptions, that the presentation was changed to avoid misreading, and that interest windfalls feed into the budget decision on Budget Day.
The percentage of households with a positive or negative purchasing-power development has been removed from the boxplot.
Het percentage huishoudens met een positieve of negatieve koopkrachtontwikkeling is geschrapt uit de boxplot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over het  bericht “Deportaties in Turkije: ‘Ze hebben hem  naar Syrië gestuurd’”

MP Groothuizen (D66) asked the government about reports that Turkey deported Syrian refugees to Syria, a country not considered safe, and about the implications for the EU-Turkey agreement and for Greek arrivals. The State Secretary answered that Turkey claims returns are voluntary, that about 340,000 Syrians have returned, that international partners could not confirm structural forced returns though a few individual cases suggest involuntary returns, and that no direct link to Greek arrivals can be concluded.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the developments.
Nederland blijft de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de "gevolgen van een langdurig lage en/of negatieve rente voor Nederlandse pensioenfondsen"

An MP asked the ministers about the effects of prolonged low and negative interest rates on Dutch pension funds, including the cost of pension payouts, the role of ECB policy, and whether scenario studies exist. The ministers answered that low rates are largely structural, that ECB policy contributes but its impact is hard to quantify, and that scenario analysis and further study will be addressed in a later letter on the pension accord roadmap.
I am willing to comply with that request.
Ik ben bereid om aan dat verzoek te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Slootweg over berichten dat de Europese Commissie voorstellen zal doen om het Stabiliteits-en Groeipact (SGP) aan te passen

MPs Omtzigt and Slootweg asked whether the government had seen Commission plans to loosen the Stability and Growth Pact, whether any loosening had been proposed, and what position the Netherlands takes. Minister Hoekstra answered that no proposal had been made, that the Netherlands wants the pact reformed for stricter enforcement and less flexibility, and that it opposes loosening.
No. No proposal has been made to amend the European budget rules.
Nee. Er is geen voorstel gedaan om de Europese begrotingsregels aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de kandidatuur van oud-minister Dijsselbloem als directeur van het IMF

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister how the cabinet chose and backed former minister Dijsselbloem as IMF managing director candidate, including the selection process, lobbying, MPs' contact and the cost of his travel. The minister answered that the decision was made in July, the process was intensive but confidential so no full overview is given, and the candidacy was not publicly discussed to protect its chances.
Given the number of conversations and their confidential nature, no overview can be provided of the conversations that took place.
Gezien het aantal gesprekken en het vertrouwelijke karakter kan geen overzicht geven worden van de gesprekken die hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Van Raak over  het  lekken van de plannen voor Prinsjesdag (eerste set vragen)

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister why the cabinet's Prinsjesdag budget plans were leaked to a newspaper before being shared with parliament, and whether the plans would be sent to the Chamber. The Prime Minister replied that he values adequate information for parliament, that deliberations are ongoing, and that the plans will be shared at the designated moments before the budget debates.
The cabinet's plans for Prinsjesdag will be shared with your Chamber at the designated moments so they can be discussed during the general political and financial deliberations.
De plannen van dit kabinet voor Prinsjesdag worden op de daarvoor aangewezen momenten met uw Kamer gedeeld zodat het besproken kan worden tijdens de algemene politieke beschouwingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het lekken van de plannen voor Prinsjesdag (derde set vragen)

MP Van Raak (SP) asked Prime Minister Rutte whether leaked proposals on the transfer tax (overdrachtsbelasting) would be sent to parliament and whether answers to the leak questions would be shared today. Rutte replied that the budget decision-making is not finished, that he values adequate information to parliament, and that the plans will be shared at the designated moments during the budget debates.
The decision-making process on this is not yet completed.
Het besluitvormingsproces hierover is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Van Raak over het opnieuw lekken van de plannen voor Prinsjesdag (tweede set vragen)

An MP asked the Prime Minister to send the detailed Prinsjesdag plans on tax cuts, corporate tax and housing investment to parliament, and whether leaked figures were correct. The Prime Minister stressed the importance of information to parliament but said the decision process was ongoing and the plans would be shared at the designated moments during the budget debates.
The decision-making process on this is not yet complete.
Het besluitvormingsproces hierover is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bezoek van de Minister-President aan de Verenigde Staten en de hoogopgelopen spanningen tussen de Verenigde Staten en Iran

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would raise concerns about rising US-Iran tensions during his visit to the United States, what topics would be discussed, whether the Netherlands would warn against war, and whether it would seek de-escalation via international channels. The government answered that the Prime Minister spoke with President Trump on 18 July, discussed bilateral relations, trade, defence and Iran including a US request on the Strait of Hormuz, and that the Netherlands calls for de-escalation and supports EU diplomatic efforts while urging Iran to respect the nuclear deal.
The Netherlands regularly calls on all parties involved, both bilaterally and multilaterally, to de-escalate tensions in the Gulf and around the nuclear agreement.
Nederland roept met regelmaat alle betrokken partijen, zowel in bilaterale als in multilaterale gelegenheden, op tot de-escalatie van spanningen in de Golf en rond het nucleaire akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over Nederlandse burgers die de dupe zijn van Amerikaanse regelgeving

D66 MPs Van Weyenberg and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government would press the US for a solution for Dutch citizens who are also US citizens ('Accidental Americans') harmed by FATCA, including whether banks may refuse basic payment accounts when no US SSN is held, and whether a coordinated European approach would be pursued. State Secretary Snel answered that the issue is high on the government's agenda, that a missing US TIN/SSN is not a valid ground to refuse a basic payment account, and that Netherlands is seeking a coordinated European action, with a follow-up letter promised after the summer.
The cabinet will continue to work on behalf of this group of people.
Het kabinet zal zich blijven inzetten voor deze groep mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over Pakistan

An MP asked whether the government would respond to a reported video showing images of Geert Wilders with 'dead/murdered' text being walked and spat on in Pakistan, and whether it finds this acceptable. The Minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the video dates from August 2018 and that he discussed Pakistan's reactions and the government's concerns about threats with his Pakistani counterpart in 2018.
I held talks in August and September 2018 with my Pakistani counterpart, Foreign Minister Qureshi, about Pakistan's reactions to this and the cabinet's concerns about the threats.

Ik heb in augustus en september 2018 gesprekken gevoerd met mijn Pakistaanse ambtgenoot, Minister Qureshi van Buitenlandse Zaken, over de reacties van Pakistan hierop en de zorgen van het kabinet over de bedreigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Moorlag over de kabinetsplannen over het klimaatbeleid

PvdA MPs Asscher and Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that a draft CO2 levy would largely exempt industry, whether industry would receive the revenue back, and related questions on the Climate Agreement, household energy burdens and planning bureau analyses. The minister answered that the levy is still being explored and that industry revenue will be used to green industry, but refused to send the internal draft note to parliament and gave only general responses on the other points.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het ‘wobben’ van SMS-verkeer met de CEO van Unilever in verband met de dividendbelasting

The MP asks whether the Prime Minister will provide SMS traffic with the Unilever CEO about abolishing dividend tax under the Wob, and whether that data was destroyed. The Prime Minister states the SMS was not retained, that it predates the Raad van State ruling, and that the communication was handled by SMS and phone.
The SMS message to which the Wob request relates was not retained.
Het SMS bericht waarop het WOB verzoek betrekking heeft is niet bewaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het kweken van medicinale wiet in het Westland

MP Bergkamp (D66) asked about cannabis cultivation for medical use in Westland and why growers cannot export more freely, including whether the government would allow multiple producers. The minister replied that the single-buyer bureau (BMC) model follows the 1961 UN convention, export is capped at 100 kg per country per year, and a second grower may be contracted via European tender.
With the Bureau medicinale cannabis (BMC), the Netherlands complies with this convention.
Met het Bureau medicinale cannabis (BMC) houdt Nederland zich aan dit verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Raan over het openbreken van de associatieovereenkomst met Oekraïne en het vervolgens fors verhogen van de importquota voor Oekraïens kippenvlees

MPs Ouwehand and Van Raan asked whether the EU-Ukraine association agreement quota for Ukrainian chicken meat was tripled through a loophole, which Dutch and other EU processors may have facilitated, and whether the government would act to stop it. The minister confirmed the loophole and a proposed quota increase, said the government will decide its position after reviewing the Commission proposal, and gave limited answers on the named companies and the EBRD loan, pointing to other bodies.
The cabinet will study the European Commission's proposal after publication and on that basis take a definitive position.
Het kabinet zal het voorstel van de Europese Commissie, na publicatie, bestuderen en op basis hiervan een definitief standpunt innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Helvert, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de samenwerking met Armenië

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about cooperation with Armenia, including whether an embassy in Yerevan would be opened and when the EU-Armenia partnership agreement bill would reach parliament. The minister answered that opening an embassy is not currently on the agenda due to limited postal network funds, that the bill's explanatory memorandum will go to the Council of State in the first half of the year, and that Armenia is covered by the Georgia embassy.
The explanatory memorandum will be submitted to the Council of State in the first half of this year.
De MvT zal in de eerste helft van dit jaar aan de Raad van State worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over de doorrekeningen van het Klimaatakkoord

The MP asks why the PBL climate-agreement calculations use a 3% social discount rate, versus about 1.5% for pension funds, and whether climate investments are less diversified and riskier. The minister confirms the 3% social discount rate follows the government's MKBA guidance, explains it reflects a risk premium for public investment, and says pension funds use a different discount rate for valuing liabilities.
The use of the discount rate therefore gives insight into whether a public investment is sufficiently worthwhile from a societal point of view.
Het gebruik van de discontovoet geeft dus inzicht in de vraag of een publieke investering vanuit een maatschappelijk oogpunt voldoende loont.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over Brexit, veterinaire keurpunten en levende dieren

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked the government about Brexit no-deal preparedness, the lack of veterinary inspection posts on the north bank of the Nieuwe Waterweg, and the handling of live animals and products. Minister Schouten answered that NVWA preparations are on track but disruptions are not excluded, that inspection post applications are pending with the European Commission, and that temporary alternatives such as transport to southern inspection posts are being explored.
I am awaiting the definitive response of the European Commission.
Ik ben in afwachting van de definitieve reactie van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Maeijer over de juridische werking van het Migratiepact van Marrakesh

PVV MPs asked the government to confirm the authenticity of a leaked European Commission legal note suggesting the UN Global Compact for Migration could have binding effects via EU law, and asked why ministers had said the Compact was not legally binding. The government answered that the Commission described the note as an unofficial document by an individual staff member, that the Compact remains legally non-binding and creates no enforceable rights, and that the earlier legal analysis stands.
The fact remains that the Compact is a legally non-binding document and does not generate enforceable rights.
Feit blijft dat het Compact een juridisch niet-bindend document is en geen afdwingbare rechten genereert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de schriftelijke toelichting van de Europese Commissie op het SGP-besluit Italië van december 2018

MP Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister whether the government would press the European Commission to publish its explanatory note on the Italian budget and to put SGP non-compliance on the European Council agenda, and asked about banking union and pension risks. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government shares the view that Italy does not comply with the SGP, that it has repeatedly raised the issue with the Commission and the Eurogroup, and that the Commission has not yet published the note, which was made available to the Chamber confidentially.
The European Commission has so far not proceeded to publish the note.
De Europese Commissie is tot nu toe niet overgegaan tot publicatie van de nota.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het loskoppelen van het burgerrechtengedeelte in het Brexit-uittredingsverdrag

Verhoeven (D66) asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister whether the government supports decoupling the Brexit citizens' rights chapter so it applies in all cases, including no deal, and whether dual nationality should be allowed for affected Dutch citizens in the UK. Minister Blok replied that the UK is responsible for protecting citizens' rights in a no-deal scenario, that the government will keep pressing the UK, and that it will not pursue a 'mini-deal' or broader dual nationality, preferring ratification of the withdrawal agreement.
The cabinet maintains that the EU and the European Council on its behalf must keep fully committed to ratification of the withdrawal agreement.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de EU en de Europese Raad namens haar zich vol moeten blijven inzetten voor ratificatie van het terugtrekkingsakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over toeristische bedrijven die verdienen aan illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An MP asked the government whether it condemns online booking firms such as Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia and TripAdvisor for offering accommodation in Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory, and whether it would discourage such trade and ban settlement goods. The ministers answered that companies are responsible for their own human rights due diligence, that the government does not support import bans on settlement goods, and that it discourages economic ties with settlement businesses while Booking.com has agreed to label settlement listings.
The cabinet, in line with the EU, is not in favour of an import ban on goods from settlements or measures leading to a boycott of these goods.
Het kabinet is, in lijn met de EU, geen voorstander van een importverbod van goederen uit nederzettingen of maatregelen die leiden tot een boycot van deze goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

An MP asked the government whether it would promote the Week without Meat, make ministry dinners meat-optional, state its role in the initiative, and act on external costs of meat consumption. The government answered via the Agriculture minister, referring to an earlier answer in the Handelingen appendix, so the substance of the response is not in this text.
have been answered by means of the Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896
zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1896
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Van den Hul, Krol en Özütok over de Nederlandse versie van de Nashville-verklaring

MPs from several parties asked the government about the Dutch version of the Nashville Statement, its signing by a military chaplain and MPs, the Vrije Universiteit's response, effects on LGBTI youth, and biblical passages. The minister distanced the government from the statement, said courts and prosecutors will decide on complaints, and declined to comment on biblical interpretation or engage signatories.
As long as these matters are under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service and/or the court, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to make statements about them.
Zolang deze zaken ter beoordeling liggen bij het OM en/of de rechter ligt het niet in de rede dat het kabinet daarover uitspraken doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Sneller over het bericht dat koningin Maxima in Argentinië de belasting zou hebben ontdoken

MPs Kuiken and Sneller asked the Prime Minister whether Queen Máxima underpaid tax in Argentina by understating the value of real estate, and whether royals have an exemplary role. Prime Minister Rutte answered that such investments fall within the private sphere protected by articles 10 and 41 of the Constitution, that the public interest is not affected where laws are followed, and gave no substantive confirmation or denial.
This advice clarifies concretely, among other things, that investments in real estate abroad belong to the private sphere and that reporting on them does not in itself detract from that.

Deze voorlichting maakt in concrete zin onder meer duidelijk dat investeringen in onroerend goed in het buitenland behoren tot de persoonlijke levenssfeer en dat berichtgeving hierover daaraan op zichzelf niet afdoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Oranjes verkochten in stilte kunst aan Rijk’

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked whether the state bought royal art and heritage objects since the 1980s, whether a list of purchases can be published, and why public access is limited. The minister answered that only palace-bound inventory was bought and placed with the Royal Household, that private owners decide on disclosure and sales, and that some palaces are partly open to the public.
Regarding openness and transparency for art held in private ownership, I note that it is up to the private owner to decide whether and how insight is given.
Wat betreft openbaarheid en transparantie bij kunstbezit in privé eigendom merk ik op dat het aan de particuliere eigenaar is om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, inzicht wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Oranjes verkochten in stilte kunst aan Rijk’

Two D66 MPs asked whether a Rubens drawing and other artworks sold by princess Christina at Sotheby's had ever belonged to a Orange foundation, and if so how they moved to private ownership. The minister answered simply that they had not.
No, that is not the case.
Nee, dat is niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de Nederlandse zuinigheid tegenover de Franse spilzucht

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the Dutch versus French fiscal stance, including whether the Netherlands would reward citizens with a comparable gesture to France's 10 billion euro concessions to yellow-vest protesters. The Finance Minister replied that the Dutch and French contexts are not directly comparable, that the government is pursuing tax cuts and higher public spending, and that EU fiscal rules favour building buffers in good economic times.
The Dutch and French contexts are not directly comparable, so it is not possible to attach an amount for the Netherlands.
De Nederlandse en Franse context zijn niet direct te vergelijken, waardoor het niet mogelijk is hieraan een bedrag te koppelen voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het artikel ‘A less political European Commission is needed’

An MP asks the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister how a less political European Commission can have more real authority, why the Spitzenkandidaten process is compared to a coup, whether the European Council bypassing the election outcome violates Article 17(7) TEU, and how the government will act on the views in the minister's Financial Times op-ed. The minister answers that a stronger but objective Commission is needed to enforce agreed rules, that the Spitzenkandidaten procedure is not in the treaty while Article 17(7) requires taking account of the election results, and that the government will set out its position in the State of the Union debate.
Article 17(7) of the EU treaty is clear about the procedure to follow in electing the President of the European Commission.
Artikel 17 (7) van het EU-verdrag is helder over de te volgen procedure bij de verkiezing van de voorzitter van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak van de premier dat de Europese Commissie niet voldoende optreedt tegen Italië

Rep.
