Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister to explain his Davos criticism that the European Commission was too lax toward Italy's budget and banking practices, and asked about Italian bank rescues, a pre-retirement scheme and compliance with EU fiscal rules. Minister Hoekstra answered that the Netherlands repeatedly raised concerns in the Eurogroup and Ecofin, that Italy's budget does not meet the SGP in the government's view, and that the Commission must assess state aid and compliance, while declining to give a separate judgment on individual national measures.
The cabinet has no indications that Italy did not comply with the rules in the aforementioned cases.
Het kabinet heeft geen aanwijzingen dat Italië zich in de voornoemde casuïstiek niet aan de regels heeft gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht 'Koninklijke cadeaus, vorstelijke problemen: hoe de Oranjes omgaan met geschenken'

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked the Prime Minister about reports that a Rubens drawing sold at auction may have been on loan from a royal foundation, and whether ownership and the sale had been properly checked. The government answered that the publications do not change its earlier position that the work is private property, that the sale is for the private owner to decide, that no RVD involvement was found, and that it cannot establish whether other works sit in royal foundations.
It is up to the private owner to decide whether, and in what manner, an artwork is sold.
Het is aan de particuliere eigenaar om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, een kunstwerk wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asks the Prime Minister and ministers how the government responds to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether it rejects her claims about economic growth, climate inaction and the political system, and what it will do to meet the 1.5 degree target and reduce meat in its own canteens. The government answers collectively, as the answer text is only the header and cross-reference in the supplied excerpt, with no substantive responses visible.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2018Z24290, have been answered by way of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix, session 2018–2019, no. 1305.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24290 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1305 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de verkoop door de koninklijke familie van een Rubens tekening titel Nude Study of A Young Man with Raised Arms

An MP asked whether the royal family should have offered a Rubens drawing to Dutch museums before selling it at an American auction, and whether the Prime Minister would appeal to the family to keep it in the Netherlands. The minister replied that the work is private property, that the owner decides how to sell, that existing museum funding instruments exist, and that there is no reason to make an exception for the royal family.
It is up to the private owner to decide whether, and in what manner, an artwork is sold.
Het is aan de particuliere eigenaar om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, een kunstwerk wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het verlenen van asiel aan Asia Bibi

MP Wilders asked whether the government will grant asylum to Asia Bibi, a Pakistani Christian threatened with death over blasphemy charges, and criticised the admission of other asylum seekers. The government answered that it has intensively pressed for her case bilaterally, in the EU and with like-minded countries, and that it is pursuing quiet diplomacy, without addressing whether asylum will be granted.
The Netherlands has over recent years intensively pursued Asia Bibi's case bilaterally, within the EU and with like-minded countries, and the cabinet will continue to do so.
Nederland heeft zich de laatste jaren bilateraal, in EU-verband en met andere gelijkgezinde landen intensief ingespannen voor de zaak van Asia Bibi en dat zal het kabinet blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het stuklopen van het pensioenakkoord

MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked about the collapse of the pension agreement, its contents (including RVU levy cuts, a contribution of about 7 billion euros, reduced AOW-age increase, and easier pension saving for self-employed), and whether memos were shared with MPs. The minister answered that no agreement was reached, describes the proposed package and its costs in general terms, and states that the government shared no separate memos beyond coalition-internal consultation.
Therefore there is no pension agreement.
Er is dan ook geen pensioenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het mislukken van een pensioenakkoord

Opposition MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked about the failed pension agreement, including whether the government was ready to decouple AOW age from life expectancy, the effect on fiscal sustainability, RVU-levy cuts and support for self-employed pension building. Minister Koolmees answered that the decoupling would have been studied by an external commission, that the measures would weaken the sustainability balance, that the RVU cut was only an ultimate offer, and that no mandatory pension for self-employed had political support because no total package was agreed.
Since it was not possible to reach agreements on this within a total package, it is not opportune to go further into possible coverage measures.
Aangezien het niet is gelukt om binnen een totaalpakket hierover afspraken te maken, is het niet opportuun om verder in te gaan op mogelijke dekkingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Rutte in gesprek met Alibaba over Europees distributiecentrum’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked about reports that the Prime Minister met Alibaba about a European distribution centre near Maastricht-Aachen Airport, with questions on jobs, environmental and noise impacts, the RLI mainport report, Belgian airspace arrangements and whether the government would reconsider. The minister declined to disclose details of the meeting as commercially confidential, called environmental effects a matter for future permit procedures, and reaffirmed general support for logistics investment.
It is not for the cabinet to disclose information from conversations with individual companies, as these are often commercially confidential in nature.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om informatie uit de gesprekken met individuele bedrijven openbaar te maken, omdat deze veelal bedrijfsvertrouwelijk van aard is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over Italië en de Euro

An MP asked the government about Italy's rising bond yields, its stress scenario in the MEV 2019, a pension plan, and banking union risk reduction. The government answered that the scenario is not overly optimistic, reported its talks with Italy's prime minister on the budget, and said it would send a new letter on banking risk before April 2019.
The intention is to send your House a new letter on risk reduction in the European banking sector before April 2019.
Het voornemen is om uw Kamer vóór april 2019 een nieuwe brief te sturen inzake risicoreductie in de Europese bankensector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht dat de Duitse regering bij alle officiële gelegenheden vegetarisch zal eten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government whether it would follow Germany in serving vegetarian food at official events, and whether it would act on climate-friendly food choices and nudging concepts. The Minister of Agriculture replied that food production contributes to emissions, that government catering sustainability is already being promoted through procurement and projects, that a proposal to drop meat at all official catering goes too far, and that the government will continue its sustainable food policy as set out in the Paris-linked climate and food reduction targets.
The suggestion to offer no meat at all government catering unless specifically requested goes too far for the cabinet.
De suggestie om bij alle overheidscatering geen vlees meer aan te bieden, tenzij daar specifiek om gevraagd wordt, gaat het kabinet te ver.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Rooijen over het Twitterbericht van voormalig minister van Financiën Dijsselbloem over zijn lidmaatschap van de partij van de Franse President Emmanuel Macron

MP Van Rooijen asked the Prime Minister whether former Finance Minister Dijsselbloem's membership of Macron's En Marche movement, and his stance on ministers joining foreign parties, was acceptable. The Prime Minister answered that the choice was Dijsselbloem's own, that En Marche was not yet a party when he joined in 2016, and that the French elections do not change his views.
The choice to get involved with a political movement in formation was Mr Dijsselbloem's own.
De keuze voor betrokkenheid bij een politieke beweging in oprichting is er een van de heer Dijsselbloem zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over op welke punten de minister-president overtuigd is in het debat over de Algemene Beschouwingen van dit jaar

Baudet (FvD) asked the Prime Minister on which points he had changed his mind during the 2018 Algemene Beschouwingen debate, what his prior position was, and which arguments and speakers persuaded him. Rutte replied that he addressed questions and positions extensively in the debate and gave the cabinet's view on motions, referring to the parliamentary record without naming any changed positions.
I responded extensively during the debate to the questions and positions of the members.
Ik ben tijdens het debat uitvoerig ingegaan op de vragen en standpunten van de leden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse steun aan de Syrische rebellen en de vele geheime onderzoeken die daarnaar gedaan worden

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Prime Minister about Dutch support to Syrian rebels, the ending of the NLA programme, and the secrecy and multiple reviews surrounding it. Minister Blok answers that the programme ended, that delivery documents are classified for security reasons, that reports will be shared confidentially before the debate, and that some detailed information cannot be disclosed.
Prior to the debate on the NLA programme, the cabinet will send the full research report to the House on a confidential basis.
Voorafgaand aan het debat over het NLA-programma zal kabinet het volledige onderzoeksrapport op vertrouwelijk basis aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over intern volkenrechtelijk advies over de steun aan de rebellen in Syrië

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether internal international-law advice on arms-type aid to Syrian rebels is public, whether the government deliberately avoided external advice, and asked for all such advice to be sent to parliament before a debate. The minister said internal advice is not state secret but falls under personal policy views and is not released by default, and offered confidential inspection of the decision memoranda for the NLA programme.
In this exceptional case, the cabinet is prepared, exceptionally, to give the House confidential access to the decision memoranda on the NLA programme if desired.
In dit bijzondere geval is het kabinet bij uitzondering bereid de Kamer desgewenst vertrouwelijk inzage te geven in de besluitvormingsmemoranda over het NLA-programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitspaken van de minister-president inzake de dividendbelasting

An MP asks the Prime Minister to explain his description of abolishing dividend tax as 'bizarre', and whether it protects Dutch firms from hostile takeovers, is linked to low interest rates, and offsets the valuation effects of earlier measures. The State Secretary answers that the measure is justified in the explanatory memorandum, that abolition may reduce takeover incentives, and that low rates are not decisive, while giving no commitment on reintroduction or on the valuation effects.
The Prime Minister meant that it is not the easiest measure to explain.
De Minister-President doelde erop dat het niet de makkelijkste maatregel is om uit te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat vermogensbeheerders en grootaandeelhouders zich niet laten leiden door de dividendbelasting voor investeringen in Nederlandse bedrijven

MP Leijten asked the government how it reacts to foreign asset managers saying they are not influenced by Dutch dividend tax, whether the abolition is driven by lobbying, and whether anti-avoidance measures and corporate tax cuts are in contradiction. The State Secretary largely rejects the premises, argues the dividend tax does affect returns and investment, defends abolition as serving headquarters and the general interest, and states that anti-avoidance measures are not the reason for abolition.
It is questionable whether the quoted statements from certain asset managers, saying they are not guided by dividend tax, give a representative picture of current and potential investors in general.

Het is de vraag of de geciteerde uitspraken van bepaalde vermogensbeheerders die aangeven dat zij zich niet laten leiden door de dividendbelasting een representatief beeld geven van de huidige en potentiële beleggers in den brede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht 'Britse beleggers zitten niet te wachten op afschaffen dividendbelasting'

MP Nijboer asked the government about a press report that British investors are not keen on abolishing the Dutch dividend tax, and about who bears the cost and revenue effects. The State Secretary answered that no foreign investors asked for abolition, that exact investor breakdowns are unavailable, and that the government will proceed with abolition to keep headquarters in the Netherlands.
Who these portfolio shareholders are is often also unknown to listed companies.
Wie deze portfolioaandeelhouders zijn is veelal ook voor beursgenoteerde bedrijven onbekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over de uitspraken van vicepremier de Jonge en vicepremier Ollongren naar aanleiding van de uitspraken van de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken tijdens een bijeenkomst met Nederlandse

MP Ploumen asked the Prime Minister whether the deputy PMs' remarks defending Foreign Minister Blok, who remains in office after controversial comments at a closed meeting, were appropriate and whether the cabinet stands behind his apologies. The Prime Minister answered that Blok acknowledged his remarks were unwise, regretted them and withdrew them, that the cabinet supports this, and that the question of his remaining in office is for parliament to address in a forthcoming debate.
There will still be a debate in the House of Representatives on the Minister Blok's statements. The House decides on what will be raised in it.
Over de uitspraken van Minister Blok volgt nog een debat in de Tweede Kamer. De Kamer gaat over hetgeen daarin aan de orde zal worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de klokkenluidersbrief van Roelie Post.

Rep. Omtzigt asked the Foreign and Prime Minister about whistleblower Roelie Post, who sent a letter to the European Parliament president copied to the Dutch Prime Minister during the Dutch EU presidency, and about her dismissal by the European Commission. The government replied that EU whistleblowing guidelines allow external channels as a last resort, that the copy was noted rather than read, and that the dispute is for the Commission and the EU General Court to resolve, so the government takes no mediating role.
The copy of this letter was therefore officially received for information and was not read by the Prime Minister.
Het afschrift van deze brief is daarom ambtelijk aangenomen ter kennisgeving en niet door de Minister-President gelezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over omkoping van parlementariërs vanuit Azerbeidzjan

An MP asks the foreign minister and prime minister about alleged bribery of parliamentarians by Azerbaijan, including the 'Azerbaijan Laundromat' and the Council of Europe PACE corruption investigation, and asks why the Committee of Ministers and GRECO are not pursuing an independent inquiry. The minister answers that the government is aware of the reports, supports GRECO follow-up, and will monitor developments, but does not commit to pushing for a new independent investigation.
The cabinet welcomes the steps taken so far.
Het kabinet verwelkomt de tot op heden genomen stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitspraken van minister Blok over de multiculturele samenleving

An MP (Wilders, PVV) asked the government to explain Minister Blok's remarks on multicultural society and EU migration and whether they reflect cabinet policy, and asked whether policy should be overturned. The government answered that the remarks were made at a closed meeting, do not change cabinet policy, and that it will not change course.
The statements change nothing about the existing cabinet policy.
De uitspraken veranderen niets aan het staande kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht 'Weisglas maakt einde aan parlementaire BBQ'

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the renaming of the 'parlementaire BBQ' to 'Binnenhof BBQ' and the meat-industry lobby event at Nieuwspoort create an appearance of ties between government, parliament and the meat sector, and asked for consequences. The government answered that the event is initiated by two meat-sector organisations at the press centre Nieuwspoort, which decides on its own terms, and that the cabinet is not involved; any parliamentary position is for the House itself.
The press centre itself determines to whom and on what conditions it makes facilities available. The cabinet is not involved in this.
Het perscentrum bepaalt zelf aan wie en op welke voorwaarden zij faciliteiten ter beschikking stelt. Het kabinet is hierbij niet betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het scheiden van immigrantenkinderen in de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the government would react to UN calls to end separating immigrant children from parents in the United States, summon the US ambassador, condemn the practice, and raise it with President Trump. The minister replied that concerns were conveyed diplomatically earlier, that a serious debate took place in the US, and that a presidential decree on 20 June stopped separating families.
The concerns that exist in Dutch society were earlier conveyed to the US through diplomatic channels.
De zorgen die in de Nederlandse samenleving bestaan zijn in een eerder stadium via diplomatieke weg aan de VS overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over de mededeling dat Nederland een deel van de migranten van het schip 'Lifeline' gaat opvangen

PVV MPs asked whether the government agreed to take in part of the migrants from the Lifeline ship, how many, and why it acted without parliamentary approval, and urged an asylum stop. The State Secretary confirmed Netherlands offered a one-off responsibility for up to 20 asylum seekers from Malta and referred the rest to a separate letter to parliament.
For the considerations on which and the terms under which this gesture is made, I refer you to the cover letter accompanying the annotated agenda.
Voor de overwegingen op grond waarvan en de modaliteiten waaronder deze geste wordt gedaan, verwijs ik u naar de aanbiedingsbrief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, Maeijer en Wilders over de mededeling dat Nederland een deel van de migranten van het schip 'Lifeline' gaat opvangen

PVV MPs asked whether agreements to take in Lifeline migrants were already made at the 24 June 2018 meeting, and why the minister did not disclose this during the debate. The government answered that no agreement was made; Malta conditioned its acceptance on other states taking responsibility, and the Netherlands later agreed as a gesture to take up to 20 asylum seekers.
No, that is not the case.
Nee, dat is niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de detentie en de persoonlijke veiligheid van Tommy Robinson in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

An MP asks whether the government will contact the UK to guarantee the safety of detained activist Tommy Robinson, whom he says was moved to a prison with a large Muslim population and has been threatened, and whether it agrees he should be released. The government says it has no details on his detention conditions, considers this a UK responsibility, and that his release is a matter for the British judge.
The cabinet considers this a responsibility of the government of the United Kingdom and makes no further statements about it.
Het kabinet acht dit een verantwoordelijkheid van de regering van het Verenigd Koninkrijk en doet hier geen nadere uitspraken over.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het feit dat de Raad van de Europese Unie geen enkel antwoord geeft op de aanbevelingen van de Europees Ombudsman over transparantie en geheimhouding e

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked why the EU Council has not responded to the European Ombudsman's February 2018 recommendations on transparency and secrecy in its working documents, which they argued breaches the EU treaty. The Minister replied that no formal treaty deadline binds the Council, that the Netherlands pressed for a timely reply, and that a substantive Council response is expected in early July 2018.
Formally, no obligation arises from Article 228 TFEU for the Council to send its position to the European Ombudsman within three months.
Antwoord 3 Formeel vloeit er geen verplichting voor de Raad voort uit artikel 228 VWEU om binnen drie maanden een antwoord om de Europese Ombudsman zijn standpunt mede te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het proces rondom afschaffing van de dividendbelasting

An MP asks the Prime Minister why only some documents from the WOB request on the dividend tax abolition were disclosed, who prepared the 'VVD memo' and the redaction of company names, and what the contacts with the State Secretary of Finance involved. The Prime Minister answers that the other documents were withheld under the WOB decision (under court review), that civil servants supported the formation memo but details of the formation process are confidential, and that the contacts cannot be discussed without harming third-party interests.
For other documents there was no reason to depart from the content and reasoning of the WOB decision.
Ten aanzien van andere stukken was er geen aanleiding af te wijken van de inhoud en motivering van het WOB-besluit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het aandelenbezit van de Koning

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the King holds shares in Shell or other companies with a royal designation, whether the royal family previously held Shell shares, and whether financial transparency about the head of state should be increased. The government replied that the King holds no shares in royally-designated companies, that his asset dealings fall under Article 41 of the Constitution and the privacy sphere per the Council of State's 2010 advice, and it did not commit to greater disclosure.
This article guarantees the room the King has for organising his Household.
Dit artikel waarborgt de ruimte die de Koning heeft voor de inrichting van zijn Huis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de handelsmissie naar China

The MP Kuzu asks why the government organised a trade mission to China, how it squares with criticism of human rights and religious freedom, and what is being done on Uyghurs and Tibetans. The Minister answers that the mission aims to strengthen economic ties and that human rights concerns, including Xinjiang and Tibet, were raised bilaterally and will be discussed in a human rights dialogue, but gives little operational detail on the Mensenrechtenfonds projects.
For the safety of project partners, further details cannot be provided.
Omwille van de veiligheid van projectpartners kan niet op nadere details worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de handelsmissie naar China

An MP asked the Prime Minister about the content of his China trade mission, the deterioration of human rights there under Xi Jinping, and whether he had raised NGO legislation, Tibet, and specific detainees. The government listed the mission's programme, said it is concerned about shrinking civil society and individual human rights defenders, and said it will raise these issues, including religious freedom and NGOs, at the bilateral human rights dialogue in July and will also raise individual cases there.

In the talks with the Chinese leadership during this visit, the Prime Minister indicated that the Netherlands again wants to put both freedom of religion or belief and the role of NGOs on the agenda for the bilateral human rights dialogue with China, which China has confirmed for July.

In de gesprekken met het Chinese leiderschap tijdens dit bezoek heeft de Minister-President aangegeven dat Nederland zowel vrijheid van religie en levensovertuiging als de rol van ngo's wederom op de agenda wil zetten voor de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China, die door China is bevestigd voor juli.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte Ministerie van Defensie)

Asscher (PvdA) asked the Prime Minister about the cabinet's first hundred days, listing 100 questions on defence personnel, pay, housing, care, education, pensions, Groningen gas extraction and more. The Defence ministers answered on personnel, stating the Defence Note 2018 invests in staff and that burn-out cases are not registered separately due to medical confidentiality.
Defence keeps records of sick leave, but not specifically of people with burn-out complaints.
Defensie houdt een registratie bij van het ziekteverzuim, maar niet specifiek van mensen met burn-outklachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het informeren van de Kamer

The MP asks the Prime Minister why he answered the earlier questions generally and whether the Chamber should be informed before the media about plans and reports, and whether ministers have a media strategy. The Prime Minister answers that the Chamber may rely on receiving relevant information before the media, that existing working agreements with the Chamber's clerk were reconfirmed, and that these agreements already set out how and when the Chamber is informed, without committing to new measures.
The Chamber could and can, as a starting point, rely on receiving relevant information before the media report on it, insofar as the cabinet controls this.
De Kamer mocht en mag er als uitgangspunt op vertrouwen dat zij – voor zover het kabinet dat in de hand heeft – de beschikking krijgt over relevante informatie voordat media daarover berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de Nederlandse steun aan het Vrije Syrische Leger

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether Dutch non-lethal support to Free Syrian Army groups had reached groups now fighting alongside Turkey in Afrin, and requested transfer documents and a fuller answer. The government declined to publish transfer documents or group names for security reasons, said support was stopped in northern Syria in March 2018, and referred the specific questions to a confidential letter.
For security reasons the cabinet does not make public information from which it can be inferred which groups Netherlands supports or supported or where they are located.
Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen maakt het kabinet geen informatie openbaar waaruit kan worden afgeleid welke groepen door Nederland worden of werden gesteund of waar ze zich precies bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte I&W)

Asscher asks how the government will improve road safety around schools and how much it allocates so older people without a car can travel. The minister says road safety around schools is primarily a municipal responsibility, points to VVN and ProRail programmes, and says no money is earmarked specifically for older people, but general transport funds serve all users and accessibility investments in stations and public transport are cited.

I do not allocate money specifically for transport of older people, but in principle all funds for public transport, rail and roads in chapter XII of the national budget and the Infrastructure Fund are intended to enable everyone, including older people, to travel from A to B.

Ik trek geen geld uit dat specifiek voor vervoer van ouderen is bedoeld, maar in principe zijn alle middelen voor openbaar vervoer, spoor en wegen op hoofdstuk XII van de Rijksbegroting en het Infrastructuurfonds ervoor bestemd iedereen, en daarmee ook ouderen, de mogelijkheid te geven zich van A naar B te verplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte SZW)

An MP asked the government about measures to create permanent jobs, curb bogus self-employment, support older and disabled workers, tackle discrimination and debt, and address equal pay. The minister answered at length, outlining planned labour market reforms, the DBA law replacement, a pension reform route via the SER, and promised follow-up letters on several issues.
Before the summer I will inform the House further about the outcome of talks with the social partners.
Voor de zomer zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren over de uitkomst van gesprekken met sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte BuZa en BuHa-OS)

An MP asked the government about its first hundred days, specifically how it would actively contribute to a nuclear-weapon-free world and how much money it would give to the She Decides initiative in 2018. The government answered that it pursues nuclear disarmament through NPT follow-up, FMCT negotiations and verification work within NATO's nuclear framework, and that it commits EUR 13.6 million extra to She Decides in 2018 via reprioritisation in the budget.
Within the framework of its alliance obligations, the cabinet actively works towards a nuclear-weapon-free world.
Het kabinet zet zich, binnen het kader van de bondgenootschappelijke verplichtingen, actief in voor een kernwapenvrije wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid)

An MP asked the Minister-President about the first hundred days of the cabinet, covering police and public-sector workers' pay and support, burnout and staff shortages, online child sexual abuse legislation, crime reporting and clearance rates, discrimination against LHBT people, sexual intimidation, and police pay demands. The Minister of Justice and Security answered most items on substance, committing to a plan on police sick leave, a consultation on new sex-crime legislation and a strategy on case durations, while declining to pre-empt police pay negotiations and referring defence, care and education questions to other ministers.
For the answers to the questions on defence, care and education, I refer you to the answers of the responsible ministers.
Voor de antwoorden op de vragen over defensie, zorg en onderwijs verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden van de verantwoordelijke ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte Financiën)

Asscher (PvdA) asked the government how much revenue the corporate tax cut and dividend tax abolition yield from multinationals and foreign investors, whether foreign governments and hedge funds benefit most, what is done to protect savings and whether the leverage buffer will rise, how SMEs are compensated, and whether abolition of dividend tax will be postponed. Minister Hoekstra answered that the corporate tax cut benefits all taxable companies, that net dividend tax revenue of 1.4 billion comes almost entirely from foreign portfolio investors whose burden depends on many factors, that a 3% leverage ratio is being negotiated in Europe, that the SME question is answered by reference to an earlier reply, and that abolition will not be postponed and a bill is due on Prinsjesdag 2018.
The cabinet sees no reason to postpone submission of this bill.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om indiening van dit wetsvoorstel uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste 100 dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte OCW)

An MP asked the government about education, culture and social policy issues in its first hundred days, including teacher pay, cyberbullying, school costs, segregation, numerus fixus for nursing, teacher shortages and workload. The ministers answered largely by pointing to existing measures, funding commitments and planned studies, with several promises of further letters or discussions.
If schools fail to make good agreements in time, the Minister will tighten the law.
Lukt het de scholen niet om tijdig goede afspraken te maken, dan gaat de Minister de wet aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport)

An MP asked the government about its first hundred days, covering staff shortages and burnout in healthcare and other sectors, insurance premium costs, mental health care for people with confused behaviour, administrative burden, pharmaceutical pricing, youth mental health places, ambulance response times and abortion pill access. The health ministers answered mostly by pointing to existing programmes, figures and planned letters, and declined to create a national drug research fund or to change abortion rules.
The cabinet does not intend to make the abortion pill available through the GP or to remove criminalisation from the Criminal Code.
Het kabinet heeft niet de intentie om de abortuspil via de huisarts beschikbaar te maken en de strafbaarstelling uit het Wetboek van Strafrecht te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties)

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the first hundred days of the cabinet, covering housing supply, cuts to rent allowance, public sector pay, disinformation, and facilities in shrinking regions. The minister answered with projected social housing construction, explained the rent allowance changes, outlined the pay policy and disinformation measures, and promised follow-up on several points.
I will return to the financing of the shortfall from the transfer of the Environment Act to the Ministry of Interior after the decision-making on the spring memorandum.
Op de financiering van het tekort door de overheveling van de Omgevingswet naar het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties kom ik na besluitvorming over de voorjaarsnota terug.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het informeren van de Kamer

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he stands by his earlier statement that parliament must be informed before the media, and how he assesses two recent cases where journalists received information about the tax rulings report and the Petten nuclear waste funding before parliament. The Prime Minister answered yes to the first question and, on the rest, only restated the general principle that parliament should be informed as quickly as reasonably possible under article 68 of the Constitution, without addressing the specific cases or committing to any measure.
This includes that the government informs the chambers as quickly as reasonably possible about relevant matters.
Daarbij hoort dat de regering de Kamers zo snel als redelijkerwijs mogelijk informeert over relevante zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat)

An MP asked the government roughly 100 questions about its first hundred days, covering public sector workload, housing, pensions, Groningen gas extraction and damage, climate costs, corporate social responsibility and many other topics. The ministers answered selectively, providing substantive answers on some items (e.g. Groningen damage, CO2 storage, corporate social responsibility) while leaving most questions unanswered or referring them elsewhere.
Question 100: Can you answer these questions before the 100-day debate?
Vraag 100 Kunt u deze vragen voor het 100-dagen debat beantwoorden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het aanvullend pensioenfonds van Europarlementariërs

MP Omtzigt asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Social Affairs about the supplementary pension fund for MEPs, which has a coverage ratio of about 37% and may need large top-up payments. Minister Blok answered that the European Parliament itself must find a solution for its own pension scheme, that the Dutch recovery rules would likely force substantial cuts for a Dutch fund at that level, and declined to write to EIOPA or commit to a specific step, saying the answers would follow within the deadlines.
It is for the EP to find a solution to this problem.
Het is aan het EP een oplossing voor deze problematiek te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de Ien Daleslezing

MP Asscher asked the Prime Minister whether Minister Ollogren's Ien Dales lecture on article 1 of the Constitution expressed the cabinet's position, and whether her spokesperson's remark that it was more a campaign matter than a cabinet position still stood. The Prime Minister answered that the minister spoke as a cabinet member on article 1 of the Constitution, leaving room for personal examples and interpretation in the societal debate, and that the answers were sent on time.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations spoke as a member of the cabinet about article 1 of the Constitution.
De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties sprak als lid van het kabinet over art. 1 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over STER-inkomsten

An SP MP asked why the shortfall in STER advertising revenue and the expected gap in the public broadcaster budget were not raised at the coalition talks, and why the EY reports and the ministry's knowledge of the shortfall were not disclosed sooner. The minister replied that these issues were not discussed at the formation table, that the EY draft reports are internal and not published, that the ministry informed the state secretary and NPO during the study, and that the November media budget letter was the proper moment to inform parliament.
Draft versions are part of the internal process and are not made public.
Conceptversies zijn onderdeel van het interne proces en worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over Ster-inkomsten

MP Kwint asked when the falling STER advertising revenues became known at OCW, why the EY report dated 9 September 2017 was not shared, and why the shortfall was absent from the coalition agreement and reported only after the new minister took office. The minister answered that EY's final report was delivered on 5 October 2017, the 9 September date being a planned deadline, that the findings were used in the media budget letter of 17 November 2017, and that no other shortfalls are known.
EY delivered the final report on 5 October last.
Het definitieve rapport heeft EY opgeleverd op 5 oktober jongstleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een zakenprins illegale activiteiten onderneemt

The SP MP Van Raak asked the ministers about a report that a prince of the royal family, Bernhard, runs illegal rental practices such as charging key money, possibly unregistered tenants, and asked whether royals must obey the law. The minister answered that rental law applies to everyone, that the ACM supervises the rental market and municipalities can fine unregistered occupancy, and declined to comment on the specific case.
Laws and regulations, such as those on rental, apply to everyone. I see no reason to address this specific situation.
Wet en regelgeving, zoals ten aanzien van verhuur geldt voor iedereen. Ik zie geen aanleiding om op deze specifieke situatie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een lastercampagne van pro-Israël activisten tegen de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking

Member Kuzu asked the government about a smear campaign by pro-Israel groups against Minister Kaag, including attacks on her family, a misquoted article, and reported Israeli surveillance of pro-Palestinian activists in Europe. The government condemned personal attacks, said the quoted remark was incorrect and regretted the resulting confusion, and declined to say anything publicly about foreign intelligence activity while noting the Dutch services operate under the Wiv 2002 and ECHR standards.
No public statements can be made about knowledge of or investigations into the activities of foreign intelligence services.
Over kennis van en onderzoek naar activiteiten van buitenlandse inlichtingendiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over het mogelijke baanverlies bij Tata Steel

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about job losses and the independence of Tata Steel Nederland after its planned merger with ThyssenKrupp, including whether the merger should be blocked if it involves forced layoffs. The minister said the government supported a strong IJmuiden position and would monitor developments closely, but would not block the merger, relying on a workforce pact and natural attrition to limit layoffs.
Banning the merger is not on the table, but I will bring Dutch interests to the attention of the Tata Group management where necessary.
De fusie verbieden is niet aan de orde, maar ik zal waar nodig de Nederlandse belangen onder de aandacht brengen van de directie van Tata Group.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting

Asscher and Nijboer asked the Prime Minister whether Shell, Akzo Nobel, Unilever and Philips lobbied for abolishing the dividend tax, how the formation archive was handled, and what the effects on SMEs, housing corporations and the investment climate would be. The government answered that it talks regularly with business, that the contacts are confidential, that the formation archive contains only the listed documents, and that the effects of abolition are uncertain and not quantified in detail.
My interlocutors must be able to rely on our conversations being in principle confidential.
Mijn gesprekspartners moeten erop kunnen rekenen dat onze gesprekken in beginsel vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over "de overname van de Haagse Thomaskerk door een moskee"

PVV MPs asked whether replacing the Thomaskerk in The Hague with a mosque undermines Judeo-Christian culture, whether the municipality should be told not to facilitate Islam, and whether borders should be closed. The minister rejected the cultural-replacement framing, cited freedom of religion, said municipal contacts with religious organisations fall under local autonomy, and declined to close borders.
Maintaining contacts with religious organisations falls under municipal autonomy.
Het onderhouden van contacten met religieuze organisaties behoort tot de gemeentelijke autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maeijer over de vermindering van het aantal zetels in het Europees Parlement na Brexit

An MP from the PVV asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister whether the government would push, in the European Council, for cutting 73 European Parliament seats after Brexit, and questioned a proposal on seat allocation. The government replied that it has consistently argued for reducing the EP by 73 seats, that few member states share this, and that it will await the definitive Commission/EP seat proposal before taking a position.
The cabinet is awaiting the definitive proposal on the seat allocation of the European Parliament and will determine its position on that in due course.
Het kabinet wacht het definitieve voorstel voor de zetelverdeling van het Europees Parlement af en zal zijn standpunt daarop te zijner tijd bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Krol over mededelingen in de Troonrede en media over de voor 2018 verwachte koopkrachtontwikkeling

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister-President whether the Throne Speech claim that all groups, including social minima and the elderly, keep their purchasing power in 2018 is nuanced enough, citing budget figures showing many workers, benefit recipients and pensioners losing ground, plus municipal tax effects and the Wajong cut. Minister Asscher answers that median household purchasing power rises, that averages cannot be read as guarantees for individual households, that municipal effects are excluded from national projections yet small in aggregate, and that the government is open about these limits.
It is always good to nuance the purchasing power figures.
Het is altijd goed om de koopkrachtcijfers te nuanceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van den Berg over de aanbesteding fotografie in relatie tot de naleving van het clusterverbod

MPs Kuiken and Van den Berg asked the Prime Minister about the non-public tender for photography services, how selection criteria protect small firms and freelancers, and the current contracts with about 30 freelance photographers. The Prime Minister confirmed a two-stage non-public EU tender, explained that 101 firms applied and 40 contracts are planned from March 2018, and gave total spending of 2.935 million euros while withholding per-photographer turnover as commercially confidential.
The turnover per photographer concerns commercially confidential information.
De omzet per fotograaf betreft commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over Brussel die de deur open zet voor EU- lidmaatschap van Oekraïne

MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked whether EU Council President Tusk's quote on Ukraine's European choice undermines the Dutch no vote and the referendum, and whether the government will ever accept Ukraine's EU accession. The minister replied that the Council decision of 15 December 2016 legally binds an interpretation of the Association Agreement excluding candidate status, that this addresses referendum concerns, and that no accession application has been filed.

The decision of the heads of state and government does not amend the Association Agreement nor constitute a reservation, but legally binds how the EU member states implement the Association Agreement on a number of specific points.

Het besluit van staatshoofden en regeringsleiders wijzigt de Associatieovereenkomst niet en vormt evenmin een voorbehoud, maar legt juridisch bindend vast hoe de lidstaten van de Europese Unie op een aantal specifieke punten uitvoering geven aan de Associatieovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Marijnissen over het bericht dat melkgeitenhouders in opmars zijn

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that goat dairy farms are expanding despite Q-fever concerns, whether expansion raises infection risk, what advice local health services gave on a specific expansion, and whether compensation for Q-fever victims will be reconsidered. The government answered that existing measures such as vaccination and milk-tank monitoring keep the risk low, that permitting is a municipal responsibility, that it does not track expansion locations, and deferred the compensation question to a separate cabinet response.
The Brabant Due Diligence Score is not public until the expansion permit is granted.
De Brabantse Zorgvuldigheidsscore is niet openbaar tot toekenning van de vergunning tot uitbreiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het bezoek van minister-president Modi van India aan Nederland

MP Voordewind asked the government to raise with PM Modi the restrictions on civil society and NGOs in India, visa problems for Dutch critics, labour and child labour abuses in supply chains, and violence against Dalits, Muslims and Christians. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally, in the EU and multilaterally, without committing to specific new steps beyond ongoing dialogue.
In contacts with the Indian government, the cabinet consistently underlines the importance of civil society organisations for a well-functioning democratic constitutional state.
Het kabinet onderstreept in contacten met de Indiase overheid voortdurend het belang van maatschappelijke organisaties voor een goed functionerende democratische rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Consument & Markt een rekenhulp introduceert voor roamingkosten

The MP asks whether consumers are adequately informed about limits on the EU roam-like-at-home rules, whether intra-EU calls to other member states should be regulated, and whether the minister will push for EU regulation. The minister says consumers are sufficiently informed through contract terms and notifications, that cross-border calling pricing is market-driven and not generically out of proportion to cost, and that he does not wish to advocate EU regulation of intra-EU calls.
I am of the view that consumers are sufficiently informed about these limitations under the EU roaming rules.
Ik ben van mening dat consumenten op grond van de roamingregels in de EU voldoende worden ingelicht over deze beperkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de Aanbesteding Fotografie in relatie tot de naleving van het clusterverbod

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the planned 2018 photography tender, which may consolidate ministries' photo assignments into one structure, breaches the Dutch procurement clustering ban and harms freelancers and SMEs. The government answered that it has reconsidered the single-bureau option, will contract 40 photographers, keeps the choice of photographer with each ministry, and argues the bundling is justified and not unnecessary under the procurement law.
In response to these parliamentary questions and motion 32 440, no. 100 of 23 February 2017 by MPs Mei Li Vos and Agnes Mulder, this choice has been reconsidered.
Naar aanleiding van deze Kamervragen en motie 32 440, nr. 100 van 23 februari 2017 van de leden Mei Li Vos en Agnes Mulder is deze keuze heroverwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Wilders over beschuldigingen van antisemitisme van vice-voorzitter van de Europese Commisie Frans Timmermans aan het adres van Hongarije

PVV MPs Maeijer and Wilders asked whether the government would condemn EU Commissioner Timmermans' remarks about antisemitism in Hungary and demand his resignation. The Foreign Minister replied that the Commission and Hungary should explain the statements, that the cabinet supports Timmermans' defence of EU values, and that attention should focus on Hungarian higher-education and NGO legislation.
The cabinet supports the efforts of First Vice-President Timmermans to defend fundamental EU values and sees no reason for the measures you propose.
Het kabinet steunt de inspanningen van eerste vicevoorzitter Timmermans om fundamentele waarden binnen de EU te verdedigen en ziet geen aanleiding voor de maatregelen die u voorstelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer, Beertema en Wilders over een plan van de Franse president en de Duitse bondskanselier inzake de toekomst van de Europese Unie

PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister whether the government is committed to a Franco-German roadmap for deeper EU integration (banking, defence, migration) and whether this conflicts with the 2005 Dutch referendum result, and whether the Netherlands should reject an EU superstate or pursue Nexit. The government replied that there is no Franco-German roadmap, that the Commission only issued reflection papers, that further integration in the single market and migration is needed, and that there is no EU superstate.
There is currently no Franco-German roadmap for deeper EU integration.
Er is thans geen sprake van een Frans-Duitse routekaart voor diepere EU-integratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over 5 mei als verplichte vrije dag

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Prime Minister whether 5 May (Liberation Day) should be a mandatory day off, given that it is not a standard day off for most Dutch workers while other public holidays are. The minister replied that collective agreements between social partners decide paid holidays, that the government itself made 5 May a day off for civil servants in 1982, and that it will not legislate or negotiate with social partners to make it mandatory.
My ministry has no insight into the costs to the Dutch economy if all employees were given Liberation Day off.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen zicht op de kosten voor de Nederlandse economie wanneer alle werknemers op Bevrijdingsdag vrij krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Arissen over de vorming van de ‘Stichting Aanmoedigingsfonds van de Koninklijke Facultatieve’

MPs Van Raan and Arissen asked whether a cremation association's transfer of about 17 million euros to a charitable foundation run by the same board was proper, and whether independent investigation, prosecutorial action or a supervisory protocol is warranted. The government declined to assess the facts, saying private associations are outside its remit, pointed to members' civil-law remedies and to the pending bill on governance of legal entities, and refused to instruct the prosecutor.
The cabinet has no involvement in the ownership and business transactions of individual private companies and organisations.
Het kabinet heeft geen bemoeienis met het eigenaarschap en de zakelijke transacties van afzonderlijke private ondernemingen en organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jetten over de aanschaf van een Boeing 737 Business Jet als nieuw regeringsvliegtuig

Two D66 MPs asked why all four bids in the government aircraft tender were declared invalid, why negotiations went only with Boeing rather than retendering, the claimed 18 million euro price difference, Airbus's objection, and the King's role in choosing the aircraft. The minister answered that no bid met all criteria, that Airbus did not supply required documents, that the price gap is under 2 million euro once VAT is considered, that Airbus did not appeal, that the King had no role in the decision, and provided a timeline, while citing procurement-law limits on disclosing bid details.
The principles of procurement law limit me in making information about the bids public.
De beginselen van het aanbestedingsrecht beperken mij in het openbaar kunnen maken van informatie over de inschrijvingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de mogelijkheden tot het verbieden van campagnes van buitenlandse politici van niet-vrije landen in Nederland

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister whether the government could ban political campaigning in the Netherlands by foreign politicians from non-free countries, citing the European Convention on Human Rights and its Article 16. The government answered that questions 1 to 8 were addressed in a separate letter to parliament on the Turkish ministers' campaign visits of March 2017.
have been answered by means of the letter 'Campaign visits by Turkish ministers and the events that took place around 11 March 2017'
zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Campagnebezoeken van Turkse ministers en de gebeurtenissen die daaromtrent plaatsvonden rond om 11 maart 2017»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de schoffering van Nederland door de Turkse regering

Two MPs from the Bontes/Van Klaveren group asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about Turkey's alleged insults to the Netherlands, dual nationality and loyalty, expelling the Turkish ambassador, and halting EU accession talks. The government referred to a separate letter on Turkish ministers' campaign visits and did not answer the substantive questions directly.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Jetten over de aanschaf van een Boeing 737 Business Jet als nieuw regeringsvliegtuig

MPs Van Meenen and Jetten asked why four tenders for a new government aircraft were rejected, why negotiations went exclusively with Boeing, the role of the Royal House, total costs, pricing comparisons, future rules on scheduled flights, and related matters. The minister answered most questions substantively, explaining the procedure, costs (about 89 million euro net), and that the Royal House had no say in the procurement decisions, while declining to verify external price figures.
The Royal House had no say in decision-making on the design of the tender procedure, the assessment of bids, or the negotiations with Boeing.
Het Koninklijk Huis had geen zeggenschap in besluitvorming over de vormgeving van de aanbestedingsprocedure, de beoordeling van inschrijvingen alsmede de onderhandelingen met Boeing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, Omtzigt, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van der Staaij, Van Klaveren en Voordewind over de vluchtelingendeal met Turkije

MPs from several parties asked whether PM Rutte and Chancellor Merkel made a gentlemen's agreement with Turkey to resettle 150,000-250,000 Syrian refugees a year, and whether the government asked Turkey to postpone a visit by Minister Cavusoglu. The government denied any side agreement, pointed to the EU-Turkey statement of 18 March 2016 and ongoing EU resettlement talks, denied any request to postpone the visit, and declined to answer the questions one by one before the requested deadline.
No. Agreements have only been made at European level on resettling Syrian refugees from Turkey.
Antwoord 4 Er zijn enkel in Europees verband afspraken gemaakt over het hervestigen van Syrische vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije.
Antwoord op van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht "Turkse Nederlanders kiezen: ’evet’ of ’hayir'’', over het faciliteren van het Turkse referendum in Nederland

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the government about reports that Turkish referendum polling stations were being facilitated in the Netherlands, covering postal voting, costs of traffic signage and police, AK-party representatives posing at a polling station, and whether the stations should be closed. Minister Asscher answered that postal voting is a choice for other states, that costs fall within regular Rijkswaterstaat and police work, that the government cannot confirm the posing claim, and that the polling stations would not be closed because they are permitted under the Vienna Conventions.
The Netherlands does not supervise the polling stations and therefore cannot confirm whether members of the AK Party posed at one of the polling stations.
Nederland houdt geen toezicht in de stemlocaties en kan dus niet bevestigen of er door leden van de AK-partij is geposeerd in een van de stemlocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het mogelijk 'cadeau doen' van klokkenluider Edward Snowden door president Poetin aan president Trump

MP Van Raak asked whether the government shares concerns that Russia might hand Edward Snowden to the US as a gift to Trump, whether it shares concerns about Trump calling Snowden a traitor who should be executed, whether Snowden will get a fair trial in the US, what importance his NSA revelations have for the Netherlands, and whether the government will grant him asylum quickly. Minister Koenders answered that the government has no information that extradition is imminent, reaffirmed opposition to the death penalty, saw no indication Snowden would not get a fair trial, referred to earlier letters on the revelations, and noted that an asylum request can only be made in person in the Netherlands and Snowden has not made one.
The cabinet has no information indicating that extradition of Mr Snowden by Russia to the United States is imminent.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie waaruit blijkt dat uitlevering van de heer Snowden door Rusland aan de Verenigde Staten aanstaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over de berichten “Bod Unilever van baan” en “De drie meedogenloze saneerders uit Brazilië”

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and the Prime Minister about a reported takeover bid for Unilever by 3G Capital, including effects on Dutch jobs, R&D, food security, sustainability, and whether Dutch takeover protection could block it. The minister answered most questions on substance, noting the bid is off the table, the Netherlands' Corporate Governance Code applies, and the planned telecom-only takeover law does not cover this sector, with no commitment to block a future bid.
As long as the acquiring party would maintain a statutory Dutch-based listed company, that listed company falls under the scope of the Dutch Corporate Governance Code.

Zolang de overnemende partij een statutair in Nederland gevestigde vennootschap met beursnotering zou handhaven, valt die beursvennootschap onder de reikwijdte van de Nederlandse Corporate Governance Code.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de ordinaire zakkenvullerij met betrekking tot pensioenen door het Europees Parlement

Wilders asks the Prime Minister whether the government condemns the European Parliament using EU budget money to cover a pension shortfall for former MEPs and whether the Dutch EU contribution should be cut by the same amount for Dutch pensioners. The government replies that it favours modernising pension arrangements in EU institutions, that the matter belongs to the European Parliament's budget discussion, and that the Dutch contribution will not be reduced.
The cabinet considers it important that the discussion on this subject be conducted within the European Parliament.
Het kabinet acht het van belang dat de discussie over dit onderwerp dan ook binnen het Europees Parlement gevoerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht "Juncker stapt op na verzoek van Rutte"

An MP from the PVV asked the Prime Minister whether Juncker's possible departure from the European Commission was linked to the government wanting to withhold the EU future vision before elections, and whether the vision's federalist direction would harm the campaign. The government denied both links, saying the Prime Minister had already addressed the Commission's White Paper in a February debate.
No, during the debate on the informal European summit in Malta on 2 February, the Prime Minister already addressed the publication of the Commission's White Paper.
Nee, tijdens het debat over de informele Europese top in Malta op 2 februari is de Minister-President reeds ingegaan op het verschijnen van het Witboek van de Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Pechtold en Klaver over inzage in e-mails van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken inzake de Teevendeal

MPs Roemer, Pechtold and Klaver asked whether the Prime Minister will reconsider refusing disclosure of the e-mails and attached message about the Teeven deal, and why the government's privacy and advisory-confidentiality interests outweigh openness, plus questions on whether the e-mail was passed to the Oosting commission and forwarded to a private address. The Prime Minister refused to release the e-mails citing civil servant confidentiality and privacy, gave a summary of how the attachment was handled, and stood by his claim that the cabinet never deliberately withheld information while acknowledging serious failures.
Emails of individual civil servants are therefore in principle not provided.
Mails van individuele ambtenaren worden daarom in beginsel niet verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Segers, Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma en Klaver over openstaande vragen met betrekking tot de Teevendeal

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, D66, CDA and GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister about the open questions surrounding the Teeven deal, including why officials at Algemene Zaken had a ministry email with draft answers without the PM being informed, and asked for access to the emails. The PM answered that the email was received but not read or discussed, that no reply was sent, and that releasing the underlying internal emails is incompatible with protecting open deliberation and staff privacy.

Granting access to the underlying internal civil-service emails is not compatible with the essential interest in properly preparing decision-making, which is served by confidentiality of free and open exchange of ideas.
Verlening van inzage in onderliggende ambtelijke mails is niet verenigbaar met het wezenlijke belang dat is gemoeid met een goede voorbereiding van besluitvorming
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Pechtold over het bericht dat de koninklijke familie heimelijk erfgoed heeft verkocht zonder dit eerst aan Nederlandse musea aan te bieden

MPs Monasch and Pechtold asked about reports that the royal family secretly sold heritage (an atlas and the painting Boschbrand) without first offering it to Dutch museums. The minister answered that the sales were private transactions within existing law, that the export permit followed the normal review, and that the works were private property, without committing to new action.
It concerns a private matter. This sale between private parties took place in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations.
Het betreft een privéaangelegenheid. Deze verkoop tussen particulieren is tot stand gekomen in overeenstemming met de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het associatieverdrag met Oekraïne en de agenda van de Europese Top

MP Omtzigt asked the government why the agenda for the December 2016 European Council was late, whether a European Council conclusion is legally binding, what plan B exists if the EU-Ukraine association agreement fails, and how the government acted on a motion about EU funds and torture. The answer refers the MP to letters on the European Council and the General Affairs Council, which were sent separately.
have been answered by means of the letters 'Response to requests for additional information regarding the European Council of 15 December 2016'
zijn beantwoord middels de brieven «Reactie op verzoeken om aanvullende informatie aangaande de Europese Raad van 15 december 2016»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het gebruik van het regeringsvliegtuig tijdens het staatsbezoek aan Australië

An SP MP asked whether using the government aircraft, which flew largely empty, cost €250,000 on the Australia state visit, and why the Australian offer of an aircraft was declined. The minister answered that the government plane was chosen after comparing costs with a local charter, that the aircraft's limited range required the delegation to fly commercially, and that the aircraft carried baggage ahead of the trip, with the estimated cost of the outbound and return legs at €293,929.27.
The Australian offer was of course considered in preparing the state visit.
Het Australische aanbod is uiteraard betrokken bij de voorbereiding van het staatsbezoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Samsom, Jan Vos en Hoogland over de komst van een Tesla-fabriek naar Nederland

Three PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister and Minister of Economic Affairs whether the government would do everything possible to attract a Tesla Gigafactory to the Netherlands for green jobs and manufacturing. Minister Kamp answered that the Netherlands is a suitable location and the cabinet will make efforts, but that Tesla alone decides on location and he cannot yet estimate investments or jobs.
The cabinet will certainly make efforts to bring the production plant to the Netherlands.
Het kabinet zal zich zeker inspannen om de productiefabriek naar Nederland te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Tsunami van jihadisten’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a possible wave of ISIS fighters returning to Europe, asking whether the government is worried, how returnees will be handled, and whether borders should be closed to stop them. The minister answered that returnees are treated as a security risk and are interviewed, prosecuted where possible, and assessed in local case meetings, but that fully sealing the borders is neither practically nor legally possible, so intensified controls are used instead.
This question gives the impression that it would be practically or legally possible to hermetically seal the Dutch borders and thereby easily eliminate all risks to society.
Deze vraagstelling wekt de indruk dat het praktisch of juridisch mogelijk zou zijn de Nederlandse grenzen hermetisch af te sluiten en zo eenvoudig alle risico’s voor de samenleving weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het nieuws dat de FBI vooraf zou hebben geweten van de aanslag in Garland op 3 mei 2015

An MP asked whether the FBI withheld threat information from the Netherlands before the 2015 Garland attack, and how the government would respond. The minister confirmed the FBI shared intelligence with US police but said he cannot yet judge whether Dutch security staff should have been informed, and has requested further information from the US.
I have therefore requested additional information from the American authorities.
Ik heb de Amerikaanse autoriteiten daarom om aanvullende informatie verzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de berichten dat leden van het Koninklijk Huis financiële compensatie krijgen voor de vermogensbelasting die zij moeten betalen

An MP asked the Prime Minister 17 questions about press reports that members of the Royal House received compensation for wealth tax, including whether a 1972 fl.150,000 allowance was a disguised compensation. The government replied by referring to a separate letter answering the same matter, so the questions were answered only indirectly.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over het bericht dat leden van de Koninklijke familie al tientallen jaren compensatie krijgen voor het betalen van belasting

Pechtold (D66) asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister, after reports that royal family members received tax compensation for decades, about the amounts paid, the secrecy of the agreements, archiving and disclosure, cabinet decisions, and why a 2015 evaluation report omitted the arrangement. The answer refers the MP to a separate letter responding to a Van Klaveren request, without answering the questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het nieuws dat de FBI vooraf geweten zou hebben van de aanslag in Garland op 3 mei 2015

Wilders asked whether the US has issued a statement on reports that the FBI had prior knowledge of the 2015 Garland attack, how often the Netherlands pressed for one, and when clarity would come. The minister answered that the US authorities state the FBI developed no specific, credible threat information before the attack and shared intelligence with local police, but the answer relates to a US matter and the Dutch government only forwarded it.
I hereby inform you of the response from the American authorities, dated 12 October, which I received on 14 October 2016.
Hierbij informeer ik u over het antwoord van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten, gedateerd op 12 oktober, dat ik op 14 oktober 2016 heb ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Sjoerdsma over de Turkse publicatie van een lijst met Nederlandse 'Gülen-organisaties'

MPs Van Meenen and Sjoerdsma asked whether Turkey's publication of a list of Dutch 'Gülen organisations' was unacceptable interference, and what steps the government would take toward Turkey and the Dutch-Turkish community. The government answered that it has consistently told Turkish officials that direct interference from Ankara in domestic affairs is unacceptable, and referred to a cabinet letter on tensions in the Turkish-Dutch community.
In all talks with members of the Turkish government, the cabinet has consistently and critically made clear that Turkish tensions must not be exported to the Netherlands.

Het kabinet heeft in alle gesprekken met leden van de Turkse regering consequent en in kritische bewoordingen duidelijk gemaakt dat de Turkse spanningen niet naar Nederland moeten worden geëxporteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Helder, Fritsma en De Graaf over de Marokkaanse straatterreur in Maassluis

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about street disturbances by Moroccan-origin youths in Maassluis, including arrests, the mayor's conduct, camera use, police response times and denaturalisation. The minister answered that local authorities chose an emergency order that restored order, eight complaints were filed, five suspects arrested under OM direction, and that camera deployment was routine, while declining to discuss the ongoing investigation and noting the 15-minute police response target.
While the investigation is ongoing, I, as usual, make no further statements about it.
Lopende het onderzoek doe ik, zoals gebruikelijk, hierover geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de erkenning van de genocide, die op dit moment door ISIS gepleegd wordt

An MP asked the government whether it recognises ISIS as committing genocide against minorities and what obligations follow under the 1948 Genocide Convention, citing European Parliament, Council of Europe and US positions. The minister answered that the government does not formally determine genocide absent a court ruling, outlined existing counter-ISIS and foreign-fighter measures, and declined to publish internal legal advice.

The Cabinet has been advised internally several times under international law on this issue. The Cabinet attaches importance to civil servants being able to advise their ministers freely and to present all views, and publishing that advice afterwards would undermine this.

Het Kabinet is intern meermalen volkenrechtelijk geadviseerd over deze kwestie. Het Kabinet hecht eraan dat ambtenaren hun ministers vrijelijk kunnen adviseren en daarin alle standpunten kunnen weergeven. Het achteraf openbaar maken van die adviezen staat daaraan in de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over financiering van de referendum campagne in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked the government about foreign and undisclosed funding of the 2016 Dutch referendum campaign, including donor disclosure rules, GRECO recommendations on foreign donations, and contacts with George Soros's organisations. Minister Plasterk answered that party donations above EUR 4,500 are disclosed, no rules exist on foreign donations or referendum-period disclosure, the government had no direct contact with Soros, and the referendum subsidy audit is still ongoing.
I do not have overviews of organisations or persons who spent more than EUR 4,500 on campaign activities for the referendum of 6 April.
Ik beschik niet over overzichten van instanties of personen die meer dan € 4.500 hebben uitgegeven aan campagneactiviteiten voor het referendum van 6 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het archief van de MH17

An MP asks the government about the archiving of MH17 crisis documents, including whether emails were lost, why interview transcripts and evaluations were withheld, and the status of the JIT and prosecution strategy. The minister answers that no separate hotspot list exists, that archive transfers have not yet taken place, that interview transcripts remain confidential to protect research validity, and that some evaluations and prosecution strategy details are still in progress.
This promised confidentiality weighs very heavily for me in considering not sending the report to your House.
Deze toegezegde vertrouwelijkheid weegt voor mij zeer zwaar bij de afweging om het verslag niet aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold inzake activiteiten van de Turkse geheime dienst in Nederland

MP Pechtold asks the government about Turkish intelligence activities in the Netherlands, the AIVD's staffing for Turkish-language analysis, whether the AIVD uses information obtained by Turkish services, the protection of Turkish-Dutch residents against intimidation, and the assessment notes governing intelligence sharing with Turkey. Minister Blok answers that he cannot publicly confirm or deny activities of foreign services or the AIVD's expertise, refers complaints to the police, and states that the assessment notes are continuously reviewed and cannot be discussed individually.
No public statements can be made about activities that foreign intelligence and security services would carry out with the permission of the Dutch government.
Er kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan over activiteiten die buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten met toestemming van de Nederlandse overheid zouden uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over het nieuwe Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland (DTN)

PVV MPs Wilders and Fritsma asked whether the government takes seriously reports that IS terrorists used the refugee flow to reach Europe, and whether borders and asylum centres should be closed. The minister rejected the claim that asylum intake alone threatens security, said all asylum seekers are identified and registered, acknowledged that misuse cannot be excluded, and said full border closure is neither possible nor the chosen approach.
The cabinet rejects the suggestion that merely admitting asylum seekers would pose a threat to national security.
Het kabinet verwerpt de suggestie dat enkel het binnenlaten van asielzoekers een bedreiging zou vormen voor de nationale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het Turkse dreigement de vluchtelingendeal op te blazen

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the government would yield to Turkey's threat to end the refugee deal unless visa liberalisation for Turks is granted by October, and whether the deal was wise given Turkey's authoritarian turn. The minister answered that government visa policy is unchanged (visa-free travel only once all roadmap benchmarks are met), that the deal is needed to manage migration, that criticism of Turkey's post-coup developments stands, and that pre-accession aid would be cut and the death penalty is a red line if the rule of law deteriorates further.
