Government visa liberalisation policy remains unchanged: only when Turkey meets all benchmarks of the Roadmap for visa liberalisation can the Netherlands agree to visa-free travel for Turkish citizens.

Het kabinetsbeleid ten aanzien van visumliberalisatie blijft onveranderd: enkel wanneer Turkije aan alle benchmarks van de Roadmap visumliberalisatie voldoet, kan Nederland instemmen met het invoeren van visumvrijheid voor Turkse burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over het feit dat het OM nu de MH17 radargegevens in Rusland opvraagt

Two MPs asked whether the Public Prosecution Service's request to Russia for raw primary radar data on MH17 reflected political pressure, whether an ICAO dispute should be launched, and why Russia, Ukraine and the UN had not fully complied with Security Council resolution 2166 and the victims' families' letters. The minister replied that the prosecution's independence must be protected, that the Netherlands is ready to assist on request, that no ICAO dispute will be started because the safety investigation did not need the data, and that the Russian authorities have said they are willing to cooperate.
The cabinet does not want political influence on this important criminal investigation.
Het kabinet wil geen politieke beïnvloeding van dit belangrijke strafrechtelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het nieuws dat de FBI vooraf zou hebben geweten van de aanslag in Garland op 3 mei 2015

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether, if an undercover agent's sworn statement is correct that the FBI had prior knowledge of the Garland attack, the US authorities should have informed the Dutch services, and how the government would respond. The minister answered that US authorities were asked for clarification of the media reports, that no timeline for that clarification is known, and declined to answer the hypothetical 'if so' questions.
Anticipating this, I do not wish to go into 'if so' questions.
Vooruitlopend hierop wil ik niet ingaan op «als dan» vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het nieuws dat de FBI vooraf zou hebben geweten van de aanslag in Garland op 3 mei 2015

Wilders asked the Minister-President whether the FBI had advance knowledge of the Garland attack, which an undercover agent's affidavit suggested, given a Dutch MP was present, and whether the US had informed Dutch authorities and would be asked to clarify. The Minister of Justice answered that the US had not informed the Netherlands of any FBI foreknowledge, that the US was asked for clarification, and that routine information exchange on protected persons took place.
I have asked the American authorities for further clarification of the media reports in view of the alleged foreknowledge of the FBI.
Ik heb de Amerikaanse autoriteiten verzocht om een nadere duiding van de mediaberichten met het oog op de vermeende voorkennis van de FBI.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Minister van Economische Zaken doorgaat met het gebruik van Gmail voor communicatie met ambtenaren

An MP (Verhoeven, D66) asked whether Minister Kamp's use of a private Gmail account for work email exposed state secrets, whether he was phished, and whether ministers receive cybersecurity training. The minister answered that he has ended the private-account use, that an Auditdienst Rijk investigation into classified material is underway with results expected after the summer recess, and that he sees no grounds to assume classified information reached third parties.

I have therefore instructed the Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) to investigate whether documents bearing the classifications Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim or Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim were present on my private email account.

Ik heb daarom de Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de vraag of documenten met de rubriceringen Departementaal Vertrouwelijk, Staatsgeheim Confidentieel, Staatsgeheim Geheim of Staatsgeheim Zeer Geheim

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek over de radargegevens van de OVV, de non-disclosure clausules in het JIT MH17 verdrag, het archief over de MH17 en de brieven van nabestaanden

An MP asks the government about radar data on MH17, JIT non-disclosure clauses, the MH17 archive, and letters from relatives to Ukraine, Russia and the US. The minister answers that the government took note of the OVV report, that JIT-related agreements are not public, that the archive is being indexed, and that the interview notes of the Twente evaluation cannot be disclosed.

The cabinet wants to avoid that starting a dispute procedure could be taken to mean that the Netherlands considers this data necessary to draw the conclusions of the OVV report and that the investigation must be reopened.

Het kabinet wil voorkomen dat uit het starten van een geschillenprocedure zou kunnen worden geconcludeerd dat Nederland van mening is dat deze gegevens nodig zijn voor het trekken van de conclusies van het OVV rapport en dat het onderzoek heropend moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Beertema en Bosma over de uitspraken van de Koning over de EU

PVV MPs Wilders, Beertema and Bosma asked whether the King's European Parliament speech, which implied opposition to a Brexit, was an improper use of the head of state to influence the British electorate, and whether he should be told the EU threatens Dutch sovereignty. The minister replied that the speech was delivered under ministerial responsibility and that the cabinet holds that the UK staying in the EU is better for all parties.
The aforementioned speech by the King was delivered under ministerial responsibility.
Voornoemde toespraak van de Koning is uitgesproken onder de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de passieve rol van de Nederlandse overheid ten tijde van de jodenvervolging

Two MPs asked the Prime Minister whether the Dutch government should give fuller expression to commemoration of WWII, how it judges the Dutch government-in-exile's inaction on reports of Jewish deaths and deportations, and why the Netherlands has never apologised for its passive role in the persecution of Jews. The government answered briefly, pointing to commemorations, to publications and an independent institute as the proper domain of historiography, to Queen Beatrix's 1995 speech to the Knesset, and to earlier condemnations of antisemitism; it did not apologise.
The assessment of publications on these subjects belongs to the domain of science and society.
De beoordeling van publicaties over deze onderwerpen behoren tot het domein van wetenschap en samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het initiatief van het Europees Parlement om Turks toe te voegen als officiële EU-taal

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Netherlands, as Council presidency, received a Cypriot request to add Turkish as an EU official language, and urged rejection given Turkey's human rights record. The minister confirmed the Cypriot request is linked to Cyprus reunification preparations, that its scope is unclear, that treaty change would require all member states' consent, and that the Netherlands will stay in contact with Cyprus and the Commission on it.
The request is not related to the EU accession negotiations with Turkey.
Het verzoek houdt geen verband met de EU-toetredingsonderhandelingen met Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Agema over het TV-programma ‘Geer en Goor zoeken een hobby’ waarin de minister-president oproept iets voor eenzame ouderen te doen

PVV MPs Wilders and Agema asked the Prime Minister whether he is ashamed to call for help for lonely elderly while cutting elderly care, and whether the government will reverse cuts to home help and reopen care homes. The Staatssecretaris answered that loneliness is not primarily solved by more professional care, that the reforms aim to detect loneliness early, and that the government is pursuing a loneliness action plan with local cooperation until 2016.
Admission to a care home or additional care at home, however, is not a solution to loneliness.
Opname in een verzorgingshuis of extra zorg thuis is echter geen oplossing voor eenzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over aanwezigheid van de minister president in het buitenland terwijl in Nederland grote onrust heerst

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Prime Minister why he was abroad on an economic mission to Atlanta during the 2015 asylum unrest in the Netherlands and whether he would cut short his trip and refrain from further travel. Rutte replied that the mission served Dutch interests, that he stayed in contact with ministers at home, particularly on asylum, and that return was unnecessary; he did not name a maximum number of asylum seekers and referred to earlier letters and debates.
Modern communication allows us to stay in permanent contact with each other, so returning to the Netherlands was not necessary.
Moderne communicatie stelt ons in staat permanent met elkaar in contact te staan, waardoor terugkeer naar Nederland niet noodzakelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het verzoek van de RMS voor een gesprek met de president van Indonesië

MP Van Bommel asks whether the government will press for a meeting between the Moluccan government-in-exile (RMS) and Indonesian President Widodo during his Netherlands visit, and raises human rights concerns and the location of Chris Soumokil's grave. The minister says the request is known to Indonesia, that the decision rests with Widodo, and that the Netherlands has raised the grave location request on humanitarian grounds.
The request for a meeting is known to the Indonesian authorities.
Het verzoek tot een onderhoud is bekend bij de Indonesische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de kosten van Koningsdag

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister why the municipality of Zwolle's Koningsdag 2016 costs of €920,000 were considered proportionate, who decides the programme and who pays, when Zwolle knew of its €595,000 share, and whether municipalities hosting the celebration would get financial support. The government answered that Zwolle sets and pays for the programme from its own budget, the council approved the budget on 21 March 2016, and a specific national subsidy does not fit the municipal fund system.
It is up to the municipality of Zwolle to determine which costs it incurs to organise this day.
Het is aan de gemeente Zwolle om te bepalen welke kosten deze maakt om deze dag te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de Groene Draeck

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister why the Kamer was allegedly misinformed for years about the true maintenance costs of the royal yacht Groene Draeck, why budgets were not realistic, why a second opinion is needed, and why the government appears to juggle figures on royal household costs. The government answered that the cost increase was disclosed in September 2015 and in the 2016 budget, that the 2015 Kersten report underpinned the raise, that a second opinion is underway and will be sent to the Kamer, and that the Algemene Rekenkamer found no material errors in royal household accounts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, van Haersma Buma en Pechtold over onduidelijkheden rond het door de regering gevoerde asielbeleid

Opposition MPs from GroenLinks, CDA and D66 asked the Prime Minister and State Secretary of Security and Justice about unclear targets, forecasts, budgets, border controls and information on the asylum intake of 2016. The State Secretary answered at length, often stating that effects cannot be quantified in advance, that a 58,000 intake target is assumed for the budget while contingency planning uses the 93,600 forecast, and that some information is not available in the requested form.
Because the causes of migration are strongly influenced by external factors, it is not possible to quantify the effects of these measures in advance.
Doordat de oorzaken van migratie sterk beïnvloed worden door externe factoren is het niet mogelijk om effecten van deze maatregelen vooraf te kwantificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over ‘fiscaal onderdak Rostec’

An MP asked the government whether Rostec's arms-exporting subsidiary Rosoboronexport, linked to the BUK missile, should be denied tax residence in the Netherlands, and about the EU sanctions on Rostec's director Chemezov. The government answered that the sanctions and the 2014 listing were in place, that tax confidentiality prevents detail on a single company, and that the Netherlands cannot refuse a company's seat based on its activities.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, the cabinet cannot provide further information about individual taxpayers (legal persons).

Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan het kabinet geen verdere informatie verstrekken over individueel belastingplichtige (rechts)personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de berichtgeving over de echtgenoot van de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport

The SP MP Leijten asked the Prime Minister whether the health minister's husband, a consultant in the care sector, posed a conflict of interest, and why the minister's press spokesperson had contacted a journalist about the story. The Prime Minister answered that partners' business interests are not normally relevant to appointments, that the spokesperson acted with the minister's consent to correct a story that did not reflect the facts, and that he sees no reason for further steps.
In light of the answers given, I see no reason to do so.
Ik zie daartoe in het licht van de gegeven antwoorden geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de onderhoudskosten van de Gouden Koets en de Glazen Koets

An SP MP asked whether maintenance costs of the Gouden Koets and Glazen Koets are a state secret, for the pre-investigation and budget breakdowns, and whether the condition report on the Gouden Koets will be published. The Prime Minister answered that costs fall under Begroting I article 2 and are controlled via the budget and annual report with audits, but that detailed individual expenditure need not be made public under article 41 of the Constitution, and the Gouden Koets report will not be released.

The research report on the condition of the Gouden Koets cannot be provided because this would intrude on the constitutional authority of the King to organise his household, taking into account the public interest.

Het onderzoeksrapport naar de staat van de Gouden Koets kan niet worden verstrekt omdat dan getreden zou worden in de grondwettelijke bevoegdheid van de Koning om, met inachtneming van het openbaar belang, zijn Huis in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de onderhoudskosten van de Gouden Koets

MP Pechtold asked the Prime Minister why the maintenance costs of the Gouden Koets (Golden Coach) cannot be itemised and why its public interest is not recognised, citing the Groene Draeck precedent, Article 41 of the Constitution and Council of State advice. The Prime Minister declined substantive detail on privacy and constitutional grounds, promised to seek Council of State advice on Article 41 and ministerial responsibility, and will reply later.
The renovation costs are not specified further insofar as they affect the personal sphere of life (Articles 10 and 41 of the Constitution).
De verbouwingskosten worden niet nader gespecificeerd voor zover deze de persoonlijke levenssfeer raken (artikelen 10 en 41 van de Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet van de burgemeester van Hilversum als 'steunzender' in het referendum

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether the mayor of Hilversum had been recruited as a 'supporter' of the government's referendum campaign without consent, and about similar outreach to other bodies, companies, unions and parties. The government replied that the list reported in the media was only the output of an internal brainstorm of possible opinion makers, not a record of agreements made, and that it says nothing about those people's views.
It is not an overview of people and organisations with whom agreements have been made.
Het is geen overzicht van mensen en organisaties waarmee afspraken zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet van de burgemeester van Hilversum als 'steunzender' in het referendum

An SP MP asked the government about the Hilversum mayor's reported role as a supporter in the government's 'yes' campaign for the Dutch referendum, about the timing of commitments and consultation, about other mayors involved, and about whether fewer polling stations in municipalities were part of the campaign. The minister said the list of named people was merely an internal brainstorm of possible opinion-makers, not agreed commitments, and that polling station numbers are a municipal responsibility.

The list of persons and organisations that appeared in the media is nothing more than the result of an internal brainstorm at working level about possible opinion-makers who could get involved in the debate.

De lijst van personen en organisaties die in de media terecht is gekomen is niets meer dan het resultaat van een interne brainstorm op werkniveau over mogelijke opiniemakers die zich in het debat zouden kunnen mengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het referendum over het associatieverdrag Oekraïne

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked whether the government would suspend implementation of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement pending the April 2016 advisory referendum, and whether it would respect a no vote. Minister Koenders answered that provisional application continues because the referendum is part of national ratification, that the government will follow the Referendum Act, and that a negative outcome would lead to a further decision in consultation with parliament.
In the event of an irrevocable advisory rejection, the cabinet will submit to the House, under the Referendum Act, a bill to withdraw or to bring into force the approval act.

Bij een onherroepelijke raadgevende uitspraak tot afwijzing zal het kabinet op grond van de Wet raadgevend referendum een wetsvoorstel tot intrekking dan wel tot inwerkingtreding van de goedkeuringswet bij de Kamer aanhangig maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Fritsma over groepen van vooral Arabische mannen die tientallen jonge vrouwen hebben aangerand, beroofd en verkracht in Duitsland

PVV MPs asked the government whether it shares the view that New Year's Eve sexual assaults by groups of mostly Arab men in German cities reflect imported violence from migrants, and whether it will close borders. The State Secretary answered that sexual violence against women must be combated, that the Cologne events were serious and the investigation ongoing, and declined to speculate on causes or to adopt the rhetoric, without committing to border changes.
For completeness, I note that the investigation into the events in Cologne is still ongoing; I therefore do not think it appropriate to speculate about possible underlying causes.
Volledigheidshalve merk ik op dat het onderzoek naar de gebeurtenissen in Keulen nog loopt; ik vind het daarom niet gepast om te speculeren over mogelijke onderliggende oorzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de onderhoudskosten van de Gouden Koets

Pechtold (D66) asked the Prime Minister about the total and annual cost of major maintenance on the Gouden Koets and which work was planned. Rutte answered that costs are paid from the royal household budget without extra tax burden, that the detailed cost lists and studies cannot be shared because of the King's constitutional freedom to organise his household, and that restoration will take several years in phases.
If individual expenditures within the three components of budget article 2 had to be made transparent to everyone, this would not be consistent with Article 41 of the Constitution.
Zouden individuele uitgaven binnen de drie componenten van het begrotingsartikel 2 transparant moeten worden gemaakt voor een ieder, dan spoort dit niet met artikel 41 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over ‘Toenemende twijfels over neerhalen Russisch gevechtsvliegtuig door Turkije’

MP Knops (CDA) asked the government whether it still believes Turkey's account of shooting down a Russian Su-24, given analyses of radar data suggesting the jet did not clearly enter Turkish airspace, and whether the Netherlands has independent intelligence. The government replied that the exact circumstances cannot be verified from the released radar images alone, that it relies on the consistent assessments of several allies and NATO's Secretary General, does not comment publicly on intelligence sources, and sees no reason for an international investigation.
The cabinet does not publicly comment on the information position or sources of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over de informatiepositie of bronnen van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de brief van commissievoorzitter Juncker aan de Turkse regering met beloftes over de toetredingsonderhandelingen van Turkije tot de EU

Omtzigt asked the government about a letter from Commission President Juncker to Turkey promising progress on EU accession talks, including whether the Commission committed to finishing preparatory work for chapters 15, 26, 23 and 24 by 1 April, and about Turkey's human rights and Copenhagen criteria. The minister answered that the Commission's commitment only concerns completing preparatory documents, that the Netherlands supports treating rule-of-law chapters 23 and 24 with Cypriot blockade in place, and referred back to earlier letters for the rest.
The content was first communicated to your House in the report of the EU-Turkey Summit of 29 November, sent to your House on 2 December.
Over de inhoud ervan is uw Kamer voor het eerst geïnformeerd in het verslag van de EU Turkije Top van 29 november, dat uw Kamer op 2 december is toegegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over ontbrekende primaire radargegevens, de ontbrekende satellietbeelden en het ontbrekende gesprek met de luchtverkeerleider in het onderzoek van de Onderzoeksraad vo

MPs Omtzigt and Sjoerdsma asked the government about missing primary radar data, missing satellite images and the absence of an interview with the Ukrainian air traffic controller in the OVV's MH17 investigation. The minister answered that the OVV is independent, that its conclusions are not affected by the missing data, and that the government facilitated the investigation while declining to detail which information was requested from partner states.
Disclosure would give insight into the course of the investigation and could put pressure on ongoing discussions with requested states.
Openbaarmaking zou inzicht geven in de loop van het onderzoek en lopende besprekingen met aangezochte staten onder druk kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de vermeende beïnvloeding van de NOS door het Koninklijk Huis

MP Verhoeven asked whether a phone call expressing displeasure from the Royal House over an NOS satirical clip during a sports gala occurred, and whether there was pressure on media. The Prime Minister answered that no call was made on behalf of the Royal House during the broadcast, only a brief personal SMS from a Royal House staff member, with no intent to influence content, and declined further investigation.
During the broadcast in question, no one on behalf of or from the Royal House telephoned to express displeasure about the broadcast.
Er is gedurende de bewuste uitzending niet door of namens leden van het KH getelefoneerd om ongenoegen over de uitzending uit te drukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de demagogische uitlatingen van eurocommissaris Timmermans

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Prime Minister whether the government would distance itself from European Commissioner Timmermans' remarks that the only alternative to the EU is war, and whether it would urge a return to the EEG. Minister Koenders answered that he does not share the 'demagogic war rhetoric' characterisation, sees no reason to distance the government from the speech, and that a return to the EEG does not match cabinet policy.
No, this speech gives no reason to do so.
Nee, deze speech geeft daartoe geen aanleiding.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de uitlatingen van de Nederlandse Vertegenwoordiger bij het Politiek en Veiligheidscomité van de EU, over het immigratiebeleid de "Merkel-way"

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch representative's remarks praising Merkel's migration policy as an opportunity, and whether the government would distance itself from it. The minister answered by referring to existing government positions on migration and EU asylum packages, without explicitly disavowing the remarks, and said the Netherlands would act as an honest broker during its EU presidency.
Are you willing to distance yourself from the remarks of the representative concerned?
Bent u bereid afstand te nemen van de uitlatingen van de betreffende Vertegenwoordiger
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het neerhalen van een Russisch gevechtsvliegtuig door Turkije

An MP from the CDA asks the government about Turkey's shootdown of a Russian Su-24, questioning Turkey's account (the 17-second claim, speed calculations, Rules of Engagement, warnings) and whether NATO should investigate. The ministers answer that the government has no independent information, sees no reason for its own investigation, considers Turkey's right to protect its airspace subject to necessity and proportionality, and backs NATO's call for de-escalation without taking a position on the legal merits.
The cabinet does not have sufficient information to make well-founded statements about the application of those requirements in this specific case.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over voldoende informatie om gefundeerde uitspraken te kunnen doen over de toepassing van die vereisten in dit specifieke geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over de uitspraken van de heer Samsom over het toelaten van 200.000 asielzoekers in Nederland

Wilders asked the Prime Minister whether Samsom's claim that the Netherlands supports admitting 200,000 refugees is true, citing cost estimates and a SCP survey, and demanded he distance himself and end the coalition with the PvdA. Rutte answered only that Samsom placed refugee reception in an international perspective and that the cabinet favours controlling flows, including reception in the region, and refused to end the coalition.
Together with the cabinet he is of the view that efforts should be focused on controlling the refugee flow, including through reception in the region.
Met het kabinet is hij van mening dat ingezet moet worden op beheersing van de vluchtelingenstroom, onder meer door opvang in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de uitlating van de president van Oekraïne met betrekking tot het aanstaande referendum over het associatieverdrag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Prime Minister how to read President Poroshenko's remark that the Dutch referendum does not stop the EU-Ukraine association agreement, and why the government did not react. Foreign Minister Koenders answered that the agreement only enters into force once all parties, including the Netherlands, ratify it, that Dutch ratification is suspended pending the advisory referendum, and that the agreement is partly applied provisionally.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de brief, die Europarlementarier Schaake (D66/ALDE) samen met 33 Europarlementariers aan eurocommissaris Timmermans geschreven heeft op 10 december 2015

Omtzigt asks whether the government will disclose the Juncker letter to Turkey's prime minister, all deal elements, and details of the refugee redistribution proposal before the EU summit debate. Minister Koenders replies that the government cannot share the Commission letter as it is an official Commission document, points to earlier letters for the deal's contents, and says the redistribution proposal will be shared with parliament in the usual way.
The cabinet is not authorised to give access to this letter between the European Commission and a third party.
Het kabinet is niet gemachtigd inzage te geven in deze brief tussen de Europese Commissie en een derde partij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van Koning Willem-Alexander aan China

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked whether the King's private holiday in China before the state visit, and his failure to voice human rights concerns personally, undermined the message on human rights in China. The minister replied that the King raised human rights in the banquet speech and at CELAP, that the government consistently prioritises human rights, and that a dialogue is maintained.
The cabinet does not share this view.
Het kabinet deelt deze opvatting niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verkrijgen van panda’s uit China

An MP asked whether three former Prime Ministers wrote letters to China to obtain pandas, what those letters argued, and whether the cabinet accepts animals as diplomatic currency and taxpayer money is involved. The minister answered that the loan is part of a wider conservation project with Ouwehands Dierenpark funded by the zoo, declined to provide the letters as a commitment, and stated that no Dutch government money was invested.
Can the House be given access to all letters written by the cabinet regarding the supply of pandas?
Kan de Kamer inzage krijgen alle brieven die vanuit het kabinet inzake de levering van panda’s zijn geschreven?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over dolfijnenslachtingen en de walvisjacht als onderwerp van de economische missie naar Japan

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked how the government would press its opposition to Japanese dolphin hunts and whaling during the economic mission to Japan, and how it used the EU-Japan trade agreement to secure a whaling moratorium. The government answered that it raised its position with Prime Minister Abe, promised to inform parliament afterwards, and said it backs the Commission's push for an ambitious sustainability and animal welfare chapter in the trade deal.
The Netherlands, like several other member states, has repeatedly urged the European Commission to include an ambitious chapter on sustainability and animal welfare in the EU-Japan trade agreement.

Nederland heeft – net als verscheidene andere lidstaten – bij de Europese Commissie meerdere malen aangedrongen om een ambitieus hoofdstuk over duurzaamheid en dierenwelzijn in het handelsverdrag tussen de EU en Japan op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over EU-Turkije top

MP Omtzigt asked the government for the EU-Turkey deal text, a report of the summit, a list of commitments for each party, Turkish funding and Dutch contributions, resettlement and refugee-convention commitments, returns of migrants, budget implications and whether a parliamentary reservation was made. The minister answered that the action plan is provided via a letter, that Dutch funding (up to EUR 117 million extra, EUR 3 billion EU-wide) will be decided in the Spring Memorandum, and that no general parliamentary reservation was made, while leaving detailed modalities and resettlement commitments largely open.
No concrete agreements have been made on resettlement of refugees from Turkey.
Over hervestiging van vluchtelingen vanuit Turkije zijn geen concrete afspraken gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Omtzigt over het bericht van de Kiesraad “Groen licht voor referendum over Associatieovereenkomst Oekraïne”

MPs Verhoeven and Omtzigt asked about the Kiesraad's approval of a referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement, whether partners were informed, how the public will be informed, and the agreement's provisional application and ratification status. The government answered that the referendum does not affect provisional application, that the ratification law's entry-into-force provision lapsed, and that it will follow the Advisory Referendum Act, with a further decision on any rejection to be made later.
The cabinet will follow the Advisory Referendum Act.
Het kabinet zal de Wet raadgevend referendum volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Hachchi over de uitspraken dat een Nederlandse militair die is overgelopen naar ISIS beter ‘daar kan sneuvelen’

Two MPs asked the government whether the Minister-President's and Defence Minister's remarks that a Dutch soldier who defected to ISIS could better die there were government policy, and about related questions on citizenship loss, prosecution and punishment. The government answered that the remark was a reaction to a multiple-choice question, not cabinet policy, that the soldier will be arrested and questioned on return, that ongoing criminal investigation prevents further disclosure, and that a bill to expand citizenship revocation for terrorism is pending.
The Public Prosecution Service (OM) has started an investigation into criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) is een onderzoek gestart naar strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het voorstel van de Belgische premier om de Schengen-akkoorden open te breken

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government backs Belgium's proposal to reopen the Schengen agreements amid terrorism and migration pressure, and whether it will support the Australian model. The government answered that no change to Schengen rules is currently needed, that internal border controls can be intensified under existing rules, and that it will raise the issue in the Luxembourg presidency's December discussions.
For now there is no need to amend the Schengen rules to counter illegal migration flows within the Schengen area.
Vooralsnog is er geen noodzaak de Schengenregelgeving aan te passen om de illegale migratiestromen binnen het Schengengebied tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van Raak over de extra kosten bij de verbouwing van Huis ten Bosch

MPs Pechtold and Van Raak asked why the renovation of Huis ten Bosch cost almost double the earlier estimate and whether the cost figure would hold. The minister said the higher cost reflects detailed technical research and a higher per-square-metre price, and that the budget of 59 million euros is binding, with the requested documents partly released under the Wob.
For security reasons, among others, part of the information could not be made public.
Om onder meer veiligheidsredenen kon een deel van de informatie niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de afwezigheid van de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao bij de Troonrede

MP Van Raak (SP) asked the Prime Minister why Curaçao's authorised minister was absent from the Speech from the Throne and when the Curaçao government informed the government of this absence. The Prime Minister answered that the minister was accompanying Curaçao's Prime Minister on a working visit to Milan and Rome, notified the government by letter of 8 September, and was replaced by a deputy so that Curaçao was represented.
The authorised Minister of Curaçao accompanied the Prime Minister of her country on a working visit to Milan and Rome from 14 to 17 September 2015.
De gevolmachtigde Minister van Curaçao vergezelde de Minister-President van haar land bij een werkbezoek aan Milaan en Rome van 14 tot en met 17 september 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar lekken

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether there were concrete indications that Prinsjesdag budget plans had leaked from ministries, whether he supported a criminal investigation into the leaks proposed by a minister, and when it would start. The government replied that a criminal investigation into leaks can be ordered but that the circle of people with access may be so broad that an investigation would be costly and fruitless, so no investigation is requested.
In this case, therefore, no criminal investigation is requested.
In dit geval wordt daarom niet verzocht om een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het lekken van de plannen voor Prinsjesdag

An MP asks the Prime Minister about leaks of the Prinsjesdag budget plans, the embargo, possible penalties and whether a leak complaint was filed. The government says it will not comment on the accuracy of the leaks, no complaint has been filed, and there are no concrete indications that ministers or officials leaked confidential information.
The cabinet has no concrete indications that confidential information was leaked by ministers or officials.
Het kabinet heeft geen concrete aanwijzingen dat vertrouwelijke informatie door bewindspersonen of ambtenaren is gelekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Franse voorstel een eigen regering te vormen voor de eurozone

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government shares opposition to French president Hollande's idea of a separate eurozone government and parliament, and whether the euro project has failed and should be dismantled. The minister replied that the cabinet's view on EMU is set out in its letter on the Five Presidents Report, that it values democratic legitimacy and national parliaments' role, and that a eurozone government is not on the table.
In that context the cabinet wants to ensure that the principle of subsidiarity is safeguarded and that national parliaments remain responsible for national policy.
Daarbij wil het kabinet erop toezien dat het subsidiariteitsbeginsel geborgd blijft en nationale parlementen verantwoordelijk blijven voor nationaal beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma en Omtzigt over het aftreden van de Griekse premier

Two CDA MPs asked whether the cabinet knew in advance of the Greek prime minister's planned resignation and snap elections, what this means for implementing the Greek bailout, and whether an Eurogroup meeting would be convened. The government answered that it was not informed beforehand, that calling elections is a sovereign Greek decision not in conflict with the agreement, that an interim government cannot take binding decisions, and that the next Eurogroup meeting is on 12 September.
A decision to hold early elections is a sovereign decision of Greece.
Een besluit tot vervroegde verkiezingen is een soeverein besluit van Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over ook een Nederlandse onderscheiding voor de Thalys-helden

Wilders asked whether the four men who overpowered the Thalys attacker should receive a Dutch honour, given that Dutch passengers were likely spared. The minister answered that France and Belgium had honoured them, that the Netherlands supports this and was represented at the ceremony, and that the cabinet will not award an additional Dutch decoration.

The cabinet is of the view that the above-mentioned decorations from the countries first involved have appropriately honoured the heroes' actions and will therefore not award an additional Dutch decoration.

Het kabinet is van mening dat met bovengenoemde onderscheidingen van de eerst betrokken landen op passende wijze eer is betoond aan het optreden van de helden en zal daarom niet aanvullend een Nederlandse onderscheiding uitreiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het doodvonnis voor de Egyptische oud-president Mohammed Morsi

An MP asked the government about the death sentence against former Egyptian president Morsi, whether it was political, why the Netherlands had not spoken out more firmly, what diplomatic, legal and political steps it would take, and about the scale of death sentences in Egypt. The government answered that it opposes the death penalty, has raised concerns bilaterally and through the EU and UN, but declined to send a special envoy or to pursue the steps asked, and gave no firm new commitments.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to separately appoint a Dutch special envoy to raise the death sentences in Egypt.
Om die reden acht het kabinet het niet opportuun om separaat een Nederlandse speciale gezant aan te wijzen om de doodvonnissen in Egypte aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over de Bilderbergconferentie

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister about topics discussed at the 2015 Bilderberg conference, his own contributions, and the travel costs. The Prime Minister answered that the organisers published the main topics, that the Chatham House rule applies so his own input is not disclosed, and that his travel and accommodation cost 1,590 euros borne by the state.
The Chatham House rule applies to the meeting, which ensures a meaningful exchange of views.
Voor de bijeenkomst geldt de Chatham House rule, die een zinvolle gedachtewisseling verzekert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de vervolging wegens de ‘fuck de koning-uitspraak’

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government whether article 111 of the Criminal Code (insult of the King) is outdated, whether prosecution under it should be deprioritised, whether its five-year maximum sentence and its compatibility with free speech are justified, and whether it should be repealed. The Minister referred back to earlier answers to D66 questions and refused to repeal the provision, defending it as it stands.
Are you willing to repeal article 111 of the Criminal Code? If not, why not?
Bent u bereid artikel 111 Sr te schrappen? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Schouw over het vervolgen van een activist voor het beledigen van de koning en de koningin

Two D66 MPs asked the government about the prosecution of an activist for insulting the King and Queen (lese majesty), questioning whether arresting him was justified and whether these articles should still be enforced. The Minister of Security and Justice answered that the OM decides on prosecution, the case was dropped after the objection, and that lese majesty provisions remain in force, to be applied prudently and only when necessary, while providing prosecution figures for recent years.
The OM has since informed the suspect and his counsel that the case has been dismissed.
Het OM heeft inmiddels aan de verdachte en diens raadsman laten weten dat de zaak is geseponeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Jan Vos over de handelsmissie naar India en het verzoek van een aantal NGO’s om te pleiten voor de vrijheid van organisatie en meningsuiting

MPs Servaes and Jan Vos asked the Prime Minister and ministers whether the government would press India during the trade mission to protect freedom of association and expression, given reported restrictions on NGOs such as Greenpeace and visa refusals. The minister answered that the government shares concern about shrinking space for international NGOs in India, raised it with Indian officials and agreed to discuss NGO cooperation in coming months, but left constitutional judgments to Indian courts and only promised reporting in the quarterly letter.

During my meeting with Minister of State Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary I emphasised that a free, independent, active and critical civil society, through dialogue with businesses and governments, can contribute greatly to inclusive growth and development.

Ik benadrukte tijdens mijn onderhoud met Minister of State, Mr Haribhai P. Chaudhary dat een vrij, onafhankelijk, actief en kritisch maatschappelijk middenveld via een dialoog met bedrijven en overheden veel kan bijdragen aan inclusieve groei en ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de tientallen miljoenen extra voor de verbouwing van een paleis

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the renovation of Huis ten Bosch palace would cost EUR 60 million instead of EUR 35 million, requested a breakdown, and asked what measures would prevent the higher cost. The government answered by referring to a separate letter on the palace renovation rather than answering the questions in this document.

The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes (both Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren), question number 2015Z09557, have been answered by means of the letter 'Renovation of Huis ten Bosch palace' (Parliamentary paper 34 000-XVIII, no. 22).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (beiden Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren), vraagnummer 2015Z09557 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief « Renovatie paleis Huis ten Bosch » (Kamerstuk 34 000-XVIII, nr. 22 )

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het verzoek van de Nederlandse regering aan de Europese Commissie om alle documenten en briefwisselingen tussen Nederland en de Europese Commissie over de naheffing van 642 mil

An MP asks why the government asked the European Commission to keep correspondence about the 642 million euro levy secret, and demands the letter and emails be released. The government refuses to provide the Commission correspondence, citing diplomatic confidentiality and Wob exceptions, and says Article 68 of the Constitution rather than the Wob governs its duty to parliament.
Providing the correspondence with the European Commission itself is, in line with the cited cabinet position, considered undesirable.
Verstrekking van correspondentie met de Europese Commissie zelf achten wij, in lijn met genoemd kabinetsstandpunt, onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma, Slob, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Roemer over het bed, bad, brood compromis

MPs from several parties asked the government to explain its reliance on the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers resolution rejecting the ECSR findings on basic provision for irregular migrants, the conditional 'bed, bath, bread' shelter scheme tied to return cooperation, the funding and sanction mechanism for municipalities, and the buitenschuld permit system. The government answered that the ECSR findings have no basis in the treaty, that Article 3 ECHR sets the floor, that shelter in pre-VBL locations will be time-limited and tied to return efforts, and that details will be settled with the VNG.
It is not for the ECSR to pronounce on the rights of persons residing illegally in our country.
Het is dan ook niet aan het ECSR om zich uit te spreken over de rechten van illegaal in ons land verblijvende personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob, Van der Staaij en Wilders over de herdenking van de Armeense genocide

MPs Slob, Van der Staaij and Wilders asked whether the cabinet still backs the Rouvoet motion urging Turkey's recognition of the Armenian genocide, given the minister's view that history is not for the cabinet to interpret, and whether a minister would attend the 100-year commemoration in Armenia or in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the cabinet maintains the motion's supportive interpretation and that the Dutch ambassador to Georgia, also accredited to Armenia, will attend the Armenia commemoration, with attendance at other events decided case by case.
The cabinet maintains the interpretation that previous cabinets have given to the motion.
Het kabinet handhaaft de interpretatie die voorgaande kabinetten aan de motie hebben gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een verleende subsidie aan de nieuwe minister van Veiligheid en Justitie

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a 437,362 euro heritage subsidy to 't Huys te Warmont, a castle partly inhabited by the new Minister of Security and Justice, complied with rules excluding occupied dwellings and the 3% rebuilding-cost cap. The government replied that castles are not classed as dwellings under the Brim rules, the subsidy was granted lawfully under the 2006 rules then in force, and the owner's office shares the minister's home address.
Dwelling houses are excluded from a Brim subsidy.
Woonhuizen zijn uitgesloten van een Brim-subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat de website van de Rijksoverheid plat lag door een DDoS-aanval

An MP from D66 asked about a DDoS attack that took the central government website offline, the status of 2013 counter-measures, attacker identity, a cybersecurity conference agenda and the lack of an emergency website. The minister confirmed awareness, reported progress on the 2013 measures, said attackers are unknown, a criminal complaint was filed, and promised a supplier improvement plan and a further legislative proposal in 2015.
The Ministry of General Affairs has filed a criminal complaint.
Het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken heeft aangifte gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het uitblijven van excuses voor de passieve houding van de Nederlandse regering ten tijde van de jodenvervolging

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the Dutch government never apologised for its passive role in the persecution of Jews during WWII, including inaction on wartime reports of mass murder, and whether it will now apologise. The Prime Minister's answer refers only to Queen Beatrix's 1995 Knesset speech, which assessed the Dutch stance, and to his own condemnations of antisemitism, without addressing the apology question.
Queen Beatrix's speech to the Knesset on 28 March 1995 contains the government's assessment of the Dutch stance towards the persecution of Jews in the Second World War.
De rede van Koningin Beatrix voor de Knesset op 28 maart 1995 bevat de beoordeling door de regering van de Nederlandse opstelling ten aanzien van de jodenvervolging in de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht dat het verslag van de diplomatenbriefing geheim blijft

An MP asked why the government will not send the report of the diplomatic briefing on MH17 to parliament, even confidentially, and whether withholding it limits parliamentary scrutiny. The minister answered that the report is confidential, was given to the Safety Board (OVV) for its ongoing independent investigation, that only its gist was shared with parliament, and that findings will be shared later.
The report has been made available to the OVV in accordance with the Safety Board Act, for the purpose of the ongoing and independent investigation.
Het verslag is ter beschikking gesteld aan de OVV in overeenstemming met de rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid, ten behoeve van het lopende en onafhankelijke onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de golf van incidenten jegens moskeeën

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a wave of incidents against mosques, including threats, vandalism and arson, and about police registration of anti-Muslim discrimination, protection of mosques and prosecution. Minister Opstelten answered that the government condemns such attacks, will improve registration of Muslim discrimination and report on it separately, will take protective measures where threat warrants, and will apply prosecution policy with aggravated sentencing for discriminatory offences.
No public statement is made about information received from the intelligence and security services.
Over ontvangen informatie van inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten wordt in het openbaar geen uitspraak gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Van Haersma Buma, Wilders, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij naar aanleiding van zijn uitspraken tijdens het debat op 14 januari jl. over de aanslagen in Parijs

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister whether his remark that the AIVD, with current staffing and funding, can do its job was meant regarding jihadism, how many staff track returnees, whether budget cuts reduced coverage and staff quality, and how police, mayors and national government coordinate. The government replied that all eleven questions were already answered in an earlier letter to parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288), without giving substance in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by letter 'extra measures counterterrorism and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Kamerstuk 29 754, no. 288).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de affaire Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about the Demmink affair, including a Turkish document on entry records, the handling of security reports, costs of legal aid for former secretary-general Demmink, and contacts between officials and MPs. The minister answered that the Turkish document was passed to the Public Prosecution Service and a letter rogatory was sent, declined to comment on the content of documents in an ongoing criminal investigation, provided cost tables, and said security dossiers are kept by the AIVD and that the department does not keep records of MP contacts.
I do not comment on the content of documents that form part of an ongoing criminal investigation.
Ik doe geen mededeling over de inhoud van documenten die onderdeel zijn van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de affaire Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked the Minister of Justice to comment on testimony that former SG Demmink was under investigation in the Rolodex case, contrary to earlier denials, and on a former detective's statement that he was tasked to follow Demmink. The Minister said the Public Prosecution Service found no information confirming the testimony, and that the statements are being considered in a separate prosecutorial investigation, so he declined to comment further.
In that light, I refrain from commenting.
In dat licht onthoud ik mij van commentaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de uitspraak van de rechter die het AD in het gelijk heeft gesteld in de zaak Demmink

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the Justice Ministry would pay the legal costs of former secretary-general Demmink after a court ruled the AD's publications lawful, and whether the ministry would further investigate the allegations. Minister Opstelten answered that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating other allegations, that he will not judge any investigation, and that he would reconsider reimbursement if Demmink appealed and sought costs.
Against that background, I will therefore refrain from giving a substantive judgement on any investigation into the former secretary-general of my ministry.
Tegen die achtergrond zal ik mij dan ook onthouden van het geven van een inhoudelijk oordeel ten aanzien van enig onderzoek naar de voormalige secretaris-generaal van mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de Europese naheffing die op 30 december 2014 betaald gaat worden

An MP asked the Finance Minister why the Netherlands was surprised by the EU levy, why internal emails and the 17 October 2014 negotiation note (stuk 75) were withheld under the Wob, and when the Parliament was told about the 30 December payment date. The minister answered that the surprise concerned the size of the levy, that stuk 75 was withheld to protect confidentiality of negotiations and Dutch relations with other states, and that Parliament was informed of the payment date via the Najaarsnota and a supplementary budget.

I previously set out to your House, by letter of 13 November 2014, the reasons underlying the decision not to make public the report of the Permanent Representation in Brussels of 17 October 2014, document 75.

Ik heb eerder, per brief van 13 november 2014, aan uw Kamer de redenen uiteengezet die ten grondslag liggen aan het besluit het verslag van de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging in Brussel van 17 oktober 2014, stuk75, niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de reconstructie van gebeurtenissen na de aanslag op de MH17 in het politievakblad Blauw

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about a Blauw police magazine reconstruction of the Dutch forensic team's work after MH17, including contacts with separatist leader Borodai, a request to Van Vliet to approach separatists, and surprise at Malaysian investigators on the train. The government answered that no direct negotiations took place, that contacts ran via the OSCE, that the SGBO asked Van Vliet to arrange access via the OSCE, and that the Malaysian presence was on Malaysia's own initiative with no concrete cooperation agreements yet.
On 21 July there was no question of direct negotiations with the separatists.
Er was op 21 juli geen sprake van rechtstreekse onderhandelingen met de separatisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Beertema over het bericht ‘Kritiek op royale vertrekpremie Van Rompuy’

PVV MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the Prime Minister whether he regretted honouring Van Rompuy and whether the former European Council President's roughly 630,000 euro departure payment was theft, and whether the honour should be reclaimed. Minister Koenders replied that the entitlement is a legal transitional allowance under EU rules, the actual net amount is about 349,000 euro over up to three years, no relocation allowance applies, and the Netherlands is examining further modernisation of EU political office-holder arrangements.
The amount of 630,000 euro mentioned in some media is therefore incorrect.
Het in sommige media genoemde bedrag van € 630.000 is derhalve onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over het bericht “Mansveld niet naar klimaattop in Lima”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister why the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment would not attend the Lima climate summit, whether a substitute minister should go, and what this means for Dutch negotiating room on emissions targets and climate finance. The government replied that the climate envoy substitutes for the state secretary, that the EU negotiating team has a binding mandate so her absence does not affect negotiating room, and that the Dutch points will be raised by the envoy.
A team of negotiators from the Member States and the European Commission is negotiating in Lima on behalf of the EU, within the mandate set out in Council conclusions.
Een team van onderhandelaars uit de Lidstaten en de Europese Commissie onderhandelt in Lima – binnen het in raadsconclusies vastgelegde mandaat – namens de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de naheffing

An MP asked the Finance Minister and Prime Minister about the 2014 EU budget surcharge (naheffing), including when Eurostat reservations were known, who in government knew and when, and the correspondence with the European Commission. The minister answered almost every question by referring to earlier letters and debates, while answering question 9 and 10 only in general terms and pointing to Ecofin reports.
I informed you about this on 3 November in answering the parliamentary questions on the consequences of the macroeconomic revisions for the EU contributions.
Ik heb u hierover op 3 november geïnformeerd bij de beantwoording van de Kamervragen over de gevolgen van de macro-economische revisies voor de EU-afdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Omtzigt over de naheffing bij 5 miljoen Nederlanders

An MP asks why the government did not disclose earlier the estimated 800 million euro reclaimed from 5 to 6 million taxpayers caused by the incomplete implementation of the tax credit phase-outs, and when ministers knew of the problem. The State Secretary gives indicative amounts, explains the systems constraints, and states the issue was communicated and known since 2013, while rejecting the term 'errors' and announcing communication steps.
From the moment this measure was decided, it was therefore clear that the phase-out in 2014 would lead to additional payments or lower refunds on the final assessment in 2015 for 2014.
Vanaf het moment dat tot deze maatregel werd besloten was dus duidelijk dat de afbouw in 2014 zou leiden tot bijbetalingen of lagere teruggaven bij de definitieve aanslag in 2015 over 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en Wilders over de ebola uitbraak

Two PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands was not part of a ministerial emergency meeting on Ebola, whether the government takes the public health risk seriously, and whether it will push for an EU-wide halt to flights from West Africa. The Minister replied that no invitation was received, that the risk is taken seriously with reference to a letter, and that she rejects flight bans because the virus should be isolated and regional borders kept open.
No. The three affected countries have, in line with WHO guidelines, introduced exit screening.
Nee. De drie getroffen landen hebben, conform de WHO richtlijnen, exit screening ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de relatie tussen prins Bernhard en de geheime diensten

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Bernhard ordered the BVD in 1995 to provide information on a US intelligence file about him, what other orders he gave, whether he informed the PM, and whether the CTIVD should investigate his contacts with security services. The government answered that Bernhard was not a commissioning party of the BVD or other services, that the services acted within legal frameworks, and that a parliamentary motion for an investigation was rejected in December 2013.
The late Prince Bernhard was not a commissioning party of the BVD or other secret services.
Wijlen prins Bernhard was geen opdrachtgever van de BVD of andere geheime diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het functioneren van de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister which law says he cannot have a good conversation with the Curaçao plenipotentiary minister about her performance, and why he fears that conversation. The Prime Minister replied that his earlier answer contained no suggestion or fear, only a reference to advisory opinion from the Council of State.
The answer to earlier questions contains no suggestions or fear, but a reference to the advisory opinion of the Council of State's Advisory Division.
De beantwoording van eerdere vragen bevat geen suggesties of angst maar een verwijzing naar de voorlichting van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Raak over het bericht ‘Curaçao: De bokkensprongen van Marvelyne Wiels’

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would hold a good talk with the Curaçao plenipotentiary minister after a media report about the conduct of Marvelyne Wiels. The Prime Minister replied that media reports do not change the constitutional relationship between the plenipotentiary minister and the Curaçao government, referring to a Council of State advisory opinion.
Media reporting does not change the constitutional relationship between the plenipotentiary minister and the government of the country concerned.
Berichtgeving in de media brengt geen wijziging in de staatkundige verhouding tussen de gevolmachtigde Minister en de regering van het betreffende land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de Griekse woning van de Koning

An MP asked the Prime Minister about the state's acquisition of an easement over land around the King's Greek holiday home, its cost, the security arrangements, the withheld inspection report and the terms of the pier agreement. The government answered most questions substantively, explained the easement route and costs, but declined to publish the inspection report before the easement ends and withheld total security costs citing protection of persons.
The inspection report mentioned in the deed will only be drawn up when the easement ends, in order to establish what must be removed or adjusted to restore the strips of land to their former state.

Het in de akte genoemde inspectierapport wordt pas opgemaakt wanneer het recht van erfdienstbaarheid zal eindigen, om daarmee vast te stellen wat er dient te worden verwijderd of te worden aangepast om de stroken grond in de oude staat te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Kooiman en Van Gerven over de publicatie ‘Verstand op veilig’

MPs Smaling, Kooiman and Van Gerven asked whether the government shares concerns from a Rathenau Instituut report that marketisation has strained the core tasks of national-security knowledge institutes, and whether it will convene stakeholders, examine horizontal cooperation and review inspectorates' reliance on these institutes. The minister denied that marketisation is a problem, cited existing funding and statutory safeguards, and declined new round-tables, new horizontal structures or a review, saying existing forums suffice.
The cabinet sees no reason in the report to sit down with the institutions concerned and other relevant parties outside existing forums where this already happens.
Het kabinet ziet in het rapport geen aanleiding om met de betrokken instellingen en andere relevante partijen om tafel te zitten buiten verbanden waarin dat al gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de uitspraken in de media van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het hek rondom de Griekse woning van de Koning

An MP asked the Prime Minister about media statements by the Justice Minister on a security fence around the King's Greek residence, including alternatives to land swaps and the basis for minimum distances. The government answered that no land exchange was considered, declined to disclose the distance standards for security reasons, and gave a timeline for the remaining answers.
For security reasons I will not make further statements on this.
Om veiligheidsredenen doe ik hier verder geen uitspraken over.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de artikelen 'Nederlandse Joden huren bewaking in', 'Angst onder Rotterdamse joden na bedreiging op straat', 'Gesprek moet helpen' en 'Antisemitisme: 'Zo doen wij

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the government about press reports on Jewish security, antisemitism, a housing association's letters ordering removal of an Israeli flag, Muslim discrimination, and revoking Dutch nationality from jihadist travellers. The minister answered that the housing association regretted its letters and no action is planned, an antisemitism study is due in early 2015, and nationality can only be revoked after a terrorism conviction under limited conditions.
A study into possible breeding grounds and triggering factors for antisemitism ... will be delivered in early 2015.
Een onderzoek naar mogelijke voedingsbodems en triggerfactoren voor antisemitisme ... zal begin 2015 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende antisemitische golf die ons land overspoelt

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the government about a rising wave of antisemitic incidents in the Netherlands, including a violent attack, and why they had not yet adopted ten proposed action points. Minister Asscher answered that the government rejects antisemitism, will hold a round table and an interfaith meeting, and will inform parliament on jihadism and prevention measures, but did not commit to adopting the specific ten action points.

The cabinet will, as also announced in the joint statement after the meeting with Jewish organisations on 4 August, take the initiative with all parties involved, following several municipalities, to discuss the rising tensions between groups and intervene where necessary.

Het kabinet zal, zoals ook is aangekondigd in de gemeenschappelijke verklaring na het overleg met de Joodse organisaties op 4 augustus jongstleden, in navolging van verschillende gemeenten, het initiatief nemen met alle betrokken partijen om de oplopende spanningen tussen groepen te bespreken en waar nodig te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer en Leijten over de ebola-uitbraak in West-Afrika

SP MPs asked the government to explain the WHO's declaration of the West African Ebola outbreak as a public health emergency, which requests for help Dutch authorities had received, whether Nederland would provide solidarity and logistical support, and why. The minister answered that Nederland contributes about 822,600 euro via Artsen Zonder Grenzen and the Red Cross plus indirect funding through the EU, CERF and WHO, and that a further WHO request for medical experts and field hospitals was still being studied.
At this moment the recent WHO request, which in addition to financial support also asks for medical experts, field hospitals, etc., is still being studied.
Op dit moment wordt het recente verzoek van de WHO, waarin naast financiële steun ook wordt verzocht om medische experts veldziekenhuizen, etc nog bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren naar aanleiding van het bericht “CPB onderzoekt gevolgen “instortend” Schiphol”

An MP asked whether the CPB is studying the economic effects of Schiphol losing its hub function and whether this affects the Lelystad expansion. The government denied any such commissioned study, explaining only that the CPB and PBL are updating long-term scenarios in which the hub position is one uncertainty, without economic effects being examined.
No. The Netherlands Bureau for Economic Policy Analysis (CPB) is not conducting research into the economic consequences of Schiphol losing its hub function, including in relation to Lelystad.
Nee. Het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) doet geen onderzoek naar de economische gevolgen van het wegvallen van de hubfunctie van Schiphol, ook niet in relatie tot Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over een anti ISIS demonstratie in de Schilderswijk op 10 augustus jl.

An MP from the PVV asked whether the government would tolerate an anti-ISIS demonstration in The Hague being disrupted by counter-demonstrators, whether police capitulated by changing the route, and whether those advocating violence should be expelled. The government answered that police did not capitulate, had agreed route changes beforehand to prevent disorder, and that existing legal powers suffice, without committing to new measures.
The police did not capitulate to the counter-demonstrators.
De politie heeft niet gecapituleerd voor de tegendemonstranten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht inzake felicitaties van het kabinet aan Erdogan met zijn verkiezing

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government condemns Erdogan's antisemitic remark comparing Israeli policy to Hitler's, whether it is aware of his record on press freedom and human rights, and why it congratulated him on his election. The Minister answered that congratulating heads of state with regular relations with the Netherlands is customary and the government sees no reason to depart from it.
It is customary to congratulate heads of government of states with which the Netherlands maintains regular relations on such occasions.
Het is gebruik om regeringsleiders van staten waarmee Nederland reguliere betrekkingen onderhoudt bij dergelijke gelegenheden te feliciteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Servaes over de situatie in Gaza

MP Servaes asked the government whether its view on Israeli strikes on schools and hospitals in Gaza had changed, whether it still expects Israel to respect necessity and proportionality, and how it judges US, UN and EU statements and its own contacts with Israel. The government condemned the strike on a UNRWA school, said it lacks facts for a firm judgement, called for an independent international investigation, and noted its contacts with Israeli leaders.
The cabinet does not have the necessary factual information about attacks on schools and hospitals to give a well-founded judgement on the circumstances of these attacks.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over de benodigde feitelijke informatie over aanvallen op scholen en ziekenhuizen om een gefundeerd oordeel te kunnen geven over de toedracht van deze aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi, Van Haersma Buma en Van Toorenburg over de onduidelijke antwoorden van de regering inzake de hongerstaking van minister-president van Aruba

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government how it prevented escalation with Aruba over the budget dispute, whether the College Financieel Toezicht was explicitly assigned the investigation, what solution it intends, whether a mediator should be appointed, and whether the Raad van State should rule on the lawfulness of the Rijksministerraad decision. The minister answered that the joint press statement clearly pointed to Cft staff, that a quick interim report and a final report within six weeks are expected, and that the royal decree was adopted lawfully, so no Raad van State ruling is sought.
With a view to the process of finding an acute solution, I do not consider it useful to make that communication public now.
Met het oog op het proces van het vinden van een acute oplossing, acht ik het niet dienstig die communicatie nu publiek te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi, Van Haersma Buma en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de Arubaanse premier Mike Eman in hongerstaking gaat

MPs from D66 and CDA asked whether Aruba's prime minister's hunger strike was caused by a Council of Ministers decision instructing the Governor not to sign Aruba's 2014 budget, and whether that decision was lawful. The minister replied that the Council acted lawfully, that the budget right remains with Aruba, and that the Governor's instruction is a temporary suspension pending an independent review.
The decisions of the Council of Ministers are taken carefully and lawfully.
De beslissingen van de Rijksministerraad komen zorgvuldig en rechtmatig tot stand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de betrokkenheid van de Nederlandse staat bij de beveiliging van een woning van de Koning in Griekenland

An MP asks how the Greek claim of public interest over a royal holiday home squares with the government's earlier position that such purchases are a private matter. The Prime Minister answers that a prior security assessment by Veiligheid en Justitie was positive and that the King's family is always protected, but does not explain how the claim fits the earlier position.
Prior to the purchase of the home in Greece, a positive assessment of the security aspects was carried out by Veiligheid en Justitie, including the security of the perimeter.

Voorafgaand aan de aankoop van de woning in Griekenland heeft een positieve beoordeling van de beveiligingsaspecten door Veiligheid en Justitie plaatsgevonden, waaronder de beveiliging van de perimeter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Recourt over de betrokkenheid van de Nederlandse staat bij de beveiliging van een woning van de koning in Griekenland

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Dutch state is involved in securing the King's holiday home in Greece, including a fence and a private harbour, and who pays. The government answered that state security responsibility extends to the royal family abroad in coordination with host authorities, the state pays security costs, a servitude covers a strip of land for a fence, and Greek authorities granted the necessary permits.

For the activities mentioned in the answer to question 4, aimed at securing the King, his family and their surroundings, the necessary permits and/or consents were granted and published by the Greek authorities.

Voor de in het antwoord op vraag 4 genoemde activiteiten ten behoeve van de beveiliging van de Koning, zijn gezin en hun omgeving zijn de benodigde vergunningen en/of toestemmingen verleend en gepubliceerd door de Griekse overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het bericht dat IJsland Nederlandse spaarders niet wil uitbetalen

An MP asked the Dutch government whether it would push Iceland to release Icesave deposit funds to Dutch savers, including the 100,000+ savers, and what steps it was taking. The government answered that it urges Iceland to grant exemptions for future estate payouts, that Iceland's central bank has not yet decided on a fifth payout request, and that efforts benefit all preferred creditors equally, with about €617 million of principal still outstanding.
The cabinet considers it of the utmost importance that the Icelandic authorities grant exemption without delay for future estate payouts
Het kabinet vindt het inderdaad van het grootste belang dat de IJslandse autoriteiten zonder vertraging vrijstelling verlenen voor toekomstige boedeluitkeringen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitspraken van de minister-president en zijn antwoorden op vragen over de rol van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de scheiding van machten

An SP MP asks the Prime Minister whether the Minister of Security and Justice's remark that a pending Public Prosecution Service investigation 'will come to nothing' was improper, given the separation of powers, and asks him to explain his own remark that the minister may speak more freely than other politicians. The government refers to a previous Handelingen answer instead of answering the questions directly.
For the answers to the questions, reference is made to the Appendix to the Handelingen, session 2013–2014, no. 1919.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen zij verwezen naar Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2013–2014, nr. 1919
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het monitoren en beïnvloeden van internetdiscussies over het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the Prime Minister whether ministry staff monitor and try to influence online discussions about the ministry's policy, and whether this is acceptable given citizens' freedom of expression. The minister replied that no staff are recruited to influence opinion, that monitoring media is a way to pick up signals from society, that staff must identify themselves as civil servants online, and that influencing discussions is outside the communication guidelines.
Ministers do not recruit staff to monitor and influence citizens' opinions about their policy and functioning.
Bewindslieden werven geen medewerkers om de meningsvorming van burgers over hun beleid en functioneren te volgen en te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de stijgende werkloosheid en de mogelijke komst van een banenplan

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister and Minister Asscher about rising unemployment at 8.7%, the withdrawal of young people from the labour market, and reported talks on a jobs plan with social partners. The government answered that unemployment is the top priority, attributed the levelling-off to discouragement effects, outlined existing measures, and said proposals from social partners would be considered in budget discussions.
The cabinet is willing to discuss any proposals from social partners with them and will then seriously consider them in the context of the budget discussions for the coming year.
