Het kabinet is bereid om eventuele voorstellen van sociale partners met hen te bespreken en zal ze dan serieus bezien in het kader van de begrotingsbesprekingen voor het komende jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht dat leden van het Europees Parlement 200 miljoen euro hebben gedeclareerd

PVV MPs Wilders and Madlener asked whether the cabinet would ensure strict checks on European Parliament members' office-cost declarations and whether Dutch MEPs avoid submitting receipts. The minister replied that office costs are paid as a flat-rate allowance without declarations, that the European Court of Auditors is responsible for public control, and that its audit found the EP's control systems effective.
Public control over these expenditures is the responsibility of the European Court of Auditors.
De publieke controle op deze uitgaven is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Europese Rekenkamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Segers en Dijkgraaf over het rapport “The European Union Integrity System” van Transparency International

MPs Omtzigt, Segers and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would act on Transparency International's report on EU integrity gaps (openness and corruption) and its 12 recommendations, whether it would raise the report at the European Council, and who should check EU institutions on rule of law. The minister said the government supports follow-up on transparency and anti-corruption measures in Council and EU fora, but declined to put the report on the European Council agenda, and stated the EU's rule-of-law oversight is shared with member states.
The cabinet attaches importance to the greatest possible transparency regarding European legislative and decision-making processes.
Het kabinet hecht aan een zo groot mogelijke transparantie ten aanzien van Europese wetgevings- en besluitvormingsprocessen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de uitkomsten van de Nederlandse ‘subsidiariteitsexercitie’

An MP from D66 asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister whether the Dutch 'subsidiarity exercise' yielded real results, citing press criticism that only a handful of the 54 action points succeeded, and whether the government's promises of a more focused EU were kept. The minister replied that results are still being negotiated, that the aim is a lasting change in EU behaviour, and that the government does not consider the outcome meagre.
The aim is a lasting change in behaviour. This is not something that happens overnight.
Het doel is een blijvende gedragsverandering. Dit is niet iets dat van de ene op de andere dag tot stand komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitspraken van de minister-president inzake de rol van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie bij lopende onderzoeken van het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP member asked Prime Minister Rutte whether he said the Minister of Security and Justice did not go too far with remarks about an ongoing Public Prosecution Service investigation, and what he meant by the minister being entitled to speak as the link between separated powers. Rutte denied linking the remarks to the investigation and explained that the minister is politically accountable for the Public Prosecution Service and may be questioned on it, while the prosecution is not hindered by his statements.
The Minister of Security and Justice bears ministerial responsibility for the Public Prosecution Service.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie draagt de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid voor het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het serveren van halal voedsel tijdens NSS2014

An MP asked whether all food served at the 2014 Nuclear Security Summit was halal, whether meat from non-stunned animals was served without guests being informed, and whether the government would stop serving such meat at officially commissioned meals. The state secretary answered that not all food was halal, that the caterer used both regular and halal-certified meat, and that the EU is studying mandatory labelling while government meals accommodate guests' dietary wishes.
The cabinet follows developments on this closely.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het Grondwetfestival en de openstelling van overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked whether the Grondwetfestival and opening of government buildings such as parliament, ministries and the Catshuis should be seen as a success, and whether such buildings should be open to the public at least annually, including Het Torentje. The minister agreed it was a success and said the ministry will take the initiative, with The Hague and partners, to explore a suitable follow-up to public openings of constitution-related buildings.

Following the findings of the National Committee 200 Years Kingdom on the Grondwet Festival, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will take the initiative, in consultation with The Hague municipality and other partners, to examine how a suitable follow-up can be given to attention for the Constitution and the opening of related buildings.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van het Nationaal Comité 200 jaar Koninkrijk over het Grondwet Festival zal het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties het initiatief nemen om in overleg met de gemeente Den Haag en andere partners te bezien op welke wijze een passend vervolg kan worden gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de agressie van de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao tegenover een journalist

The SP MP Van Raak asked the Prime Minister about the alleged assault by the Curaçao plenipotentiary minister on a journalist, asking whether it is acceptable, why bodyguards followed the journalist, and what the Prime Minister can do. The Prime Minister answered that the matter falls under the authority of Curaçao's own authorities and he will not take a position on it.
The matter to which the questions relate falls within the competence of the authorities of the country of Curaçao.
De aangelegenheid waarop de vragen betrekking hebben, behoort tot de bevoegdheid van de autoriteiten van het land Curacao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Bosma over het stemadvies van vice-premier Asscher

Wilders and Bosma asked the Prime Minister whether Vice-Premier Asscher's campaign advice against voting PVV reflected the whole cabinet and whether it was improper. The Prime Minister answered that Asscher did not call on voters to avoid the PVV, quoting his remark that such statements could be countered by making a different choice.
Mr Asscher did not call on people not to vote for the PVV.
De heer Asscher heeft niet opgeroepen niet op de PVV te stemmen.
Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66) aan de Minister-President en de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de aanbesteding Fotografie Beeldcentrum Overheid (ingezonden 7 februari 2014).

An MP asks the Prime Minister about the EU tender for government photography (Fotografie Beeldcentrum Rijksoverheid), including criticism from the sector, the transfer of copyright, pay levels, quality, and photographers' liability for portrait rights. The government answers that the tender followed the rules and the standard government terms (ARVODI), that pay was set by market research, that copyright transfer is intended for government communication, and that portrait consent forms are required.
In preparing the tender, use was made of the knowledge and experience of all the departments involved.
Bij de voorbereiding van de aanbesteding is gebruik gemaakt van de kennis en ervaring van alle betrokken departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Sjoerdsma over Nederlandse reputatieschade in het buitenland

MPs Pechtold and Sjoerdsma asked the government to reconcile Foreign Minister Timmermans' remarks about damage to the Dutch reputation abroad with earlier statements by his predecessor and the previous cabinet's position, and whether the earlier government should have commissioned a study. The government answered that Dutch reputation is good, that differing views with partners are normal, that the cabinet invests in dialogue and explanation of policy, and that no study was needed.
The Dutch reputation abroad is good and rooted in a long tradition of international cooperation.
De Nederlandse reputatie in het buitenland is goed en gestoeld op een lange traditie van internationale samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht dat de Nederlandse economie tuimelt naar 30e plaats

PVV MPs asked whether the reported drop of the Dutch economy to 30th place means the Netherlands would be better off outside the euro, whether lower taxes would boost growth, and whether the government will reverse tax rises and redirect spending. The minister rejects leaving the euro, says the ranking drop is relative and largely driven by emerging economies, and explains that the government lowers household burdens while reducing deficits mainly through spending cuts.
No, I do not share that view.
Nee, die mening deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Segers over afschaffing slavernij

MPs Slob and Segers asked why the Netherlands did not sign the 1949 UN Convention on trafficking and prostitution, whether it will do so, what anti-trafficking goals exist, and how the government addresses the legacy of slavery such as discrimination. The government answered that it will not join the convention because it would criminalise exploitation of adult voluntary prostitution, that regulation is preferred, and outlined trafficking task force and referral mechanism plans plus commemoration and anti-discrimination actions.
The Netherlands does not intend to become a party to the UN Convention.
Nederland is niet van plan partij bij het VN-Verdrag te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht Oostblokker verdringt bouwvakker

PVV MPs Wilders and De Graaf asked whether the government will fully maintain work permits for Romanian and Bulgarian workers after 1 January 2014, given displacement fears in construction. The minister replied that transitional restrictions end on that date under the accession treaties, that displacement through bogus constructions will be tackled, and that bilateral agreements on enforcing Dutch working conditions were made.
From that date no measures are permitted that restrict the access of Bulgarian and Romanian workers to the labour market.
Per die datum zijn geen maatregelen meer toegestaan die de toegang van Bulgaarse en Roemeense werknemers tot de arbeidsmarkt beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Wilders over de uitvaart van Nelson Mandela

PVV MPs De Roon and Wilders asked whether the government would request the arrest and extradition of Suriname's president Desi Bouterse, convicted to 11 years for cocaine trafficking, and whether it was improper for the King to attend a ceremony with him. The minister answered that Netherlands values attendance at the Mandela memorial, that the conviction stands but cannot be enforced while Bouterse enjoys head-of-state immunity.
The court's judgment convicting Bouterse remains in force, but cannot be enforced as long as he enjoys international immunity as head of state of Suriname.

De uitspraak van de rechtbank waarbij Bouterse is veroordeeld blijft van kracht, maar kan niet tot uitvoering worden gebracht, zolang hij als staatshoofd van Suriname internationaal immuniteit geniet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Segers over de capaciteit van de antennes op het dak van de ambassade van de Verenigde Staten

MPs Van Raak and Segers asked whether antennas on the US embassy roof in The Hague could intercept and decode nearby communications, including those around the Binnenhof and the Prime Minister's office, and whether the government would check this with the US. The minister confirmed interception is technically possible but could not confirm it occurs, said foreign intelligence operations in the Netherlands require prior authorisation, and committed to contacting the US embassy and reporting back.
The Ministry of BZK will contact the American embassy. I will inform your House of the outcome.
Het Ministerie van BZK zal contact opnemen met de Amerikaanse ambassade. Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomst hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Pechtold en Van Ojik over de zaak De Roy van Zuydewijn

MPs Van Raak, Pechtold and Van Ojik asked the Prime Minister about a 2003 confidential DKDB report on a security investigation into Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, a partner of a royal relative, and about who ordered and knew of it. The Prime Minister answered that the report was released under freedom-of-information rules in 2003, that DKDB acted on its statutory task with Prince Bernhard as protected person, found no security risks, and declined to publish the report to protect private life.
No. The report contains data on the private life of Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, his former spouse and various other persons.
Nee. Het rapport bevat gegevens met betrekking tot de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn, zijn voormalige echtgenote en verschillende andere personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over de uitspraak van Eurocommissaris Kroes over Verhofstadt als kandidaat-voorzitter van de Europese Commissie

MPs Wilders and Madlener asked the Prime Minister whether the Dutch government supports Guy Verhofstadt as candidate for Commission president, after Commissioner Kroes said the VVD would back him, and asked which liberal has the most EU-right. The government answered that it will decide which candidate to support once the candidates are known, and that this is not yet on the agenda.
The government will decide which candidate for President of the European Commission to support when the candidates are known.
De regering zal een beslissing nemen over welke kandidaat voorzitter van de Europese Commissie te steunen wanneer de kandidaten hiervoor bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Minister-President and the Minister of Interior about reports that Curaçao's plenipotentiary minister hired family and friends without the usual recruitment procedures, and whether her CV was verified. The minister replied that it is not for the Dutch government to assess recruitment procedures in another country and referred back to that answer for the CV questions.
It is not for the Dutch government to assess the recruitment procedures for posts in other countries.
Het is niet aan de regering van Nederland om de sollicitatieprocedures voor functies in andere landen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over de Turkse steun aan jihadisten in Syrië

An MP asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about alleged Turkish state support for jihadist groups in Syria, the Dutch Patriot deployment in Turkey, and whether an international criminal investigation or diplomatic action was warranted. The minister replied that the Netherlands knows of media reports but has no confirmed evidence of Turkish support, that Turkey denies it, and that cooperation on foreign fighters has been pursued, while rejecting an investigation and leaving Turkish responses to Turkey.
The Netherlands is aware of media reports of alleged Turkish support for jihadist groups in Syria, but is not aware of actual Turkish support for such groups.
Nederland kent de mediaberichten over vermeende Turkse steun aan jihadistische groeperingen in Syrië, maar is niet bekend met daadwerkelijke steun van Turkije aan dergelijke groepen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de zorgen die een Duitse deelstaatpremier en de Senaat en het Huis van Afgevaardigden van Michigan hebben geuit over de sluiting van Nederlandse consulaten

An MP asked the ministers of General Affairs and Foreign Affairs about concerns raised by a German state premier and US Michigan legislative bodies over the closure of Dutch consulates-general in Munich and Chicago. The government answered that consulate closures are necessary to cut about 100 million euro from the network budget, that consular and economic functions will be taken over by alternatives, and that it will not postpone closures pending a full cost-benefit analysis.
The cabinet wants to maintain a worldwide network and keeps as many embassies open as possible.
Het kabinet wil wereldwijd een netwerk behouden en houdt zoveel mogelijk ambassades open.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid  Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) bij een onderzoek naar de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Bernhard instructed the Kabinet der Koningin to request BVD information on De Roy van Zuydewijn in 2000, why the 2003 government did not disclose this, and for comment on a journalist's account of the prince's remarks. The government answers that the 2003 letter and parliamentary debates contain its position, that the earlier answers were given in good faith, and that statements by the former editor-in-chief are his own responsibility.
Statements by the former editor-in-chief are for his own account.
Uitlatingen van de voormalig hoofdredacteur komen voor diens rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het door de Koning regeren “bij de Gratie Gods”

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the royal title 'bij de Gratie Gods' in the promulgation formula is a personal religious statement or a feature of the constitutional order, and why the formula remains in an additional article without a statutory deadline. The government answered that the phrase is a traditional religious expression rather than a constitutional element, that the 'enz.' allows it, and declined to prioritise a bill to replace the formula.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het Droomboek

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Droomboek was printed in Germany, on what criteria the printing contract was awarded, how many copies and what cost, and whether it is a dream or nightmare that such a book is printed abroad. The minister confirmed printing in Germany, said the Postcode Lottery funded it without taxpayer money, and explained that a German printer won the offer process on cost, climate-neutral printing and capacity.
Because the Committee was not granted any budget by the central government when it was established, it depends on sponsorship to fund its initiatives.
Omdat aan het Comité bij de instelling ervan geen budget vanuit het Rijk is toegekend, is het Comité voor de bekostiging van initiatieven afhankelijk van sponsoring.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over Homorechten in de Verenigde Republiek Tanzania

MP Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether they were aware of the Human Rights Watch report on discrimination against sexual minorities in Tanzania and of Zanzibar's president rejecting LGBT rights linked to aid, and what the government would do about criminalisation and abuse of LGBT people, including raising it with President Shein and coordinating EU action. The government said it shares the concerns, will monitor enforcement through the embassy, raised rule of law and human rights in talks with Zanzibar's leaders, and will answer for the upcoming Human Rights policy debate.
As usual, no statements are made about the conversation with the King.
Over het gesprek met de Koning worden zoals gebruikelijk geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Roemer over de Prinsjesdagstukken

MP Roemer (SP) asked the Prime Minister to respond to an open letter calling for the Prinsjesdag budget documents to be made public earlier. The Prime Minister replied yes, explaining that various release variants were tried, none avoided media leaks, and the cabinet chose one coherent presentation on Prinsjesdag as required by the Constitution.
The cabinet has chosen a uniform approach, namely a coherent presentation on Prinsjesdag based on the Constitution
Het kabinet heeft gekozen voor een eenduidige benadering, namelijk een samenhangende presentatie op Prinsjesdag op basis van de Grondwet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht: ‘Rutte: werkloze jongeren naar Nederland halen’ van de website van de Telegraaf

Wilders and Madlener asked the Prime Minister whether he is aware of a news report that Rutte wants to bring unemployed youth to the Netherlands, and insulted him with a rhetorical question. The government replied that the report is known and that it will respond in answer to a separate request from the Social Affairs committee.
The cabinet will respond to this news report in reply to the request of the standing committee for Social Affairs and Employment of 9 July.
Het kabinet zal op deze berichtgeving reageren in antwoord op het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid van 9 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over de wens van het Nederlandse volk de voortgaande islamisering te stoppen

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked the government whether it would stop mosque construction, introduce a constitutional ban on sharia, halt immigration from Islamic countries, and apologise for mass immigration and Islamisation. The minister answered that freedom of religion is a core democratic right, that municipalities decide on new mosques, that nationality is not relevant to residence permits, and that the government does not recognise mass immigration or Islamisation.
People are free to adhere to and profess any religion they choose.
Het staat mensen vrij welk geloof dan ook aan te hangen en te belijden.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Madlener over het bericht 'Poll:39% Nederlanders wil uit de EU'

PVV MPs Wilders and Madlener asked whether the government will prepare for Dutch withdrawal from the EU after a poll showing 39% support for leaving, and whether a referendum will be held. The minister replied that the government takes citizens' concerns seriously and will pursue EU reform, that withdrawal is not on the table, and that no referendum is needed.
A departure of the Netherlands from the EU is not on the table as far as the cabinet is concerned.
Een vertrek van Nederland uit de EU is wat het kabinet betreft niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wilders over zijn deelname aan de Bilderberg-bijeenkomst

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he attends the Bilderberg meeting, why he is skipping a cabinet meeting, whether the agenda covers nationalism and populism with a report to the Chamber promised, and who pays his costs. The Prime Minister confirmed attendance, said the Vice Prime Minister chairs cabinet abroad, invoked the Chatham House Rule for the meeting, and stated the state paid EUR 1,223 in travel and stay costs.
The Chatham House Rule applies to the meeting, which ensures a meaningful exchange of views.
Voor de bijeenkomst geldt de Chatham House Rule, die een zinvolle gedachtewisseling verzekert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma, Van Bommel en Voordewind over de mensenrechtennota

MPs asked when the human rights note would reach parliament, whether the old note still guides policy, and how much was spent from the human rights fund since the new cabinet took office. The minister replied that the letter will be sent after cabinet approval, that it will state continuity and new emphases, and that ongoing commitments from the fund have been honoured.
The human rights letter will be sent to the House immediately after the Council of Ministers has approved it.
De mensenrechtenbrief wordt direct nadat de Ministerraad deze heeft goedgekeurd aan de Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een waterproject in Israël

The SP MP Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister and Prime Minister about a water project in Mitspe Ramon, Israel, linked to Prince Willem-Alexander and the Jewish National Fund, including alleged land appropriation, activity in settlements and water rights under international law. The minister confirmed the project lies within Israel's internationally recognised borders, uses household wastewater, and that the government is satisfied it has no link to occupied territory or settlements.

The government has satisfied itself that the projects of the Stichting Joods Nationaal Fonds in Amsterdam are located exclusively within the so-called Green Line in Israel, and thus not in occupied territory.

De regering heeft zich ervan vergewist dat de projecten van de Stichting Joods Nationaal Fonds te Amsterdam zich uitsluitend binnen de zogenaamde «groene lijn» in Israël bevinden, dus niet in bezet gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over een waterproject in Israël

An SP MP asked the foreign minister whether a Jewish National Fund water project in Israel harms Bedouin, whether JNF afforestation caused the loss of Palestinian villages and farmland, and whether JNF is an unacceptable partner for the Dutch prince. The minister answered that the project area is undisputed and has no Bedouin residents, that the related Israeli bill is still pending in the Knesset, that the Absentee Lands afforestation was authorised by the Israeli state, and that there is no project partnership.
The Netherlands follows such developments closely.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) bij een onderzoek naar de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Bernhard in 2000 had instructed the Queen's Cabinet to request information from the BVD about Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, why the 2003 cabinet did not disclose that the initiative came from the Prince, and why an intelligence service inquiry beyond a standard security check was considered justified. The government answered by referring to the 10 March 2003 letter to parliament and the earlier debate and motions, without restating the substance.
The letter of 10 March 2003 contains the cabinet's position on this subject and the grounds on which it rests.
De brief van 10 maart 2003 bevat het kabinetsstandpunt over dit onderwerp en de gronden waarop het berust
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over mogelijke belastingontwijking door leden van het Koninklijk Huis

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked the Prime Minister and State Secretary of Finance about possible tax avoidance by members of the Royal House, including how their structure compares to Princess Christina's, and whether they should be taxed like ordinary citizens. The government answered that royals are subject to the same legal privacy protections in tax matters as other taxpayers, that no change is needed, and that press reports do not alter this.
With regard to the legal protection of personal privacy connected to taxation, members of the Royal House do not differ from other taxpayers.
Ten aanzien van de met belastingheffing verbonden wettelijke bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer verschillen leden van het koninklijk huis niet van andere belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het beleid bij mogelijke belangenverstrengeling bij de beantwoording van vragen uit de Tweede Kamer

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether the government accepts a duty to answer parliamentary questions properly, and whether the minister's husband, employed at Slotervaart hospital, creates a conflict of interest and what safeguards were agreed. The Prime Minister answered yes to the first question and denied the husband sits on the hospital's board, stating no conflict of interest exists.
There is therefore no question of a conflict of interest, see also the answers to previous questions on this matter.
Van belangenverstrengeling is derhalve geen sprake, zie ook de beantwoording van vorige vragen ter zake.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het pensioen van prinses Beatrix en belastingen voor de Koninklijke familie

MP Thieme (PvdD) asked the Prime Minister about a reported royal pension for Princess Beatrix, whether royal family members are exempt from personal taxes, how that fits article 40 of the constitution, and about transparency and comparisons with other European monarchies. The Prime Minister answered that royal family members are taxable with limited constitutional exemptions, pointed to the 2009 financial statute law's added transparency, and said a comparison with other monarchies is not feasible, without addressing the specific pension figures.

During the oral debate on the bill, the Prime Minister explained that members of the royal family are taxable and that the Constitution partially exempts a limited number of royal house members for a few specified subjects.

Tijdens de mondelinge behandeling van het wetsvoorstel heeft de minister-president toegelicht dat leden van de koninklijke familie belastingplichtig zijn en dat de Grondwet een beperkt aantal leden van het koninklijk huis hiervan ten dele vrijstelt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een huishouden in Cyprus gemiddeld vier keer meer vermogen heeft dan een Nederlands huishouden

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked why Cypriot households hold about four times the average wealth of Dutch households and why the Netherlands should contribute to Cypriot bailout aid, asking whether this aid should be reversed. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the ECB itself notes Cyprus data are not comparable across the eurozone, pointed to earlier letters on the bailout, and did not reverse or commit to changing the aid.
The ECB states in its study that the figures for Cyprus are not well comparable with the rest of the eurozone for several reasons.
De ECB stelt in haar studie dat de cijfers voor Cyprus niet goed vergelijkbaar zijn met de rest van de eurozone om meerdere redenen
Antwoord vragen van het lid Roemer over het sociaal akkoord

Roemer (SP) asked about the newly concluded social accord, its differences from the coalition agreement, its budgetary treatment and whether the zero wage norm in healthcare is off the table. The minister replied that an updated planning overview will be sent, detailed the measure-by-measure differences, said the accord will feed into the Stability Programme, and declined to have the financial basis checked by the CPB beforehand, offering instead a view in its June forecast.
Yes, the House will receive an updated planning overview as soon as possible.
Ja, de Kamer ontvangt zo spoedig mogelijk een geactualiseerd planningsoverzicht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma, Pechtold, Slob, Van Ojik en Van der Staaij over de gevolgen van het akkoord voor de ontwikkeling van het (structurele) EMU-saldo en de staatsschuld in de periode 2014-201

MPs from CDA, D66, ChristenUnie, GroenLinks and SGP asked the government how the social accord affects the structural EMU balance, debt, the 3% deficit target, and the WW premium changes. The minister replied that the accord causes a shortfall of 119 million structurally and up to 543 million in 2017, that the government abandons the 4.3 billion supplementary package but will take further measures if the CPB forecast requires it, and that a CPB analysis of structural effects will come with the June forecast.
The cabinet will take additional measures if the CPB's MEV forecast, given the 2014 balance target, gives reason to do so.
Het kabinet zal aanvullende maatregelen nemen indien de MEV-raming van het CPB gegeven het saldodoel 2014 daartoe aanleiding geeft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt over nieuwe stappen gezet ten aanzien van de buitenlandse financiering van Russische niet-gouvernementele organisaties

Mr. Omtzigt (CDA) asked whether the government knows of and assesses new Russian steps on foreign funding of NGOs, whether Russia's human rights situation has worsened under Putin, and what the EU and the Netherlands will do about it. Minister Timmermans answers that the government has repeatedly voiced concern about Russian NGO legislation, will raise human rights with Putin, and that the EU has discussed Russia's internal situation, without committing to a concrete new step.
Since the legislation on NGOs (foreign funding and labelling as 'foreign agent') came up in Russia last summer, my EU colleagues and I have repeatedly expressed our concerns to Russia.

Vanaf het moment dat wetgeving inzake NGO's (buitenlandse financiering en betiteling als «buitenlands agent») vorige zomer in Rusland aan de orde is, hebben mijn EU-collega's en ikzelf hier herhaaldelijk tegenover Rusland onze zorgen kenbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de onafhankelijke beantwoording van vragen uit de Tweede Kamer

A Socialist Party MP asked the Prime Minister what policy applies when a minister's close associates may be involved in, or subject of, parliamentary questions, and how independent answers will be ensured. The government answered that the Handbook for incoming ministers' integrity framework applies, requiring ministers to avoid any appearance of biased decision-making, and that the health minister can handle questions on the Slotervaart hospital within that framework.
Within this framework, ministers are responsible for performing their duties with the required objectivity and avoiding any appearance that decision-making would not be objective.

Binnen dit toetsingskader zijn bewindspersonen er verantwoordelijk voor dat zij de uitoefening van hun functie met vereiste objectiviteit verrichten en iedere mogelijke schijn vermijden dat er van objectieve besluitvorming geen sprake zou zijn.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Wilders over het bericht dat de EU 11,2 miljard euro wil om Brusselse gaten te dichten

PVV MPs Madlener and Wilders asked the Finance Minister and Prime Minister whether the government would refuse to pay a proposed 11.2 billion euro EU budget increase and demand the money back. The minister answered only that Question 1 was yes and that Questions 2 to 4 were covered in a separate letter to the House.
For an answer to questions 2 to 4, I refer you to the letter I sent to the House of Representatives simultaneously with the answers to these parliamentary questions.
Voor een antwoord op de vragen 2 t/m 4 verwijs ik u naar de brief die ik hierover gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen naar de Tweede Kamer heb gezonden.
Antwoord vragen Bergklamp en Sjoerdsma over het bezoek van premier Erdogan

MPs Bergkamp and Sjoerdsma asked the Prime Minister whether he would send Parliament a report on Turkish Prime Minister Erdogan's visit, covering the political dialogue and the controversy over foster care in the Netherlands, within a week. The answer states that the questions were already answered in the Prime Minister's letter of 27 March 2013.
These questions have been answered in the letter of the Prime Minister, Minister of General Affairs of 27 March 2013
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij de brief van de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken van 27 maart 2013
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Klaver over de wijziging van de grondwet in Hongarije

MPs Servaes and Klaver asked whether the Hungarian constitutional amendment limiting the Constitutional Court and checks and balances is a concern, whether the EU and Council of Europe should act, and how EU monitoring of rule of law should be strengthened. The minister said the government shares concerns, will raise the issue at the European Council, supports a stronger Commission role and a new EU safeguard mechanism, and notes the Council of Europe's Venice Commission is reviewing the amendments.

The government will, together with the other member states that wrote the letter and possibly other supporting member states, consult the European Commission and EU member states to further develop these aspects of such a mechanism.

Het kabinet zal, samen met de andere lidstaten die de brief hebben geschreven en mogelijk ook andere lidstaten die voorstander zijn van de totstandkoming van een dergelijk mechanisme, in overleg treden met de Europese Commissie en de lidstaten van de EU om deze aspecten verder uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over het beleid voor de koninklijke archieven

MP Pechtold asked the Prime Minister about transfers of royal archive material concerning Prince Bernhard's public functions to the National Archives, under the Kalsbeek motion, and whether the Royal House Archive should be opened to historians. The Prime Minister answered that the Royal House Archive is a private archive not covered by the Archives Act, that relevant documents were transferred to the Ministry of Defence, and that documents under Archives Act institutions will be transferred to the National Archives under the applicable rules.
The Royal House Archive is a private archive to which the Archives Act does not apply.
Het Koninklijk Huisarchief is een particulier archief waarop de Archiefwet niet van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de arbeidsvoorwaarden van de EU-ambtenaren

An MP asked the ministers about EU civil servant pay and pensions, including the lapse of the 5.5% solidarity levy, salary comparisons with US and Dutch officials, and the Council's role in the salary dispute. The government answered that the levy lapsed, gave salary figures, and blamed the impasse on the Commission's salary method and the need for an MFK administrative ceiling.
The salary tables you received with Parliamentary Paper 32 833, no. 9 are current. The adjustments for 2012 and 2013 are not yet available.
De salaristabellen die u ontving bij Kamerstuk 32 833, nr. 9 zijn actueel. De aanpassingen voor 2012 en 2013 zijn nog niet beschikbaar
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Madlener over het bericht: ‘EU-controleur in Den Haag’

MPs Wilders, Tony van Dijck and Madlener asked whether the government would send back an EU 'European Semester Officer' stationed in The Hague, object to growing Brussels interference, and station a Dutch controller in Brussels to oversee EU spending. The minister replied that the Commission's Semester role is important for budget oversight, that the officers only facilitate information exchange without changing Commission powers, and that the European Court of Auditors handles EU spending control while Netherlands pushes member-state accountability.
Appointing this officer changes nothing about the powers the Commission has under existing EU regulations.
Het aanstellen van deze functionaris verandert niets aan de bevoegdheden die de Commissie heeft op basis van de bestaande EU-regelgeving.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de hermelijnen koningsmantel die zou worden gedragen t.b.v. staatsieportretten en de kroning

An MP asked whether the royal ermine-lined coronation mantle would be worn at the 2013 inauguration and state portraits, and whether this conflicts with protected-species and anti-fur-farming rules, and asked for the 1980 decree to be amended. The government answered that the historical mantle uses ermine fur, no fur has been added since 1980, wearing it follows existing rules and tradition, and it declined to amend the decree.
Wearing the mantle by the King is in accordance with the applicable regulations, the Flora and Fauna Act and historical custom.
Het dragen van de mantel door de Koning is in overeenstemming met de hiervoor geldende voorschriften, de Flora- en Faunawet en het historisch gebruik.
Antwoord vragen Omtzigt over het bericht dat premier David Cameron van het Verenigd Koninkrijk op vrijdag 18 januari 2013 een speech zal geven in Nederland met als onderwerp Europa

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would attend David Cameron's planned Europe speech in the Netherlands, whether they remain political friends, and whether he shares Cameron's views on the EU. The Prime Minister said the speech was postponed due to the Algeria hostage crisis, no government member had been planned to attend, and he could not comment on its content.
On 17 January, Prime Minister Cameron decided to postpone the speech on Europe that was to be given in the Netherlands on 18 January, due to the hostage situation in Algeria.
Op 17 januari heeft premier Cameron besloten de toespraak over Europa die op 18 januari in Nederland gehouden zou worden, uit te stellen vanwege de gijzeling in Algerije.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht “Grieken lopen fors achter op schema”

PVV MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about reports that Greece is well behind schedule on reforms, including 210 of 300 unimplemented measures, continued pension and disability benefit fraud, and whether the next loan tranche will be blocked. The answer was given in a letter of 28 November 2012, which the summary of the answer text provided here does not include.
Will you block the request for postponement of payment and the disbursement of the next tranche if Greece has not kept to the agreements?
Gaat u de aanvraag om uitstel van betaling en de uitbetaling van de volgende tranche blokkeren als Griekenland zich niet aan de afspraken heeft gehouden?
Antwoord vragen van het lid Pechtold over het bericht dat Prins Bernhard een massa-executie wilde

MP Pechtold asked the Prime Minister whether the RVD refused to respond to a report that Prince Bernhard wanted a mass execution, and whether parts of the Royal Household Archive would be opened to historians. The Prime Minister said the RVD does not normally respond to such reports and that there is no reason to assume the Royal Household Archive contains relevant material.
There is no basis for the assumption that the Royal Household Archive contains parts relevant to this matter.
Er is geen grond voor de veronderstelling dat het Koninklijk Huisarchief terzake delen bevat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de uitspraak van Z.K.H. de Prins van Oranje tijdens de handelsmissie in Brazilië

An MP asked the government about remarks by the Crown Prince on feeding 9 billion people through more meat production, a bull producing over a million offspring, and an apparent contradiction with his earlier call to reduce meat consumption. The minister answered that the remarks concerned efficient, sustainable agriculture and dairy shortages in Brazil, denied any call to reduce meat consumption, and said the remarks were made under ministerial responsibility.
The statements by His Royal Highness the Prince of Orange were made under the ministerial responsibility of myself and of my colleague of Economic Affairs.
De uitspraken van Z.K.H. de Prins van Oranje zijn gedaan onder ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid van mijzelf en die van de collega van Economische Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Wilders over het bericht «Griekenland kan niet aan eisen voldoen»

PVV MPs Van Dijck and Wilders asked the Finance Minister whether Greece can meet the conditions for its bailout tranche and why Dutch money should go to a country that fails to reform. The minister replied that the Troika found Greece had met the conditions, so the tranche was released and the loan programme continues.
Following the latest Troika progress report, I judge that Greece has ultimately met the requirements to disburse the tranche from the loan programme.
Naar aanleiding van het laatste voortgangsrapport van de Trojka oordeel ik dat Griekenland uiteindelijk aan de eisen heeft voldaan om de tranche uit het leningenprogramma uit te keren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een streekbezoek van Hare Majesteit de Koningin aan de provincie Noord-Brabant

An MP asked the government why the Queen would attend a round-table on intensive livestock farming during a regional visit to Noord-Brabant, what information she would receive, who organised it, which parties would attend, and whether a list of attendees would be provided. The state secretary answered that the round-table was a customary part of regional visits prepared with the province, that it was confidential, and listed the types of attendees (residents, farmers, a welfare/environment-type organisation, a health body) but no Q-fever patient organisation.

It concerned a confidential conversation attended by citizens and residents of Reusel-de Mierden and surroundings, entrepreneurs/livestock farmers, a representative of an organisation for humans and animals and of a health institution, and a representative of the Provincial Health Council.

Het betrof een vertrouwelijk gesprek waarbij aanwezig waren burgers en inwoners van Reusel-de Mierden en nabije omgeving, ondernemers/veehouders, een vertegenwoordiger van een belangenorganisatie voor mens en dier en van een gezondheidsinstantie en een vertegenwoordiging van de Provinciale Raad voor de Gezondheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Pechtold, Timmermans en El Fassed over ‘tegenstrijdige kabinetsuitlatingen’

MPs Pechtold, Timmermans and El Fassed asked the Prime Minister to reconcile minister Leers' claim that PVV rhetoric made Dutch intentions suspect in the EU with earlier government statements about the PVV's influence on European policy and the 'no misunderstanding' remark. The government answered that the statements concerned different matters (migration versus European dossiers generally), that it depends on other parties for most European files, and that it sees no contradiction, though it agrees such inconsistency would be undesirable.
Yes, but there is no question of contradiction.
Ja, maar van tegenstrijdigheid is geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de voorbeeldfunctie van leden van het Koninklijk Huis in relatie tot de plezierjacht

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Willem-Alexander's duck hunting is compatible with the royal family's exemplary role, whether publicly funded royal hunting staff or security were involved, and whether he should apologise like King Juan Carlos did. The government answered briefly that hunting is legally permitted for those following the rules, that duck hunting is lawful, and that the Faunabeheer department manages game on the royal domain, without addressing the involvement of public staff or the apology question.
Hunting is subject to legal rules. Anyone who fully complies with these rules may hunt.
Voor de jacht gelden wettelijke regels. Iedereen die deze regels volledig in acht neemt, kan jagen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Tony van Dijck over de uitspraken van de Finse minister van Financiën dat het uiteenvallen van de eurozone slechts een kwestie van tijd is

Wilders and Van Dijck asked the government to react to Finnish minister Tuomioja's remarks that eurozone breakup is a matter of time, and what the Netherlands is doing to prepare, and whether it will stop signing blank cheques for Brussels. Minister De Jager replied that Tuomioja is foreign minister, not finance minister, that the Finnish government did not endorse his view, that the Dutch government considers various scenarios and aims to strengthen the euro, and that existing measures (SGP automaticity, twopack, conditionality on EFSF aid) already reflect its position.
The government's aim is a strengthened euro.
De inzet van het kabinet is een versterkte euro.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Bontes over zakkenvullende eurocraten

Two PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister, Foreign Affairs and the Foreign Affairs state secretary whether they agree that EU officials' salaries, pensions and allowances (commissioners, MEPs, junior staff) are excessive, whether the Dutch EU contribution should be suspended until they are cut, and what the government will do. The government answered that it wants EU staff conditions modernised and reduced, that it pressed for more ambitious Commission proposals and voted against the 2011 indexation, and that it is pursuing lower Dutch contributions in the MFF negotiations, but did not commit to suspending payments.
The cabinet is of the view that in the upcoming revision of the EU staff regulations, the working conditions of EU staff should be modernised and reduced.
Het kabinet is van mening dat bij de komende herziening van het EU-ambtenarenstatuut de arbeidsvoorwaarden van EU-personeel gemoderniseerd en versoberd dienen te worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders en Bontes over het bericht "Brussel wil meer geld van EU-lidstaten"

PVV MPs asked the government, after a press report that Brussels wants more money from member states, whether it finds this absurd during the economic crisis and whether it will act like Thatcher to cut Dutch EU contributions. The state secretary replied that the Netherlands voted against the Council position, that it favours a nominal freeze of the EU budget and a substantial reduction of Dutch contributions, and that it keeps its rebate and collection fee.
The Netherlands voted against the Council position mentioned in the report.
Nederland heeft tegen de in het bericht genoemde Raadspositie gestemd
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over online privacy

An MP asked the ministers whether withholding requested data on online privacy under the 'state interest' clause (art. 68 Grondwet) was justified, and whether police phone-tapping and social media data requests are subject to equal controls. The state secretary declined to disclose cabinet deliberations, maintained that investigation interests justify withholding the requested figures, and said the Limburg-Zuid police should not have released social media request data.
As is well known, deliberations in the Council of Ministers are confidential and no statements are made about them.
Zoals bekend zijn de beraadslagingen in de Ministerraad vertrouwelijk en worden hierover geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Wilders over het hijsen van de Europese vlag door de gemeente Amsterdam

Wilders (PVV) asked the Prime Minister whether he agrees it is absurd that Amsterdam flies the European flag, whether VVD members of the city council show they are pro-EU, whether he will address his Amsterdam party colleagues, and whether he will remove the EU flag from all public buildings. Rutte answered briefly that the national flag instructions only cover central government buildings, not the municipality's flag practice.
The general flag instruction and incidental flag instructions of the Prime Minister relate exclusively to the Dutch flag at buildings of central government.
De algemene vlaginstructie en incidentele vlaginstructies van de minister-president hebben uitsluitend betrekking op de Nederlandse vlag bij gebouwen van de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over deelname van de Minister-President aan de Bilderberg-conferentie

Thieme (PvdD) asked the Prime Minister whether the Chatham House Rule allowed participants in the 2012 Bilderberg conference to speak publicly about the discussions, whether the participant list could be withheld, and whether government funds covered Dutch non-government participants. Rutte answered that the rule means off-the-record discussions with no statements to third parties afterwards, that publishing a participant list is up to each organiser, and that government funding of non-government participants can be ruled out for this cabinet period.
Whether or not the participant list of a meeting with third parties is shared is up to the organisation of each meeting.
Het al dan niet delen van de deelnemerslijst van een bijeenkomst met derden is aan de organisatie van een iedere bijeenkomst.
Antwoord vragen Tony van Dijck,  Bontes en Wilders over de berichten "De Jager moet miljard bijlenen voor steun aan Griekenland" en "Merkel pleit voor nieuwe politieke unie in Europa"

MPs Van Dijck, Bontes and Wilders asked whether the government would refuse further Greek support and reject Merkel's call for more EU powers. The government answered that the Greek loan programme is funded via the EFSF without Dutch market borrowing, and that it will respond to the Van Rompuy report on the economic pillar once published.
The cabinet will come with a response to this report as soon as it has been published.
zal het kabinet met een reactie op dit rapport komen zodra dit is verschenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme aan de minister-president over de Bilderbergconferentie 2012

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he attended the 2012 Bilderberg conference, in what capacity, and for details on its agenda, invitation policy, public disclosure and costs. The Prime Minister confirmed attendance as PM, deferred to the Chatham House Rules and the conference's public topic list, and said government travel costs are paid from state funds.
Like many other international conferences, the discussions at the Bilderberg Conference fall under the so-called Chatham House rules.
Net als veel andere internationale conferenties, vallen de besprekingen van de Bilderberg Conferentie onder de zogenoemde Chatham House rules.
Antwoord vragen Klaver en Peters over de geheimhoudingsplicht ten aanzien van de notulen van de onderraad

MPs Klaver and Peters asked why the government will not release minutes of the subcommittee (onderraad) on Olympic Games information, despite the health minister saying she would like to send them. The Prime Minister replied that confidentiality under the Council rules of procedure (art. 26) applies, that no waiver will be granted, and that the government's information duty is not to be read broadly.
Preserving this confidentiality is a state interest that limits the provision of information to parliament.
Bewaring van deze vertrouwelijkheid is een belang van de staat dat de informatievoorziening aan het parlement begrenst
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over de plezierjacht op beschermde dieren door hoogwaardigheidsbekleders

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would object to King Juan Carlos's elephant hunting, ban trophy hunting offers and gifts to officials, and bar Dutch royals from hunting protected species. The state secretary replied that trophy hunting is legal and may fund conservation, declined to disclose royal hunting or trophy details citing privacy, and saw no need for a ban on hunting-trip advertising.
Providing information on participation in hunting and the presence of hunting trophies in palaces and homes is incompatible with protecting the privacy of the Royal House.

Verstrekking van gegevens over deelname aan de jacht en aanwezigheid van jachttrofeën in paleizen en woningen is niet verenigbaar met de bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van het Koninklijk Huis.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Bommel over het uitreiken van de Four Freedoms Award  aan de heer Al-Shahristani, minister van energie van Irak, op 12 mei 2012.

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether he would present the Four Freedoms Award to Iraq's energy minister Al-Shahristani, given accusations of corruption and a no-confidence motion in Iraq's parliament. The government answered that the award is chosen by the Roosevelt Institute and will be presented by another official, then stated the Prime Minister will not present it himself, leaving Iraqi parliament to judge the corruption allegations.
As stated in the answer to question 1, I will not present this award.
Zoals vermeld in het antwoord op vraag 1 zal ik deze prijs niet uitreiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven inzake de ondernemer Roel Bakker

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he failed to answer calls from entrepreneur Roel Bakker after promising to be reachable, and whether his ministry is unreachable for entrepreneurs. The Prime Minister confirmed giving his number, denied missing calls, said the issue was resolved and a follow-up call was missed, and denied the ministry is unreachable.
No. I have learned from Mr Bakker that he did make a call attempt, but when he got no voicemail he subsequently discarded the number.
Nee. Ik heb van dhr. Bakker vernomen dat hij wel een belpoging heeft gedaan, maar toen hij geen voicemail kreeg het nummer vervolgens heeft weggegooid.
Antwoord vragen Hazekamp over verkoop woning Mozambique

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Crown Prince actively promoted the sale of his Mozambique villa in a magazine ad, whether this contradicted the government's January letter saying the royal couple had no further involvement, and about the ad's cost and timing. The Prime Minister said his only surprise was the unverified online article, that the ad was placed by the estate agent and involved no tax money, and that the sale ended the legal ties, while the royal couple helping sell the house through the owners' association does not conflict with the government's position that private property sales of royals do not touch the public interest.
Antwoord vragen Klavers en Peters over de geheimhoudingsplicht van de notulen van de onderraad

Klaver and Peters asked whether the confidentiality rules of the ministerial council (artikel 26 Reglement van Orde) justify withholding the minutes of the onderraad on the Olympic Games, and whether the minister would grant a waiver. The government confirmed the rule allows waiver but answered that confidentiality of council deliberations is a state interest limiting parliamentary information, and gave no commitment to release the minutes.
Preserving this confidentiality is a state interest that limits the provision of information to parliament.
Bewaring van deze vertrouwelijkheid is een belang van de staat dat de informatievoorziening aan het parlement begrenst
Antwoord vragen Verhoeven over de niet nagekomen belofte over lokale lastenverzwaring

Verhoeven (D66) asks Prime Minister Rutte why local tax burdens for businesses are rising despite the cabinet's earlier promise to prevent disproportionate local levies, and what action the cabinet will take. The government answers that it will send a letter in May after consulting local government bodies, and rejects the claim that the cabinet broke its promise.
As the state secretary of EL&I already committed to your House on 17 January, the cabinet will come with a letter in May addressing the development of local levies.
Zoals de staatssecretaris van EL&I uw Kamer reeds op 17 januari heeft toegezegd, zal het kabinet in mei met een brief komen waarin wordt ingegaan op de ontwikkeling van de lokale lasten.
Antwoord vragen Pechtold over de rol van wijlen prins Bernhard bij de Lockheed-affaire en de toegankelijkheid van verschillende archieven

An MP asked the Prime Minister about access to archives on Prince Bernhard's role in the Lockheed affair, including the Donner commission files withheld until 2025 or 2050 and the status of the Koninklijk Huisarchief. The government said the restrictions rest on the Archiefwet grounds of confidential information, privacy and internal deliberation, denied that the foundation is a public body, and rejected any revision of the archive policy.
The restrictions rest on the three grounds listed in Article 15, first paragraph, of the Archives Act.
De beperkingen berusten op de drie gronden die zijn opgenomen in artikel 15, eerste lid, van de Archiefwet.
Antwoord vragen Wilders en Tony van Dijck over het Frans-Duitse voornemen om een financiële transactiebelasting in te voeren in de eurozone

Wilders and Van Dijck asked the government whether it shares business and pension-sector fears that a Franco-German financial transaction tax would cut pensions and shrink the economy, and whether it will oppose the tax. The minister acknowledged fears of higher pension costs and pointed to a cabinet reply to a CPB evaluation for the economic analysis, without committing to a position beyond that.

For a detailed analysis of the risks of structural economic contraction from a possible introduction of the financial transaction tax, and the government's view on the financial transaction tax, I would refer you to the cabinet's response to the CPB evaluation of the Financial Transaction Tax.

Voor een uitvoerige analyse van de risico's op een structurele krimp van de economie als gevolg van een eventuele invoering van de financiële transactiebelasting en de mening van de regering over de financiële transactiebelasting zou ik willen verwijzen naar de kabinetsreactie op de CPB evaluatie Financiële Transactiebelasting.
Antwoord vragen Dijkstra over De uitspraak van de Minister-president dat het voor homoseksuele mannen mogelijk wordt bloed te doneren.

An MP asked whether the Prime Minister's statement that gay men would be allowed to donate blood is accurate, and whether the government had already decided its position without waiting for Council of Europe recommendations. The minister answered that the policy is under review in consultation with the education minister, that current rules exclude men who have sex with men, and that a decision depends on a forthcoming Council of Europe resolution expected in May 2012, with a letter to parliament promised before the summer recess.
I expect to inform your House about this before the summer recess.
Naar verwachting zal ik uw Kamer hier voor het zomerreces over informeren.
Antwoord vragen Peters en Van Gent over de geheimhouding van de agenda's van de ministerraad

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Prime Minister whether he intends to remove agenda items from cabinet meetings to prevent ministers from publicising news early, and whether cabinet agendas should be published in advance as other bodies do. The Prime Minister confirmed only that items may be removed, rejected publishing agendas in advance, saying the agenda's function is to facilitate internal cabinet deliberation.
Publication of the agenda items would hinder open and unconstrained deliberation among the council members, which benefits decision-making.
Openbaarmaking van de geagendeerde onderwerpen belemmert de open en ongedwongen beraadslaging tussen de leden van de raad die de besluitvorming ten goede komt.
Antwoord vragen Elissen en Hernandez over het functioneren van de AIVD

PVV MPs Elissen and Hernandez asked about a newspaper report of errors in AIVD recruitment and careless handling of sensitive information, whether the CTIVD oversees culture and information handling, and whether a klokkenluidersregeling exists. Minister Spies replied that the Hofstad investigation capacity issues were already addressed by the CTIVD and earlier reforms, that the AIVD operates around the clock, that internal care and whistleblower arrangements exist, and that a broad external oversight system (CTIVD, Rekenkamer, ombudsman, courts) applies.
The AIVD is operational and reachable 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.
De AIVD is 24 uur per dag, 7 dagen per week, 365 dagen per jaar operationeel en bereikbaar.

Vragen van het lid Pechtold (D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over het bericht dat de rol van wijlen prins Bernhard bij de Lockheed-affaire groter was dan verwacht (ingezonden 21 december 2011)

An MP asked the Prime Minister about reports that Prince Bernhard's role in the Lockheed affair was larger than thought, whether the 1976 Donner commission had minimised it, and whether undisclosed archive documents should be released early or transferred to the National Archives. The government answered that the 2011 court-ordered disclosure decision stands, that the Royal House Archive is a private archive outside the Archiefwet, and that it sees no grounds for a new historians' inquiry.
The Royal House Archive is a private archive. The Archiefwet does not apply to private archives.
Het Koninklijk Huisarchief is een particulier archief. De Archiefwet is niet van toepassing op particuliere archieven.
Antwoord vragen El Fassed over de grondwetswijziging in Hongarije

An MP asked the government whether it shares concerns that Hungary's Orbán government laws (media, electoral system, judiciary, constitution) breach democratic principles and fundamental rights, and whether it will raise this at EU level or start an Article 7 procedure. The government answered that it shares concerns, that the Commission is investigating, and that it sees no reason yet for an Article 7 procedure.
Like the European Commission and many of our European colleagues, we are concerned about various legislative changes the Orbán government has initiated over the past year.
Wij zijn, net als de Europese Commissie en veel van onze Europese collega’s, bezorgd over verschillende wetswijzigingen die de regering-Órban het afgelopen jaar heeft geïnitieerd.
Antwoord vragen De Roon en Wilders over de houding van de Nederlandse regering ten tijde van de Holocaust

Two PVV MPs asked the prime minister whether he would apologise, as Borst and Zalm had suggested, for the Dutch government's passive stance in London during the persecution of Jews in WWII. Rutte answered that the 2000 advisory reports contained nothing significant on that stance and that no broad-based advice or objective information warranted a new government position, so he would not apologise.
The cabinet does not have a broadly supported advice from those involved or objective information that warrants a cabinet position like that of 21 March 2000.
Het kabinet beschikt terzake niet over een breed gedragen advies uit de kring van betrokkenen of geobjectiveerde informatie die noopt tot een kabinetsstandpunt als dat van 21 maart 2000.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Elissen en Wilders over de islamitische hoofddoek van ons staatshoofd

Three PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Minister for Immigration, Integration and Asylum whether the Queen's headscarf during a mosque visit in Abu Dhabi legitimises the oppression of women and whether this could have been prevented. The government answered that when the Queen visits a place of worship the dress rules of that building are respected, without addressing the substance of the criticism.
When Her Majesty the Queen visits a house of worship, the associated dress regulations are respected.
Bij een bezoek van H.M. de Koningin aan een godshuis worden de daarbij behorende kledingvoorschriften gerespecteerd.
Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het toekennen van de eretitel Minister van Staat (ingezonden 21 oktober 2011)

MP Schouw (D66) asked the Minister of the Interior whether the honorary title of Minister van Staat has criteria and how arbitrariness is prevented, after reports that Van Agt wanted the title. Prime Minister Rutte answered that there are no formal criteria beyond exceptional merits comparable to earlier recipients, and declined to disclose the Queen's role in the nomination.
There are no criteria other than exceptional merits comparable to the exceptional merits of those to whom this title was previously granted.
Er zijn geen criteria anders dan bijzondere verdiensten die vergelijkbaar zijn met de bijzondere verdiensten van degenen aan wie deze titel eerder is verleend.
Vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Dijck (beiden PVV) aan de minister-president en de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat Griekenland 400 tanks koopt (ingezonden 11 oktober 2011).

MPs Wilders and Van Dijck asked whether reports that Greece is buying 400 tanks are true, and whether the government will pressure Greece and halt aid if it does not cancel. Prime Minister Rutte answered that the reports are incorrect: the US offered the tanks free of charge, but Greece declined because transport and logistics costs would fall on Greece, so no action is warranted.
As the Minister of Finance indicated in response to earlier questions on this from MPs Irrgang and Van Bommel (SP), the reporting about Greece's purchase of 400 tanks is incorrect.

Zoals de Minister van Financiën heeft aangegeven in reactie op eerdere vragen hierover van de leden Irrgang en Van Bommel (SP) (kenmerk BFB 2011–1972M) is de berichtgeving over de aanschaf van 400 tanks door Griekenland onjuist.
Vragen van het lid Recourt (PvdA) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, over de belastingvrijstellingen voor leden van het koninklijk huis (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

Recourt (PvdA) asked Prime Minister Rutte whether he knew of reports on royal tax exemptions, why the Constitution exempts the King and his heir from inheritance tax, and what criteria and who decide which royal assets are excluded from the wealth return tax base. Rutte answered that the exemptions are functional, explained the historical rationale from the 1967 Simons commission and the 1972 constitutional revision, and said the tax inspector determines which assets serve the royal function.
Thus Article 40 of the Constitution provides that assets of members of the royal house that serve the exercise of the monarchy are not included in calculating the base for the wealth return tax.

Zo is in artikel 40 van de Grondwet bepaald dat vermogensbestanddelen van leden van het koninklijk huis, die dienstbaar zijn aan de uitoefening van het koningschap, niet worden meegenomen bij de berekening van de grondslag voor de vermogensrendementsheffing.
Vragen van de leden Wilders, Bontes en van Dijck (allen PVV) aan de minister-president over de onacceptabele voorstellen van de Voorzitter van de Europese Commissie (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Prime Minister whether he objects to Commission President Barroso's State of the Union proposals for eurobonds, a financial transaction tax and treaty changes removing member-state veto rights. The Prime Minister answered that the Netherlands opposes eurobonds and an EU-level transaction tax (preferring a global one), supports unanimity on certain files, and will raise these views with the Commission.
The Netherlands is not in favour of abolishing this.
Nederland is er niet voor om dit op te heffen.

Vragen van de leden Pechtold en Van der Ham (beiden D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over onjuiste informatie in debat met de Kamer, met name over onderwijsuitgaven (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

D66 MPs Pechtold and Van der Ham asked Prime Minister Rutte whether his claim that the Netherlands ranks fifth on the Global Competitiveness Index for education spending was correct, given that the GCI ranks it eighth and contains few education indicators. Rutte answered that his statements were based on the GCI and OECD data, that the Kennisinvesteringsagenda is not a better basis, and that the cabinet will keep drawing on multiple sources.
No. The statements were supported by the cited GCI and OECD figures.
Nee. De uitspraken waren onderbouwd door de genoemde cijfers van GCI en OESO.
Vragen van de leden Heijnen en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de minister-president over de toezeggingen aan de heer Robesin ten aanzien van ontpoldering in Zeeland (ingezonden 23 juni 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the Prime Minister whether an open letter from Provincial Councillor Robesin showed that a promise had been made to him in exchange for his vote against depoldering in Zeeland, and whether his claim that no commitments were made holds. The Prime Minister answered that the government will keep the coalition agreement's commitment to develop an alternative to depoldering the Hedwigepolder, that he will not comment on a confidential meeting, and that no commitments were given to the councillor.
It concerned a confidential conversation. I wish to confirm once again that no commitments were made to those involved.
Het betrof een vertrouwelijk gesprek. Ik wil bij deze nogmaals bevestigen dat er geen toezeggingen zijn gedaan aan betrokkenen.

Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de manier waarop de Kamer wordt geïnformeerd over zaken betreffend

Van Raak asks why the crown prince's private payments via a tax haven were disclosed only to the Commissie IVD, why this was treated as secret, which other Royal House matters that committee discussed, and whether it is intended to keep information unwelcome to government from the public. The minister-president answers that the payments are private with no public interest affected, that the information will not be shared with the committee again, refers to the committee's annual reports for past topics, agrees the committee is not meant to suppress unwelcome information, and explains the VIRBI classification rules.
Given the private nature of the payments, I see no reason to provide further information on this to the House of Representatives.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding, gelet op het privékarakter van de betalingen, nadere informatie hierover aan de Tweede Kamer te verstrekken.

Vragen van de leden Dibi (GroenLinks), Schouw (D66), Spekman (PvdA), Rik Janssen (SP), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Thieme (PvdD) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken en de minister voor Immigratie en A

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister whether he would accept a request for a meeting with civil servants about a 17 September 2010 discussion on the numerical effects of the government's migration and asylum plans. The Prime Minister declined, saying the conclusion was a political one for which the government took responsibility and referring to ministerial contact rules under the Aanwijzingen inzake externe contacten.

No. In the debate with the House of Representatives on 3 March I explained that in the discussion, based on information orally provided by expert civil servants, a substantive conclusion was drawn for which we then took political responsibility.

Nee. In het debat met de Tweede Kamer op 3 maart jl. heb ik toegelicht dat in het gesprek op basis van door deskundige ambtenaren mondeling verstrekte informatie een inhoudelijke conclusie is getrokken waarvoor wij vervolgens politieke verantwoording hebben genomen.
Vragen van het lid Thieme (Partij voor de Dieren) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over persoonlijke garantstelling in het Kunduz debat (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

An MP asks the Prime Minister what legal meaning and liability his personal guarantee to GroenLinks during the Kunduz debate carried, whether a reserved sum exists, and whether it adds anything beyond existing government obligations. The Prime Minister replies that the statement only confirmed his political intention to ensure the conditions for the police training mission are met and that MPs can hold him to it, without any separate legal effect.

In response to your questions, I inform you that with that statement I confirmed my (political) intention to ensure and oversee that the conditions the Dutch government set for the Afghan authorities are met.

In antwoord op uw vragen deel ik u mee dat ik met de betreffende uitspraak mijn (politieke) intentie heb bevestigd ervoor zorg te dragen en erop toe te zien dat aan de voorwaarden, die door de Nederlandse regering aan de Afghaanse autoriteiten zijn gesteld, wordt voldaan.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister- president en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over uitspraken van de premier met betrekking tot de hoogte van overhead bij hoger onderwijsin

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether his earlier claim that overhead in higher education could reach 40% was incorrect, given newer research putting it at 25-26%, and whether this misinformation distorts the debate on cuts. The Prime Minister called the discrepancy a misunderstanding because the two figures measure different things, rejected the claim that cuts pressure education quality, and said the government uses the most current data while noting the latest secondary-process measurement dates from 2000.
I regard that as a misunderstanding. Both percentages concern different subjects and are not comparable with each other.
Dat beoordeel ik als een misverstand. Beide percentages betreffen verschillende onderwerpen en zijn onderling niet vergelijkbaar.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president, de minister van Algemene Zaken over de uitspraken van theoloog en dichter Huub Oosterhuis over de inhoud van de kersttoespraak van H.M. de Koningin (ing

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Queen's 2010 Christmas speech was censored by the PVV or Geert Wilders, how much freedom of expression the Queen has, and whether a purely ceremonial monarchy would be better. The Prime Minister replied that ministerial responsibility applies to the Queen's speeches, including the personal Christmas address, and declined to disclose contacts between the Queen and the Prime Minister.
No information is given about contact between the Queen and the Prime Minister.
Over het contact tussen de Koningin en de minister-president worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Van der Ham (D66) aan de minister-president over uitspraken over het hoger onderwijs (ingezonden 17 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Prime Minister how budget cuts and quality investments in higher education relate over 2011-2015, what evidence supports claims of insufficient quality, how contact hours will increase, which red tape will be cut, and how school consolidation will be curbed. The government answered that a quality boost of 50 to 300 million euros is planned alongside cuts, that quality is largely in order but needs improvement via agreements with institutions, and described existing instruments such as a merger test law and red-tape reduction programmes.
Your House will be informed annually about the progress of these agreements.
Uw Kamer wordt jaarlijks geïnformeerd over de voortgang daarvan.
Vragen van het lid Dijkstra (D66) aan de minister-president over een uitspraak van de minister-president bij presentatie WK-bid (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An MP asks the prime minister whether he promised to meet all FIFA demands in the World Cup bid presentation, and how this squares with FIFA's demands on tax exemption, criminal immunity and labour rules. The prime minister denies saying he would meet all FIFA wishes, says he only claimed the bid meets FIFA's needs, and states he made no additional commitments beyond earlier letters to parliament.
With this statement I have made no additional commitment beyond the guarantees of the World Cup bid as set out in the letters to your House.
Ik heb met deze uitspraak geen enkele extra toezegging gedaan ten opzichte van de garanties van het WK-bid zoals vermeld in de brieven aan uw Kamer

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de ministercode en de zakelijke belangen van de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel (ingezonden 5 november 2010).

The SP MP Gesthuizen asks the prime minister whether the Minister for Immigration and Asylum breaches the ministerial code on separating business interests, since he can appoint and dismiss board members of Fiducia Trajectum, and whether he will be asked to fully distance his interests. The government, answering jointly with the minister, refers to its earlier answers to similar questions from MP Van Gent, which were already given on 5 November, rather than answering the questions again on substance.

These additional questions have crossed the answers given on 5 November of the questions on the same subject by MP Van Gent dated 4 November 2011 (Appendix to the Handelingen, session 2009–2010, no. 394).

Deze aanvullende vragen hebben de beantwoording op 5 november jl. van de vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp door het lid Van Gent d.d. 4 november 2011 (Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2009–2010, nr. 394) gekruist.
