Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de integriteitcode voor bewindspersonen (ingezonden 5 november 2010).

An MP asked how ministers' financial interests are kept from being affected by their decisions, whether those interests should be fully disclosed, which ministers hold foreign property, and whether the code's exemption for non-commercial assets still holds after the immigration minister's holiday home controversy. The Prime Minister answered that integrity is safeguarded by ministerial responsibility, parliamentary, judicial and ombudsman oversight, and privacy rights, declined to list interests per ministry or disclose how assets are managed, and confirmed that some ministers own foreign property.

Insofar as the data concern information that is not already public, it is up to the individual ministers to judge whether and to what extent they consider disclosing data consistent with the fundamental right to a private sphere of themselves and others.

Voor zover het geen gegevens betreft die niet reeds openbaar zijn, is het aan de individuele bewindspersonen om te beoordelen of en in hoeverre zij verstrekking van gegevens in overeenstemming achten met het grondrecht op een persoonlijke levenssfeer van henzelf en anderen.

Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken, over de vermeende schending van de ministerscode door de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel (ingezonden 4 november 2010).

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Minister for Immigration and Asylum violated the ministerial code by placing business interests in Bulgaria in a foundation he still effectively controls, and what the government will do about it. The government answered that the holdings are managed by a foundation run by two independent experts, that the arrangement follows a 2002 letter on responsibilities of incoming ministers, and that further distancing measures will be taken.
The minister, after consultation with the State Attorney, is taking several measures that further increase the distance.
De minister neemt na overleg met de landsadvocaat enkele maatregelen die de afstand verder vergroten.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de huur van privéjets door ministers (ingezonden 19 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether ministers facing large spending cuts should be restrained in renting private jets, whether previous ministers followed the rules requiring government or defence aircraft first and coordinator-arranged charters, and whether ministers would be reminded of the rules and asked to use scheduled flights or trains. The Prime Minister answered that the decree already implies restraint, that not all flights went through the coordinator though the decree allows exceptions under ministerial responsibility, that ministers were informed in formation documents, and that each trip requires an individual assessment including safety and time.
As the various decisions taken following the RTL Nieuws freedom-of-information request show, not all flights were chartered through the flight coordinator.
Zoals uit de verschillende besluiten die zijn genomen naar aanleiding van het Wob-verzoek van RTL Nieuws blijkt, zijn niet alle vluchten ingehuurd door tussenkomst van de vluchtcoördinator.
Vragen van het lid Van Gent (GroenLinks) aan de minister-president, minister van Algemene Zaken over de stokkende vrouwenemancipatie in Nederland (ingezonden 15 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the prime minister why the Netherlands dropped from 11th to 17th on the WEF Global Gender Gap Index, what the causes are, and what steps will restore a top-ten place. The prime minister acknowledged the decline, attributed it mainly to other countries improving and to lower political participation, and promised a plan to be sent to parliament in spring 2011, while refusing to move the emancipation portfolio to his own ministry.
About the cabinet's ambitions and how these will be further specified, your house will be informed in spring 2011.
Over de ambities van het kabinet en de wijze waarop daar nadere invulling aan zal worden geven, zal uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2011 worden geïnformeerd.
